text.Barret: Get down here, merc.

text.ACTION: Upon walking past Barret.

text.Barret: You're up.

text.ACTION: After the battle starts.
Upon entering the station.

text.Jessie: Have fun!

text.ACTION: During the battle.
Upon filling an ATB bar.
Upon using an ability.

text.Security Officer: Holy shit! He a SOLDIER operator?

text.ACTION: Upon using magic.
Upon jumping further inside.

text.Biggs: You got this!

text.Wedge: Yeah, what he said!

text.ACTION: During the battle.
Upon approaching Wedge in front of the Reactor Grounds entrance.

text.Jessie: So what's SOLDIER boy's deal? Is he one of us now? He's got balls, this, uh... Uh... what was his name again?

text.Biggs: Cloud. Cloud Strife.

text.Jessie: Right.

text.Biggs: And he isn't a SOLDIER anymore. Still, he's a professional—unlike the rest of us. I'm glad to have him.

text.Cloud: This is a onetime gig. When it's done, we're done.

text.ACTION: In the background, after the cutscene ends.

text.Biggs: Real joy to work with though.

text.Jessie: Real joy to look at too.

text.Biggs: Here we go...

text.Jessie: Looks are what people notice first.

text.Biggs: Guess I'm not on the same page as "people."

text.Jessie: I'd say you're not even reading the same book.

text.Biggs: Enough. We're done here.

text.Jessie: Or even the same—

text.Biggs: Give it a rest.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge before approaching Barret.

CHOICE.Wedge: You'll keep us safe... right, Cloud?
Wow, they've almost got the door.
We're doing this. We're really doing it. Man... I think I'm gonna be sick...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Barret.

text.Wedge: C'mon, nobody'd do something this crazy just for money. *They* may not think you're a true believer, but you know what I think?

text.Barret: Wedge!
You'd better be worth the money, merc. Every last gil.

text.ACTION: During the first battle against the Security Officer and a Guard Dog.
Upon targeting the Security Officer first.
After defeating the Guard Dog before the Security Officer.
Upon taking the treasure chest after the battle.
Upon entering the small warehouse.

text.Wedge: Hey Cloud! Elevator's over there! Catch up soon!

text.ACTION: After Jessie cuts a hole in the fence.

text.Biggs: This way!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Biggs.

text.Biggs: Not so fast. We've got company.

text.ACTION: Upon coming out of the fenced area and approaching two Security Officers.
Upon pulling down the switch.

text.Barret: You know what to do—now *go*!

text.Wedge: See you later!

text.Jessie: C'mon, Cloud!

text.Barret: Pick up the pace!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge before entering the reactor.

CHOICE.Wedge: I'll secure our escape route, okay? You go on and catch up with the others.
Keep them safe—please!
Don't worry about me. Go!

text.ACTION: Upon entering Mako Reactor 1.

text.Barret: SOLDIERs may attack on command, but I hear they make good guard dogs too. Bet you've seen a few reactors. So how do we get to the bridge above mako storage?
Ain't holding out on me, are you? Stamp scared to bite the hand that fed him? Or is he a loyal little doggie!?
Have it your way, mutt. We can do this *with* you, or we can do this *without* you.

text.Cloud: Different reactor, different layout. Depends when it was built. Never seen one like this, but I'll manage.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie before talking to Biggs.

text.Jessie: Don't you worry. Biggs'll have the door open soon.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret before talking to Biggs.

text.Barret: I'm watching you.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Biggs

text.Biggs: In three, two... Damn, I'm good!

text.Barret: W-wait!

text.ACTION: During the battle.

text.Security Officer (1): He's alone! We can take him!

text.ACTION: After the battle.

text.Jessie: We're back!
He always knows just what to say!

text.Barret: Cut it out!

text.ACTION: Upon passing Biggs before talking to Jessie.

CHOICE.Biggs: I got this place covered.
Well, what're you waiting for?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret before talking to Jessie.

text.Barret: Simmer down, hotshot.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie.

text.Jessie: It's a good thing I know someone who can get us the passcodes. Pity no one else at command will talk to us, but what can you do? And we're good!

text.Biggs: Careful in there.

text.STATUS: If Biggs was approached before talking to Jessie.

text.Biggs: Well, what're you waiting for?

text.STATUS: If Biggs was not approached before talking to Jessie.

text.Biggs: I got this place covered.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret before pressing the button to call the elevator.

text.Barret: Security's only gonna get tighter, so be ready. We can't afford any mistakes.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie before pressing the button to call the elevator.

text.Jessie: Looks like the elevator's on another floor. Mind pushing that button?

text.ACTION: Upon pressing the button to call the elevator.

text.Jessie: So... you know Tifa, right? It's not really my business, but are you guys *close*?

text.ACTION: During a flashback.

text.Tifa: Cloud! Are you ignoring me!?

text.ACTION: After the flashback ends.
In President Shinra's office.

text.Heidegger: These sewer rats appear to call themselves Avalanche, sir. We are currently investigating whether they belong to the same group that made the attempt on your life. Rest assured, our inquiries will not take much longer.

text.ACTION: In the elevator.

text.Barret: This pump's sole purpose is to drain the planet dry. While you sleep, while you eat, while you shit—it's here, sucking up mako. It doesn't rest and it doesn't care! You do realize what mako is, don't you?
Mako is the lifeblood of our world. The planet bleeds green like you and me bleed red. The hell you think's gonna happen when it's all gone, huh!? Answer me!
You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain? I know you can!
Damn straight I do!
Say that again!

text.Cloud: I'd worry less about the planet and more about the next five seconds. Save the screaming for later.

text.ACTION: After exiting the elevator.

text.Barret: Our lives are on the line now. You listening, merc? One false move... And that happens!

text.Jessie: Well, so much for having Cloud do all the fighting. There are some places a sword just can't reach... Just... bear with him for me, would you?

text.ACTION: As the battle against Sentry Rays begins.

text.Barret: Gonna throw your sword at 'em? Let the man with the gun go to work! These tin cans ain't got nothing on me!

text.ACTION: Upon using Barret's Overcharge.

text.Barret: Now for the real show!

text.ACTION: Upon destroying all three Sentry Rays and switching to Cloud.

text.Barret: Do your job, merc!

text.ACTION: Upon switching to Barret again.

text.Barret: Oh yeah? How about I aim for your head!?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Jessie downstairs.

text.Jessie: Look what we have here.
Those things'll hurt more than your pride if you're careless. They'll cut you down to size and then some. ... But I'm guessing you've done this kind of thing before.

text.Cloud: Yeah. Figure out the timing of the lasers. Then make a move when they cycle off.

text.Jessie: Exactly! I'll go first. Nothing like a little danger to get the blood pumping.
Just keep those baby blues of yours on me!

text.ACTION: Upon hitting the lasers, one of the following lines of dialogue will play depending on how many times the player has hit them. After playing all lines, one of the following will randomly play.

CHOICE.Jessie: You okay!?
Pay more attention.
Just relax.
Keep your cool.
Sorry, couldn't help myself.
You SOLDIERs sure can take a beating. Still kickin', I see.
Are you *trying* to get hit?
You sure you were a SOLDIER?
I had no idea you were such a klutz.
Um, you have a fetish or something?
There's a fine line between being daring and being dumb. Food for thought.

text.ACTION: After safely going through the first set of lasers.

text.Jessie: Huh. He's a natural!

text.ACTION: After safely going through the second set of lasers.

text.Jessie: Not too shabby.

text.ACTION: After safely going through the third set of lasers.

text.Jessie: You're doing good, SOLDIER!

text.ACTION: Upon arriving at the second staircase.

text.Jessie: Okay, let's see what's up next!

text.ACTION: Upon arriving down the second staircase.

text.Jessie: ... And it's more of the same. Come on, then.

text.ACTION: After passing through the fourth set of lasers.

text.Jessie: Pretty easy, right?

text.ACTION: After passing through the fifth set of lasers.

text.Jessie: Nice job, Cloud!

text.ACTION: After passing through the sixth set of lasers.

text.Jessie: Like a walk in the park, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the third staircase without getting hit by the lasers.

text.Jessie: Not a scratch! Now onto the objective!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the third staircase if hit by the lasers.

text.Jessie: Well, I'm glad that's over with. And we're almost at our objective.

text.ACTION: Upon arriving down the third staircase.

text.Jessie: Look. They don't call those things sweepers for nothing. They can wipe out a whole squad in seconds.

text.Cloud: Not if you wipe the floor with them first.

text.ACTION: At the start of the battle with the sweeper.

text.Barret: Hah! We can take this hunk of junk!

text.Cloud: That "hunk of junk" is a heavy weapons platform. If we rush in... we die.

text.Barret: Is that right?

text.Cloud: Need to hit it with magic. That should give us an opening.

text.ACTION: Upon pressuring the sweeper.

text.Barret: Hey! It stopped moving!

text.Cloud: Let's pin it down! Give it all you've got!

text.STATUS: If its pressure first subsides without being staggered.

text.Barret: Of course, it just had to get back up.

text.Cloud: So we knock it down again. No time to complain.

text.ACTION: Upon staggering the sweeper.

text.Barret: Don't need to tell me twice! I'm gonna enjoy this!

text.ACTION: Upon destroying the sweeper.

text.Jessie: And that's that!

text.Barret: What are you, twenty-something?
Huh?

text.Cloud: SOLDIER: First Class. Doesn't go into the twenties.

text.Barret: The hell you talking about? I mean your age, not your goddamn rank!
Though, for all I know, a SOLDIER's rank could be the same as his age... Mm-hmm. Guess that'd make you a one-year-old, huh? Live and learn!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching mako storage.

text.Jessie: That's our target. The reactor core. Gotta set the bomb at the bottom.
Let's get down there.

text.ACTION: Upon arriving down the ladder.

text.Barret: Goddamn... I can practically *taste* the mako in here... Hurry it up!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching near the end of the platform.

text.Barret: My heart's pounding like a jackhammer!
Hah! More like excited. I've been dreaming about this for years!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Jessie.

text.Jessie: Heads up, boys—the end's in sight. I leave the rest in your capable hands. Good luck!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the other ladder to the right.

text.Jessie: Not that way! Down the ladder, dummy!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie.

CHOICE.Jessie: Aw, you're choosing me over the reactor? That's sweet, but I'll wait my turn. Go blow her mind.
Go on. Shoo.

text.ACTION: Upon arriving down the stairs before the last ladder leading downwards.

text.Barret: You think, if we fell in, we'd sink right down to the bottom? To the planet's core?

text.Cloud: No, the pump would suck us back up.

text.Barret: How comforting.

text.ACTION: Upon taking the ladder down to the floor with the reactor core.

text.Barret: Yeah, let's do this... Let's do this!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the core.

text.Barret: All right. Let's see if little Stamp really *can* bite the hand that feeds...
Go on. Do the honors. Prove to me you're the man Tifa says you are. That you're one of us.

text.Cloud: Never said I was. I'm just here for the paycheck.

text.Barret: Then do the damn job!
What's wrong?

text.Cloud: I'm fine. What about the timer?

text.Barret: Your call, merc.

CHOICE.Barret: Pretty cocky, ain'tcha?
Hah! That long enough for you?

text.Barret: You double-crossing—
What in the hell!?

text.ACTION: As the battle with Scorpion Sentinel begins.

text.Barret: Hey! How the hell do we fight this thing?

text.Cloud: It's got reinforced armor plating—but the internals can be overloaded. Lightning magic.

text.Barret: No other option, huh.

text.ACTION: Sometimes during battle.

CHOICE.Cloud: Going in for the kill! Follow my lead!

text.STATUS: When Barret is targeted by Scorpion Sentinel for the first and/or second time. Either line plays.

CHOICE.Barret: Uhh, should I be worried?
Why you gotta pick on me!?

text.ACTION: Sometimes after using normal attacks with Cloud against the Scorpion Sentinel.
Sometimes after using normal attacks with Barret against the Scorpion Sentinel.

text.Barret: Damn, this thing is tough!

text.Cloud: Wouldn't be much of a weapon if it went down easy.

text.Barret: Don't compliment the giant scorpion!

text.STATUS: If Cloud's HP falls to half during the battle.
If Barret's HP falls to half during the battle.

text.Barret: Sure could use a break...

text.STATUS: If Cloud's HP is critically low.

text.Cloud: Damnit. Need to heal up soon...

text.STATUS: When both are consecutively struck by the Scorpion Sentinel's attacks.

text.ACTION: After missing multiple attacks.

text.Cloud: Gotta time our attacks just right! Hold out until you spot an opening!

text.STATUS: When Barret uses Thunder for the first time in the battle.

text.Barret: Hell yeah! You see the damage that did!?

text.STATUS: When Scorpion Sentinel sustains damage if Barret hasn't used Thunder.

text.Barret: We barely scratched the damn thing!

text.Cloud: Didn't I tell you to use magic!?

text.Barret: Thought you were full of shit.

text.Cloud: Think whatever you want—just do it!

text.STATUS: When Barret is struck by an attack such as Mark 99 Launchers.

text.Barret: Damn pain in the ass...

text.STATUS: When Cloud is bound by the Scorpion Sentinel.

text.Barret: Got anything you wanna say?
Funny way to ask for help.

text.STATUS: If Barret fails to free Cloud from being bound, leading to Cloud being thrown off onto the platform.

text.Barret: Shit. Was just about to get you out.

text.Cloud: Wasn't expecting you to do jack...

text.STATUS: If Barret is struck by Tail Swipe.

text.Barret: Pretty quick for a heap of scrap!

text.ACTION: Phase 2: When Scorpion Sentinel engages its barrier.

text.Barret: The hell is that!?

text.Cloud: A barrier? Never seen this defense system before...

text.Barret: Thought you were the expert!

text.Cloud: So what's your brilliant plan, genius?

text.ACTION: Upon first changing to Barret during this phase.

text.Barret: It's my time to shine!

text.STATUS: When Cloud attacks the Field Generator, either of the following dialogues plays.

CHOICE.Cloud: There! Attack it from the rear!

CHOICE.Barret: Aight, SOLDIER boy! Show me what you got!
Oh, *now* he remembers. Don't keep me waiting in suspense next time!

text.STATUS: If Barret uses Thunder while the Scorpion Sentinel's barrier is active.

text.Barret: Huh!? It didn't work!?

text.ACTION: Sometimes upon attacking normally with Cloud while the barrier is active, any of the following lines/dialogues may play.

CHOICE.Barret: Nice try, dumbass!
Haha! Swing and a miss!

CHOICE.Cloud: There's gotta be a weak point somewhere...

CHOICE.Barret: Then hurry the hell up and find it!

text.ACTION: Sometimes upon attacking normally with Barret while the barrier is active, any of the following lines/dialogues may play.

CHOICE.Barret: Dammit! Gotta do something about that barrier first!
Damn, this thing is tough!

CHOICE.Cloud: Wouldn't be much of a weapon if it went down easy.

CHOICE.Barret: Don't compliment the giant scorpion!
If we don't change it up soon, this thing's gonna kill us both!
How 'bout less lip from you!?

text.STATUS: If Cloud destroys the barrier.

text.Cloud: Now! Hit it hard and fast!

text.Barret: Ohhh, you're in for it now!

text.STATUS: If Barret destroys the barrier.

text.Barret: Hell yeah, baby!

text.Cloud: Now's our chance! Give it everything you've got!

text.STATUS: If the Scorpion Sentinel sets up another barrier.

CHOICE.Barret: Enough with the barriers!

text.ACTION: Phase 3: When Scorpion Sentinel engages its Tail Laser.

text.Cloud: Watch the tail! You don't want to get hit by that laser!

text.Barret: Huh!? So, whadda we do!?

text.Cloud: Don't get hit! Take cover behind that debris.

text.ACTION: Sometimes after the Scorpion Sentinel's finishes a Tail Laser attack, any of the following lines/dialogues may play.

CHOICE.Barret: Now! Get in there and do some damage!
It's wide open! Gonna light it up!

text.STATUS: When it uses Tail Laser again, any of the following dialogues may play.

CHOICE.Barret: I see it!
There really no other option?

CHOICE.Cloud: Wanna get shot? Be my guest!

CHOICE.Barret: Hey, it's doing that thing again!
Again and again and again!
Getting tired of that laser!

CHOICE.Cloud: Mechs don't get tired. Or complain.

CHOICE.Barret: And you're getting tired of my complaining, huh? Solid copy!

text.ACTION: Phase 4: When Scorpion Sentinel first activates its Auto-Repair.

text.Barret: Aw, hell, what's it doing now!?

text.Cloud: An auto-repair unit? Dammit—we gotta take it out quick or we're screwed!

text.Barret: Oh, I am way ahead of you, merc!

text.ACTION: Sometimes during this phase, any of the following lines/dialogues may play.

CHOICE.Barret: When I get my chance, I'm gonna blow this bastard the hell up! And that's a promise!
I ain't about to quit after coming this far!
Firing everything!
Hey, you still with me!? We better bring the heat—and quick!

text.ACTION: Upon crippling one leg, any of the following lines/dialogues plays.

CHOICE.Cloud: It's down! Rain hell on it!

CHOICE.Barret: Ain't gotta tell me twice!
Hey! Follow my lead!

CHOICE.Cloud: No time to waste—let's take it out quick!

CHOICE.Barret: Oh, I got your leg! You ain't going nowhere now!

text.ACTION: Upon crippling another leg, any of the following lines/dialogues plays.

CHOICE.Cloud: There goes another! Now's our chance to do some real damage!

CHOICE.Barret: And down goes another! Ohh, you're in for it now!

CHOICE.Cloud: It's not gonna go down easy! Focus!

CHOICE.Barret: *You* focus, SOLDIER boy! You ain't gotta worry 'bout me missing *my* shot!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the Scorpion Sentinel.

text.Barret: Shit! The bomb!

CHOICE.STATUS: If the bomb timer was set to twenty minutes.
If the bomb timer was set to thirty minutes.

text.Barret: Hah, you hear that? Damn thing showed you how it's done!
Wedge should be covering our way out! Go, go, go!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Jessie.

text.Jessie: Do I look okay!? Help a girl out, would ya!?
My hero!

text.Barret: Hey! We'll link up over there! Look after Jessie!

text.Jessie: Come this way! This route should lead us straight to Barret! Probably!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bottom of the ladder.

text.Jessie: I think I see an exit. Come on!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bottom of another ladder.

text.Jessie: Don't look back! Let's go, let's go, let's go!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bottom of a third ladder.

text.Jessie: We're running out of time!

text.Cloud: Shut up and climb. You're not helping.

text.Jessie: Sorry, it just— It keeps me focused! I'll freak out if I don't talk!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the topmost platform.

text.Jessie: Barret—

text.Barret: I've got you covered. Find us a way outta here!

text.Jessie: But then—

text.Barret: Don't worry, I'll be fine. I've got SOLDIER boy with me!

text.ACTION: During the battle.

text.Barret: We don't have time for this shit! The clock's ticking!

text.Cloud: Cool it. Five seconds is all we need.

text.STATUS: If Cloud's HP falls to critical in any battle during the quest.

text.Barret: You don't look so good. Take care of those wounds before you bleed out.

text.ACTION: After the battle.

text.Barret: Let's go! The others are waiting! Gotta get the hell outta here ASAP...

text.ACTION: Upon encountering another sweeper in battle.

text.Barret: Ugh! This is all we need!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering a group of Monodrives after climbing the staircase.

text.Barret: Heads up! We got a whole lotta company!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering a Shock Trooper.

text.Barret: Whoa! Ain't you a feisty one!

text.Cloud: Like a rook seeing his first action...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the elevator, cut to President Shinra's office.

text.Heidegger: Sir.

text.ACTION: After cutting back to the elevator.

text.Barret: Come on... come on, come on, come on!

text.Jessie: Door's open!

text.Barret: Bada-bing bada-boom—bam!

text.Jessie: We don't have a lot of time here! Pick up the pace, people!

text.ACTION: Upon leaving Mako Reactor 1.

text.Wedge: Over here! This way!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Jessie.

text.Jessie: If I couldn't, believe me, you'd be the first to know.

text.Cloud: I'll take that as a yes.

text.Jessie: Cloud!
Okay, *that* was pretty cool.
All right. Come on!

text.Barret: Looks like we made it. And with nothing but a few scratches to show—
Think you might've overdone it?

text.Jessie: I followed the instructions to the letter. Maybe it triggered a reaction with the mako?

text.Barret: Well, let's hope this city's still in one piece.

text.Biggs: But the planet's what matters, right?
I mean... this must've helped *some*.

text.Jessie: After all that, it better have. Anyway, let's get going. We in Sector 8?

text.Wedge: That'd be just down there!

text.Barret: All right, then. Lead the way.

text.Wedge: You got it!

text.ACTION: After the first cutscene, while walking through as Cloud.

text.Wedge: Watch out for live wires. They're everywhere.

text.Biggs: Ugh, the air in here reeks. Can't wait to get out in the open!
Man, what *is* that? I've never smelled anything so foul. (sniffs) Aw, it's me. Gotta do something about that, and soon.

text.ACTION: After rubble falls near the end of the first hallway.

text.Wedge: I felt that one in my guts...

text.Biggs: They just keep on coming.

text.Barret: We need to get out of this place.

text.Jessie: Was it the mako density? The primary explosive? The blasting agent?

text.Biggs: Hey, we can figure that out later.

text.Wedge: Ugh. I'm running on empty here...

text.Barret: You can refuel at the base.

text.Wedge: Next time, I'll have to bring a little pick-me-up.

text.ACTION: Before the second hallway.

text.Jessie: How much farther do we have to go?

text.Wedge: Not far!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the second hallway.

text.Wedge: That's about as good a place as any.

text.Jessie: Stand back then. I'll set the bomb.

text.Barret: Can't wait to see you, Marlene.

text.Biggs: Can't wait to take a hot shower.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the end of the second hallway.

text.Jessie: She's good to go.
Fire in the hole!

text.Biggs: You sure told those doors.

text.Jessie: Let that be a lesson to anything that gets in my way!

text.ACTION: Upon exiting the Plate Partition - Interior onto the Business District.

text.Announcement: Attention all citizens. Attention all citizens. This is an alert from the Shinra Emergency Operations Center. Unidentified intruders have detonated a bomb inside Mako Reactor 1. Multiple explosions have been confirmed, as well as ongoing fires. In response, a disaster warning has been issued in Sectors 1 and 8. Structures in the area are at high risk of collapse, rendering the entire sector hazardous.

text.Jessie: No... No way.

text.Biggs: This couldn't have been us... could it?

text.Wedge: But what if it was... ?

text.Barret: Merc's right. It ain't pretty, but we can't stop now. This was just the first reactor. And the planet won't be safe till we get the rest.

text.Biggs: Yeah... We always knew this was gonna get messy.

text.Wedge: And this is only the beginning...

text.Barret: Y'all gotta look at the bigger picture here. Nothing worth fighting for was ever won without sacrifice. Though you may not be crying out, I know you're in pain—just like the planet. But it's okay, 'cause I'm here for you! To help take the load off your shoulders!
Your fears... Your worries... Your concerns... And yes, your fees... Whatever your problem, I got you.

text.Biggs: So, what's our next move, boss?

text.Barret: That's easy enough! We get our asses home!

text.ACTION: Upon running up the staircase.

text.Barret: We'll split up and shoot for the last train home. Regroup in the freight car. Got it?

text.Wedge: Later then!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Barret.

text.Cloud: Hey. I'd like my money now.

text.Barret: You can have it—once we're *back at base*.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bottom of the staircase.

text.Jessie: Yoo-hoo.
I don't need to tell you what this is, right?

text.Cloud: Of course not. It's healing materia.

text.Jessie: You can have it. For saving my life.

text.Cloud: Just doing my job. Nothing more.

text.Jessie: Yeah, yeah... Fact is, I'm lucky you were there.

text.Cloud: Survival can be a matter of luck or skill. And you can't rely on luck.

text.Jessie: Words to live by!
You do know how to use it, right?

text.Cloud: You do know what I was, right?

text.ACTION: After the materia tutorial is viewed or skipped.

text.Jessie: Okay! I was only trying to help.

text.STATUS: If the bomb timer was set to 20 minutes.

text.Jessie: Oh—before I forget, here's a little something extra, for being so brave. That really was the ride of a lifetime... Well, see you on the train!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Jessie at the end of the street if Cloud did not wait for too long.

text.Jessie: Cloud! Up here! Look up! I said look *up*!

text.STATUS: If Cloud does not look up at Jessie.

text.Jessie: I said look *up*!

text.STATUS: If Cloud does not look up at Jessie again.

text.Jessie: I give up. If you ever get up here, just be careful you don't fall, okay?

text.ACTION: Upon aiming the camera toward Jessie.

text.Jessie: Careful up here! This could collapse at any moment! If you want up, you'll have to use those stairs!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the main in front of the staircase.

CHOICE.Topside Resident (Male 1): The stairs are right there if you wanna try crossing the rubble.
If you really want to get to the station, you can always climb those stairs. Try picking your way across the rubble...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the station.
After rubble falls.
Upon reaching Sephiroth.

text.Sephiroth: I am?

text.Cloud: I killed you with my own—

text.Sephiroth: Oh, you need not remind me. It was the crowning moment of our time together. But that was then, and this is now. I have a favor to ask.
Our beloved planet is dying. Slowly. Silently. Painfully. Can you bear to see the planet suffer... Cloud?
Were the planet to die, so many things would be lost. Your hometown that burns so bright... The sound of her voice pleading for me to spare you. The shiver of her flesh yielding to cold steel.
That which binds us together would be no more. And I would be loath to live in such a world. Which is why I must ask you this one favor. Don't worry. It's a simple thing.
Run, Cloud... Run away. You have to leave... You have to live.
Good, Cloud. Very good. Hold on to that hatred.

text.Cloud: I'm seeing things. Fumes from all the mako, maybe. All right. You got this.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the rubble.

CHOICE.Cloud: All right. Need to find another route.
Better hurry. Don't have much time.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the couple in the alleyway.

CHOICE.Topside Resident (1): Shooting for the station? Take the alley and climb up to the roof of that building at the end and you're practically there.

CHOICE.Topside Resident (2): If you make it that far...
Sure, we could try the alley, but is getting to the station really worth breaking our necks over?

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the ladder, after the camera pans over to the reactor ruins.
Upon talking to the man at the end of the roof.

CHOICE.Topside Resident (Male 2): The station? Well, take that fire escape. It'll put you right on the street.
Once you're on the street, you'll want to head for the plaza with the fountain. Station's not too far.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Loveless Street.
Upon attempting to go down the barricade street near Loveless Street.

CHOICE.Cloud: No need to make it harder for yourself.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the end of Loveless Street.

text.Sephiroth: You are too weak to save anyone. Not even yourself.

text.Aerith: Are you okay!?
Hey... Are you okay?
Here. This is for you.
That's right. It's a gift. You know, for scaring those things away.
Never mind. Think of it as a memento.
I heard that, you know.

CHOICE.Aerith: Well, that depends on the customer. In your case... It's on the house.
Oh, don't be like that. I know you want one. When was the last time you saw a real flower, huh? Plus, it'll make your girlfriend's day. I guarantee it.
Well, that depends on the customer. In your case... It's on the house.

CHOICE.Cloud: Enough already. I'll give you two gil for it.

CHOICE.Aerith: Two measly gil!? For a real flower? Come on.
Please, that's not nearly enough. Besides, I clearly said it was on the—
You're trying to get rid of me! For five lousy gil! Sorry, but your plan won't work.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Fine, I'll take it.", the dialogue options conclude.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Aerith: Lovers used to give these when they were reunited...

text.Cloud: Look, I'm involved in things. Dangerous things.

text.Aerith: Oh, I'm sure you are. So?
Wait—you think someone's out to get you? Is that what you're all worked up about? Relax. No one's going to attack you. I promise.

text.Cloud: Hey, a mako reactor just blew. You shouldn't be out here trying to sell fl—

text.Aerith: Help me!
What are they?
You know—you're right!
Nice meeting you!

text.Security Officer: Sword on the ground! Right now!

text.ACTION: Upon heading to the alley.

CHOICE.Captain: That bastard couldn't have gotten far. Stay alert!

CHOICE.Cloud: Gonna have to find a way around.

CHOICE.Captain: The suspect is armed and dangerous. Be on your guard!

CHOICE.Cloud: So much for the direct route.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the Security Officers past the barricades on Loveless Street.
Upon encountering the Security Officer near the end of Loveless Street.
Upon encountering the Security Officers at the end of Loveless Street.

text.Security Officer (1): There he is! You're not going anywhere!

text.Security Officer (2): HQ, this is Sector 8 Unit 4. We have eyes on the target! We need backup! I repeat: this is 8-4 requesting immediate backup!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Security Officer with two Guard Dogs near the alleyway on the way to the fountain.
Upon beginning the battle at the fountain.
Throughout the battle while defeating enemies.

text.Security Officer (3): Box him in! Box him in!

text.Shinra Helicopter: Target sighted. I repeat, target sighted.
Shock troopers, prep for immediate deployment!
Be advised—target is headed for the station!
Enemy combatant—you are surrounded! Lay down your weapon and surrender!
Ground forces engaging target in fountain plaza! All nearby units converge and provide immediate support!
Requesting immediate reinforcements at fountain plaza!

text.ACTION: After the battle at the fountain ends.

text.Shinra Helicopter: Target still mobile! Support, proceed to rally point at the station.

text.Cloud: So much for the direct route. Find another way... Use the rooftops, maybe...

text.ACTION: While searching for the ladder.

text.Security Officer: Don't let him get away, no matter what!

text.ACTION: While running away from the ladder.
While climbing the ladder.
After climbing the first ladder.
While running across the rooftops.

text.Shinra Helicopter: Be advised—target approaching residential area. Seal all access immediately!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the end of the rooftops.
Upon reaching the Residential Area.
Upon engaging the first group of Security Officers in the Residential Area.
Upon engaging the second group of Security Officers.
While moving down the street.

text.Shinra Helicopter: Full lockdown is in effect! All units—

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the third group of Security Officers.

text.Security Officer (1): I have eyes on the target.

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the fourth group of Security Officers.
Upon engaging the fifth group of Security Officers.
While moving down the street.

text.Shinra Helicopter: Enemy combatant—you have been warned! Surrender yourself to Public Security immediately!

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the sixth group of Security Officers.
Upon reaching the end of the road.
After defeating all enemies.

text.Security Officer (3): HQ, this is Sector 8 Unit 2. Target is surrounded. Moving to secure.

text.Wedge: Guess Cloud won't be joining us after all...

text.Biggs: No need to assume the worst. I'm sure he's fine. You saw him in action, didn't you? Guy's a SOLDIER. Goddamn one-man army.

text.Jessie: Mmm, you think he's a keeper?

text.Barret: On my go.
Ugh, you had me worried for a minute...
What the hell you been up to? Huh!?

text.Cloud: Giving Public Security the runaround, that's what. Had to draw them away from the station somehow.

text.Jessie: Nicely done.

text.Biggs: Well—can't argue with the results, huh?

text.Cloud: Wait. Got a question for you all.

text.Barret: What?

text.Cloud: Ever been attacked by an invisible enemy?
Wearing robes. Came and went like the wind.

text.Biggs: Thought they were invisible.

text.Cloud: They were—at first. Only saw them after she grabbed me...

text.Jessie: A new Shinra weapon, maybe?

text.Barret: Hah! More like a panic-induced hallucination!

text.Cloud: Never mind. Forget I said anything.

text.Barret: Suit yourself. C'mon, let's move up.

text.ACTION: While walking through the train.

text.Wedge: Lotta people here.

text.Jessie: And in the freight car, too...

text.Biggs: 'Cause of the evacuation order, maybe?

text.Barret: Lucky us. We've got a crowd to hide in. Head for the front of the train and hold there.

text.Announcer (Train): Due to an explosion at Mako Reactor 1, an emergency schedule is now in effect. Your understanding and cooperation is appreciated.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Wedge.

text.Wedge: Ugh, so cramped...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge.

text.Wedge: Man, everyone's on edge.
Hey, Cloud, I... um...
Yeesh... You don't make it easy...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching to Biggs.

text.Biggs: Hey, got a sec?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Biggs.

text.Biggs: You're uh... holding up pretty well, huh? Even after what we saw at the station and all over Sector 8?
Well... my hands are still shaking.
Something to look forward to... Or maybe not.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Jessie.

text.Jessie: Little help, Cloud? Please?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie.

text.Jessie: I can't stop thinking about it. The bomb I made shouldn't have produced an explosion that big. It doesn't make any sense...

text.Cloud: The explosion triggered a reaction with the mako. You said so yourself.

text.Jessie: That was my first guess—but shouldn't a reactor have fail—safes to prevent that kinda thing? You mentioned "invisible enemies" back there, right?
Hmm... No. I'm just looking for excuses for something that was clearly my own fault. Gotta own up to it if I'm gonna learn from this and move on. Thanks, Cloud. You're a good listener.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the train cart with Barret.

text.Shinra Employee (train 1): What kind of maniacs would go so far as to bomb a reactor?

text.Shinra Middle Manager: They've yet to announce it publicly, but I heard it was Avalanche's doing.

text.Shinra Employee (train 1): Really? Aren't they the terrorists who tried to kill the president?

text.Shinra Employee (train 2): Is there nothing they won't do?

text.Barret: Hey! Quit talking out your ass. Everyone knows Avalanche only cares about saving the planet.

text.Shinra Middle Manager: J-just who do you think you are?

text.Barret: A law-abiding concerned citizen.
In my humble opinion, that explosion was a message—a message to the bastards bleeding our planet dry. Think they got it? Heard it loud and clear? Y'all's masters?

text.Shinra Middle Manager: We will not submit to intimidation or violence! But work together for peace and prosperity! That is how civilized people change the world!

text.Barret: Hmph. Them's fighting words.

text.Shinra Middle Manager: It's what we believe. We all have to follow our conscience, don't we?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Biggs.

CHOICE.Biggs: Well, I get it if you can't relate...
Shower might help. A long, hot one...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge.

CHOICE.Wedge: They'd probably kill us if they knew we were the ones responsible...
No-don't think about it.

text.ACTION: Upon trying to head back to the freight.

CHOICE.Wedge: You got somewhere you need to be?

CHOICE.Biggs: Don't wander off, huh?

CHOICE.Barret: Quit acting like a damn kid. I ain't in the mood.

CHOICE.Jessie: Cloud! Over here.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret.

CHOICE.Barret: You hear that suit? Shinra creed my ass.
We're the good guys, damnit...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie.

text.Jessie: Let's get this out of the way... Personally, I find visual aids make the dull stuff a lot more bearable. If it helps, think of it as an initiation rite.

text.Cloud: How many times do I have to tell you people. I'm not—

text.Jessie: Shh. There's such a thing as playing too hard to get.

So, here we've got a wireframe model of the great city of Midgar. Complete with massive steel plates suspended three hundred meters above ground level... Atop which stands a shining beacon of civilization. The whole system is sustained by the mako reactors, which feed the insatiable appetites of the public.

text.Announcement: The train will be passing through an ID checkpoint shortly.

text.Jessie: This here is the train's route. As you can see, it'll take us around this main pillar. Look—we're about halfway through it now. They've set up a checkpoint here to scan the IDs of all passengers heading in and out. Date of birth, residential status, criminal history... All that and more is automatically cross-referenced in their databases. Public Security wouldn't have it any other way. Heads up.
Don't worry. Our IDs are impeccable.
What'd I tell you? Have a little faith.
Won't be long till we reach the bottom. Relax.

text.Barret: Take a good look. It's because of that great big pizza in the sky that people down there gotta struggle to survive. Shinra sucks up mako while the soil turns to dust, the air fills with smog, and the flowers die.

text.Cloud: Then leave and don't look back. That's what's always worked for me.

text.Barret: Hmph! Well, that's all well and good if you're only out for yourself. But the folks down there don't have the luxury of choice, you know?

text.Cloud: Like this train, I suppose... There's only one way it can go...

text.Barret: Hot damn, we are good!

text.Jessie: Woohoo!

text.Biggs: Yes!

text.Wedge: Bombs detonated: one. Members lost: zero!

text.Biggs: And one step closer to a brighter future!

text.Jessie: Hell yeah!

text.Barret: Guys! Lower your voices, huh? People are listening.
Now get some R&R. You've earned it. Just be ready for the next mission, alright?
See you soon. At Seventh Heaven? You know, where Tifa works? Don't keep her waiting. She'll worry.

text.ACTION: After the scene ends.

text.Barret: Not long now, honey! (laughs) Daddy's almost home!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Pillar Plaza.

text.Undercity Resident (Posters): Hah. "Mako is the lifeblood of the planet"? The hell it is. Goddamn eco-warriors with their dumbass posters. I tear 'em down and they're back up inside of an hour. Like I've got nothing better to do...
I mean, look at all that steelwork... You're trying to tell me that's not progress?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Biggs, Wedge, and Jessie.

text.Biggs: That hot shower can't come soon enough. I can barely tell my skin from all the ash and sweat.

text.Wedge: When I get back, it's refuelin' time.

text.Biggs: And you, Jessie?

text.Jessie: I dunno. Figure out how I screwed up?

text.Biggs: Hah! You're such a kidder.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Shinra soldiers at the Pillar Plaza fence gate.

text.New Recruit: Um, excuse me. Due to an emergency, entry into this area is prohibited. Sorry for the inconvenience.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the two again.

text.New Recruit: In accordance with emergency regulations, entry into this area is prohibited. Please, leave at once!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the two again.

text.New Recruit: This area's off-limits! Turn around and leave at once! If you don't, I'll have no choice but to use force!

text.Senior Officer: *Now* you're gettin' the hang of it!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Residential Area.
Upon passing a TV screen.

text.Announcer (TV): Once again, relief supplies are currently being distributed in the lobby of the Shinra Building. Doctors are also stationed at the building's disaster relief center. If you are unable to reach the building on your own, please contact the nearest Shinra employee for assistance. Mayor Domino, in conjunction with President Shinra, has declared a state of emergency in Midgar. The administration have issued assurances that they are doing everything they can that they are doing everything in their power to provide aid to those most in need. As yet, no group has claimed responsibility for the attack, but security services are doing everything they can to identify those involved. If you have any information pertaining to the identity of the perpetrators, please contact your nearest Public Security officer or Security Headquarters.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa in front of Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: Marlene!

text.Barret: That's right angel, I am! (laughs)

text.Tifa: Welcome back!

text.Barret: Have you been a good girl?
Oh you did, did you? Well, well... (laughs)

text.Tifa: You made it.
Where'd you get that? I can't remember the last time I saw a real one.
How sweet. When did *you* get so thoughtful?

text.Cloud: A guy can change. *Has* been five years.

text.Tifa: Huh?

text.Cloud: I need to talk to Barret.

text.Tifa: Right. Come on in.

text.Marlene: Daddy, the mako place blew up. Everyone on TV's talking about it.

text.Barret: Don't you worry about all that silliness. Daddy's here, and he's not going anywhere tonight. Now turn that thing off and let's get you to bed, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Tifa.

text.Tifa: Do you mind keeping Marlene company until I'm done with this?
Yeah, you.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret.

text.Barret: Yeah, yeah, your money. Ask Tifa. She takes care of all that.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marlene.

text.Barret: Hey! The hell you think you're doing scaring my daughter like that!?

text.Marlene: Daddy says never talk to strangers.

text.Barret: That's right, honey, I do say that. What a good girl you are, remembering Daddy's lessons. You know what else good girls do? They go to bed on time. C'mon.

text.Marlene: But I'm not tired! I wanna talk some more, Daddy...

text.Barret: Mmm... Alright—but just this once!

text.Tifa: So, then! What can I get you?

text.Cloud: My money. I'm still waiting on it.

text.Tifa: Ah... Right... About that... We should talk. Outside.

text.Marlene: Um, Daddy... did the people who died all return to the planet?

text.Barret: Of course.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret.

text.Barret: Let that be a lesson to you.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret again.

text.Barret: When you wanna talk to a little kid, don't go giving her the professional-killer eyes.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa outside Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: Before we get onto money... There's an empty apartment in a place just down the road. It's nothing fancy, but... I was thinking you could stay there for now. The landlady's a big friend of the cause, so you wouldn't even have to pay rent! Sound good?
Follow me then!

text.ACTION: While following Tifa to Stargazer Heights.

text.Tifa: How was it up on the plate?
Sorry for dragging you into all this. It was wrong of me to put you in danger like that. I promise I won't do it again.

text.Cloud: Danger's part of the job. Don't worry about me.

text.Tifa: I'll try not to.

text.Cloud: Always happy to help stick it to Shinra.

text.Tifa: So, you make nice with everyone?

text.Cloud: Much as I could, all things considered. Maybe not enough for them.

text.Tifa: Good. You had me worried. You're not exactly a people person.
I saw Sector 8 on the news... It was like a war zone...

text.Cloud: The news is just another Shinra mouthpiece. They'll spread whatever lies Shinra tells 'em to.

text.Tifa: So... it wasn't that bad?
Oh. Right.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Stargazer Heights.

text.Tifa: And here we are. Good ol' Stargazer Heights. You're on the second floor.

text.ACTION: Upon walking away from Stargazer Heights.

CHOICE.Tifa: Do you need some alone time or something?
Hey, Cloud! This way!
Stick with me for now. I'll give you the grand tour later.
It's not my fault if you get lost.
Cloud—come on!
Uh... that's not the way.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the second floor of Stargazer Heights.

text.Tifa: Room 201 here is where I sleep. Don't have time for much else, what with Seventh Heaven and all. Not even time to decorate.
Here's your room—202. Don't worry, I already told the landlady about you.
Yes? Ohhh, I mean I told her I had a friend looking for a place to stay. Was that too much?
That one's, uh... Know what, it's getting late. I'll introduce you tomorrow.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to interact with room 201.

text.Cloud: Wait a minute. That's Tifa's room. Don't be weird.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to inteact with room 203.

text.Cloud: What are you doing? You've never even meet this person.

text.ACTION: Upon entering room 202.

text.Tifa: It's a little bare, but should be enough to get you through the night. If you want anything else, we can always get it—

text.Cloud: There is one thing. My money. You guys owe me two thousand, remember?

text.Tifa: I do, and we'd love to settle up, especially since this was your first job for us, but...
Sorry. We spent the rest preparing for the mission. That really is it. But not for long! I'm collecting money for filters tomorrow, so I can pay you after.
Of course... as long as you help, that is. Wait... Then I'd have to pay you for that too. Never mind.

text.Cloud: No, two thousand's enough. That's what we agreed on, so that'll be the price. With what you gave me, that leaves fifteen hundred.

text.Tifa: You're the best! I'll see you bright and early at the bar, then. Thanks again for everything. Sleep tight!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching room 201.

text.Cloud: What, you gonna wake her up?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching room 203.

text.Tifa: Cloud! Stop!

What are you doing to Marco? This is his apartment. He's got a few problems, but he's not a bad guy. The landlady asked me to check on him now and then to make sure he's okay. Can I ask you to do the same?

text.ACTION: Upon exiting Stargazer Heights.

text.Marle: Well, now. You must be Cloud. I'm Marle, your landlady. So how'd you like the place? You from up on high?
I'll bet. No matter. All kinds come through with all kinds of reasons. If you ever need an ear to bend, I'll lend you mine. Can be about anything—even Tifa.
The granddaughter I never had. And if you hurt her, I'll take it out of your hide. You hear me?
Good! Now you'd best get a move on to Seventh Heaven! She's got a head start on you and then some.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle.

CHOICE.Marle: You know Tifa's probably wondering why you haven't joined her yet.
Come on, quit lollygagging and go to Seventh Heaven already!
Is your face always that pale? You're not getting enough sleep!

text.ACTION: Upon entering Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: Morning!
Just so you know, Marlene's still asleep.

Let's get down to business, shall we? These water filters won't replace themselves. Although, the next batch probably *could*, if Jessie put her mind to it. Most every home in the area has one. Folks love 'em 'cause they practically eliminate the rotten-egg smell. Honestly, they make us more money than this place. And it's easy money too. We bring new filters, collect the old ones, and get paid.
What?

text.Cloud: Gimme a break. I'm not a salesman. I'm a SOLDIER.

text.Tifa: Which is why no one will refuse to pay. What do you say? Please?
Great. And while we're at it, I'll give you the grand tour.

text.ACTION: Upon walking outside Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: Go ahead and keep whatever we collect. Seeing as you didn't bring any luggage, I'm guessing there's stuff you need to buy.
And don't worry. We'll pay you the difference after. Barret's out making his rounds too.

text.Cloud: As long as I get it all today.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Item Store.

text.Tifa: Hey, there. Here to change out your water filter.

text.Item Store Owner: Tifa baby, how you doing? Been waiting for you to—Wait. Who's he?

text.Tifa: Cloud's in charge of collections. He'll take your money.

text.Item Store Owner: Sounds like a pretty sweet gig! If you ever need someone to fill in, I'm your man.

text.Tifa: Cloud! Uh... since we're here, maybe we should do a little shopping?

text.Cloud: Suppose I could take a look.

text.ACTION: After closing the shop menu.

text.Item Store Owner: Thanks! If you're ever in the market for anything else, drop on by. Especially if Tifa's with you.

text.Tifa: We'll see you around, okay? And let us know when your filter next needs changing!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the item store owner.

CHOICE.Item Store Owner: What's a girl like Tifa doing running around with a guy like...
What you see is what we got.
Take a look around if you want.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the store.

text.Tifa: He's a regular. Stock up here and he might throw in a freebie or two.
Well... You could try being a little nicer.

text.Cloud: To get free shit? Not my style.

text.Tifa: Our next stop is Stargazer Heights. Landlady's a client.
Then you know what to expect. Remember: she's a good friend of Avalanche, so be nice. Please.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Marle.

text.Tifa: Hey, Marle! Got some filters for you.

text.Marle: Tifa! My dear, dear girl! ... Oh. What's he doing here?

text.Tifa: Be nice! Cloud's helping me with collections.

text.Marle: You'd better take care of her!

text.Tifa: I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know.

text.Marle: That I do. Still, better him than you. No charm, no wit. Big sword... but no skills.

text.Tifa: Be nice!

text.Marle: You're looking awfully glum. Are you getting enough sleep? A good long rest'll cure anything, I tell you.

text.Tifa: A tried-and-true lesson for life on the ground floor, am I right?

text.Marle: That you are. Now—your money.

text.Tifa: Thanks, Marle. You take care of yourself.

text.Marle: Don't do anything I wouldn't do!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle after the conversation.

CHOICE.Marle: You'd better not cause Tifa any heartache!
You'd have more color in your cheeks if you went to bed earlier!
Don't you still have work to do? Well, go on, then—get back to it!

text.ACTION: Upon leaving towards the Beginner's Hall.

text.Tifa: Marle's great. She helped get me set up back in the day.

text.Cloud: You... been here a while now?

text.Tifa: Five years, give or take... But never mind that! We've gotta get you your money! Last stop is the weapon store.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Weapons Vendor.

text.Weapons Vendor: Hey! That last filter didn't do shit!

text.Tifa: We're so sorry about that. Hopefully this one will work better...

text.Weapons Vendor: Save your excuses and get out!

text.Tifa: All right. If you could just settle your bill, we'll be on our way.

text.Weapons Vendor: The hell? You charging me for your busted-ass goods?

text.Tifa: My associate handles payment disputes...

text.Weapons Vendor: Think you can mosey up in here and have it your way?

text.Tifa: Thank you very much!
Seeing as we're done with our rounds, and you've got a small fortune now, why not take a gander at the weapons?

text.Cloud: Well... when will Barret be back with the rest?

text.Tifa: Before we open up tonight. It'll be a while yet, so... what do you wanna do?
In that case, I've got a suggestion. Wanna hear it? If you're serious about becoming a merc, then you're going to need to start making connections. "It's not what you know, but who you know," y'know?

text.Cloud: Hmph. Another lesson for life on the ground floor?

text.Tifa: Yep. Connections get you jobs, jobs build your rep, and more rep gets you better connections...
Hmm... why not help out the neighborhood watch? They're mostly volunteers, but you'll get to know people.
Didn't see anybody at the office, so let's head up top.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Weapons Vendor.

text.Weapons Vendor: Huh? I ain't got nothing for a punk-ass bitch like you! Get on outta here!

text.LOCATION: A Job for the Neighborhood Watch

text.ACTION: Upon entering the room on the second floor of the Beginner's Hall.

text.Tifa: Huh, didn't know you were holding down the fort.

text.Wedge: Oh, hey, Cloud. Looking to join the neighborhood watch?

text.Cloud: That depends. What does this neighborhood watch do?

text.Biggs: Umm... lots of stuff, really. But our top priority is taking care of any beasts that wander into town. That, and teaching the locals how to defend themselves.

text.Wedge: Like they say: "The only one who'll look out for you is you."

text.Tifa: Cloud's a great fighter, but only we know that. If no one knows him, no one'll hire him. Thought if he joined the watch, he could get his name out there.

text.Wedge: That would work for everybody!

text.Biggs: Truth be told, we could really use your help. We can't pay you in girl, but we'll work something out. For example... Aha, what about your sword? I could mod it for you.

text.Cloud: No thanks. It's fine just the way it is.

text.Biggs: You some kind of a purist? I know *I'd* never pass up a chance to improve my gear. C'mon... at least let me show you how it's done.

text.ACTION: After closing or skipping the weapon upgrade tutorial.

text.Biggs: All set? Needless to say, you'll have to try it out to appreciate the difference.
We'll do you one better—spread the word to everyone who'll listen about the new merc in town.

text.Tifa: Between him and Wedge, there isn't anyone they don't know.

text.Wedge: I'll march through the streets singing your praises—even on an empty stomach!

text.Biggs: Scrap Boulevard. Good hunting.

text.Tifa: Hey, Cloud. I'll come with.
But... you don't know the way, do you?
Sure thing. I know these streets better than anyone.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Biggs.

CHOICE.Biggs: Just so you know, the watch relies on residents' donations for funding.
This isn't just a cover—we really do wanna keep the neighborhood safe. We grew up here, after all.
Lemme have a look at your sword when you get back, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge.

CHOICE.Wedge: Won't be anyone who doesn't know about the new merc when we're through!
Working for the neighborhood watch is the best kind of cover.
You can go all over town, meet all kinds of people, and no one bats an eye.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the room towards Scrap Boulevard.

text.Tifa: Scrap Boulevard is out west. Past the barricades supposed to keep the monsters out. Anyway, we should prepare, just in case.

text.ACTION: Upon entering Scrap Boulevard.

text.Tifa: Here's Scrap Boulevard.

text.Cloud: I can see why monsters'd feel right at home.

text.Tifa: Hm. And the more we pile up, the more they show up.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching a group of monsters.

text.Tifa: And there's our first challenger! Show me what you got, Cloud!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the first group.

text.Tifa: Wow... So that's what a SOLDIER looks line in action.
I'll bet. Let's keep at it!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating a third group of monsters.

text.Tifa: You're good at this! Charging in like it was nothing...

text.Cloud: You too. It's a little surprising.

text.Tifa: Well, I've been here five years now. "If you don't look out for yourself, no one else will." By the way—that one's gonna be on the test.
Gotta learn if you're gonna stick around. Okay, let's wrap this up...

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the final group.

text.Tifa: Alright. I think that might be the last of them.

text.Cloud: They won't stay gone for long...

text.Tifa: Of course not. Even so, folks'll be grateful for the peace and quiet in the meantime. A win's a win, you know?
Trust me—it'll do wonders for your rep. Right, let's go check in with Biggs and Wedge.

text.ACTION: Upon walking past Katie before talking to her.

CHOICE.Katie: Got new numbers for monsters slain this month! Check 'em out!
The tally of monsters slain has been updated!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Katie.

text.Katie: It's you! You're the merc everybody's talking about, am I right?

I *knew* it! So, the board here tracks how many monsters folks've taken down, right? A bigger number means a safer town—and who wouldn't want that? Just between you and me, though—they're pretty much all *your* kills. Cool, huh? Anyway, keep up the good work! We'll try to make it worth your while.

text.ACTION: Upon walking past Katie after talking to her while numbers are lower.

text.Katie: C'mon you guys! Let's get these numbers up!

text.ACTION: Upon walking past Katie while numbers are higher.

CHOICE.Katie: Can you believe how much safer our town has become!?
I sure do love the smell of safety, don't you!?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Katie after defeating 50+ monsters.

text.Katie: Whoa, check it out! I don't think the number's ever gone that high before! At this rate, we won't have to worry about monsters ever again! What a thing to be able to say...

Thank you so, so much! We'll never forget how many bloodthirsty beasts you kept off our streets! Ahhh, smell that fresh air! That's the smell of a safe and happy town—one you can be proud to call home!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Katie after collecting the final reward.

text.Katie: Hey there, how's it going? I don't think anyone's ever gonna beat that record of yours! It's incredible!

text.ACTION: Upon returning to Biggs and Wedge at the Beginner's Hall.

text.Biggs: Back already?

text.Tifa: Got every last one too. Now the slums should be safe.

text.Wedge: You guys are machines!

text.Biggs: Good job. Meanwhile, we told everyone we could about you.

text.Cloud: So I heard. I've gotta ask though. *What* did you tell them?

text.Tifa: It's alright. All you gotta do is keep up the good work. It'll pay off soon enough, I promise.

text.Biggs: How's the sword, by the way?
Glad to hear it. Seems like the perfect fit for you.

text.Cloud: Yeah. We've been through a lot—

text.Tifa: You okay?
Been meaning to ask... After you left the village...
I've got time! Why don't you tell me all about it while we try to rustle up some more work for you?

text.Wedge: That sounds great! I'll come too!

text.Biggs: Oh, no you won't. Run along now, you two. Go on.

text.Tifa: Sorry. Maybe next time.

text.Wedge: No fair!

text.Biggs: Think about it for a second. They haven't seen each other in years. You'd be a third wheel!

text.Tifa: Hey, before we get back to it, why don't you check out the weapons?
C'mon, the dealer's probably heard all about you by now. Might treat you better.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Weapons Vendor.

text.Weapons Vendor: Hold up. Heard there's a merc that'll take on any monster. You the man?

text.Tifa: Word spreads fast around here.

text.Weapons Vendor: Sorry 'bout before. I get antsy when business is slow. Man in your line of work needs weapons, no? Why not try that one on for size? Yours on the house. Badass like you rocking my weapons is good advertising. Think about it.
Or if you wanna take a look at something else...

text.ACTION: After closing the weapon store menu.

text.Tifa: Since you've got yourself a new weapon, let's see if we can't put it to good use. Come on. Let's go chat up Wymer.
The guy who tracks all the requests that come to the watch. You never know—could toss some work your way.
Oh, he should be back at the office by now.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer.

text.Wymer: Hey there, Tifa! You need a helping hand?

text.Tifa: Actually, I wanted to introduce you to an old friend of mine. This is Cloud. He's a merc.

text.Wymer: Hah, you don't say! Well, we're always on the lookout for experienced fighters to help us deal with the bigger critters.

text.Cloud: I'll take on anything. For the right price, that is.

text.Wymer: Experienced *and* cocky, huh? If it's a challenge you want, I might have a few good ones. Your clients can fill you in on the details. Prove yourself with these jobs, and I'll see if I can't find you some more.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer before completing any Odd Jobs.

CHOICE.Wymer: You're gonna have to talk to your clients if you want all the details.
You'll never want for work around here if you prove yourself useful.
Do me proud now, and I just might have more work for you later.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the DJ near the Municipal Storage Area.

text.DJ: Hey man, check it out! This song's pretty sweet, ain't it? You like it? Have a copy!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the DJ again after obtaining the song.

CHOICE.DJ: Still rocking out to that song I gave you, bro?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Johnny's house near Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: Something's wrong. Let's check it out.

text.ACTION: After completing one Odd Job.

text.Tifa: That went well. Could be you've found your calling.
Think of each job as an opportunity—not to make money, but to build connections.

text.Cloud: "It's not what you know, but who."

text.Tifa: You remembered.
Maybe not so patient next time.
Oh, Barret should've finished collecting his share of the money by now, so what do you wanna do? Head back to the bar?

text.ACTION: Upon completing three Odd Jobs.

text.Tifa: I'll be a lot of people are talking about you right now. "There's this amazing merc who can handle anything!"

text.Cloud: Nothing I've done around here has been all that special though.

text.Tifa: Oh, so you want more of a challenge, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon completing six Odd Jobs.

text.Tifa: Okay then! That's another solid gig in the books! You know the whole town is really impressed with what you've done. Keep it up and you'll have enough work to keep you fed for a lifetime!
And don't you forget it!

text.Cloud: So where do we get paid? The shop or something?

text.Tifa: Yeah, but why don't we head back to the apartments first? Take a quick breather.
Lesson one. Got it? Anyway, let's go!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley. In a first playthrough, this occurs immediately after the conversation with Wymer.

text.Chadley: Candidate detected. Performing physical analysis... Sizable weapon, excellent cardiovascular health and impressive lung capacity. Perfectly balanced muscle and bone structure... An optimal candidate!
My name is Chadley. I'm an intern for Shinra's Research and Development Division. I hope you'll be interested in helping me with my research. Please accept this as a down payment.
I would like you to set that Assess materia in your equipment and use it to gather intelligence in battle. This data will help me to develop new types of materia.

text.Cloud: I'm not interested in working for Shinra.

text.Chadley: You should know that I work actively to undermine Shinra's efforts. I'm sure you of all people can appreciate the tremendous power of materia—as well as how it might be wielded against your corporate enemies. And if you later decide that I am not worthy of your trust, you can do what you do best.

text.Cloud: I will hold you to that.

text.Chadley: Excellent! Then we shall work together so long as you deem fit. Once you've completed your task, please return and report to me.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley before completing the Battle Intel report Monster Bio Pt. 1.

text.Chadley: Please set the orb of Assess materia to your equipment, and use it to whether battle intel.

text.ACTION: After completing a battle when the Battle Intel report is complete.

text.Cloud: There. That should be enough intel for the kid.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport in front of him.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley once the Battle Intel report is complete.

text.Chadley: Cloud. You were the first to gather the data I requested. Here is the rest of your payment. I have developed new materia. Would you like to see it?

text.ACTION: After closing Chadley's materia shop menu.

text.Chadley: I plan to develop more materia in the future. Together, we can harness enough power to take down Shinra. I'll be preparing more battle intel reports, which I hope you will assist me in completing.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley at any point after completing the quest.

CHOICE.Chadley: I look forward to receiving all of your future battle intel submissions.
I hope you will continue to help me gather vital information for my research.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley after completing a Battle Intel report.

CHOICE.Chadley: I've done it. I've developed a new materia!
I have to tell you that I am grateful for all of your help thus far.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley and closing the menu when new Battle Intel reports are available.

text.Chadley: Cloud, I've come up with the most fascinating theory. Perhaps you can lend me your assistance in gathering data to test it?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Item Store Owner to begin the quest.

text.Item Store Owner: Hey there, Tifa, welcome back! And you. The new merc in town looking for work, right?

In that case, maybe you could do something about the doomrats? Them and their wererat buddies have been tearing up town, looking for food and whatnot. Got into the store and made one hell of a mess, let me tell you.

Oh, you think that's funny, do you? Don't lie. I saw you crack a smile. Well, do the job and you can laugh it up for all I care. Anyway... they're probably nesting in the outskirts. Now I've heard a wererat in pain'll call its friends for help. And the whole rat pack'll come running, just like that.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Item Store Owner again.

CHOICE.Item Store Owner: Seriously, though, I can't have doomrats coming in here again, chasing off customers and chewing up the merchandise. I'll be ruined.
Kill the wererats and their buddies oughta show, so you'd best make sure you're ready for round two.
Figure the pack must be nesting somewhere just outside of town. Good hunting.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Undercity Resident outside the tunnel entrance.

text.Undercity Resident (tunnel entrance): The leader of the rat pack is the worst of 'em all. The loudest, most obnoxious squeaking... Johnny liked to mimic it until we told him to cut that shit out.

text.ACTION: After defeating the wererats.

text.Tifa: Hmm, what do you think? Should we wait? You know, this might be a waste of time. Let's head back to the store and touch base for now.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Item Store Owner after defeating the wererats.

text.Item Store Owner: Well? Rats too much to handle? I'm just messing with you—heard you took out some wererats, which is nice and all, but the job was to wipe out the doomrats. No biggie—get back out there and finish the job and we're good.
Don't look so glum. It's only a matter of time till they show. You'll get 'em this time for sure!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the doomrats.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport in front of the store.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Item Store Owner after defeating the doomrats.

text.Item Store Owner: Finally managed to get those doomrats, huh? Thanks guys—you're the greatest! Was so dead in here I thought I might have to close up shop for good.
Hey—got an idea. Hear me out. If the guy who took care of the town's rat problem told everybody where he liked to shop... Well? Whaddya say?
I'll make it worth your while, of course. Give you some incentive. Talk you up to Wymer and my customers and anybody else who'll listen. You'll be swimming in work before you know it!
Okay then! That's what I like to hear! Seventh Heaven, the new merc in town, and my little store! I can see it now! We're gonna clean up!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Item Store Owner any time after completing the quest.

text.Item Store Owner: Keepin' your nose to the grindstone, huh? I've got just the thing for a go-getter like you!

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.

text.Item Store Owner: Pleasure as always. Say hi to Wymer for me!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Undercity Resident outside the tunnel entrance after completing the quest.

text.Undercity Resident (tunnel entrance): I'm guessing you're the merc who dealt with those damn rats? That wasn't me who put in the request, but as a resident of Culvert Street, I appreciate what you did.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Junk Dealer to begin the quest.

text.Junk Dealer: Hello, hello! Oho, what do we have here? I'm guessing you're that merc I've heard so much about. You're not here to shop, are you? People were right. You look like you can handle yourself.

So some drakes've made themselves at home in the abandoned Talagger factory. Can't have that kind of trouble around here. My regulars will do anything to get their hands on the scrap in there, and if they run into those drakes, they could get hurt.
Much obliged, sir! Head on over to the old Talagger factory and talk to Narjin. He's the watchman guarding the entrance. Good luck! I'm counting on ya, my friend!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the dealer again.

text.Junk Dealer: Narjin's the one with all the details. You'll found him outside the old Talagger factory. Don't forget to stock up before you go!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Narjin.
Upon talking to Narjin.

text.Narjin: Factory's off-limits. Drakes have been spotted inside.

Huh? Wait a minute. Tifa? Don't tell me you're here to take care of those things. Are you? In that case, be my guest! We believe there's at least two groups lurking somewhere inside the factory. Find and cull 'em all.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to him again.

text.Narjin: Reports said the drakes looked like they were nesting. Need you to clear 'em out before they breed.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the factory.
Upon defeating all drakes.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport to the junk dealer.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Junk Dealer after defeating all the drakes.

text.Junk Dealer: Got rid of those drakes in the factory, did ya? What a relief! I can't wait to give my regulars the good news!

You're the real deal all right. Keep it up, and I can see you going far as a merc in this town. I've worked with my fair share over the years, so believe me when I say that I know what I'm talking about.
Anyway—you're needed over at the pillar. Apparently another flying bastard's stirring up trouble. Bet you can't get enough of this, eh?

No, I get it. If you're good at something, might as well make it your living. May not know you, but I know a man who's found his calling when I see one. Keep at it! I switch out my stock every so often, so drop by when you're in the neighborhood, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Junk Dealer after completing the quest.

CHOICE.Junk Dealer: Welcome! I'm always getting in new stuff to keep up with the latest trends. You won't be disappointed!
Couldn't stay away, eh? Step right up—check out what I have in stock!
Welcome! Lemme know if you need help.

text.ACTION: Upon closing the store before beginning "Just Flew In from the Graveyard".

text.Junk Dealer: Always a pleasure. Oh—you look into that other gig yet? If you're planning to, might wanna buy some extra supplies first.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Betty before talking to her.

text.Betty: Hey... where'd you guys go?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Betty to begin the quest.

text.Betty: Oh, hey there! Uhh, is Marlene with you?

text.Tifa: No.

text.Betty: Oh, okay. I was kinda hoping she could help me find my friends.

text.Tifa: I know someone who can help you. This guy right here.

text.Betty: Really!? Okay! Lemme tell you all about them. They have long arms and legs. And they're a little skinny. They like places where there's food. And nice people who give them treats when they ask! And small spaces! Oh yeah, and they're all cats!
They're friendly, so if you call them, they'll come running. All three of them! Find my friends. Please!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Betty after accepting the quest.

CHOICE.Betty: They love crowded places, like the road to the station. A lot of people stop to play with them there.
They'll also go wherever there's free food. Marlene says she always gives them some snacks when they go to Seventh Heaven.
I see a lot of cats hanging out near the Beginner's Hall, too. You know the place. It's the one with all the houses around it.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching one the cats not found behind a tunnel.

CHOICE.Tifa: Wait. Did you hear that just now? I think one of Betty's cats might be nearby.
Ah! That was definitely a cat. I wonder if it's one of Betty's.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the woman near a tunnel leading to a cat.

text.Undercity Resident (Cat): Hey, what are you doing in there? Come on out.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her before finding the cat.

text.Undercity Resident (Cat): I'm trying to get a cat to come out. It snatched one of my pastries and scurried in there. Will you be a dear and lend me a hand?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her generally.

CHOICE.Undercity Resident (Cat): I've been seeing more and more cats around here lately.
And of course, they all come to *me* for food, as cats do.
But I can't complain. They're so adorable.

text.ACTION: Sometimes upon finding a cat.
Upon talking to the woman near the tunnel after finding the cat.

text.Undercity Resident (Cat): Oh, for the love of... I am sick and tired of chasing this little guy around!\

text.ACTION: After finding them all.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport in front of her.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Betty after finding them all.

text.Betty: What? They ran away? So... I'm never gonna see them again?
You guys! You came back! They said that a scary man was chasing them! Thank you!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Wymer before accepting the quest.

text.Wymer: Hey, I got another job for you, merc.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer to begin the quest.

text.Wymer: A certain shopkeeper told me you paid him a visit. Thanks for helping him out. Just so happens there's another job I'd like to offer you, now that I know you can handle yourself in a fight.
We've got a real killer on the loose, you see. A rabid catch dog. Maybe you heard people talking about it? Shinra mutt gone feral. Last sighting was in Scrap Boulevard. Think you're up to it?
You're a lifesaver! Doubt anyone else around here stands a chance! Go get 'em, bud.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer again.

CHOICE.Wymer: The catch dog was last seen in Scrap Boulevard, but if it wanders into town, a lot of people could get hurt.
This is no ordinary dog, my friend. Damn thing's already put a few of the watch out of commission.
What idiot let that ugly mutt loose in the first place?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Wymer at the front of Scrap Boulevard after taking out half of Wrath Hound's HP.

text.Wymer: Hey! Over here! Tifa! Hey, Cloud!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer.

text.Wymer: I drove the hound into the area up ahead. He's pissed, so make sure you're ready.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Wrath Hound.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport in front of him in front of the Scrap Boulevard entrance.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer after defeating the Wrath Hound.

text.Wymer: Took care of the dog, did ya? Phew! We owe you one.

text.Cloud: Gotta say, I've never seen a Shinra breed like that before. Out of curiosity, when exactly did it show up?

text.Wymer: Oh, today. The first reports came in just this morning. Uh... why do you ask?
Wait a minute... There's this crazy story about a Shinra research lab hidden right beneath our feet—under the slums.

text.Cloud: Huh. Really... ? That's news to me.

text.Wymer: And here I thought you might know something I don't! Well, I guess not.

text.Cloud: It's a big organization. I'm sure there's lots of secrets I don't know.

text.Wymer: Yeah, fair enough. You got the bastard. That's good enough for me.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer after completing the quest.

CHOICE.Wymer: A new breed of attack dog, huh? Not something you see every day—around here, at least.
Can't thank you enough for everything you've done lately.
I didn't tell you this, but you've inspired some of our people to hit the training room, believe it or not.
Well, I sure do hope that we can count on your assistance in the future, Cloud.
I'll make sure everyone knows just how much you've done for us.
Still can't believe how badly tht mutt hurt out guys. We're getting soft. Might need a new training regimen.

text.LOCATION: Just Flew In from the Graveyard

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Gwen at the Pillar Plaza.

text.New Recruit: I'm sorry, but it's outside our jurisdiction!
Y-yessir! Ma'am, if you don't leave at once, I will be forced to arrest you!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Gwen.

text.Gwen: Tifa! You won't believe this! A cerulean drake flew in from the train graveyard, but these two clowns refuse to get off their butts and do anything about it!

Hey... Is that... ? It is you! The new merc! Then maybe you can help us out? The drake is in the old Talagger factory over there, but to reach it you'll need to get ahold of a watch security key. You should be able to find one inside one of the crates—I forget which. Just smash 'em all.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Gwen again.

CHOICE.Gwen: To reach the drake, you'll need to get past a locked door in the factory.
There oughta be a key stashed inside one of the million crates in there. Keep smashing 'em until you find what you're looking for.
So long as you can track down one of our security keys, access shouldn't be a problem.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Senior Officer.

CHOICE.Senior Officer: Pest control is not our responsibility, so stop asking!
My duty is to protect Shinra's interests. And that is all!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the New Recruit.

CHOICE.New Recruit: This really isn't a good time...

CHOICE.Senior Officer: What was that!? Do your job!

CHOICE.New Recruit: Y-yessir! You will r-respect my authority, or else I'll... I'll give you what for!
Y-yessir! You will r-respect my authority, or else I'll... I'll give you what for!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Narjin.

text.Narjin: If it ain't the merc himself.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open the door to the drakes before obtaining the key.
Upon finding the watch security key.

text.Tifa: That the key?

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the drake.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport in front of her.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Gwen after defeating the drake.

text.Gwen: And there he is! I knew you were the right man for the job! There's no denying you're the real deal! Not like these idiots, with their excuses. Rather have one of you than twenty of them!

text.Cloud: They're just doing their jobs. Can't expect them to be at your beck and call.

text.Gwen: What exactly is it you're trying to say, merc?

text.Cloud: You need people who can follow orders too.
