text.Gwen: I see now. Heard you were ex-Shinra. Guess I shouldn't be surprised you'd go to bat for your old buddies. Me, I'm just looking out for my people. All there is to it.
Hell with you. We can take care of this town ourselves! No more mercs or Shinra—we'll build up the watch and kick you all out!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Gwen after completing the quest.

text.Gwen: We don't want your so-called "protection"! We'll take care of ourselves!

text.New Recruit: Y-yessir! Leave now, otherwise I'll be forced to arrest you!

text.Gwen: C'mon then, tough guy, do it!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle.

text.Marle: Huh? Someone's back awful early. Not that I mind! Would you two be dears and swap your filters out for me? I left them in your rooms.

text.Tifa: Sure thing!

text.Marle: Not so fast, you. Do me a favor. She needs a friend—a real friend.
So when she talks, are you really listening? Thinking about her and her feelings? Or are you just going through the motions? Go on.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the stairs to Stargazer Heights' second floor.

text.Tifa: Let's take care of this real quick, okay?
Come over when you're done.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the filter in Cloud's room.
Upon entering Tifa's room.

text.Tifa: Gimme one sec. I'll be done in a bit.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Tifa.

text.Tifa: Finally!
So. After you left the village.
I let you off the hook before. Back at the hall. But not this time.

text.Cloud: Well, when we were kids... everybody wanted to be a SOLDIER, right?

text.Tifa: Yeah, I remember they were on the news every day during the war.

text.Cloud: Thing is, by the time I finally made it in, they didn't need heroes anymore. It was nothing like what we'd dreamt of. It was just... working for Shinra. Just...

text.Tifa: I'm sorry. I know it's a touchy subject.

text.Cloud: Not exactly small talk. Especially with someone you haven't seen in a while.

text.Tifa: I get it. Still, it's kinda funny. Us going our separate ways, thinking that must be it... that we'd never meet again—and then here of all places we do.
You know what? We should totally celebrate! Let's dress up and hit the town!
I mean, why not? It'll be fun!

text.Cloud: Do you even have fancy clothes?

text.Tifa: Not like *fancy* fancy, but I'll figure something out! What do you think would suit me, huh?

CHOICE.Tifa: Yeah, I guess we're not kids anymore.
I don't think that'd be so different from my usual.
Uhhh... really? Then again, if we're making an effort...

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Tifa: Be sure to pick an outfit that goes with mine, okay?
This is gonna be so much fun, you'll see!
And on that happy note, I think it's time we headed back to the bar. C'mon!

text.Cloud: Uh, you don't need a break?

text.Tifa: Honestly, I'm feeling pretty good. Marle isn't always right you know.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Marle.

text.Tifa: Hey, Marle. We took care of the filters, so we're gonna head back to the bar now.

text.Marle: Take care you two! ... Oh? You're looking pretty chipper!

text.Tifa: Uh... I don't feel that different.

text.Marle: Must be my imagination then. (chuckles) Anyway! Keep your wits about you, merc! A token of my appreciation. Be good to her.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle again.

CHOICE.Marle: You'll get no second chances from me.
Swing by anytime if you want advice. Or just to talk, even.
People need more than empty words. They need to know you're there for them, and you'll *still* be there for them when things get tough. That knowledge alone can give a woman wings.

text.Johnny: Stay away from me!
Get off me, assholes! I didn't do shit!
Or what!? Screw you!

text.Tifa: What's going on?

text.Undercity Resident (Female 1): "Somebody" went and stole some blasting agent from a Shinra warehouse. So Public Security started asking questions, and you know how Johnny gets...

text.Undercity Resident (Male 4): It's because of the reactor bombing, I bet. I could be wrong... But something tells me they're not gonna settle for just roughing him up this time.

text.Tifa: We've gotta save him, Cloud!
No. He doesn't really know what we do... but he has his suspicions. And... He's a talker.
Actually, you know what... maybe I should go alone.
Uh... are you sure?

text.Cloud: It's the least I can do. Lead on.

text.Tifa: Thanks. Come on!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the first gate in front of the Municipal Storage Area.

text.Johnny: What the hell, man!? You trying to break my arm!? Dragging me through the street like this is—ow—cruel and unusual punishment!

text.ACTION: While following Johnny further in.

text.Security Officer: Shut your mouth and keep walking! Or else!

text.Johnny: Come on, guys! Is this any way to treat a model citizen of Midgar?

text.Tifa: Come on. Let's get a closer look.

text.ACTION: Upon hiding behind the storage container further in.

text.Security Officer: Model citizens don't steal blasting agent! So why don't you tell me why your ID popped when we were going over the warehouse logs!?

text.Johnny: Huh? You've got it all wrong! I've never gone anywhere near a Shinra warehouse! Unless it was Jessie... She jacked my ID!

text.Security Officer: Your ID was never logged, dumbass. It would've never gotten you inside a Shinra installation in the first place! But don't you worry—we'll take all the time we need to help you get your story straight.

text.Johnny: What!? That's bullshit! Cheap bullshit! Entrapment! Yeah, yeah! I know my rights!

text.Tifa: I swear, all he had to do was keep his mouth shut.
Anyway, you distract the officers, and I'll... figure something out.

text.ACTION: Upon opening the gate and approaching Johnny.

text.Johnny: Is that—is that who I think it is!? Aw, hell yeah! You guys really came to save me! Ava—

text.Security Officer: Hey! The hell you think you're doing!?

text.Tifa: Here we go...

text.ACTION: After defeating the enemies.

text.Johnny: Uh... so... is it over? Yo, anybody there? If you're there, then help me!

text.Tifa: Grab Johnny so we can get outta here.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Tifa: Wh—what now?
No!

text.Johnny: Huh!? You're not gonna... Hold up! Wait! Don't—don't do it, man!

text.Cloud: You wanna live, then get the hell out of town.

text.Johnny: Y-y-you got it, boss! You ain't never gonna see my face again, I swear!

text.Cloud: Are you sure about this? It's a big risk.

text.Tifa: I know, but... it's fine.
No more... Cloud... You're scaring me.
We need to go before they wake up.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the area and approaching Tifa.

text.Tifa: I... I'm worried about Johnny.

text.Cloud: I'm more worried about us. We gotta go, right?

text.Tifa: Right...
It's just... you've really changed.
I suppose it's... yeah. Your eyes. They used to be less...
... I remember. So, what do you wanna do now? Head back to the bar? Or do you wanna tackle another job or two?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the door to Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: And here we are. You must be tired.
Could use a little something to take the edge off, right? How about a refreshing cocktail made by yours truly that you can sit back and savor?
Yeah, I'm feeling it a bit too. Hey... Do you think you'll stick around a little longer?

text.Cloud: Maybe. Work for a minute, build up some savings...

text.Tifa: I see. In that case, wanna head back out and look for more gigs?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Good idea.", next quest commences.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Seventh Heaven door after first choosing not to enter.

text.Tifa: Well? You wanna head inside?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "No.", nothing happens. Upon selecting "Yeah.", next quest commences.

text.Tifa: We're back.
Lotsa fun.

text.Barret: Hey—need y'all downstairs.

text.Tifa: Uh... right now? Then the plan is... ?

text.Barret: Marlene, wanna go wait for Jessie out front?

text.Tifa: Looks like we're officially on for tomorrow night, then. Gotta go over the details with the others.

text.Cloud: Before you do, about my pay—

text.Barret: You'll get your money! So sit down and shut up until we're finished. Double time, Tifa.

text.Tifa: I'm really sorry... but it shouldn't take much longer. In the meantime... Grab a seat.
What'll it be?

CHOICE.Cloud: I dunno... something hard and bitter.
Not really in the mood right now.

CHOICE.Tifa: But if you were, then maybe...

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Tifa: Well? Most people would say something sweet right about now.
Ahh, but you're a more discerning customer, aren't you? In which case...
Our house special: the Cosmo Canyon.
I gotta go. Enjoy.

text.Jessie: Hey! You see the news? "The reactor bombing was the work of the eco-extremist group 'Avalanche.'" Public enemy number one! Gets your heart racing, doesn't it? They don't know our faces, so we're in the clear for now, but we'll wanna capitalize on this momentum. Speaking of which, you coming on the next one?
Oh, you can bet I'll be pushing hard for a raise!

Tifa'll be joining us too, but I dunno... Even a blind man can see her heart's not in it. She was never on board with the bombings, so if it comes down to do or die... If I've got to put my life in someone else's hands... Then... I'd rather that someone was a professional. Like you.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the yellow flower behind the counter.

text.Cloud: What was up with that girl anyway?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the flower a second time.
Upon interacting with the dartboard.
After playing darts.
Upon interacting with the chair.
Upon selecting "No", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Cloud: I heard you're having second thoughts.

text.Tifa: I know we have to think big if we're going to make a difference. But not like this. I just... I feel trapped.

text.Cloud: If it feels wrong, don't do it.

text.Tifa: Guess that's that, then.
We agreed to disagree. So—you want another drink?

text.Barret: Tifa! Time to celebrate! Break out all the good stuff!

text.Tifa: Oh. Sure.

text.Barret: We won't be needing you for this next job. Feel free to look for work elsewhere.

text.Cloud: Fine by me. That's how I like it. No contract, no obligation.

text.Barret: Figured you'd say that. Here—the rest of your payment, along with a little extra for your exemplary service. And thus concludes our business. Gonna have to ask you to leave now. This here's a private affair.

text.Jessie: Sorry, I tried. We talked it over, but... in the end... We didn't want to put so much on you. This is our fight.

text.Biggs: Jessie, what's the holdup?

text.Jessie: Be right there!
No hard feelings, huh?
Let's talk more after I'm done here, okay?

text.Wedge: C'mon, Jessie! I'm dying here!

text.Jessie: I'll catch you later.
Sorry to keep you thirsty boys waiting!

text.ACTION: In Seventh Heaven while roaming around.

text.Biggs: Avalanche!

text.Wedge: Avalanche!

text.Tifa: Avalanche!

text.Jessie: Avalanche!

text.Barret: Avalanche!

text.Biggs: Glug, glug, glug, glug... Ahhh! That hit the spot!

text.Jessie: Damn, Biggs, slow down!

text.Barret: Keep it tight! Ain't no room for error come tomorrow!

text.Wedge: More reason to live it up now!

text.Biggs: Yep! Best way to clear your head so. you can focus when it counts!

text.Tifa: It's been too long since we did this.

text.Wedge: Not since we went on that all-night bender after HQ gave us the boot.

text.Jessie: They did not "give us the boot"!

text.Barret: It was an "amicable separation."

text.Jessie: Just thinking about it's making me mad again.

text.Tifa: Can't believe it's already been a year. I don't know how we managed.

text.Barret: Well, I do. It was you guys going above and beyond. Thank you.

text.Biggs: No need for that, boss. We all knew what we were signing up for.

text.Barret: Yeah, but when shit hits the fan, it's good to know you're in my corner. End of the day... you're all I got!

text.Biggs: Happy to look out for you, like I know you'll look out for me.

text.Wedge: So long as someone looks out for my stomach!

text.Jessie: Tifa's got you covered there.

text.Barret: As a friend, or as a cook?

text.Jessie: As if you've really gotta ask!

text.Wedge: That tickled!

text.Tifa: I guess it is kinda obvious!

text.Wedge: You know, it'd be really cool if we could do this again tomorrow night.

text.Barret: Oh we will. Avalanche!

text.Biggs: Avalanche!

text.Wedge: Avalanche!

text.Tifa: Avalanche!

text.Jessie: Avalanche!

text.Barret: Avalanche!

text.Tifa: You guys...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Tifa.

CHOICE.Tifa: We'll talk later. I promise.
Don't take this the wrong way, but right now I need to spend time with the gang.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret.

CHOICE.Barret: When the job's done, we're done. Your words!
Oh no. You better not be about to ask for more money.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie.

CHOICE.Jessie: We were all pushing real hard for you, you know.
But he was afraid we'd lean on you too much if we took you along.
We'll talk.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Biggs.

CHOICE.Biggs: Can't expect anyone but a true believer to stand tall if everything goes sideways.
Could get pretty dicey out there.
Sorry. Boss man wasn't having it.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge.

CHOICE.Wedge: Lemme treat you to dinner at my place! I can introduce you to all my cats!
I'd offer to share but... you know.
Bet you could use a bit to eat too huh?

text.ACTION: Upon leaving Seventh Heaven.

text.Hoodlum (1): So what, we just hang around here till he shows up? Big guy with a gun for an arm?

text.Hoodlum (2): Word is he lives in this town. Just shut up and wait. We'll find him soon enough.

text.Hoodlum (3): Man! Seems like the boss always gives us the most shit-tastic assignments.

text.Hoodlum (2): Guess that's why we're paid so damn much.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the hoodlums.

text.Hoodlum: Hey brother! You from around the way?
Know a big man with a big gun strapped to his right arm? Heard he's set up shop somewhere in the neighborhood.
Clever. Smell an opportunity to make some scratch, do ya?
Whatever, man. Let's fin somewhere quiet to talk. Walk with me.

text.ACTION: While following the hoodlums.

text.Hoodlum (2): Look at all these assholes starin' at us.

text.Hoodlum (3): This shithole's got nothing on Wall Market—am I right?

text.Hoodlum (2): Word of advice, blondie. Don't piss off my friend here, or you'll be real sorry. Unless you've got some kinda death with—then be my guest. (laughs)

text.Hoodlum (1): After you, brother... And don't worry—I ain't the backstabbin' type—*most* days...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the tunnel.

text.Hoodlum: Spill it. You know where the bastard's hiding, don't you?

text.Cloud: I told you before... That depends.

text.Hoodlum: Oh yeah? You wasting my time!?
Hah. Shinra knows better than to stick its nose in *my* boss's business.

text.ACTION: After defeating two of the hoodlums.

text.Cloud: Big man with a big gun for an arm, right!?

text.Hoodlum: Just a grunt following orders, you know? Nobody tells me shit. Lemme walk away. Please!

text.ACTION: After defeating them all.

text.Cloud: So, if they weren't Shinra, then...
Not my problem. Lesson one for life on the ground floor... Get some rest.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to Cloud's room at Stargazer Heights.

text.Jessie: Welcome home, honey! Took your sweet time.
Psych.
Are you gonna let me in so we can talk in private?
Guess I'll get right to the point, then.
An apology. For not getting you on the mission. Or not. What do *you* think it is?
Nailed it in one. Gonna have to ask you to keep all this a secret from the others, though. It's a personal matter—something I need to sort out tonight.
Tonight. You and me, together. I want you to come with me to the Sector 7 plate. I'll give you the details on the way.

text.Cloud: That's fine by me... But don't you have a pretty big day ahead of you?

text.Jessie: I do, but... If I don't deal with this now, it's only gonna get harder... Anyway... I can count on you, can't I?
A down payment.
Doubt we'll be back before morning—'case you were planning on traveling light. Make sure you've got everything you need before we leave. I'll wait here.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie.

text.Jessie: You all set?

CHOICE.Jessie: Take all the time you need. Nothing a woman likes more than being kept waiting. But seriously, get your ass in gear already!
Awesome. Meet me at the station before dark. Don't be late!

text.Biggs: Tough break. They changed the times. Last train's already left. Which is why we borrowed these bikes. Need a lift to the plate?

text.Jessie: How did you guess... ?

text.Wedge: Easy. You've been acting weird. Like, talking about one thing when you're obviously thinking about something else.

text.Biggs: Yeah, and don't get me started on all that pep.

text.Jessie: All right, I'll give you that—but how did you know I wanted to head topside? Was I talking in my sleep? What else did I say!?

text.Wedge: No. We just figured you wanted to see your parents. That's all.

text.Biggs: Nailed it, huh?

text.Jessie: Yup. Right on the head.

text.Biggs: So—seeing as we don't have any family of our own... How about you let us be a part of yours for a bit? You know, spread the wealth.

text.Jessie: Are your parents still around?
Okay, then. Guess you're all invited! Here's to awkward family reunions!

text.Biggs: Yeah!

text.Wedge: Yeah!

text.Jessie: I take it you boys have your brand-spanking-new IDs?

text.Biggs: Yes, ma'am!

text.Wedge: Yes, ma'am!

text.Jessie: Then let's lay down some rubber!

text.Biggs: Crank that throttle!

text.Wedge: Okay, you got it!

text.Jessie: You hear me?
Just so you know, I'm not going plateside for the reason they think I am. Look—you saw the way the reactor went up. It was huge, right?

text.Cloud: Because of all the mako. Isn't that what you said?

text.Jessie: Yeah... that was wishful thinking. Deep down, I know it was my fault. I used a more powerful blasting agent than the directions called for. It had nothing to do with the mako.

text.Cloud: Let's say you're right. So what?

text.Jessie: I'm planning on using a weaker blasting agent this time. But... since I can't get in touch with my supplier, our only option is to loot a warehouse owned by Shinra.
With your help, we won't need luck.
ID scan! Ready!?

text.STATUS: When the bike minigame begins.

text.Biggs: So far so good!

text.Jessie: Alright, here comes the hard part!

text.Biggs: And that is?

text.Jessie: The fake IDs may have held up, but from this point on, if we get pinged by a scan...
Yeah, what he said.

text.Biggs: Oh, man!

text.Wedge: Just like that!?

text.Jessie: No need to worry. We've got Cloud, remember?
Hey, you do know how to drive, right?
Well then! You gonna take my breath away? Make my head spin with your amazing skills?

text.Cloud: Don't blame me if ya get sick.

text.Jessie: Right...

text.ACTION: Upon first using Spinning Slash or Sharp Gust.

text.Jessie: That some super-secret technique? You got a fancy name for it?

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first enemy.

text.Jessie: We've got company!
How could I not!? "Pursued by villains, a young couple thrust together by fate race through the neon-streaked night... "

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the first enemy.

text.Jessie: Oh! My hero!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the second group of enemies.

text.Biggs: Straight to lethal force!?

text.Jessie: What, so you'd just pull over if they asked nicely?

text.Biggs: Eh... You've got a point.

text.Jessie: See!? So don't go holding back now!

text.ACTION: After defeating the second group.

text.Jessie: "Had the cold-eyed mercenary's heart suddenly begun to melt?"
I won't forget that. (laughs) Wait, is it just me or did we slow down?

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the third group of enemies.

text.Biggs: More of 'em!?

text.Jessie: Think we've bitten off more than we can chew! Whadda we do!?

text.ACTION: After defeating the third group.

text.Biggs: Got more company!

text.Jessie: Uhh, I don't like the sound of that!

text.Wedge: We're not screwed, are we!?

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the fifth group of enemies.

text.Jessie: Head's up—drones!

text.Biggs: One thing after another... C'mon Wedge, gun it!

text.Wedge: I *am* gunning it!

text.Biggs: Nothing about this is good!
Fair enough! Alright then, do your thing!

text.ACTION: After defeating the fifth group.

text.Mobile Unit Officer (1): SOLDIER en route. HQ's saying he's less than a few minutes out.

text.Mobile Unit Officer (2): Probably. All the more reason to finish this quick. Don't need that kind of trouble.

text.ACTION: After defeating the sixth group.

text.Biggs: That's an ex-SOLDIER for ya. Next to him, we look like kids on trikes.

text.Jessie: You're damn right you do!

text.Biggs: You're part of that "we" too, you know.

text.Wedge: We made it!

text.Biggs: Woo-hoo! Topside!

text.Cloud: Keep going till we hit the station?

text.Jessie: No, head straight for the warehouse. Awww... Our magical ride is almost at an end...

text.Biggs: Why ya talking like we're not here?

text.Jessie: Because you're not!

text.Biggs: Clearly we are!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the seventh group.

text.Biggs: Not over yet! Cloud! Little help!?

text.ACTION: After defeating the seventh group.

text.Mobile Unit Officer (1): Time's up. Break off before he shows!

text.Jessie: What's going on?
Who's that?

text.Roche: Well, hello!

text.Biggs: Who's this!?

text.Roche: "Too quick for the eye, you cross him, you die!" Now... Mind if I cut in? Woo! Splendid! I've been looking for a new dance partner!
Private party, huh? That's fine. I'll settle for a race then. Just one.
I most certainly am.
Ah, so terribly sorry! Your words fail to reach my ears, sluggish and slow as they are!

text.Jessie: What's this guy's deal!?

text.Roche: The lady's curiosity has been piqued! My name is Roche, but you may address me by the more accurate appellation: Speed Demon!

text.Jessie: Heard *that*, huh!?

text.Roche: My ears are attuned to the feminine voice!

text.Jessie: This guy is the worst.

text.Roche: Yes. Yes! This is the contest I've been waiting for!

text.STATUS: When Roche is at half HP.

text.Roche: Fascinating...

text.Jessie: What is he up to now?

text.Roche: Not bad. You have promise, and an abiding affection for your mount. But! One cannot simply ride one's bike! Nay! One must unlock its true potential—become one with the machine! Like this!

text.ACTION: After defeating Roche.

text.Roche: Don't be absurd. As if I could ever grow tired of your company!
Naughty, naughty! Until one of our flames is forever extinguished, our dance will never end! (laughs) Burn for me!
Come on! Let's push it past the redline!
Well, well, well! I do believe this round is yours. (chuckles) Maybe next time we can keep it just between the two of us.
Until we meet again, my friend!

text.Biggs: We did it!

text.Wedge: Go team!

text.Jessie: Don't get too excited. Reinforcements are hot on our trail.

text.ACTION: After the bike minigame ends.

CHOICE.STATUS: If Cloud finished with very low HP.

CHOICE.Jessie: You failed the test.
Driving.
Hah! Great at scaring your passengers, more like...
Maybe you should just let *me* drive.
Gues I'll take one for the team and be your back warmer again.

CHOICE.STATUS: If Cloud finished with high HP but below 80%.

CHOICE.Jessie: You passed the test!
Driving.
Not really. You made it by the skin of your teeth, if we're being honest.
I bet you held back because I was with you.
So now I'm too weak to stay on a bike? Huh? Huh?

CHOICE.Cloud: Just hold on tight, will you?

CHOICE.Jessie: I might... be falling after all.
Psych!

CHOICE.STATUS: If Cloud finished with above 80% HP.

CHOICE.Jessie: You passed the test!
Driving.
So you don't need a reward?
Well, you got one anyway.
You can thank me later. I'll wait.
Giving me the cold shoulder?

text.ACTION: After either previous dialogue sequence concludes.

text.Jessie: Aw, would you look at that... It's the end of the ride.
We'll go on foot from here. Don't wanna draw too much attention to ourselves.

text.Wedge: Hey, did these things leave a mark?

text.Biggs: They got you pretty good.

text.Wedge: Aw... *and* I'm running on fumes...

text.Jessie: Don't worry, we'll top you up soon enough. Now let's roll.

text.ACTION: Upon running back towards the Corkscrew Tunnel.

text.Jessie: Hey! Focus!

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the staircase.

text.Jessie: The residential area's just beyond this gate. Mind doing the honors?

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever.

text.Jessie: You've got an arm on ya!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave down the tunnel.

CHOICE.Wedge: You really shouldn't go off on your own!
Over here, Cloud! Over here!
Where you trying to go?
Uh, Cloud? Hello?

text.Jessie: Here we are—the employee housing district. Where they put you when your parents work for Shinra. While their reactors were slowly killing the planet, we were living the good life...

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to run away from the Employee Housing Area.
Upon approaching Wedge near a cat.

text.Wedge: C'mere... Aw, no dice... Someone's playing hard to get.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Biggs near a Shinra billboard.

text.Biggs: Folks here must be living off three or four times what I do.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Jessie.

text.Jessie: Figures. Still leaves the lights on every night for the girl who only comes home once every other blue moon. Mom's an old-fashioned type like that.

text.Wedge: Think she'll make us pizza? Her "Midgar Special"?

text.Biggs: She's quite the cook. Quick to whip up finger-lickin' food even if you drop by in the dead of night.

text.Jessie: And she loves guests who ask for seconds or thirds.
Okay, let's head in. Cloud—you know what to do. Why don't you wait around the corner over there?

text.Wedge: It's a shame you won't get to try the Midgar Special. You would've really liked it.

text.ACTION: After Biggs, Wedge, and Jessie enter her house.

text.Jessie: With your help, we won't need luck. You'll take on just about any job, right? Well, I need you to rob my house. Think you can do that for me?
Go in through the back door when the coast is clear. The signal will be obvious.

text.Cloud: Once the lights come on, it's go time.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the house.

text.Jessie: Inside, you'll find a room with two doors. Don't take the one in front of you. You want the room on the right. That's where you'll find it.
Sorry about dropping in like this again.

text.Jessie'S Mom: This will always be your home. So—how's practice going?

text.ACTION: Upon entering Jessie's father's room.

text.Jessie: We'll be chatting Mom up in the kitchen, so don't even bother being quiet. There's no way she'll ever hear you. Dad'll be in there, but it's okay.
I need you to grab his Shinra ID card. And yeah, I know I should do it myself, but... (chuckles) but I honestly don't think I'm up to it. Just do this for me, okay?

text.ACTION: In the background randomly while roaming around the room.

CHOICE.Jessie: Now this—this is what I've been waiting for!

CHOICE.Biggs: Yeah, like a dog!

CHOICE.Wedge: Don't mind if I do!

CHOICE.Biggs: This is amazing!

CHOICE.Jessie: Alright, here comes a Midgar Special!

CHOICE.Jessie'S Mom: Eat as much as you like!

CHOICE.Wedge: I'll take another one, please!

CHOICE.Biggs: You've still got room, Wedge?!

CHOICE.Jessie: Dang, Mom, how'd you get even better at this?

CHOICE.Wedge: So, got more pizza in the oven?

CHOICE.Biggs: Aw, thank you!

CHOICE.Jessie: Wedge, don't hurt yourself!

CHOICE.Biggs: Now that is a damn good pie.

CHOICE.Wedge: I'm not full yet!

text.ACTION: Upon inspecting the documents on the desk or the notepad on the bookshelf.
Upon inspecting the family photo.
Upon inspecting the letter on the floor.

CHOICE.Jessie: "Dear Mom and Dad", Sorry for not getting in touch sooner, but... I'm working at the Gold Saucer as an actress now. It wasn't easy, and I had a lot of help from people along the way... but I managed to land a starring role. Enclosed are two tickets to my play. Looking forward to seeing you both there."

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with Jessie's father's maintenance outfit.

text.Jessie: My dad—he was a maintenance supervisor at the reactor.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with any other items after obtaining the ID card.
Upon leaving the house and attempting to walk back.
Upon leaving onto the road.
In Jessie's house.

text.Jessie'S Mom: When are you going to give up on the Gold Saucer? How long as it been since you even performed?

text.Wedge: A lot of people really rely on Jessie.

text.Jessie'S Mom: As a stagehand though, right? You can be one of those anywhere. So why not come home and get a job at the Sector 8 theater?

text.Jessie: Uhhh, I'll think about it. You know, I'd really love to stay and chat, but we gotta go.
Yeah, well, we hadn't even planned on dropping by. But Wedge wanted some of your famous pizza.

text.Wedge: So good!

text.Jessie'S Mom: Sure I can't tempt you with some more?

text.Wedge: Maybe just a couple slices, Missus R.

text.Biggs: Wedge!

text.Jessie: Wedge!

text.Wedge: Hey! I'm... I'm doing it for you guys! You don't want me going to work on an empty stomach.

text.ACTION: As Cloud.

text.Jessie: I'm planning on using a weaker blasting agent this time. Since I can't in touch with my supplier, our only option is to loot a warehouse owned by Shinra.
Hey there.
Now comes the hard part. I'm gonna use this to sneak into the 7-6 Annex.

text.Biggs: All right, let's get to it.

text.Jessie: Sorry, but you're staying outside. Only I know what to steal from where, so it's gotta be me who goes in.

text.Biggs: So... we came all this way just to eat pizza!?

text.Jessie: You think I'd let you off that easy? You're gonna earn every slice helping Cloud. Just do the thing where you draw everyone's attention away, like you did at my parents'. What's the word again? Maybe I'm more nervous than I thought.
Yeah, that! Nice one, military man.

text.Wedge: So what, does this mean we're gonna ask some Shinra folks out to dinner?

text.Biggs: You know damn well what she means. While you're inside, we make sure the guards are focused on the outside. Yeah?

text.Jessie: Exactly. Couldn't've put it any better. When you see a flare go up, that's your cue. Rush the front gates and make for the warehouse plaza. The more hell you raise, the more time you buy me.

text.Biggs: You're gonna run this guy into the ground, aren'tcha?

text.Cloud: How much time do you think you'll need?

text.Jessie: Not too much. I'll be in and out. I'll send up another flare when I'm done. We rendezvous in the vacant lot up ahead.

text.Biggs: Hold on. How are we supposed to get back to the slums? Wait for the first train?

text.Jessie: No, I wanna be back before that. Don't worry, I have something worked out. Now, let's get this done.

text.Biggs: Well, that diversion's not gonna create itself.
Jessie's dad was in there, right?
Mako poisoning. Happened while Jessie was doing a show at the Gold Saucer— Ah, but what do you care?
Jessie always wanted to be an actress. Worked her ass off for years until finally she caught a break. Top billing. Parents were thrilled. And then... right before opening night...

text.Wedge: Her dad had an accident.

text.Biggs: Collapsed from overwork... and in the worst possible place. Mako storage. Lay there half a day before someone found him. Been like that ever since. No change whatsoever. That's what got her into planetology, and led her to seek out Avalanche. How far we've come...

text.Wedge: Jessie's got a theory about it. Thinks her dad's spirit is stuck now—between his body and the heart of the planet. So if we don't shut down the reactors soon...

text.Biggs: He'll get caught up in the flow and... poof.
What's so funny?

text.Cloud: Just that I understand how you feel. Unlike most of the time.

text.Biggs: I see...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bridge in front of the Sector 7-6 Annex.

text.Biggs: Mako's the essence of life itself. Of memory and hope. It's not something you burn in a reactor just to keep the lights on. Hell no.
Oh—don't tell Jessie about this little chat, okay? When she gets pissed, she gets punchy.

text.Wedge: He's serious, Cloud! She'll beat the shit out of us!

text.Biggs: This guy!

text.Wedge: Hey! It's the lot Jessie was talking about. We rendezvous here when we've got what we came for.

text.Biggs: Gotta stay hidden—wait for the signal.

text.Wedge: It's so quiet...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Biggs near the gate.

text.Biggs: Just need to get past this gate.
Looks like someone beat us here.

text.Wedge: And I don't think it was Jessie.

text.Biggs: This had better not get in the way of our plans...

text.ACTION: After the scene ends.

text.Biggs: Don't see anyone. What the hell happened?

text.Wedge: Hey, man, the plaza's that way. Warehouses are further in. Jessie's supposed to be circling around from the back, right... ?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Biggs.

text.Biggs: No need for us to rush. Let's scout it out first.
What, you're trying to keep us out of it now? Don't be a jackass.

text.Wedge: We're in this together!

text.Cloud: Don't expect me to save you.

text.Biggs: If you need to check your gear, now's the time. Give the word when you're good to go.

text.Wedge: You can use that vending machine over there to stock up!

text.Biggs: Guess there's a training center too. Could go a few rounds before the main event.

text.ACTION: After the conversation, while roaming around near Wedge.

CHOICE.Wedge: Man! I get really hungry when I'm nervous!
When you leave something at home, or just need a bite to eat, vending machines can be real lifesavers!
Whenever you're ready, just let us know, Cloud!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the training center controls.
Upon talking to Biggs.

text.Biggs: Remind me—you've got summoning materia, don't you? There's no better way to deal with big groups. You'd be crazy not to equip it.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "No", conversation ends.
Upon selecting "Yeah".

text.Biggs: Okay. Let's go over the plan one last time. You start things off by cutting loose where everyone can see you.

text.Wedge: And us?

text.Biggs: We're the backup. First, we climb high enough to get a vantage point—then we go to town on 'em.

text.ACTION: During a flashback.

text.Tifa: Heya. So... what did you wanna talk about?

text.Cloud: When spring comes, I'm leaving town and going to Midgar.

text.Tifa: Should've figured. All the guys are leaving.

text.Cloud: B-but I'm not like them. I'm not going just to look for work. I'm gonna be a SOLDIER. The best of the best. Like Sephiroth.

text.Tifa: The great war hero, huh? Mm... Isn't it pretty hard to become a SOLDIER?

text.Cloud: Yeah. So I won't be back for a long time.

text.Tifa: Guess not. Think you'll be in the papers?
Just... promise me one thing. When we're older, and you're a famous SOLDIER... if I'm ever trapped or in trouble... Promise you'll come and save me.
That's what heroes do. They save people. Please? Just once.
Come on, promise me!

text.ACTION: In the following flashback.

text.Cloud: I heard you're having second thoughts.

text.Tifa: I know we have to think big if we're going to make a difference... but not like this. I just... I feel trapped.

text.Wedge: That's the signal!

text.Biggs: All according to plan.
Right!

text.Wedge: Yeah!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the warehouse grounds.

text.Security Officer: I don't see any intruders. Maybe they went home.

text.ACTION: During combat.

text.Security Officer: We've spotted more intruders. Send backup.
They have a sniper. Get him first!
Focus on the other one! Quickly, before we're surrounded!

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group of enemies.

text.Biggs: Oh, you gotta be shitting me.
Gimme a bit more time and I got you.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Elite Security Officer and Riot Trooper.

text.Biggs: Goodbye! And good riddance.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Shock Trooper and Elite Grenadier.

text.Wedge: And down she goes!

text.Biggs: Look at us amateurs putting in the work.

text.Wedge: Don't worry—I've got this!
Catch me if you caaan! (screams)

text.ACTION: During battle against Guard Dogs.

text.Wedge: Tasty treats! Come and get 'em!
Don't eat me! Please don't eat me!
Midgar Special, don't fail me now!

text.ACTION: After defeating the Guard Dogs.

text.Wedge: Think I ran off the pizza...

text.Biggs: Helluva show, man! If only the ladies loved you that much!

text.Wedge: I'm glad someone's enjoying themselves...

text.Biggs: Of course they store mechs here...
Hell yeah!

text.Wedge: More than you know! Look what I found. Let's give these jerks a taste of their own medicine!

text.ACTION: Halfway during the battle against the Sweepers.

text.Wedge: Hurry! Lead the sweepers toward the mines!

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Wedge: Now that's what I call teamwork!

text.Biggs: Well, shit.

text.Security Officer: All right, assholes! Show me your hands!

text.Roche: Well, aren't we having a wonderful time kicking the hornet's nest!
You know what I want. A second dance—just the two of us.
You turned the key... The engine roars with excitement... It hungers to be set free!

text.Biggs: Right. C'mon!

text.Roche: It's been a long time since I fought a duel out of the saddle. But... for all the miles on the clock...
I'm just as fast as I ever was!
At last, our long-awaited dance begins! Here's to a fair fight, my friend!

text.ACTION: After Roche loses one-third of his HP.

text.Roche: I told you we were gonna push it past the redline!

text.ACTION: After defeating Roche.

text.Roche: With such fleeting pleasure? Hardly. There are higher heights to which you and I can still soar...

text.Security Officer: Okay, boys! Give 'em everything you've got! But kill the swordsman first!

text.Roche: We really must do this again. Until then... try not to die. I'll see you on the road, my friend.

text.Biggs: Right!

text.Wedge: Run! Run while you can!
Glad yours is...

text.Biggs: C'mere.
Wedge'll be fine. But you won't be if they start asking questions.
First guests to the party. Another Avalanche cell. Our holier-than-thou friends from the old guard... It's always their way or the highway. Lately they've been a real pain in the ass... Till now.

text.Cloud: So then why are they here?

text.Biggs: Beats me. We've been on the outs ever since our cell got labeled too extreme... though they're the ones running around with mil-spec gear. Word is they've cut a deal with Wutai... Promised 'em all the materia in Midgar, apparently. Think there's any truth to that?
Sometimes I think we're the only ones who've realized the war is over.
Okay—mission complete. Let's make our way back to the lot.
Looking a lot more crowded now.
Just what we need.

text.Cloud: So, are we not gonna wait for Wedge?

text.Biggs: If we stuck around or went back, he'd only get upset.
Guess a SOLDIER wouldn't understand... I'll tell him you were worried about him, though. Who knows—might just make his day.

text.Security Officer: ... And many of our citizens have already been disturbed by the alarms. Squad A will set up here and search for suspects. B will establish a perimeter—roadblocks included. Contain the situation! Rumors of violence against Public Security will only serve to frighten the people. You will tell any concerned citizens that this was a false alarm!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Jessie.

text.Jessie: You made it! Over here!
Could you have been any louder? I mean, it made my job a lot easier, but— Wait, where's Wedge?
Wedge!? That was close...

text.Biggs: Hey, buddy. How you doing?
C'mon...

text.Wedge: Not my finest hour...

text.Biggs: You get hit?

text.Wedge: Just winged, I think... Or shot!

text.Biggs: Really? Let me see...

text.Jessie: Are we seriously doing this here? That's... wow.

text.Wedge: You guys are the worst...

text.Jessie: Your ass is fine. Maybe singed, but the only casualty is your underwear. This is like a bruise or a mild burn at worst!

text.Wedge: Now *that* was a gunshot.

text.Jessie: Is that a smile I spy?

text.Cloud: It's not safe here. We should go.

text.Biggs: Copy that!

text.Jessie: Copy that!

text.Wedge: Copy that!
So how do we get back to the slums?

text.Jessie: With a little trick I've been dying to try out...

text.Biggs: Man, can't believe HQ was running an op tonight of all nights.
That or a bad omen. If they're ramping up for something, could get messy. Add it to the pile of complications to think about.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the entrance to the Plate Partition.

text.Jessie: Right, this is it! Through here and we're home free.

text.Wedge: Where exactly are we going?

text.Jessie: When we get there, you'll know! Now that I've got my blasting agent, we should have everything we need for our next mission!

text.Biggs: Sure hope so.

text.Cloud: Yeah... m-me too. For your dad's sake.

text.Biggs: Hey! What the hell, man!?

text.Jessie: Huh?

text.Wedge: Uh—Cloud was just saying how he hopes to come back and try the Midgar Special next time!

text.Jessie: Really, huh? *Cloud* said that?

text.Biggs: Sure did! Wants a whole pie to himself, isn't that right?

text.Jessie: Really... ? Well, okay then! Maybe I'll lend Mom a hand next time too!

text.Wedge: That'd be awesome!

text.Biggs: Super-duper awesome!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Plate Edge.
Upon catching up with Jessie at the end.

text.Jessie: Should be somewhere around here... Bingo! I half figured my dad got it wrong, but nope! They're here just like he said!

text.Biggs: Parachutes?

text.Wedge: Huh? Whaddya mean "half figured"!?

text.Jessie: Fifty-fifty is pretty good odds, if you ask me! This is gonna be fun!
Thanks guys. I really appreciate you coming all this way with me. And like I said before, I'd be grateful if you kept this between us until after the mission. I don't wanna... complicate things.

text.Biggs: Sure. Okay, who's ready to fly!?

text.Jessie: Me! Me!

text.Biggs: Hey Cloud—you let him down gently, alright?

text.Jessie: Wait, I almost forgot! One more thing!

text.Biggs: S-stop it! What in the hell are you trying to—

text.Jessie: Easy! You'll make us fall!

text.Biggs: Not if you do first!

text.Jessie: Swing by my place after—so I can "pay you in full."

text.Biggs: Huh!? Now!? (screams)

text.Wedge: Wait! Gimme a minute!
Why do you have to be such a hard-ass, bro?
I wish I could've done more... Just got hurt—

text.Cloud: You did enough. You took one for the team. Be proud.

text.Wedge: Yeah... ? Yeah...

text.Biggs: Feels like we're flying high these days!

text.Jessie: Now more than ever!

text.Biggs: He's a keeper all right.

text.Jessie: Yeah! Together we can take on the world!

text.Wedge: I'll head home on my own. After all, I'm only a little sore...
Aw, thanks, bro!
This way!

text.ACTION: While following Wedge.

text.Wedge: Think Jessie and Biggs made it back safe?
Cool if we check on them? We'll pass by their places anyway.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Bigg's house.

text.Wedge: Well, this is Biggs's place. I guess he hasn't made it home yet.
Hope he isn't "worst case-ing" it again. He's got a habit of overthinking things. Worrying about all the possible outcomes till his head hurts.
And when he worries, I worry. Anyway, let's head on over to Jessie's!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Jessie's house.

text.Wedge: This is where Jessie lives. Men are not allowed inside.
Lots of pretty girls trying to make it big onstage live here. So don't hang around or they might get the wrong idea.
I'm telling you this for your own good, Cloud! People around here love to gossip.

text.Cloud: They know about Jessie and Avalanche?

text.Wedge: Nah, it's all good. They think she's an actress. Oh... and one more thing, bro. It's all a game to her. Don't fall for it!
Life's a stage and love's the play!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open the door to her house.

text.Wedge: Guys aren't allowed, remember!?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Wedge's house.

text.Wedge: Hey there, Biggums, Reggie, Smalls... Brought a new friend to meet you! These little guys are on guard duty today.
Thanks for seeing me home!
S'all good, bro!

text.Cloud: It's kinda weird when you call me th—

text.Wedge: Hey, don't be scared! Deep down, he's a big softie.

text.ACTION: After the scene ends, while roaming near Wedge.

CHOICE.Wedge: Aw, I missed you too!
Oh, Biggums! Acting so tough!
And you, Reggie... You are just the cutest!
Aw, Smalls! Do you want a belly rub?
Glad to see you guys are getting along just fine!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge.

text.Wedge: Hey, bro! Wanna chill with me and the gang for a bit?
The cats, dummy. Who else? Biggumus Rex, Reginaldo, Mister Smalls...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge again.

text.Wedge: Mind checking on the others again for me? Thanks! Oh, and have a good night!

text.ACTION: Upon opening Jessie's door.

text.Jessie: Well, if it isn't Cloud Strife! Was wondering when you'd show up. Without further ado... Here you are. Thanks for stepping up, "merc." And now for the cherry on top.

text.Cloud: Okay, I get it. Mind letting me breathe?

text.Jessie: Depends. Mind coming over tomorrow night? My roommates should all be out for a while.

text.Cloud: Are you seriously that desperate? Just let go already.

text.Jessie: Only if you promise to come back tomorrow night. Deal?

CHOICE.Cloud: No promises, but I'll think it over.

CHOICE.Jessie: Really? You will!? I make a mean pizza, I'll have you know! Marche, luche, black milly, red shelly—I use only the best ingredients! Sound good?

CHOICE.Cloud: Never heard of any of that stuff.

CHOICE.Jessie: Awww, you are *so* adorable, you know that!? You just leave everything to me—it'll be great!
Ah, sorry... Little too in-your-face? I'll just have to change it up then.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Jessie: Nighty night!
Psych!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with Jessie's door again.
Upon talking to Biggs in front of his house.

text.Biggs: Oh, hey, Cloud! Survived the jump? How's Wedge?

Well, that's good to hear. Tomorrow's a really big day for all of us. When Wedge said he'd been shot, I was afraid we'd have to call off the whole damn thing. Heading topside in secret... Don't think I could've faced Barret if something had happened. But Jessie'd been acting weird and I knew I couldn't just ignore her.
She must be prepping the bomb right now. But will she be able to finish before morning? I should go and see if she needs any—
Huh? Sorry. Our chute was blown pretty far off course. It... felt like a bad omen or something... so...

text.Cloud: Get some rest. You need it.

text.Biggs: Roger.
Night. And thanks. Really.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Biggs again.

CHOICE.Biggs: Tomorrow's gonna be a success, I know it. We've all put in the work.
Lesson one for life on the ground floor. "A good long rest'll cure anything." Thanks for the refresher.
'Preciate you coming.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open Tifa's door.
Upon interacting with Cloud's bed.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Sleep until tomorrow", next day begins.

text.ACTION: After choosing to sleep until the next day.

text.Tifa: Cloud?
You were out for a while.
I ran into Johnny, by the way. Said not to worry, he was getting out of town.
You... weren't thinking of leaving Midgar anytime soon, were you?

text.Cloud: Well, seems this old friend of mine's in a tight spot... Long time ago I said I'd be there for her. Made a promise, so...

text.Tifa: Can't say this is quite what I had in mind when I put that on you way back when.

text.Cloud: If you wanna talk, I'm listening.

text.Tifa: Huh? What's with you all of a sudden?
Like you're losing that hard edge.
Not at all—I like it. Maybe Marlene won't be so scared of you next time...
I'm really glad to have you back, Cloud. Really glad.
It's pretty late, huh? I'd like to catch up more, but we should probably both get some sleep, yeah?
Good night then.

text.Sephiroth: Sleep. And dream the sweetest dreams...

text.Tifa: Cloud!
Come with me! Quickly!
We were getting ready to set out when those things showed up and came after us!
Barret and Jessie are holding their ground, but for how long I don't know...
Right.
You know it!

text.ACTION: During the battle with the Mysterious Spectres.

text.Tifa: Okay!

text.ACTION: Upon attacking a Mysterious Spectre.
Upon killing a Mysterious Spectre.
Upon killing the first group of Mysterious Spectres.
Upon killing another Mysterious Spectre.

text.Tifa: What are these things?

text.Cloud: No idea. Pretty sure you can't even see them unless they make physical contact first...

text.Tifa: And that's all you can tell me?

text.Cloud: I can tell you they're not invincible.

text.Tifa: I guess that's something.

text.ACTION: Upon running towards Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: More of them!? We're running out of time.
Yeah—over here!

text.ACTION: After following Tifa.

text.Tifa: Are they trying to stop us from reaching the others?
Cloud. This way.

text.ACTION: After running towards Seventh Heaven again.

text.Tifa: Oh, you gotta be kidding me. It's like trying to fight a hurricane.
You don't have to tell me that.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Seventh Heaven.

text.Jessie: Barret!

text.Barret: Gimme a break!

text.Tifa: Jessie! Barret!

text.Barret: Where you been!?

text.Jessie: They just keep coming! We've gotta do something!

text.Tifa: Hang on!
Cloud!

text.ACTION: Sometimes during the battle with the Enigmatic Spectre and Mysterious Spectres.

CHOICE.Jessie: Leave us alone already!
How many of them are there!?

text.ACTION: Upon defeating a Mysterious Spectre.
Sometimes if Cloud is controlled when the Enigmatic Spectre becomes pressured.
Sometimes if Tifa is controlled when the Enigmatic Spectre becomes pressured.

CHOICE.Tifa: Something weird is going on.

text.STATUS: When the Enigmatic Spectre begins Flood.

text.Tifa: What is it doing now?

text.STATUS: When the Enigmatic Spectre begins Swarm.
When the Enigmatic Spectre is down to 80% HP.

text.Tifa: So this thing's not gonna give up without a fight, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the Enigmatic Spectre.

text.Barret: How's your ammo?

text.Jessie: Running low—
Shit!

text.Tifa: Jessie!

text.Barret: Dammit!

text.Tifa: Huh?

text.Barret: Jessie!

text.Tifa: You okay?

text.Jessie: Me and my two left feet...

text.Tifa: Easy now!

text.Barret: We ain't putting on a damn show!

The hell were those things? Some kind of... I dunno! Guess I shouldn't be surprised, though. Never *can* tell what weird shit'll come crawling out of the scrap down here. It's those reactors, I'm telling you...

text.Jessie: Wish I could say it didn't, but yeah... (chuckles)
God, this is so embarrassing... Hate playing the damsel in distress...

text.ACTION: Inside Seventh Heaven.

text.Wedge: What did you do to your leg!? D-does it hurt?

text.Jessie: Not nearly as much as the fuss everyone's making.

text.Tifa: Still, I think you ought to avoid putting any—

text.Jessie: I'm fine!

text.Barret: That's enough! You're out, Jessie.

text.Jessie: Huh? What about the mission? We already sent Biggs in, remember? Don't tell me you're thinking of calling it off!?

text.Barret: Nah, we got this...

text.Jessie: The hell you do!

text.Wedge: If you need someone to step up, I'm your man! (coughs)

text.Barret: Okay... So here's the thing...
Consider it done!
Aight, everyone—Cloud's in. The mission is on!

text.Jessie: Go and raise some hell for me, okay?

text.Barret: Listen, Wedge—I need you to hang back and guard the home front.

text.Wedge: But I'm in perfect health!

text.Barret: Which makes you the perfect choice to look after Jessie and Marlene.
Let's get this show on the road... to Mako Reactor 5! Once you've got your gear in order, head to the station for the meet. Got it?
This'll help you get squared away. Don't tell me I never did nothing for ya. I'm counting on you, SOLDIER boy...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge if Cloud reached the top of the darts leaderboard.

text.Wedge: Ah, forgot to give this to you, bro. Your prize for taking the top spot on the darts leaderboard. You earned it. After you guys come back from the plate, maybe we can play a round together?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge.

CHOICE.Wedge: I'm counting on you, bro... Don't let anything happen to the others.
Good luck out there, bro. And take care.
With old Wedge in charge, this place'll be safer than ever!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie.

text.Jessie: Relegated to stagehand once again. I'm starting to think I'll never have a starring role...
What's this? Words of encouragement? (chuckles) Thanks, I need them.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie again if the player selected "No promises" in response to her on the previous day. After this, her usual lines will repeat.

text.Jessie: Hurry back now. You don't want my home-cooked pizza to get cold.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie again.

CHOICE.Jessie: If I didn't know any better, I'd swear those robed things were after *me*. Be careful out there.
Once the mission's over, you've gotta celebrate with us, alright?
Don't be a hero, okay? Just get the job done.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving Seventh Heaven.

text.Tifa: Alright, let's get going.

text.Cloud: Sure... *after* you take a deep breath.

text.Tifa: Huh?
That obvious, huh?
Okay. I'm ready now.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the guards by the gate to Sector 6.

text.New Recruit: Sir... I got my hands on tickets for the *Loveless* musical. Would you like to go with me?

text.Senior Officer: You do realize, we're on duty. The slums are Avalanche territory. Stay sharp.

text.New Recruit: Right. Sorry, sir! It's just that... never mind.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the guards again.

text.New Recruit: I heard they've deployed SOLDIER operatives, too. It's been a while since they'd done that. I wanted to be a SOLDIER, but as you can see—

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the guards again.

CHOICE.New Recruit: Oh man... A bomb threat? I'm not ready for this...
I don't know who's scarier—Avalanche or my superior.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the item vendor in the truck near the station.

CHOICE.Item Vendor: Welcome! So tell me, what's the town's favorite mercenary looking for today?
Mind if I bill the items you buy as "local merc's favorites"? They'll fly off the shelves!

text.ACTION: Upon passing Chadley near the station.

text.Chadley: Cloud. You have exceeded my expectations.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret.

text.Barret: Alright, people. Mission starts the moment we board that train. You sure you ready for this?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", proceed to next scene.

CHOICE.Barret: Well then, what're you waiting for!? Finish up so we can get going.

text.ACTION: After selecting "Yes".

text.Tifa: Do you think Biggs is... on schedule?

text.Barret: All we can do is hope...

text.Cloud: Today really gotta be the day, huh?

text.Barret: Ain't no stopping this train we're on, son. A lotta people risked their lives to get it rolling... Already put the word out more's coming, too... "Shut them all down by today, or we shut another down for you." Ain't on us. Not us...
Play it cool.

text.Announcement: This is an announcement from the Shinra Electric Power Company. The terrorist group "Avalanche" has issued another bomb threat. In response, we have raised the threat level and entered a state of heightened alert. All lines are currently experiencing delays. We anticipate that our arrival at Sector 4 will be later than scheduled.

text.Barret: The target's Mako Reactor 5. From the station, we take the backstreets. Once we're inside the facility, it's the same deal as last time.
And then *blow* it all to hell.
Let's do this one for Jessie and Wedge. They deserve it.

text.Tifa: Yeah.
I didn't think word would spread this fast. There's barely anyone on this train. And none of them look happy to be here.

text.Barret: Might stand out as a group. You two stay here.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa.

text.Tifa: Cloud.

text.Announcement: The train will be passing an ID checkpoint shortly.

text.Tifa: Here comes the first hurdle...
I know, I know. But that doesn't mean I don't have butterflies in my stomach.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa after the ID scan is complete.

text.Tifa: Hey, would you mind keeping an eye on things the next car over? I'm worried there might be trouble.
Barret's always on edge before missions, but you know he's a good guy underneath it all. The people on this train don't.
Maybe... but I won't be until I know for sure.
Thanks.

text.ACTION: Upon entering Barret's car.

text.Shinra Middle Manager: So do you *still* support those terrorists? Avalanche is a blight on Midgar. Their bomb threat has thrown our offices into chaos, let alone the reactor itself. It's total insanity! But we won't lose heart! No! Everyone at Shinra agrees. The reactor will stay online!

text.Barret: Heh. Is that right?

text.Shinra Middle Manager: What? You got a problem with that?

text.Barret: Do I have a *problem* with that? Oh, you can bet—
Hmph. Asshole...

text.Cloud: You know you're better than that.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Shinra Middle Manager.

CHOICE.Shinra Middle Manager: I know nothing more to say to you and your friend.
The Sector 4 offices got the worst of it. Everyone's panicking over there.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret.

CHOICE.Barret: Go see how Tifa's doing. She needs you more than I do.
Why don't you go check on Tifa? Quit screwing around here.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to Tifa's car.

text.Announcement: Emergency ID scan in progress.

text.Tifa: No way!

text.Announcement: Unauthorized IDs detected. Threat level: critical. Inspection and containment sweep initiated, commencing at the rear of the train.

text.Tifa: Not good!

text.Barret: Get over here! Now!

text.Tifa: Take care of them, Cloud!

text.ACTION: During the battle against Slug-Rays.

text.Announcement: Lockdown protocol initiated. This train car will enter lockdown in three minutes.

text.Tifa: You have to get to the next car!

text.Barret: Keep moving, people!
Get to car two!
You wanna survive this? Then move!

text.Tifa: Cloud!

text.Barret: Move it!

text.Announcement: Lockdown protocol initiated. This train will enter lockdown shortly.

text.STATUS: If the lockdown timer expires.

text.Announcement: Lockdown complete. One unauthorized passenger detained. Inspection will continue until all unauthorized passengers are detained.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open the door.

text.Tifa: Just go! How many are there!?

text.Announcement: Three unauthorized passengers successfully contained. Neutralizing threat.

text.Barret: We gotta jump...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the next car.

text.Tifa: Please! You have to get out of here!
Trying to keep you alive.

text.Shinra Middle Manager: But I work for Shinra. I'm the enemy.

text.Tifa: I don't care. I don't want anyone to die. Please!
My turn!

text.Announcement: Three unauthorized passengers successfully contained. Neutralizing threat.

text.Barret: Looks like you're right, SOLDIER boy.
Huh?

text.Cloud: The station will be crawling with security. We gotta jump.

text.Barret: Screw *that*!

text.Cloud: Need to slow the train down.

text.Barret: Sounds like a Biggs plan E.
Okay, y'all watch and learn. I'm gonna jump. Gonna do it. Gonna show you how it's done!

text.Tifa: Yeah...
Ready.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Slug-Rays.

text.Barret: Ha ha ha!

text.Tifa: That's gotta be him!

text.ACTION: While running towards Barret.

text.Tifa: Hey, thanks. For when we jumped from the train, I mean.

text.Cloud: No biggie. You're pretty light, you know.

text.Tifa: You always know what to say.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Slug-Rays.

text.Barret: Ha ha ha!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Tifa.

text.Tifa: They just won't quit!

text.ACTION: After defeating the enemies.

text.Barret: Ha ha ha!

text.Tifa: Whew! Thanks for the assist!

text.Cloud: Glad to see you're okay. So—where's Barret?

text.Tifa: Somewhere over there, I think.

text.ACTION: While running towards Barret.

text.Tifa: After Barret jumped, I knew I had to go right after, but...
Cool as ever, I see.

text.Cloud: If I wasn't, they would've never made me a SOLDIER.

text.Tifa: Good point.

text.ACTION: In Heidegger's office.

text.Heidegger: Well done, well done! I felt sure we had them, didn't you?

text.Subordinate: Sir!

text.Heidegger: Born survivors, these sewer rats. Speaking of which, where's the third?

text.Subordinate: In custody, sir.

text.Heidegger: Return it to the wild.

text.Subordinate: Yessir! Right away!

text.ACTION: After the scene ends.
Upon encountering the first group of enemies.

text.Security Officer: It's them! We have a visual on the targets! Requesting immediate assistance!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the end of Section C.

text.Tifa: He's close! Come on!
There! Barret!

text.Barret: Tifa! Could use some help here!

text.Tifa: We're coming!

text.Barret: Make it quick! Should be some stairs over there!

text.Tifa: We'd better hurry.

text.Barret: I've had it up to here with you damn robo-bugs! I'm gonna rip off those spindly legs of yours one by one!

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the bridge.

text.Barret: I ain't going down without a fight!

text.Tifa: That doesn't sound good!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Barret.

text.Tifa: Barret!

text.Barret: Great! Gimme a hand!

text.Grenadier: Confirmed! It's the three who jumped from the train! Don't let any of them escape!

text.ACTION: After defeating the group of enemies.

text.Barret: This calls for a song! Duhn-duhn-duhn-*duhn*, duhn duhn, *duhn*-da-*duhn*!

text.Tifa: That's gotta be the last of them... right?

text.Barret: Aw, who cares? We can take 'em! Now let's confirm our position and get back on mission! That reactor's waiting!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Barret.

text.Barret: Looks like it's gonna be plan E.

Plan A was if everything went off without a stitch. From the station, it would've been a straight shot to the reactor. Didn't work out, but we knew going in we had to have alternatives. Backup plans, 'case we had to get off early.
From closer in to further out—B, C, D, and so on.

text.Tifa: ... To E.

text.Barret: You're damn right!

text.Tifa: Anyway, we were riding the train between Sector 4 and the main pillar when we had to bail out. And we ended up on the adjacent line, which should take us to Reactor 5.

text.Barret: That's right. So for now we follow the tracks. Not too far, though. Need to switch to a different route before we hit the station. 'Cause you can bet your ass it's gonna be crawling with security—all on high alert.

text.Tifa: Let's move.

text.Barret: Our friends in Sector 5 marked the route, so don't worry about getting lost. It's a straight shot to victory, people! All we gotta do... is *take* it!

text.ACTION: In Heidegger's office.

text.Heidegger: You have nothing to worry about, sir. Preparations for the grand finale are proceeding without incident. I have the utmost confidence that everything will play out as you intended...
Yes, of course. I will not fail you, sir.

text.Subordinate: Sir. Analytics reports that the results fall within the admissible range. However, the casualty rate significantly exceeds previous proje—

text.Heidegger: Remind me what your job is. Is it to question the wisdom of your superiors and bemoan your personal hardships?

text.Subordinate: Sir?

text.Heidegger: Casualty rate? You think I care about the casualty rate? They are pawns in a greater game. If your stock runs low, then go round up more for Sector 3 or wherever else. Use your head and bring me solutions instead of problems for a change, yes?

text.Subordinate: Sir!

text.Heidegger: It is so hard to find good help these days. Which is why the president ought to count his blessings. What would he do without me? (laughs)

text.ACTION: While running down the wrong way.

CHOICE.Tifa: The reactor's the other way.

CHOICE.Barret: You got any sense of direction at all?

text.ACTION: Upon hitting a warning while running the wrong way.

text.Barret: You wanna keep going this way, you best explain yourself.

text.Tifa: I think the reactor's in the other direction.

text.ACTION: While walking down the tunnel.

text.Barret: When the time comes, remember: we just gotta follow the nose.

text.Tifa: Stamp's nose.

text.Barret: We look for graffiti, then head in whichever direction its nose points. But pay attention to railway signals too. You see blue lights, you're going the right way.

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group of Slug-Rays.

text.Barret: Follow the blue lights and we'll reach the reactor.

text.ACTION: After walking down further.

text.Barret: You gotta check the signals, son. The signals!

text.ACTION: After walking down further.

text.Barret: Biggs is way ahead of us. Jessie was gonna back him up, so it wouldn't surprise me if he needs our help. So let's not keep him waiting.

text.Tifa: Right.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering a group of Slug-Rays and an Elite Grenadier.
Upon reaching the staircase at the end of Section C.

text.Barret: There's one.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to run further down Section C off-course.

text.Barret: The hell you off to?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Barret on the staircase.

text.Barret: In nose we trust.

text.Tifa: Good things our colleagues put up all that Stamp graffiti. Without it, we'd be lost for sure.

text.ACTION: Upon taking the staircase down towards Section D.

text.Tifa: What's that?

text.Barret: Nothing good.

text.Tifa: Guys... I think it might be a nest!

text.Barret: All kinds of creepy-crawlies make themselves at home in the plate, then get messed up even more by the mako.

text.Tifa: Mako did this?

text.Barret: No. Not mako. Shinra.
What?
Ya like it, huh? You know there's room for one more.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering a Grashtrike.

text.Barret: That's disgusting!

text.ACTION: Upon descending to the bottom floor of Section E with the Queen Grastrike.

text.Tifa: More of 'em!?

text.Barret: What is this? A science experiment!?

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the Queen Grastrike.

text.Barret: What now!?

text.Tifa: It's huge!

text.Barret: So you must be the queen, huh!?

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the Queen Grashtrike.

text.Barret: I ain't no exterminator. Why I gotta kill all these nasty-ass bugs?

text.Tifa: Those things really creep me out.

text.Barret: A train's gonna get derailed by 'em one of these days.

text.Tifa: Shinra should do something.

text.Barret: After an accident they will.

text.Tifa: When it's too late then.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the staircase.

text.Barret: There's good ol' Stamp. Check his nose.

text.Tifa: This isn't bad, y'know...

text.Barret: Yeah, they really captured the essence of corporate propaganda.

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the bridge over Shinra soldiers.

text.Tifa: Check it out. I guess Shinra's doing something about those monsters after all.

text.Barret: Doing a half-assed job looks like.

text.Security Officer: Man, how'd we get such a shit detail?

text.Flametrooper: Screw it. Let's just give it a quick once-over and call it a day.

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the soldiers in battle.

text.Security Officer: How did you get in here!?
It's those three terrorists from the train!

text.Barret: Alright. Let's figure out where the hell we are.

text.ACTION: Upon running away from Barret.

text.Barret: Where you going!?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Barret by the map.

text.Barret: There's an old rail yard not far from here. What we're looking for's somewhere inside.
A secret passageway.

text.ACTION: In Heidegger's office.

text.Subordinate: We've compiled our report on Avalanche's combat capabilities and are—

text.Heidegger: Report, report, report! What good do you think a damn report will do anyone!?

text.Subordinate: I don't...

text.Heidegger: Have you already forgotten the war with Wutai? An enemy spared is an enemy who will repay your "kindness" with blood. We must crush them—thoroughly and completely, without hesitation or mercy! Shinra cannot and will not settle for anything less. Will you!?

text.Subordinate: But... but sir—

text.Heidegger: If so... I can only assume that you and your men no longer wish to serve in your current positions. Is that correct?

text.Subordinate: We'll prepare the prototype in Section E for immediate deployment. Right now, dammit!

text.Heidegger: Another day, another victory! How do I do it!? (laughs)

text.ACTION: Back with Cloud.
While walking down the track.

text.Barret: Gotta love the irony of Shinra's smarmy lapdog leading the way to its master's destruction.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering Security Officers after first taking treasure from the warehouse door.
Upon attempting to run down the right path off-course.

CHOICE.Barret: We're going to the rail yard, remember?

CHOICE.Tifa: Just so you know, this way leads to the station, not the rail yard.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the edge off-course.

text.Barret: I told you this ain't the right way!

text.ACTION: Upon taking the left path down the ramp towards the objective.

text.Tifa: You really don't like Stamp, do you, Barret?

text.Barret: It's not that I hate him. I hate the fact Shinra took a loyal animal like that and co-opted it for their own self-serving agenda.

text.Tifa: Poor old Stamp.

text.Barret: Starting to remind me of one Marlene's picture books. The one that's full of nothing but mazes...

text.Tifa: Think you're making progress and then you hit a wall.
You're starting to sound like Barret.

text.Barret: It's a good plan!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the rail yard.

text.Barret: Hey! Hold up! This way.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Barret.

text.Tifa: Security is a lot tighter than I thought it would be.

text.Barret: If they wanna stand between us and the rail yard, that's their choice.

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the Flametroopers and Sentry Launchers.

text.Flametrooper: You bastards aren't going to get away this time!

text.Barret: No getting through that gate! Let's take the stairs.

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to a corridor.

text.Barret: We should be reaching that secret passage real soon. I knew plan E wouldn't fail us. Shoulda called it "plan excellent"! Whatcha think, Mister Ex-SOLDIER?
I provided some input.
What's that s'posed to mean?

text.ACTION: Upon entering the door to a nearby storage room with a vending machine and bench.

text.Tifa: Thought this place was abandoned.

text.Barret: Guess not.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering a group of Elite Security Officers.

text.Elite Security Officer: Give it up, assholes, or we'll blow you to hell!

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the room after defeating them.

text.Tifa: So many guards.

text.Barret: Too many...

text.ACTION: Upon taking the ladder down.

text.Barret: Keep looking for faithful little Stamp. He'll lead us to the passageway.

text.ACTION: Upon finding the Stamp graffiti.
Upon approaching it.

text.Tifa: What the—!?

text.Barret: That all you got!?
Take your best shot, asshole!

text.ACTION: During the battle against Crab Warden.

text.Cloud: Huh. Looks like an old model.

text.Barret: So it's an antique.

text.Cloud: Don't underestimate it. It's slow, but it hits hard.

text.ACTION: Upon attacking its main body.

text.Barret: The hell—!? Tough bastard.

text.Tifa: What do we do?

text.Cloud: Aim for its legs. Bring it down.

text.STATUS: When the Crab Warden scans Cloud.

text.Barret: I think you've got its attention, Cloud!

text.Cloud: I'll draw its fire. You two stay on the offensive.

text.STATUS: When the Crab Warden uses Target Lock on Tifa.

text.Tifa: I think it hates me.

text.STATUS: When the Crab Warden scans Barret.

text.Barret: Hah, look at that! It's tough being Mr. Popular.

text.STATUS: When the Crab Warden uses Target Lock on a character a second time.

text.Tifa: Not again!

text.ACTION: Upon crippling one of its legs.

CHOICE.SYSTEM: You crippled the right front leg.
You crippled the right rear leg.
You crippled the left front leg.
You crippled the left rear leg.

text.ACTION: Upon staggering the Crab Warden.

text.Tifa: Hey, see that?

text.Barret: I'm guessin' we aim for that!

text.ACTION: After Crab Warden loses 25% HP.

text.Tifa: What are those?

text.ACTION: While attacking the Crab Warden when Slug-Rays are active.

text.Tifa: Get out of our way!

text.Barret: Damn! Think we gotta take these down first.
This is where I shine!

text.ACTION: After the Crab Warden is down to 30% HP.

text.Barret: That it!?

text.Tifa: Now what?

text.Barret: Thing's probably busted!

text.STATUS: When Crab Warden uses Surge.

text.Barret: What's it doing now?

text.Tifa: I think—

text.ACTION: Sometimes before it uses Surge again.
After Crab Warden's Pilot becomes targetable.

text.Barret: Shit! It's still going!

text.Tifa: Now what?

text.Cloud: Destroy the pilot! That'll expose the generator!

text.ACTION: After defeating Crab Warden.

text.Barret: And stay down!

text.Tifa: Sure.

text.Barret: Alright, this way.

text.ACTION: In Heidegger's office.

text.Heidegger: This won't do.

text.Subordinate: Sir, Analytics reports that the feed went down... after an anomaly was registered during the test.

text.Heidegger: An "anomaly"? Or an excuse for your failure to properly prepare the armor?

text.Subordinate: N-no sir! All modules were confirmed fully operational! It's far more likely—given the circumstances—that the sensors were overloaded.

text.Heidegger: Is that so?

text.Subordinate: All the sensors in Section E are... inoperable.
The president.

text.Heidegger: Yes... Yes... Everything is fine, sir. Better, even—there's been a development.
Yes... Understood, sir.
We know exactly where they were headed. If the armor is intact, then you'd best determine the nature of this anomaly soon. Should you fail to do so... You will deal with our intruders. Personally.

text.Subordinate: ... Y-yessir.

text.Heidegger: Don't worry. I treat my people more than fairly. So don't disappoint me.

text.Barret: The passage is beyond these shipping containers. Let's slip through 'em.
Talk about a tight squeeze...

text.Tifa: You okay?

text.Barret: Yeah...

text.ACTION: Upon passing through the containers.

text.Tifa: So, you bump into any giant robots like that in Reactor 1?

text.Barret: Yeah, except the bastard looked like a scorpion! Speaking of which... what would you say that last one looked like?

text.Tifa: Huh? Uh... Well...

text.ACTION: Upon taking the ladder down to the Plate Maintenance Corridor.
Upon reaching the elevator to Sector 4 Plate.

text.Barret: Lo and behold.
All aboard...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the elevator.

text.Barret: Just so you know... it's not gonna get any easier.
Through here and straight on to Reactor 5.

text.Tifa: You make it sound so simple...

text.Barret: Only 'cause it is. That there's the reactor support pillar.
After plan E comes F, G, and then H!

text.Tifa: This here is Section F.

text.Barret: We cut through Section G and head for H.

text.Tifa: A cargo platform in H will get us closer to the reactor. Biggs should be somewhere over there.
Looks like the sun's going down on Midgar...

text.Barret: Right. Double time! We got a date with a reactor.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Barret across the catwalk.

text.Barret: Nothing but air below us.

text.Tifa: Just don't look down, okay?

text.Barret: Easy for you to say.
Section G's through here, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the switch for the sun lamp.

text.Cloud: This a switch for the lamp?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa by the gate.

text.Tifa: This oughta open it.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the gate controls.

text.Tifa: No good?

text.Barret: That looks more like what we need...

text.Tifa: Let's check it out.

text.ACTION: Upon heading towards the Facility Control Room before interacting with the gate.

text.Barret: Hey. You see something over there?

text.Tifa: Maybe the gate didn't budge because there's not enough power to spare?

text.Barret: Gotta figure this out.

text.ACTION: Upon heading towards the Facility Control Room after having interacted with the gate first.

text.Tifa: Maybe no one uses that entrance.

text.Barret: I'm getting the feeling no one's come down here for a long time.

text.Tifa: No "plate inspectors," huh.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Facility Control Room terminal.

text.Announcement: Error. Insufficient power.

text.Tifa: Hey guys, look at this. Instructions for dealing with a power shortage.

text.Cloud: Kill the lights, and we free up power for the gate and other stuff.

text.Tifa: "Sun lamps"... You think these are the plate suns? The closest thing we have to the real thing.

text.Barret: Gotta put out a sun just to open a gate, huh?

text.Tifa: But if we go through with it, the grounders in Sector 4 will suffer...

text.Barret: Now or later—sun's going out for good once we blow the reactor.

text.Tifa: That's true.
All these lamps... You'd think they'd be able to balance the load by now though.

text.Barret: Maybe. If the maintenance guys or whoever weren't playing hooky.

text.Tifa: The lamps are important, but when you think about how much mako it must take to keep them running...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the No. 1 Lighting Equipment sun lamp.

text.Tifa: That's gotta be one. Man, look at the size of it.

text.Barret: That a console I see near the top of that ladder? A, uh, pretty tall ladder too.

text.Tifa: Okay. We'll wait down here.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever.

text.Console: Emergency power supply confirmed. Disengaging locking mechanisms.

text.Barret: Okay! That's that.

text.Tifa: Great job, Cloud!

text.ACTION: Upon opening the gate.

text.Barret: Next stop: Section G!

text.Tifa: Yep! And after that, Reactor 5!
Not again...

text.Barret: Great. I'm sure those things'll welcome us just as warmly as before. Tell you what, the rot runs deep in this damn pizza.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first Grashtrikes.

text.Barret: Don't mind us, y'all—just passing through!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the broken bridge.

text.Tifa: Gotta go where the catwalks take us.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching deactivated Sentry Rays.

text.Tifa: They busted?

text.Barret: Lucky us, am I right? One less thing for us to worry about.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching exhaust fumes.

text.Barret: Filling the air that we gotta breathe with their shit.

text.Tifa: Monsters sure seem to like it. What's up with that?

text.Barret: It's like in the tunnels. They get twisted by the mako. But it all goes back to Shinra.

text.ACTION: Upon taking the stairs to the lower level.
Upon defeating Grashtrikes at G - 08.

text.Barret: You know the best way to not get lost is to believe that you're not. Mind over matter.

text.Tifa: Isn't that from one of Marlene's books?

text.Barret: Yup, one of her favorites! Loves it when I read it to her before bedtime, doing all the voices.

text.Tifa: "Life in the Endless Maze," am I right? (chuckles) I remember.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to cross the passageway at Section G - Lower Level.

text.Tifa: You okay?

text.Barret: Hah. Going for that materia, weren't you?

text.Tifa: So close, and yet so far. This path's no good now.

text.Barret: I'm sure there's another way to get there.

text.Tifa: Hm... Nothing we can do but search.

text.Barret: And when we find it, we can finally snag that materia.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Upper Level.

text.Tifa: Hey, let's take a moment to get our bearings.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa.

text.Barret: We're still in G, right?

text.Tifa: Yeah. And to reach Mako Reactor 5, we need to go through Section H.
Unfortunately, I didn't spot a connecting catwalk to Section H. Did you?
