text.Barret: Well, we can always do another lap.

text.Tifa: The only other route that I can think of would be...
Up for giving it a try? It might not work out, but it's the only idea I've got.

text.Barret: So we're shooting for those giant fans over there? Okay. At least we've got a clear landmark to guide us.

text.Tifa: Those ventilation fans?

text.Barret: Keeping the plate's air clean by pushing the smog into the slums. Whole system's designed to make shit roll downhill faster.

text.ACTION: Upon backtracking to lower levels.

text.Tifa: You lost?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the ventilation fans.

text.Tifa: Hey, look! I think we can climb onto that pipe!

text.Barret: Dammit.
I feel no fear... yeah, no fear... no fear... no fear... no fear... no fear—little fear!

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the ladder by the pipe.

text.Barret: Hey guys, uh... you know, these fans are really loud and...
Hell no! I'm just worried that your bony ass is gonna get blown off the side and shit!

text.Tifa: Enough. We gotta keep moving.

text.Barret: O-okay then! Follow me!

text.ACTION: While walking across the fan.

text.Barret: No worse than a windy day, huh?

text.Tifa: One with a tornado warning maybe. Don't look at the fan! Whatever you do!

text.Barret: Right.

text.ACTION: Upon crossing to the other end.

text.Tifa: Made it through in one piece.

text.Barret: Think that took a couple years off my life. I—I mean, uh, not really! Couple seconds maybe. Three tops!

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the catwalk on the Section H Utility Access to the cargo platform.

text.Tifa: Section H is just up ahead! Slow and steady, guys.
The cargo platform? Yeah, I'm pretty sure that's the one.

text.ACTION: Upon moving the camera toward the ventilation fan while crossing.

text.Tifa: Hey, what's that behind the fan over there?

text.Barret: Hey! Don't be a dumbass! Tifa told you not to look at the fan!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Section H Utility Access platform.

text.Barret: This is it. The cargo platform Biggs was talking about. Let's not keep him waiting.

text.Announcement: Error. Insufficient power.

text.Barret: You're kidding me.

text.Cloud: Needs three light's worth, looks like.

text.Tifa: But that's... That's all of them, isn't it?

text.Barret: All or nothing...

text.Tifa: Let's regroup here if we get lost. Remember the H-01 sign.

text.Barret: Lessee now... Closest light oughta be...

text.Tifa: "By the light of these magnificent lamps... we shall lead our brothers and sisters of the undercity to a brighter future."

text.Barret: Say what?

text.Tifa: It's from a speech President Shinra gave talking about the importance of the sun lamps.

text.Barret: Brighter future, my ass. Shinra's leading us down a one-way path to darkness and death.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to use a moving platform before deactivating two sun lamps.

text.Announcement: Error. Insufficient power.

text.Cloud: Gotta power down a sun lamp first.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the first sun lamp.

text.Tifa: Look! There's the switch.

text.Barret: Let's flip it and go.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever.

text.Announcement: Rerouting power. Please wait.

text.Tifa: That's one down.

text.Barret: Only two more lights to go.

text.Announcement: Reinitializing intrusion prevention system.

text.Tifa: "Intrusion prevention"?

text.Barret: No need to fret, y'all. A few rusted mechs ain't gonna keep us from reaching the reactor.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching inactive turrets.

text.Announcement: Intruders detected. Engaging countermeasures.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the first group of inactive turrets.

text.Barret: Hey, Cloud! Hang back while I deal with these pests.

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Tifa: Just made our lives a lot harder.

text.Cloud: We restored power to more than just security, remember?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with a control terminal for the catwalks.

text.Tifa: We can move this catwalk!

text.ACTION: Upon moving the catwalk again.

text.Barret: Think back. Anybody see a connecting catwalk?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the second sun lamp area.

text.Barret: Which way to the next light?

text.Tifa: If we can't make sense of this place we're gonna get lost.

text.Barret: Well at least we know where the big-ass things are.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever for the second sun lamp.

text.Barret: And that makes two lights down.

text.Tifa: Meaning we've only got one left.

text.Barret: The end's in sight, y'all!

text.Cloud: Should be able to climb down from here.

text.Barret: This'll hold, right?

text.Cloud: That the Sector 4 slums down there?

text.Tifa: Huh? You wanna check them out sometime? I can show you around.

text.Barret: We'll check them out now if we fall!

text.ACTION: Upon taking the small platform to the starting position.

text.Tifa: You think they'll miss those three plate suns?

text.Barret: I say the real sun's the only one we need! To hell with Shinra and their night-lights.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to the starting position.

text.Tifa: We're right back where we started. Hmm... Where was that last light again?

text.ACTION: Upon taking the platform to Sun Lamp 3.

text.Tifa: Almost done. It's a shame we had to wander around so much.

text.Barret: Well. No Stamps here to guide us. No Jessie or Wedge to back us up neither.

text.Tifa: Yeah... Speaking of which, what should we tell Biggs? I don't want him to worry.

text.ACTION: Upon taking the ladder down to the lower level.

text.Barret: Uhh, you takin' a detour? Well, aight then.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal on the middle level to control the catwalk.

text.Barret: If there's no viable path, we'll just have to make one.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever for the third sun lamp.

text.Tifa: And that makes three. Enough to finally get our cargo platform moving.

text.Barret: Okay! Let's head on back to the H-01 sign.

text.Tifa: I hope that Jessie's injury isn't anything serious.

text.Barret: The best thing you can do to speed her recovery is to kick Shinra ass in her stead.

text.Tifa: I know. I know. And Cloud's gotta cover for Wedge too.

text.ACTION: Upon taking the platform to return to H-01.

text.Cloud: When do we link up with Biggs?

text.Barret: Soon enough, don't you worry.

text.Tifa: He knew we might be late, so he came up with a few ways to kill time.

text.Barret: Oughta reach him long before he dies of boredom.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to H-01.

text.Tifa: And we're back at the cargo platform.

text.Barret: Get ready, Mako Reactor 5. We're coming.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the cargo platform with all three lamps deactivated.

text.Announcement: Auxiliary power supply confirmed. Reactivating cargo platform.
Cargo platform activated. Awaiting input.

text.Barret: So long, underplate. I hate you too.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to take the platform from H-01 towards the ventilation fan before deactivating two lamps.

text.Announcement: Error. Insufficient power.

text.Tifa: We need to disable a lamp first.

text.ACTION: Upon taking the platform from H-01 towards the ventilation fan.

text.Barret: Where could they be going... ? Embarking on an adventure to find some treasure!?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the ventilation maintenance control room.

text.Announcement: Ventilation system service mode active. Access maintenance terminal to complete procedure.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal.

text.Tifa: We stop it?

text.Announcement: Switching ventilation system to maintenance mode. Please complete the maintenance access procedure within the designated time limit.

text.Barret: Man, what are we even doing?

text.ACTION: Upon failing to deactivate the fans within the time limit.

text.Announcement: Error. Error. Maintenance access procedure not completed within time limit. Reactivating ventilation system.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to deactivate the fans after failing the time limit.

text.Announcement: Access denied. Ventilation system is currently active.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal to deactivate the fans.

text.Announcement: Access granted. Disengaging time lock.

text.Barret: What?

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the Chocobo & Moogle Materia.

text.Barret: This is summoning materia!

text.Tifa: Wow...

text.Barret: What kind of badass will pop outta this one?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal to move the cargo platform.

text.Tifa: Wonder what the reactor's like.

text.Barret: Dark. Dismal. A slaughterhouse where they butcher the planet. Then there's the smell. The mako. Be ready for it.

text.Tifa: Right...

text.Barret: Hear that, guys? It's the reactor calling us. Beckoning us, saying "Bring it on, Avalanche."

text.ACTION: Upon crawling through the duct in Plate Partition - Interior.

text.Tifa: Even after all that fighting, no one's coming for us?

text.Cloud: No need. This is Shinra's city. They probably have cameras everywhere.

text.Tifa: Why didn't you say something sooner?

text.Cloud: Way too late to bail now.

text.Barret: It's like walking a tightrope. When you're on it, only two ways off.

text.Tifa: Better keep my balance.
I wonder.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the first ladder inside the Plate Partition - Interior.

text.Tifa: It's nothing. Just thinking about the next step. Didn't think I'd be this nervous.

text.Barret: Some things you never get used to.

text.Tifa: Yeah.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the end of the path.

text.Biggs: Mercy!
Wait... Cloud? Where's Jessie and Wedge?

text.Barret: Report.

text.Biggs: Topside's going nuts after some terrorists jumped off a train. Nice and quiet here, though. So quiet I had no trouble securing your route into the reactor.

text.Barret: You magnificent son of a bitch, bring it in!

text.Biggs: So—where are the others?

text.Tifa: Jessie got hurt and couldn't make it.

text.Biggs: Bad?

text.Barret: Not so bad she couldn't rope in this guy.

text.Biggs: Thanks for stepping up.
Worked out pretty good, you picking that train you did. While Shinra scours Sector 4... You can waltz right on into Sector 5. It's a bit of a squeeze, but it ought to get you where you need to go.

text.Barret: Little dark and foreboding for my taste...

text.Biggs: Beggars can't be choosers. Oh—and you'll be needing your grappling guns, of course. All set?

text.Barret: Ready to take on the world and then some!

text.Tifa: Make sure everyone gets clear, okay?

text.Biggs: Will do!

text.Barret: Okay, y'all. Keep these grappling guns close. Secure 'em to your belt or whatever so you don't lose 'em. When we're done, we'll be using these babies to get down safe. All of us.

text.ACTION: At President Shinra's office.

text.Security Officer: More to the left. Left! Hurry it up!

text.Heidegger: Quickly now. Quickly!

text.ACTION: In Mako Reactor 5.

text.Barret: That's it. That's the smell. This place reeks of mako.

text.Tifa: Looks like we made it.

text.Barret: Layout's the same as Reactor 1?
Let's move.

text.ACTION: Upon running to the edge of the Perimeter Passageway.

text.Barret: I'm not seeing a way down...

text.Tifa: Here maybe?

text.Barret: Well now! That could work.
I'm next.

text.ACTION: Upon sliding down the pipe.

text.Tifa: Kinda scary, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon running through the armory.

text.Barret: Hey! Check it out. They sic this big boy on us, we'd be screwed six ways from Sunday.

text.Cloud: Mechanized units like these were designed to take out giant monsters. Probably a new prototype. If they do decide to deploy it, then our best bet would be to run like hell.

text.Barret: Then let's hope he sleeps through the explosion.

text.ACTION: Upon walking through the hallway at the end of the armory.

text.Tifa: Where is everybody?

text.Barret: You mean Shinra? Got spooked and cleared out, is my guess.

text.ACTION: Upon taking the ladder down.

text.Tifa: Almost there...
The smell... It takes me back...

text.ACTION: Upon encountering two Sweepers and Laser Cannons.

text.Tifa: Guys!

text.Barret: Well, well! What we got here!?
I can deal with those things!

text.ACTION: Upon descending further after defeating them.

text.Tifa: So... it was like this last time?

text.Barret: Little more chaotic—ain't that right?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bottom floor of mako storage.
Upon approaching the core.

text.Tifa: Sephiroth... SOLDIERs... Mako... Shinra...
I'm sick of this! I'm sick of all of this!

text.Barret: Hey! SOLDIER boy!

text.Tifa: What?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the core.

text.Barret: Got all the time in the world. This one comes with a remote detonator.

text.Tifa: Courtesy of Jessie.

text.Barret: We withdraw to a safe distance—then... kaboom!
What? No such thing?
We get out the same way we got in. Let's double back.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the ladder.

text.Barret: What the—Where you goin'!?

text.Tifa: Wait a minute. Is someone watching us?

text.Heidegger: Greetings, my dear sewer rats! As architect of our populace engagement campaign, I, Heidegger, head of Public Security... bid you welcome.

text.Barret: The chief warmonger.

text.Heidegger: You should be flattered. Right now, you command the undivided attention of every soul in Midgar.

text.Tifa: What is this!?

text.Announcer (Anchor): Breaking news from Mako Reactor 5. Shinra has confirmed the reactor to be the target of the bomb threat issued by the terrorist group Avalanche. Members of the group were observed entering the facility, and security is currently sweeping it for explosive devices. We now go live to the scene...

text.Reporter: I'm here in the Sector 5 undercity. Having confirmed the terrorists' target... the Shinra Emergency Operations Center has issued an evacuation advisory. Residents are outraged that the tragedy of Mako Reactor 1 was only the first attack... in a campaign of violence.

text.NPC (Male 4): No more bombings! No more bombings!

text.Announcer (Anchor): President Shinra has issued a statement providing assurances that the terrorists will soon be brought to justice.

text.Heidegger: And so, to a people beset by chaos and uncertainty, we will offer the finest comfort: bread and circus!

text.Barret: The big boy!

text.Heidegger: I give you Shinra's latest triumph of technology! The airbuster! Your executioner! (laughs)

text.Subordinate: Engineering on the line. Currently, the airbuster is only sixty percent operational. The estimates were optimistic...

text.Heidegger: I'm on air!
To the imbecile in charge down there—you are hereby ordered to seize those intruders and bring them to me!

text.Elite Shock Trooper: Come quietly or there'll be trouble!

text.Barret: Shhh.

text.ACTION: During battle against the Shock Troopers and Elite Shock Trooper.

text.Heidegger: Attention all security forces! I repeat—you are to bring the insurgents to the command center without further delay. What's Engineering's progress on getting that airbuster operational?
... Still only sixty percent!? Bullshit! I swear, if you fail me, I'll throw you off the plate myself! So get it done already!

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Barret: Shut the hell up!

text.Tifa: I don't believe it... We played right into Shinra's hands!

text.Barret: Yeah. And their bullshit news is already peddling their false narrative.

text.Tifa: So we're screwed.

text.Barret: No no no no no! Hell no! Listen! They wanna turn this into a spectacle? Then I say let's give 'em one! Let's take down Shinra's big-ass mech in front of everybody!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the facilities.
Upon entering the B8 Facilities.

text.Security Officer (1): You heard the man! Get these components prepped for the airbuster ASAP!

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies at the B8 Facilities.

text.Barret: All clear! Now let's see what these bastards were up to...

text.Tifa: Barret, Cloud! Over here!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining a keycard before interacting with a component console.

text.Barret: Huh? Find something?
You think!? Nice work!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal to leave the room before removing a component.

text.Tifa: You really that impatient, Cloud?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal by Tifa.

text.Tifa: It looks like a few of its components are still in transit...

text.Barret: We'll see about that.

text.Cloud: Could tamper a little with its loadout...

text.Tifa: And give ourselves an edge?

text.Cloud: There should be a console somewhere...

text.Barret: This the console you talking about?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with a component console.

text.Barret: Think you can get it to work?

text.STATUS: If Cloud has no keycard.

text.Barret: Well, let's find it then!

text.STATUS: If Cloud has a keycard.

text.Barret: Try that keycard of yours.

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining a keycard after interacting with the console first.

text.Tifa: You find it?

text.Barret: Good job! Now, let's check out that console.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the console with the keycard.

text.Tifa: "M units," huh? I'm guessing that's some sort of component?

text.Cloud: Yep. An enhancement powered by liquefied materia.

text.Barret: Sounds bad.

text.Cloud: Pretty sure I can divert this unit for disposal.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "No".

text.Barret: What the hell? You got a better plan or something?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes" and disposing of an M unit.
Upon disposing of a component through a console adjacent to Barret.

CHOICE.Barret: Serves y'all right!
Heidegger's got no idea who he's messing with!
Just imagining their faces when they find out...

text.ACTION: After the M unit is disposed.

text.Tifa: So far so good.

text.Barret: Right. Let's move!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the console to leave B8 Facilities.

text.Tifa: You think they're watching us? Even now?

text.Cloud: Yep. Probably got a live feed.

text.Barret: Nothing we can do about it... 'cept smile for the folks at home.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the B7 Facilities.

text.Engineering Officer: Copy. We've lost contact with B8. Send some men to check it out. We've got a schedule to keep!

text.Security Officer: Engineering, this is B7! We've got hostiles! Requesting backup!

text.Engineering Officer: Negative B7, airbuster prep is priority. You're on your own!

text.Security Officer: Then we'll deal with you ourselves!

text.ACTION: After defeating the enemies at B7 Facilities.

text.Tifa: Looks like there's two consoles this time.

text.Barret: Hah! Double the sabotage!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining a keycard.

text.Tifa: Any cards?
Two choices, and only one single-use card... It's up to you, Cloud.

text.ACTION: Upon first interacting with the left console at B7 Facilities.

text.Barret: Console talks about big bomber shells. You acquainted?

text.Cloud: We called 'em BBs. One's enough to blow you to hell and back.

text.Barret: Could divert them and give it a couple less shots to take out.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "No", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Yes" and disposing of a big bomber shell.

text.Console: Big bomber shell flagged for disposal.

text.ACTION: Upon first interacting with the right console at B7 Facilities.

text.Tifa: What does an "AI programming core" do?

text.Cloud: Increases processing power dedicated to motor function computation. Makes it move real quick.

text.Tifa: A "real quick" giant robot, huh? That doesn't sound good. Anyway, we should weigh our options carefully.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "No", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Yes" and disposing of a programming core.
Upon disposing of a component through a console adjacent to Tifa.

CHOICE.Tifa: Yeah. That'll do.
That should slow them down some.

text.ACTION: Upon discarding either component on B7 Facilities.

text.Tifa: So, where did we send the discarded stuff?

text.Cloud: To a storeroom for defective equipment, I'm guessing.

text.Barret: That so... You think these defective shells and programming cores might be valuable enough to warrant a little... detour?
I say we grab 'em.

text.Cloud: Hmph. If we get that far.

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to leave the B7 Facilities.

text.Barret: Okay! Listen up, y'all! Everything Shinra has told you is a goddamn lie! Mako is the lifeblood of our planet! Those greedy bastards are bleeding it dry! Y'all gotta rise up—

text.Tifa: Barret!? Who are you talking to?

text.Barret: The people! Put me on TV, I'mma drop some truth!

text.Cloud: Thousand gil says they cut the sound.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the B6 Facilities.

text.Security Officer: Engineering, this is B6—enemy contact! Enemy contact!

text.Engineering Officer: Shit! We can't afford any more delays. You need to keep those components coming—do whatever it takes!

text.Security Officer: Solid copy. B6 will hold the line!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the enemies at B6 Facilities.

text.Barret: Piece o' cake!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the keycard in B6 Facilities.

text.Tifa: Find any cards?

text.Cloud: Only one. And this time we've got three choices...

text.Tifa: Take your pick.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with a console for M units on B6.

text.Barret: Hell is this?

text.Cloud: M unit. Another type of enhancement.

text.Barret: Your call if you wanna nix it.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with a console for big bomber shells.

CHOICE.Barret: Feel like scrapping some BBs? Hurry up and decide what you wanna get rid of. It's past time we taught Shinra a lesson!
Big bomber shells. We should divert them if you think it'll improve our odds.
From what you said, even one big bomber shell is too many. But I'll let you be the judge of that.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with a console for AI programming cores.

CHOICE.Tifa: AI programming core... Hmm... What are you thinking, Cloud? Should we get rid of it?
An AI programming core. Should we discard this or something else?
AI programming cores help it move faster, right? Divert it or not?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the console to leave the room.

text.Barret: I tell you what, I ain't never looked forward to an execution more in my entire life!

text.Tifa: You don't say.

text.Barret: We're about to make fools outta Shinra while the whole damn city's watching! (chuckles) Times like these you gotta savor!

text.Tifa: Oh no—if you're about to ask me to dance, then don't.

text.Barret: C'mon, don't be shy! How 'bout you, Cloud?

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to B5 Facilities.

text.Engineering Officer: B5, this is Engineering. You need to pick up the pace—we're running dangerously low on components because of those terrorists!

text.ACTION: After defeating enemies at the B5 Facilities.

text.Barret: Buncha pushovers. C'mon, y'all. Let's see what kinda mischief they were getting up to.

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining a keycard at the B5 Facilities.

text.Cloud: Four consoles. And never enough keycards...

text.ACTION: After using all keycards to disable components.

text.Tifa: Think we've done enough to weaken the robot?

text.Cloud: All that we can, at least.

text.Barret: It's all good. The stage is set—all that's left is to hijack Heidegger's show!

text.ACTION: Upon using the console to leave the room.

text.Barret: We're coming up on the exit. Tifa—detonator still in range?

text.Tifa: We should be good.

text.Barret: The moment big boy goes down, you hit that switch.

text.Tifa: Right.

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to the hallway to the armory.

text.Barret: Can't say we didn't prepare. Now we just gotta get it done!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the armory, where XXX is either "BBs" or "AI cores" depending on which the player removed more of.

text.Security Officer: We're short on XXX, but tracking down replacements!

text.Engineering Officer: Work faster! Or you'll hear it from the brass!

text.Barret: Look! They're still preppin' it!

text.Engineering Officer: They're here! Hold 'em back! Buy us every second you can!

text.ACTION: During the following battle.

text.Heidegger: What is the status of my airbuster? Report!

text.Engineering Officer: I'm sorry, sir. We're going to need more time! The terrorists have breached the room and are engaging our forces. At this rate, there's no telling when we'll have it fully operational!

text.Heidegger: As expected. Deploy it at once!

text.Engineering Officer: But sir, it's not ready yet!

text.Heidegger: That was an order!

text.Engineering Officer: Understood. Prepare the airbuster for immediate deployment!

text.Barret: Shit! We too late?

text.Engineering Officer: That's far enough, you bastards! I'm taking you down!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the officers.

text.Barret: Y'all never had a chance!

text.Tifa: Hey, guys.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa.

text.Tifa: Looks like a performance assessment, don't you think?

CHOICE.STATUS: If more AI cores were removed.

CHOICE.Tifa: Reduced response time... Should work in our favor.

CHOICE.STATUS: If more big bomber shells were removed.

CHOICE.Cloud: We'll figure out its weaknesses as we fight it. As long as we stay focused, we'll be fine. We can do this.

CHOICE.STATUS: If three M-Units, one AI core, and two BB shells were removed.

CHOICE.Cloud: We definitely took it down a peg or two… Yeah, I'd give us a fighting chance.

text.Barret: For real, though, we need to talk victory poses. Something coordinated for the live, on-camera finish! Could blow up big—start a new trend!

text.ACTION: After the conversation ends.

text.Barret: Huh. No way up?

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave the armory.

text.Barret: Damn near gave me a heart attack!

text.ACTION: After defeating the Cutter.

text.Barret: Bastard cleared the way for us.
We were gonna spring the trap anyway!

text.ACTION: Upon walking past the airbuster on the way up.

text.Barret: Big boy's going to an execution all right. We're gonna put him out of his misery while the whole damn city watches!

text.Tifa: We give it our all and we'll win!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the elevator.

text.Barret: We're gonna get through this. We're gonna make it home. All of us. No exceptions.

text.Tifa: Right. We don't wanna disappoint Marlene.
That goes for you too, Cloud. Right?

text.Barret: You'd better give her a big ol' smile this time.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the console to leave the reactor.

text.Barret: What? Open it already!

text.Tifa: Is there any way we can get it open?

text.Cloud: Yeah. From that room over there.

text.Barret: Why does everything have to be so damn complicated... ?

text.Cloud: You know, the faulty equipment storeroom's that way too.

text.Tifa: Do you think we'll find the components we diverted there?

text.Barret: It's like a treasure vault! Hoo, I like the sound of that!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the lock terminal.

text.Tifa: So how do we do this?

text.Cloud: It's simple, really. We move the levers at the same time.

text.Tifa: Got these ones.

text.Barret: I'll take left. Which just leaves right, SOLDIER boy.

text.ACTION: Upon beginning the lock terminal disabling minigame.

text.Announcement: Emergency lockdown is currently in effect.

text.Tifa: So we need to synchronize our movements?

text.Barret: In that case, follow my lead.
Fine! Have it your way!

text.Tifa: Okay, pay attention, you two...

text.ACTION: Beginning the lock countdown.

text.Tifa: Three, two, one...

text.ACTION: Upon failing the command.

CHOICE.Barret: I'm, uh, still getting warmed up!
Shit!
Mother...

CHOICE.Tifa: No good. Let's try again.
Don't rush it!
Um... Breathe when I breathe!

CHOICE.Barret: No need to grip it so hard!
Hey, are you even trying?

text.ACTION: Upon failing after multiple attempts, immediately after a normal response.

CHOICE.Barret: Got an idea! Seventh seventh heaven heaven hoo-ah! Seventh seventh heaven heaven hoo-ah!
How 'bout this then? Seveeenth heaven! Heaven! Heaven!

CHOICE.Tifa: We're doing it my way! Three, two, one...

CHOICE.Barret: How 'bout a chant to help us time it right? Aaa-vaaa-lanche!

CHOICE.Tifa: This is exhausting!

CHOICE.Barret: Hey, I think I should lead after all. Five... four... three-two-one-go!

text.ACTION: Upon restarting the countdown after a failed attempt.

CHOICE.Tifa: We got this. Three, two, one...
Shake it off. Three, two, one...
Focus! Three, two, one...
Let's just get through this. Three, two, one...

text.ACTION: Upon successfully disabling the lock.

text.Announcement: Emergency lockdown—disengaged.

text.STATUS: If there were many failures.

text.Tifa: Thank god...

text.Barret: How the hell we made it through with dumbass here, I'll never know.

text.Cloud: We really are in sync. Took the words right outta my mouth.

text.Barret: What did you say!?

text.Tifa: Okay, that's it. Let's go.

text.STATUS: If there were a few failures.

text.Barret: Gotcha!

text.Tifa: Now that is what I call teamwork!

text.STATUS: If there were no failures.

text.Barret: Hell yeah! (laughs)

text.Tifa: We really did it! Great timing—right on the money!

text.ACTION: After successfully disabling the first lock.

text.Barret: Whatcha'll got tucked away in that vault, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the waste storage room terminal before disabling the first lock.

text.Barret: Wait. That our priority?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the waste storage room terminal.

text.Barret: This would be the treasure vault?

text.Tifa: What's the catch?

text.Cloud: Need to bypass a high-level security lock.

text.Barret: Different from the other one?

text.Cloud: Same deal, but we gotta do it several times.

text.Barret: Hah. Not a problem!

text.Tifa: Yeah, let's try!

text.ACTION: Upon beginning the lock terminal disabling minigame.

text.Announcement: Delta-level security lockdown is currently in effect.

text.Tifa: Okay, guys. You know what we have to do.

text.Barret: Copy me?
Oh, fine! After you, girl.

text.ACTION: Beginning the countdown for the first lock.

text.Tifa: Gotta get past level one first, right? Three, two, one...

text.ACTION: Upon failing, and repeat attempts, dialogue is the same as the previous mission.
Upon successfully disabling the first lock.

text.Announcement: Alpha-level security—disengaged.

text.Tifa: That was great, you guys! Let's keep it up!

text.ACTION: Upon successfully disabling the second lock.

text.Announcement: Beta-level security—disengaged.

text.Tifa: Wow! Think we've got this?

text.Barret: Hell yeah, bring it on! Ain't nothing I love more than sticking it to Shinra!

text.ACTION: Beginning the countdown for the third lock.

text.Tifa: Halfway there. Steady, guys. Three, two, one...

text.ACTION: Upon successfully disabling the third lock.

text.Announcement: Gamma-level security—disengaged.

text.Tifa: No way! You guys are naturals!

text.ACTION: Beginning the countdown for the final lock.

text.Tifa: Okay, final round. Don't lose focus. Three, two, one...

text.ACTION: Upon successfully disabling the final lock.

text.Announcement: Delta-level security—disengaged. Disposal room now accessible.

text.ACTION: Upon successfully disabling all locks with many failures.

text.Tifa: Finally. I was beginning to think it'd never end.

text.Barret: Ayo, Cloud, what's the deal? You really a bona fire SOLDIER?

text.Cloud: We didn't train for this stuff.

text.Barret: All that marching with no rhythm? How did you SOLDIER on?

text.Tifa: Okay, that's enough of that. Let's see what's inside.

text.ACTION: Upon successfully disabling all locks with a few failures.

text.Barret: Take that, Shinra? Makin' us jump through hoops to steal your shit...

text.Tifa: Didn't take as long as I expected! Good work guys!
I put my heart and soul into those countdowns...

text.ACTION: Upon successfully disabling all locks with no failures.

text.Barret: Boo-yah! Bet all the Shinra suits watching enjoyed that!

text.Tifa: You guys were great!
I swear, your timing was perfect. It's almost like... you could read my mind. SOLDIERs can't do that, can they?
Thank god.

text.Barret: C'mon, you two, let's see what we got.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever in the waste recovery room and obtaining items.

text.Tifa: Score! It's just like Cloud said!

text.Barret: They say a job well done's its own reward... I say take everything that ain't nailed down!

text.ACTION: Upon leaving through the gate.

text.Barret: All right, time to go!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the end of the walkway.

text.Tifa: Look!

text.Barret: President Shinra?

text.President Shinra: Oho. The eyes of one who has bathed in mako... Which would make you... a SOLDIER?

Once a SOLDIER, always a SOLDIER. Though not, alas, for very long. Accelerated cellular degradation being the most common cause of death by far. This is classified, of course, but every SOLDIER knows the truth.

text.Barret: Think you forgettin' someone!?

text.President Shinra: Would that I could. You strike me as the type to go on without end.

text.Barret: Ain't enough hours in the day to hold you to account for all your crimes!

text.President Shinra: And what a wasteful indulgence it would be even if there were.

text.Barret: Oh, okay then... Let's talk about wasteful indulgences. What is mako? The lifestream! The lifeblood of the planet—our planet! But Shinra keeps on slurping it up like a thirsty dog! Whadda you think's gonna happen if you don't stop, huh!?

text.President Shinra: We do indeed keep on "slurping it up," as you say... But... for whose benefit, I wonder. The true nature of mako is known to one and all, yet the people willfully turn a blind eye to the cost. As you must surely be aware?

text.Barret: Don't you dare try to put this on us! If anyone's going along with your plans... it's 'cause you brainwashed 'em!

text.President Shinra: Such methods are beneath me. As are you, my faithful sewer rats. Henceforth allies of wicked Wutai, our sworn enemy. Thank you for stoking our people's patriotic fever.

text.Barret: Wutai? The hell we are?

text.Heidegger: You still don't understand your role in this.

text.Barret: What are they doin'!?

text.Heidegger: Don't you see? You fools were never in control. Never anything but pawns in our plans to sell great and glorious war to the people! And your instruments of insurrection will detonate—when we so choose!

text.Barret: Goddammit!

text.Heidegger: Now let us raise the curtain on our main event! The trial of the eco-extremist group "Avalanche"! Terrorists who conspired with Wutai against Midgar! Your guilt is undeniable! Your punishment: death!

text.Tifa: I'm sick of this. I'm sick of all of this!

text.Cloud: *It's just like... like when I failed you.*

text.Barret: Cloud! Get your head in the game! We're counting on you, man.

text.STATUS: When the battle against Airbuster begins.

text.Heidegger: Sewer rats of Avalanche, pawns of Wutai! The people of Midgar will now see you for the cowards you are!

text.Tifa: Cloud, are you all right?

text.Cloud: I'm fine, You guys good to go?

text.Barret: As good as I'll ever be!

text.ACTION: Throughout the battle.

CHOICE.Heidegger: To fan the flames of hatred, you need a suitably spectacular display!
Now, let me hear you scream!
You struggle in vain against the airbuster. Shinra's advanced weapons are unstoppable!
You sewer rats are truly pathetic!
Yes, that's it! Very good. Now you will learn what happens to all those who oppose Shinra.
Writhe and squirm for me! You didn't think your deaths would be quick, did you?
Enjoying your time with Shinra's new weapon?
I have toyed with you three for long enough. Now I shall watch you die screaming!
This data will prove most useful!
It's almost time for the grand finale! You will burn like the reactors you so hate!
Insolent fools! You brought this torment upon yourselves by opposing us!
How does it feel to hear your friends cry out in agony?

text.ACTION: After Airbuster stuns Cloud.

text.Tifa: Cloud? What'd it do to you?

text.Barret: Dammit! Big boy means business!

text.ACTION: After Airbuster loses 25% HP.

text.Heidegger: Commencing phase two of the combat trial. You've seen but a fraction of this machine's true capabilities!

text.STATUS: When Airbuster first uses Tankbuster.

text.Heidegger: Tankbuster ready to fire! Now, show me how fast you can run!

text.ACTION: After Airbuster first uses Tankbuster.

text.Barret: Damn, that thing's powerful!

text.Tifa: That was too close...

text.Cloud: We need to come up with a plan.

text.STATUS: When Airbuster deploys its arms.

text.Heidegger: Your efforts are futile. It'll chase you to the edge of the world if need be.

text.Tifa: I hate when they do that!

text.Cloud: Let's take care of them first.

text.ACTION: After crippling one of its arms.

text.Heidegger: Hmph! I hope this isn't the end for you three. I was looking forward to a battle against worthy opponents.

text.Cloud: Now we can finally take it down!

text.ACTION: After Airbuster loses 50% HP.

text.Heidegger: Behold the full potential of the airbuster!
Time to carry out your executions!

text.Cloud: Damn, all those drones. Time to do your thing, big man.

text.Barret: Watch and learn! Just make sure you got my back, all right?

text.STATUS: When Airbuster approaches the walkway.

text.Tifa: Yep! I hear you loud and clear!

text.STATUS: When Airbuster moves away from the walkway again.

text.Barret: Let me show ya how it's done!

text.STATUS: When Airbuster returns to the walkway.

text.Tifa: Right! Give it all you've got!

text.STATUS: When Airbuster uses Tankbuster in its final phase.

text.Heidegger: And now for the grand finale! The tankbuster is ready to be deployed!

text.STATUS: When Airbuster loses 90% HP.

text.Heidegger: My dearest Avalanche. My apologies, but it is time that we part ways. This footage will prove invaluable in raising the morale of our Shinra rank and file. (laughs)

text.Cloud: We almost got this. Come on, guys!

text.Tifa: Bring it on!

text.Barret: Let's show 'em what we're made of!

text.STATUS: When Airbuster uses Tankbuster while on low HP.

text.Tifa: Again!?

text.ACTION: After defeating Airbuster.

text.Barret: We don't have long to get clear!

text.Cloud: Take Tifa, and get outta here!

text.Barret: I... I was wrong aboutchya—

text.Cloud: This ain't the end of the line for you *or* me!

text.Tifa: Cloud!

text.Barret: C'mon!

text.ACTION: In Cloud's mind.

text.Cloud: *Made it through with just a couple of scraped knees back then... *
*Never mind about that. Right now, you need to focus on yourself. Move something, anything.*
*Good. Easy does it. Slow... and steady... *

text.Aerith: Hello?

text.Cloud: Hey, uh... Who are you? Who are you!?

text.Sephiroth: I am... your everything.

text.Aerith: Hello in there!

text.Sephiroth: Oh, Cloud. There's still so much to be done.

text.ACTION: In the Sector 5 Slums Church.

text.Aerith: Maybe you're *not* okay...
Ah, he lives! Finally awake, are we?
Aerith. It's Aerith. And you are... ?
Nice to meet you again.
What? You don't remember? What about... the flowers?

text.Cloud: Ohhh... The flower girl. And this is... ?

text.Aerith: An old church in the Sector 5 slums. You came crashing through the roof without so much as a "look out below." Fell right into my flower bed. Lucky for you. Like, really.
Don't worry about it. They're a lot tougher than they look. This place... It has a kind of power.
Before I forget—you dropped this when you landed.
I've got one too.

text.Cloud: You and everybody and their mother.

text.Aerith: Not like mine, no. It's special. Mine's not good for anything at all.

text.Cloud: Bet you just don't know how to use it.

text.Aerith: Could be. Though, I really don't mind. Just having it is enough. It was a gift from my mother.
Pretty crazy, huh? Us meeting again like this. You should stay awhile.

text.ACTION: Upon wandering around the church.

text.Aerith: And just when I had finished tending the flowers here... Gotta start over... Just me, myself, and I...

text.ACTION: Upon wandering near the church exit.

text.Reno: Hang back. We're not in any hurry.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Aerith.

text.Cloud: I could stick around a bit.

text.Aerith: Really!? You will!? In that case...

text.Reno: I'll see myself in, thanks. And who are you?

text.Aerith: He's my bodyguard. And a SOLDIER. Pretty cool, huh?

text.Reno: A SOLDIER?
Well whaddya know, you've got the eyes at least.

text.Aerith: You don't mind, do you? Bodyguard work's not too different from merc stuff, right?
Uh... I guessed! From the sword! Just do this for me, okay?

text.Cloud: Fine, but it'll cost you. A lot.

text.Aerith: A *lot*, huh? One date ought to do it.

text.Reno: Well, you're weird enough to be one... What class?
If you're gonna bullshit me, at least try to make it believable...
Ooh!

text.Aerith: Hey! Watch the flowers!
You better!

text.STATUS: When the battle begins against Shinra soldiers.

text.Reno: Bodyguard, huh? You know I'm hers too, right?

text.Aerith: Really? Since when? This is the first I've heard of it.

text.Reno: 'Cause it was a classified op, princess.

text.Aerith: I don't think that counts then.

text.STATUS: When Cloud or an enemy treads on the flowers during battle.

CHOICE.Aerith: Do you really have to fight near the flowers?

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group of soldiers.

text.Reno: Ugh... Hey! Little help in here, guys?

text.ACTION: Upon beginning battle with Reno.

text.Reno: Good ol' what's-his-face. Hardly knew ya.
Hate doing cleanup, but... I'm damn good at it!

text.Aerith: Cloud, be careful!

text.ACTION: After Reno uses Beatdown.

text.Reno: Whatcha waiting for, bodyguard? I'm right here!

text.STATUS: When Reno charges towards Cloud.

text.Reno: C'mere, SOLDIER boy. I won't bite.

text.ACTION: After Reno loses 50% HP.

text.Reno: Gonna make me work for it, huh? Well, lucky for you—tough guy... I'm a consummate professional!
Figured this dance of ours could use a spark!

text.ACTION: After Reno uses Bright Spark.

text.Reno: Oooh. Feeling all right there, mister bodyguard?

text.ACTION: After Reno prepares EM Flail.

text.Reno: Not so tough now, are you!

text.STATUS: When Reno uses EM Shot.

text.Reno: Yoo-hoo! SOLDIER boy!

text.ACTION: Before Reno uses Beatdown in second phase.

text.Reno: Don't tell me you're trying to cut and run.

text.ACTION: Before Reno uses EM Mine Toss.

text.Reno: Heads up!

text.ACTION: After defeating Reno.

text.Reno: You've got it all wrong, man. I just wanted to—

text.Aerith: Cloud! No!

text.Reno: I'm fine! Go get the girl.

text.Aerith: Weird. They're not attacking.
Over here!

text.STATUS: When Aerith reaches the top of the staircase.

text.Aerith: Nowhere to go but up...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Whispers blocking the lower room on the.

CHOICE.Aerith: Are they trying to stop us?
Do they want us to go upstairs?
They're... trying to show us the way.

text.ACTION: Upon following Aerith up the first staircase.

text.Aerith: Um, we should run.
Through the attic—maybe we can get out that way!
Huh? They saved me...

text.ACTION: Upon trying to cross the ladder without Aerith.

text.Cloud: Can't leave now. She needs help.

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the beam.

text.Reno: Hey! No shooting!

text.Aerith: Aw, man...
Probably! ... Or maybe not.

text.Reno: If there's so much as a scratch on her... you're done.
We bring her in in one piece.
What now?
Oh no, you won't!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to use a ladder to leave.

text.Cloud: Can't leave now. She needs help.

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the bars.

text.Reno: What's the holdup!?
Huh. Some kind of magic trick?

text.ACTION: Upon dropping the chandelier.

text.Aerith: 'Kay!

text.Reno: Stop her!

text.ACTION: While leaving toward Aerith.

text.Aerith: Cloud! Over here!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith.

text.Aerith: Thank you!

text.STATUS: When Aerith reaches the obstacle.

text.Aerith: Cloud, gimme a hand!

text.ACTION: After climbing the ladder to attic.

text.Security Officer: They're in the attic. Should we pursue?

text.Reno: Nah. Leave 'em be.
Partner's got it. We. Are. Out. Beginner's luck.

text.Aerith: It's like they're... guiding us.
So cool.

text.ACTION: While walking and approaching the beams at the top.

text.Aerith: There!

text.STATUS: When the Whispers leave.

text.Aerith: Yeah. Think so.
I think... Actually... I don't know. Let's just go.
Okay. Up for crossing the rooftops? See that pillar over there? There's a station right by it. Shall we mosey on over?

text.ACTION: After descending the first ladder.

text.Aerith: So... what's next for you?

text.Cloud: A little bit of bodyguard work.

text.Aerith: Right.

text.Cloud: After that, it's back to the Sector 7 slums.

text.Aerith: You... know how to get there?
'Course you do...

text.ACTION: After walking further along.

text.Cloud: That suit from earlier. He was one of Shinra's Turks. What's a Turk want with you?

text.Aerith: Dunno...
Hey, don't Turks keep an eye out for potential SOLDIERs and stuff?

text.Cloud: They do more than just scout for candidates. Turks get called in to handle all kinds of situations. With extreme prejudice.

text.Aerith: Professional bad guys. Gotta love 'em.

text.Cloud: Back to my question. So what's he to you? Looked like you knew each other.

text.Aerith: Maybe he thought I could be the greatest SOLDIER yet!
Hmm? You mad?

text.ACTION: After climbing the second ladder.

text.Aerith: I... actually... haven't traveled by rooftop before.
It's honestly... kind of exciting.

text.ACTION: After hopping over a gap and proceeding.

text.Aerith: Wait! Give me a moment!

text.ACTION: After approaching Aerith again.

text.Aerith: Don't just... run off on your own...

text.Cloud: Those the words of a SOLDIER candidate?

text.Aerith: So petty.

text.ACTION: After climbing the following ladder and approaching the pillar.

text.Cloud: So, does no one live in these buildings?

text.Aerith: Nope. No one to get mad if we make noise.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the ladder atop the pillar.

text.Aerith: Looks kinda... rusty.

text.ACTION: After climbing the ladder.

text.Aerith: Okay...
You worry too much. I'm not some princess who needs to be coddled.
Shit.

text.ACTION: Upon walking away from Aerith while dangling.

text.Aerith: Cloud!

text.ACTION: After helping Aerith up.

text.Aerith: Whew, that was unexpected! Thank you, Cloud.
Ah, there it is. The wall.
You know, I thought about leaving once... But... in the end, I couldn't.

Too much. A whole world, bursting with life. Maybe more than I can handle, I think sometimes... Even now. People hate the steel sky, the slums... but I don't. How could I? All that passion, all those dreams... Flowing and blending together into something greater...

text.ACTION: Upon descending the wooden path down.

text.Aerith: This time I'll go first. After all, I can't count on you to wait.
See for yourself!
Hmm... Maybe I'll go on ahead and leave you all by your lonesome! Just—
Then you talk. Tell me a story.

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the pipe.

text.Aerith: Cheapskate. You're—(screams)
Gotcha.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Aerith by the slide.

text.Aerith: Here goes nothing!

text.ACTION: After jumping down.

text.Aerith: Of course!
My hero!

text.Cloud: Never a dull moment with you.

text.Aerith: That a compliment?
Thanks anyway!
We're getting closer to the station. Even so, we'll probably run into a few monsters on the way.
Heh... There's a face that screams "so what?"

text.Cloud: Eh. I've fought scarier things in my sleep.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to run back to the church.

text.Aerith: Where are you going, Cloud?

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first group of enemies.

text.Aerith: Look out, Cloud!

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Aerith: Someone looks like they're in their element.

text.ACTION: After defeating the second group of enemies.

text.Aerith: So Cloud... you don't know the slums that well, do you?

text.Cloud: Compared to you? No. Training grounds, barracks, battlefields—that's the world I know.

text.Aerith: Heh, you sound proud of that.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the fence near the station.

text.Aerith: Station's there.
Oh? Thought the world you knew didn't include stations.

text.Undercity Resident (Male 1): We poured so much of our blood and sweat into building that reactor, and now...

text.Undercity Resident (Older Female): I can't believe this is happening...

text.Station Worker: If you would all just please calm down...

text.Undercity Resident (Male 7): Hey, what the hell's going on!?

text.Girl: Check it out, Mom!

text.Undercity Resident (4): Come on, there's no need to shout...

text.Aerith: Yeah, well, it's got a good view of the reactor.
They know that. They're worried.

text.ACTION: After the cutscene ends.

text.Undercity Resident (Concerned): Oh! Didn't expect to see you here.

text.Aerith: Huh? Um... Yeah...

text.Undercity Resident (Concerned): Oh, on your way home from the church?

text.Aerith: That's... right.

text.Undercity Resident (Concerned): Well, I'm glad you're okay. Did any debris hit the church?

text.Aerith: Not debris, no...

text.Undercity Resident (Concerned): That's something, at least—but you may not be so lucky next time!

text.ACTION: Upon walking away while Aerith is talking to an NPC.

text.Aerith: Oh—Cloud! Wait!

text.ACTION: Upon passing the topside resident.

text.Topside Resident (Male 3): Hey. You know a way to get topside other than the train?

text.Aerith: Sorry, can't say I do...

text.Topside Resident (Male 3): Figured as much. What a goddamn pain in the ass...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the south end of the station.

text.Aerith: A real man on a mission.
For me? Or you?
Then... let's stick to the backstreets? Ah. There will be monsters.

text.ACTION: Upon trying to enter the Sector 5 slums.
Upon entering the Scrapyard Back Alley.

text.Aerith: There's a Shinra dump site up ahead. Not the kind of place anyone would ever choose to hang around in.

text.Cloud: But a great place to lay low.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first group of monsters.

text.Cloud: They've got the run of it.

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Aerith: No telling where they'll come from...
Hmm... You'd better watch out then, Cloud.

text.ACTION: Upon traveling to the northwest end of the area.

text.Aerith: That way's a dead end. They were doing some construction, but quit halfway.
Over here.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open the gate atop Scrapyard Back Alley.

text.Aerith: That didn't work. Maybe it's broken?
Pretty sure this path we're on loops around, too, so...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Shinra storage containers blocking the path.

text.Aerith: Hmm, wonder if we can move this.

text.ACTION: After moving it.

text.Aerith: Ah, I knew it!

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group of enemies in Twilight Valley.

text.Aerith: Must've been a new breed.
'Cause they went for the stronger prey.

text.ACTION: After traveling up Steel Mountain.

text.Aerith: There—check it out! The heart of the slums.
Well, we did take a detour. Getting tired?
Me, I'm feeling a bit hungry. How about you?
You're in for a treat when we make it back.
You'll wanna make time for my mom's cooking! And that's the final word on it! We'll get home quick and eat ourselves stupid!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the Smogger.

text.Aerith: It's awake!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open the gate at Nuts 'n' Bolts Hills.

text.Aerith: Don't think it'll open. What to do... That gate just doesn't want to open, does it? Maybe there's a way to get over it? For you, at least.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the plates before moving the container.

text.Aerith: No good. That sucks. Ah! Try moving that container to make a path.

text.ACTION: Upon pushing the container.

text.Aerith: Yeah! That should do the trick!

text.ACTION: Upon trying to leave before opening the gate.

CHOICE.Aerith: Um, can you get it open from over there?
You're not really gonna leave me, are you?

text.ACTION: After opening the gate.

text.Aerith: Thanks, Cloud. I knew you'd find a way.

text.ACTION: After opening the gate with a quick thought.

text.Aerith: Nice work! Way to think ahead.

text.ACTION: Upon traveling down the path.

text.Aerith: Guess we're home free.

text.Cloud: No need for thanks. I'd rather get paid.

text.Aerith: Hm? You're getting paid right now.
Huh?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the exit to the backstreets.

text.Aerith: Should be able to relax a little now...
Ah!

text.Cloud: Could come at us anytime. Keep an eye out.

text.ACTION: Upon traveling down the Station Way towards the Undercity Station.

text.Aerith: Uhhh... That's the station.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to travel down Station Way.

text.Aerith: Somewhere else you'd rather be?

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Center District.

text.Aerith: What're they watching?

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave the path.
Upon approaching the monitor.

text.Reporter: I'm standing inside the gutted shell of Mako Reactor 5. As you can see, there's still a lot of smoke rising from the rubble. While fallen beams and other debris continue to hinder rescue efforts, the fires appear to have been mostly extinguished.
Ah, over there! That's the director of Shinra's Advanced Weaponry Division, isn't it? Excuse me, ma'am, but would you mind answering a few questions?

text.Scarlet: Move.

text.Reporter: Can you give us any updates on the status of the reactor? What kind of damage did it suffer in the explosion? Are we in any danger?

text.Scarlet: Mako Reactor 5 has been temporarily shut down, and all fires have been successfully extinguished. The situation is under control, and the people of our fair city need not worry about any additional complications. We are in the process of conducting a full forensic investigation. But we suspect the device used was similar to that employed in the attack on Mako Reactor 1.
The perpetrators of that atrocity were filmed making their escape. These agents of the eco-terrorist group Avalanche are currently believed to be hiding somewhere in Midgar...

text.Reporter: And... given that this group has now attacked two reactors in quick succession... can they really be stopped before they strike again?

text.Scarlet: What do *you* think?
Have no fear. Shinra *will* keep Midgar safe.

text.Aerith: Alright... let's go.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave Aerith.

text.Aerith: Hey, my house is this way.

text.ACTION: Upon passing Fifth Cafe while following Aerith.

text.Restaurant Owner: Aw, what timing. Mind lending me a hand?

text.Aerith: The place is really hopping, huh?

text.Restaurant Owner: Nice side effect of the train situation! So, whaddya say?

text.Aerith: I'd love to, but...
I help out every now and then. It's fun.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Oates.

text.Oates: Aerith!

text.Aerith: Well, well, what are you doing all the way up there?

text.Oates: Was trying to get a look at the reactor. Who's this guy?

text.Aerith: This is Cloud. He's a mercenary... and currently my bodyguard. That's Oates.

text.Oates: See you.

text.Aerith: Two peas in a pod.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching a group of orphans.

text.Boy: Aerith!

text.Aerith: So, what are you guys up to?

text.Girl: We all went to see the reactor.

text.Boy: Oh, that's right. You're supposed to come by the House.

text.Aerith: What for?

text.Girl: I dunno. You're just supposed to.

text.Aerith: Well, guess we have a new destination.
I should probably explain. The Leaf House is the local orphanage. That's where all these kids live.

text.Girl: Hey Aerith, where'd you go?

text.Boy: The church again?

text.Girl: Next time, we should all go together!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the doctor.

text.Doctor: Why hello, Aerith. As popular as ever, I see.

text.Aerith: Apparently. But they sure keep me on my toes!

text.Doctor: Thanks again for all those herbs. You've helped a lot of people.

text.Aerith: No problem. Anytime.

text.Doctor: How'd you manage to find so many, anyway?

text.Aerith: Oh, I have my ways.
He's my bodyguard. Just until I get home.

text.Doctor: And you're sure he's up to it?

text.Aerith: Hmmm... Maybe?
Since I'm so generous, I gather medicinal herbs for his patients sometimes.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Leaf House.

text.Aerith: Here's the Leaf House.

text.Boy: We're back! And we brought Aerith with us!

text.Housemother: Sorry to make you come out here.

text.Aerith: Don't be. It's on my way home.

text.Housemother: Well then, I hope you won't mind me asking for some flowers.

text.Aerith: No problem! How many?

text.Housemother: All you can carry. What with all the doom and gloom we've been hearing on the news recently, I thought some flowers might help cheer everyone up.

text.Aerith: I'm sure they will, and I'd love to help.

text.Housemother: Let's all wash up before our meal.

text.ACTION: While following Aerith to her house.

text.Aerith: So, Cloud, what's your favorite flower?

text.Cloud: They're all the same to me.

text.Aerith: You sure you wanna say that to a florist?
Okay, then what'd you do with the flower I gave you?
You give it away?
Ooh! To who? Tell me!
Hmmm?
Thought you didn't like lying.
Well, anyway...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith's garden.

text.Aerith: My house is just up this path. Mom should be home by now, so I'll introduce you.
There you go. That's my house.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Aerith's house.

text.Aerith: Come on.
I'm home!

text.Elmyra: Hey baby. Been up to no good? Rude came by—

text.Aerith: So, this is my mom, Elmyra. And this is Cloud. My bodyguard.

text.Elmyra: Take good care of her?

text.Cloud: That's my job. Or *was* my job.

text.Aerith: Yep. Thanks. So, Cloud, you gonna head back to Sector 7?
Then I'll show you the way.

text.Cloud: Then why'd you have me bring you here? What if the Turks show up again?

text.Aerith: It'd suck, but I've dealt with them before. Honestly, I'm much more worried about you. What if you get lost, huh? You'd be too embarrassed to admit it, so you'd just and so you'd just keep on going.

text.Cloud: Quit acting like you know me.

text.Aerith: Hey, Mom? I'm gonna go take Cloud over to Sector 7, okay?

text.Elmyra: Okay... But why not wait until tomorrow? If you head out now, it'll be dark when you get back. Better to rest up here and make the trip first thing in the morning. When you'll have daylight to spare.

text.Aerith: That's true. She's got a point, Cloud.
Oh, yeah! I still need to deliver some flowers to the Leaf House. Since we have a little time before dinner... You should come with.
You mean you want more? Even though you've got a *priceless* reward coming your way? Do you know what I promised him?
I'll go grab the baskets. Be right back!

text.Elmyra: That Aerith... She's a handful, isn't she?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Elmyra.

text.Elmyra: It must be tough— No, never mind.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Elmyra again.

text.Elmyra: Hmph.

text.ACTION: Upon passing Aerith's room.

text.Aerith: That's weird. Could've sworn I put them here...

text.ACTION: Upon passing into the balcony.
Upon descending the staircase after passing Aerith's room.

text.Aerith: Found 'em!
You take this one. Take it.
Right. Off we go!

text.ACTION: After leaving the house.

text.Aerith: And these, right here, are my babies.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the flower beds.

text.Aerith: Hmm... Which ones do you think we should pick?
Aw, don't be like that. I know you have an eye for this kind of thing.

text.ACTION: Upon picking up the yellow flowers.

text.Aerith: That's the one I gave you.
Nice try, mister. You can't fool me.

text.ACTION: Upon picking up the foxtails.

text.Aerith: Whoa, foxtails, huh? I gotta hand it to you, I never would've thought of that. It'll definitely take them by surprise.

text.ACTION: Upon picking up the white flowers.

text.Aerith: Good eye. People used to give these to declare their loyalty to one another. Interesting, right?

text.ACTION: After taking the first group of flowers.

text.Aerith: I think we still need a few more. What should we pick next?

text.ACTION: After taking the second group of flowers.

text.Aerith: She said "as many as you can carry," so maybe a few more?

text.ACTION: After taking three groups of flowers.

text.Aerith: I think we're good now. Whaddya say? Shall we go?

text.ACTION: On the path to the Leaf House.

text.Aerith: No need to hurry. We're not under the gun or anything.

text.Cloud: I'm not cut out for this crap.

text.Aerith: Sure you are. And when you're done, you'll be drowning in job offers.
So, how do you think they'll arrange these flowers?
Well, we'll soon find out.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to walk away from the Leaf House.

CHOICE.Aerith: Did you forget the way or something?
You do know we're going to the Leaf House, right?
Come on, the flowers are drying out.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Leaf House.

text.Aerith: Oh, okay. But I might be a while. Why not check out the town?

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave the Sector 5 slums.

text.Cloud: Nah, can't leave without telling her.

text.ACTION: After talking to Chadley and closing the menu.

text.Chadley: Cloud, I have the most amazing news! I believe I might know how to develop summoning materia, something heretofore thought impossible. Scientists say that this materia can only be found in nature, but I may just be able to prove otherwise! And so, Cloud, I turn to you. I would like to test this theory by way of my combat simulator—to wit, I want you to fight and defeat summon data in VR. I sense that you find my phrasing to be somewhat... obtuse.

text.ACTION: Upon beginning a VR battle against a summon.

text.Chadley: Then I invite you to ready your portable battle simulator.

text.ACTION: After losing to the summon.

text.Chadley: What a shame. It was a close match. However, I did manage to obtain valuable data. Analyze and learn from your mistakes, so that you can claim victory next time.

text.ACTION: After defeating Shiva.

text.Chadley: Outstanding. The Shiva summoning materia is complete. And now it's yours. Use it as you see fit. The lady of frost is the perfect companion for a man like you, Cloud. She will prove most useful when the time comes to destroy Shinra.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the materia store vendor.

text.Materia Vendor: I've got the finest collection of materia you'll find anywhere.

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.

text.Materia Vendor: I knew you had a keen eye.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the weapon store vendor.

text.Weapon Vendor: What'll it be for you today?

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.

text.Weapon Vendor: Got what you need to stay safe?

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to enter the hideout.

text.Boy: Nuh-uh! No grown-ups allowed!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Oates.

text.Oates: Ah!
Where's Aerith?

text.ACTION: Upon returning to Aerith at the Leaf House.

text.Aerith: You could say that. Sounds like someone spooked the kids.

text.Oates: Yeah, two of 'em disappeared. They ran away after this creepy guy wearing black clothes showed up.

text.Aerith: That's what I thought, but no.

text.Oates: It's this guy who's always stumbling around town in a dirty robe full of holes. They say he's sick or something. Oh, and he had some kind of number tattooed on his arm.

text.Aerith: I don't like the sound of this. I'm gonna check it out.

text.Cloud: I know someone who fits that description. I'll come with.

text.Aerith: 'Kay.

text.Oates: C'mon.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave the Sector 5 Slums.

CHOICE.Aerith: You can go sightseeing later, Cloud.
Uh, aren't we supposed to be helping the kids?
Don't you get it? Children are in danger!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley.

text.Chadley: Cloud! I understand you must be busy, but I hope you haven't forgotten about my research.
Oh, hello. Cloud has been assisting me with my research and development.

text.Aerith: Ooh, that sounds fun. Count me in.

text.Chadley: One moment while I run diagnostics. Huh... How very strange... You don't appear to be in my database...

text.Aerith: And that's bad?

text.Chadley: There must have been some sort of server error. Oh well, any friend of Cloud's is sure to be of great help.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Oates by the entrance to the Children's Secret Hideout.

text.Oates: C'mon.

text.Aerith: I know this place is off-limits to grown-ups, but if we want to rescue them... well... We gotta break the rules.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Children's Secret Hideout.

text.Oates: Aerith's come to help.

text.Aerith: Yeah, leave it to us. We'll take care of it from here.

text.Boy (1): But there are monsters out there!

text.Aerith: Don't worry. I've brought a superstrong friend along with me.

text.Cloud: I used to be a SOLDIER. So where's the guy?

text.Oates: I dunno. He disappeared and we can't find him.

text.Aerith: Right now, let's worry about the kids.

text.Oates: C'mon.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Oates by the entrance to Underdeveloped Land.

text.Oates: They ran off this way. Be careful.

text.ACTION: Upon entering Underdeveloped Land.

text.Aerith: Where do you think they went?

text.Cloud: Who knows. They're kids. Nothing to do but look all over.

text.Aerith: I just hope we find them in time.

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the bridge.

text.Aerith: There they are!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the first group of enemies at Toad Marsh.

text.Aerith: Quickly! We gotta save them!

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the monsters near the children.

text.Boy: Aerith!

text.Girl: Hey, Aerith!

text.Aerith: Hold on!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Aerith after defeating the monsters.

text.Boy: Stay back!

text.Girl: Watch out! The ground's really shaky!

text.Boy: It's 'cause of the reactor. You can't trust your feet.
Thank you.

text.Girl: That was cool...

text.Aerith: Okay. Let's head back.

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group of enemies.

text.Boy: That's *so* cool!

text.Girl: How did you get to be so strong!?

text.Aerith: Well you see, Cloud here used to be a SOLDIER!

text.Boy: He was?

text.Girl: Did you go fight in the war?

text.ACTION: After defeating the second group of enemies.

text.Boy: I'm gonna grow up to be a SOLDIER—like you.

text.Girl: You can't just grow up to be a SOLDIER. You gotta work at it.

text.Boy: Cloud thinks I'm good enough to be one. Right?

text.Aerith: Look at you, Mr. Popular.

text.Boy: That was so cool, you guys! Especially that, "Hah! Yah!"

text.Girl: Yeah, it was really cool when you went like, "Hah! Yah!"

text.Boy: You've got it all wrong. (imitates fight noises) Like *that*.

text.Girl: No way! It was way faster than that! (imitates fight noises) Like *that*.

text.Boy: Fine, then how about—(imitates fight noises) Yeah?

text.Girl: Yeah! (imitates fight noises) Like that.

text.Boy: Isn't that right, Cloud?

text.Girl: Isn't that right, Cloud?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the entrance to the Children's Secret Hideout.

text.Aerith: Tifa?
What's wrong?
Is Tifa, like... your girlfriend?
But she's someone special.

text.Cloud: It's not like that. More like... I don't know how to explain...

text.Aerith: I see...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Oates.

text.Oates: Thank you.

text.Aerith: From now on, if you run into trouble, promise me you'll find an adult, okay?

text.Oates: Okay, I will. And here. Since you're so cool. You guys are both grown-ups, but you're also one of us now. You can come and play here whenever you want.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave to the Center District.

text.Aerith: Don't worry. It'll be okay.

text.Cloud: Hm. Not him, but looks pretty damn similar.

text.Aerith: Huh? There's the number... but why "2"?

text.Sephiroth: The reunion... is nothing to fear.

text.Aerith: Cloud? Get it together. Come on.

text.Cloud: You don't know who Sephiroth is... do you?

text.Aerith: Sephiroth, the war hero? I know he died in an accident five years ago. They said so on the news.

text.Cloud: Maybe they did. But I've got a feeling he's still alive.

text.Aerith: Oh... right. C'mon, let's go.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the boy near the exit.

text.Boy 1: My dad told me that that man, he used to be a SOLDIER when he was younger.

text.Boy 2: I heard he came back because he got sick or something. Isn't that kinda weird? Can SOLDIERs even get sick?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Oates at the Children's Secret Hideout.

text.Oates: Hey, Cloud. I know a lot of people around here need help. When I'm out on patrol, a lot of them tell me about their problems. Do you think you might be interested in helping out?

text.Aerith: Well, I'm all for it! We still have plenty of time.
Don't worry. I give you permission!

text.Oates: I always have the latest information. Come find me if you wanna know.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Oates again.

text.Oates: The monsters out there are getting stronger and stronger. But that's no problem for you, though, right? ... Be careful anyway.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to a man outside the community center.

CHOICE.Undercity Resident (Community Center): This here's the Sector 5 community center.
Truth be told, it's really just a place for us old folks to sit here and chat.
Care to stay and keep us company a bit?

text.ACTION: After completing one Odd Job.

text.Aerith: I see you're working hard, mister merc.
So whaddya gonna do next?
As you always do, I'm sure.

text.Cloud: You know, this *is* how I earn a living.

text.Aerith: Huh? Really!? I thought you were just doing it for fun!
Hello! I'm some people. Nice to meet you!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Weapons Vendor after completing a few Odd Jobs.

text.Weapons Vendor: People are talking about you. You've got one helluva reputation.

text.ACTION: After completing three Odd Jobs.

text.Aerith: It feels good to help people out, doesn't it?
You having fun yet?
Then you can't be afraid to show it more. Don't forget, it's all about service and salesmanship.
All right, but don't think you can rely on me forever, mister.
That's good. 'Cause I demand a very good salary.

text.ACTION: After completing all Odd Jobs.

text.Aerith: We probably oughta call it a day.
You've been working so hard, you lost track of time.
'Cause they didn't know if you were worth it yet. But now they do. C'mon. Let's go home.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the road to Aerith's garden after completing an Odd Job.

text.Housemother: Aerith, you're back. Come, look what we've done with the flowers. Lovely, don't you think?

text.Aerith: Great job. It's wonderful.

text.Housemother: Oh, I nearly forgot. I saw some Shinra suit walking towards your house a little while ago. He was dressed all in black. A little scary looking.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Housemother.
Upon approaching Rude.

text.Aerith: What do you want?

text.Rude: Haven't seen him before. He your new boy toy?

text.Aerith: He's my *bodyguard*, if you must know.

text.Rude: Wait a minute... Those eyes... Is he the one who beat up Reno?
Need to cross my T's, dot my I's. That's all.

text.Aerith: Cloud, leave him be. Rude's not a bad person. Really.

text.Rude: No, I'm not bad. But like it or not... I sometimes have to do bad things. Don't take it personal.

text.Cloud: You Turks are all the same. All bark... no bite.

text.ACTION: During the battle after it begins.

text.Aerith: No need to get rough!
Can't you leave us alone?

text.Rude: Gotta get a little payback for my partner.

text.ACTION: After Rude loses 30% HP.

text.Aerith: So, you had enough yet?

text.Rude: No, I don't believe that I have.

text.STATUS: When battle resumes.

text.Aerith: Just stop it.
Cloud's pretty strong, isn't he?

text.Cloud: How's that payback working out for ya?

text.Rude: I thought you didn't wanna get rough.

text.Aerith: No... but this is self-defense!

text.ACTION: After defeating Rude.

text.Aerith: Please. Just leave us alone.

text.Rude: You know I can't do that.

text.Reno: Hey there, partner. I'm sure you're having the time of your life, but we're needed on standby for a job. Something about Sector 7. So get your ass back here now.

text.Aerith: Got somewhere else to be?
You know I can't do that!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the door to Aerith's house.

text.Aerith: You're heading in already?

CHOICE.Cloud: Yeah. That's enough for one day.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Moggie.

text.Aerith: Oh my! Is that a moogle!?

text.Moggie: You can see me, kupo? Then you two must be very, very special people. In that case... Welcome to the Moogle Emporium! I'm the owner—Moggie!

text.Aerith: You must not be familiar with "Mog the Moogle." It's a pretty famous fairy tale. Mog wanted to bring happiness to all the moogles of the forest, so he decided to open a shop of wonders.

text.Moggie: That's right, kupo! I opened a store to bring happiness to the slums—like Mog! And you know, only people with the purest of hearts can even see moogles!

Well... moogle magic isn't perfect, kupo. Anyway, we've collected all kinds of rare and wonderous goods! They can be yours if you've got enough moogle medals. But you'll need to buy a membership first!

text.ACTION: Upon purchasing a Moogle Membership Card.

text.Moggie: If you find any moogle medals, you can spend them here, kupo!

text.Aerith: So, Moggie, what do you do with the medals we give you?

text.Moggie: Oh, you know what! I use them to make everyone happy! That's the duty of every moogle!

text.Aerith: Of course. Just like Mog the Moogle.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Moggie again.
After closing the store menu having purchased items for the first time.

text.Moggie: You guys are great! Thanks to you, I've got a ton of medals, kupo! Which means I can bring happiness to a ton of people!

text.Aerith: Hey, Cloud... maybe say it like you mean it?

text.Cloud: Not until I'm happy. Go on. Work your magic. Make me smile. From ear to ear.

text.Moggie: I'll need a lot more medals, kupo!

text.Aerith: Well, that won't do! C'mon Cloud—let's go get more!

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.
Upon talking to Ms. Folia.

text.Ms. Folia: Oh... You're that former SOLDIER, aren't you? Cloud, was it?

text.Aerith: Former SOLDIER turned problem solver. Are you okay, Ms. Folia? You look upset.

text.Ms. Folia: Yeah! I am pretty upset. The kids are still off doing patrols, even though it's now time for their lessons. Not a single one of them has come back yet!

text.Aerith: Patrols? Is that a Leaf House thing? Something they do to help out?

text.Ms. Folia: That's right. In return for the donations we receive, the kids go around town picking up litter, running errands—that kind of thing. I don't suppose you've seen any of them, have you? You see, I have some important plans this evening, and I really need to go and get ready.

text.Aerith: Would you like us to go round them up?

text.Ms. Folia: That would be wonderful! There are five of them out on patrol right now. They all wear homemade swords on their back, so they should be easy to spot.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the girl by the community center.

text.Girl: Wow, you're that SOLDIER, right? Can I ask you a super important question? I heard bad people broke the mako reactor and there's gonna be another war 'cause of it. Is that true?

text.Cloud: Who knows, but isn't there something else you should be worrying about right now?

text.Girl: I forgot about Ms. Folia's lesson! I gotta head back to the House.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the boy in the southwest corner in a tunnel.

text.Boy: Cloud!?

text.Aerith: Hey there. How goes the patrol?

text.Boy: There's a lot more people on the streets than usual. Maybe because the reactor blew up?

text.Aerith: Well, you've been keeping a very sharp lookout. But don't you think you're forgetting something important?

text.Boy: Oh, Ms. Folia's lessons! I gotta get back to the House!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the girl in the eastern end of the Center District.

text.Aerith: Hey there. How goes the patrol?

text.Girl: Great! I've been picking up garbage and giving people directions! Plus, I helped an old lady cross the street!

text.Aerith: You've been busy.

text.Girl: It's a normal day for me. Gotta work hard—the House depends on people's donations!
Oh no, I'm late! Did you see Ms. Folia? Is she mad? I gotta go! I'm sorry!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the boy by the weapon store.

text.Boy: You scared me!

text.Aerith: Hey there. How goes the patrol?

text.Boy: I've been watching them really close. I'm trying to learn all about the business.

text.Aerith: You wanna open up a shop of your own someday?

text.Boy: Yeah, so I can earn lots of money and use it to help the House. The teachers don't like to talk about it, but we know the donations aren't enough to keep things running. ... But that's a secret, okay? I'm not supposed to tell anyone! Anyway, I gotta go study!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the boy at the southern tip of Station Way.

text.Boy: Hello, Cloud—Sir! It's a real honor to meet you! I think you SOLDIER guys are awesome! I wanna be strong and tough when I grow up too!

text.Aerith: You sound very determined.

text.Boy: These are dangerous times! A reactor blew up, and a bunch of kids lost their friends and families. Who knows what might blow up next?

text.Aerith: I guess that means more children might be coming to the House soon.

text.Boy: Then I think the teachers are gonna have a whole lot more work to do.

text.Cloud: Speaking of teachers, Ms. Folia is looking for you.

text.Boy: Oh man, I completely forgot! I have to get back right now!

text.ACTION: After talking to all children.

text.Aerith: That's everyone. Let's go back to the House.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ms. Folia after finding all children.

text.Ms. Folia: The children finally came back—thanks to you two. You've been a great help. Okay, everyone! Come inside—it's time to hit the books!

text.Boy (1): You guys, the toad king's back! I saw him near the hideout!

text.Boy (2): We gotta do something about him.

text.Aerith: The toad "king"?

text.Boy (2): A weird, creepy monster we've seen near the hideout lately.

text.Girl (1): He wears a crown and walks around like he owns the place. If he's not a king, he's gotta be monster royalty at least. I bet a SOLDIER could beat him up easy!

text.Cloud: Oh, yeah. Real easy. But here's the thing... I don't work for free—or cheap.

text.Girl (1): But we don't have any money!

text.Girl (2): The watch wouldn't ask for money.

text.Boy (1): But if we ask any other grown-ups for help, they'll find out about the hideout, and that'll be it!

text.Girl (2): We really don't wanna lose the hideout. C'mon, help us! Oh—and we'll give you some cool treasure if you do!

text.Boy (3): And if that's not enough, I'll pay the rest of your fee once I open my shop!

text.Boy (4): Well! If you won't help, then we'll just have to kill it ourselves!

text.Cloud: I'll do it for three gil. I'm offering a special discount right now on toad king jobs. Looks like it's your lucky day.

text.Boy (2): Awesome! Now that's my kind of bargain!

text.Boy: The toad king wants to take over our hideout. He's mean and angry, and smells bad too, so be careful!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the Hedgehog Pie King.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport to the Leaf House.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the boy after defeating the Hedgehog Pie King.

text.Boy: Did you defeat the toad king!?

text.Cloud: Yup. Kicked his butt real good.

text.Boy: Awesome! I knew you could do it!
Now we don't have to worry about the king and his smelly friends!

text.Girl: Thank you so much! Here—this is for you—the treasure we promised. It's definitely worth at least three gil.

text.Ms. Folia: Okay, kids, playtime's over for now! I've prepared a special assignment for everyone. One that I expect you to finish today. Understood?

text.Boy: Yes! Yes, Ms. Folia!

text.Ms. Folia: I appreciate you getting rid of the toad king, by the way.

text.Aerith: Wow, Ms. Folia. You must know all their secrets.
