text.Ms. Folia: Oh, if only. Easier said than done. They're always on the move, looking for new adventures, chasing new dreams, all while trying to make the lives of everyone around them just a little better. I try to make sure they don't stumble and fall, and when they finally do, I help them back up.

Sometimes it is. But I want the children to know that until they can stand on their own two feet that I'm here to support them, care for them, love them—that even if we're not actually related, we're still a family—a real family, in all the ways that matter. If I can do that for them, then well... then maybe I'm making this world a better place.

text.Aerith: I know you are.

text.Ms. Folia: My predecessor taught me everything I know. I just took up his torch and ran with it, I guess. Not that I'm anything close to what he was. Biggs is one of a kind.
Oh no! I've completely lost track of time!

text.Aerith: Do you have somewhere you need to be?

text.Ms. Folia: More like a dream I need to fulfill! Thank you again for your help!

text.Aerith: I wonder what kind of dream she's chasing tonight.

text.Boy: Thanks again for saving our hideout from the king. In return, I let everyone know you guys can join the "game"—as special guests. If you wanna know more, then come to the hideout!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Oates after completing the quest.

text.Oates: Now that things are starting to settle down a bit, we can finally play Whack-a-Box again! It's all thanks to you!
Oh, yeah, I forgot. There's this tired-looking guy out by the community center... and I heard he was looking for some help.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Scared Man.
Upon talking to the scared man.

text.Scared Man: Shinra weapons are on the rampage. Five of 'em, like floatin' eyeballs! I saw them wander off into the scrap, but if they come back into town, it'd be a disaster. We need someone who's willing and able to fight...
You will!? Aw man, you're the best! I could hear them shouting "intruder detected" or some other nonsense when they floated off. Be careful. They looked dangerous!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating all Mark II Monodrives.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport in front of the scared man.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to the scared man after defeating Mark II Monodrives.

text.Scared Man: I heard, I heard! You got 'em all, right? Robots from the reactor getting lost in the slums... Must be because of the explosion up top, huh? They must've thought they were protecting the reactor, and figured I was trespassin' on their turf or something.
Almost feel sorry for 'em, getting all lost and confused like that.
Ah, what am I sayin'? Man or machine... Shinra bitches get what they deserve.

text.Aerith: Anyway, I think it's safe to say our work here is finished! If you're ever in the market for a merc again, remember: you can count on Cloud!

text.Scared Man: Uh, sure. And sorry about putting this on you all of a sudden. I'm really glad you were willing to help out, though! Thanks again.
Actually, while you're here, I've got another favor to ask. There's this old guy who hangs out in front of the weapons shop. I think he might need your help. Would you mind talking to him?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the scared man again after the quest is complete.

text.Scared Man: I'd appreciate it if you could talk to that old guy. He helped me out a while back, and I'd like to return the favor.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sarah.

text.Sarah: Oh hey, Cloud! You're just in time for our favorite game—Whack-a-Box! You want in? It's super fun! The rules are easy. The person who whacks the most boxes is crowned champion of the hideout! We usually don't let adults play, but since you're cool, we're gonna make a special exception just for you.

text.ACTION: After Sarah offers to play a Whack-a-Box game.
Upon selecting "No", nothing happens. Upon selecting "Yes", a game begins.
After playing the first game of Whack-a-Box.

text.Sarah: See? Pretty fun, right? Play with us again, 'kay!

text.ACTION: After obtaining the target score.
Upon talking to Sarah again.
Upon entering a match and not reaching the highest score.

CHOICE.Sarah: Only one way to become a Whack-a-Box master: whack, whack, whack!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Damon.

text.Damon: Ah, you wouldn't happen to be a certain merc that's become the talk of the town?
I'm Damon. Little more than a humble reporter with the Daily Buzz.

text.Aerith: Ugh, that rag? The one that's always printing awful rumors about the slums?

text.Damon: On the contrary, my dear! We strive to raise awareness of the plight of our undercity brethren. We seek a better future for everyone, rich and poor.

Now then, my friends. I find myself in need of your exceptional services for a trifling matter. Are you familiar with the mysterious—and notorious—bandit known as the "Angel of the Slums"? She delivers written declarations to her victims—usually Shinra associates—before divesting them of their valuables.

text.Aerith: Everyone knows her. Everything she steals, she gives to the poor and needy.

text.Damon: Yes. She's got a knack for public relations. Very popular down here as a result. Nevertheless, she is a criminal and a threat to the public order! I've made it my mission to unmask the villain, but the locals have been uncooperative and uncommunicative, to put it mildly. And now that my identity as a reporter has been exposed, my sources have all deserted me! Which brings me to you—the merc of the hour, and the man who will serve up my scoop!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Damon again.

text.Damon: I'll welcome any and all information pertaining to the so-called Angel of the Slums.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to a woman inside the community center.

text.Undercity Resident (Female 2): Why, hello! What is it? The Guardian Angel of the Slums? Such a mysterious figure. Always talked about, but never *seen* by anyone! The Angel gets in and out without being noticed and always leaves a calling card. Maybe a magician!? No, no, it's no magic trick—it's genuine magic! Rumor has it that the Angel is a witch.

text.Undercity Resident (Female 4): If we're going by rumors, then I've heard that it's actually a monster in disguise.

text.Undercity Resident (Female 2): Well, I could talk all day about the *dozens* of stories *I've* heard!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille.

text.Aerith: Good to see you again, Mireille.

text.Mireille: Good to see you too, Aerith. I'd heard you found yourself a funny new friend.

text.Aerith: Cloud, meet Mireille. She knows everything there is to know about the slums. Mireille, meet Cloud. He's a former SOLDIER, and super strong.

text.Mireille: He looks useful enough. The kids have been talking about you. The defender of the secret hideout. And now the Hero of the Leaf House is helping the Daily Buzz look for the Angel of the Slums.
I'm a lover of the whispered word. Not that it's any real secret, considering how chatty that Shinra mutt's been.

text.Cloud: Not looking into it for the reporter. I'm doing it for myself. Call it curiosity... or whatever.

text.Mireille: Or could it be you've fallen under the Angel's spell like so many others? Anyway—it so happens that I have some information for you. But I'll need a moment before I can give it to you. Why don't you wait with that reporter of yours?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille again.

text.Mireille: Just wait outside with the reporter. I'll be along soon.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Damon again.

text.Damon: So! Any news?

text.Aerith: Have you tried talking to Mireille at all? She told us that she had some information to share.

text.Damon: Mireille as in *the* Mireille? The town gossip? I chased her for days, begging for info, but she wouldn't give up a single scrap! So how'd *you* get the old bird to talk?

text.Mireille: This old bird had a change of heart, that's all.

text.Damon: Then quickly, before you have another, tell us: what do you know about the notorious Angel of the Slums? Has she struck again? Is that it!?

text.Mireille: I don't know anything about that. But I do know where her hideout is.

text.Damon: Her base of operations? Now that's a scoop! Where is it!? Tell me!

text.Mireille: Deep in the scrap—at Lookout Point. Hardly anyone goes out there these days. It's the perfect place for a criminal to hole up.

text.Damon: Lookout Point—got it! I'll check it out right now!

text.Mireille: But before you go, I should warn you about this rumor I heard—about a terrible fiend that's claimed the Angel's hideout as its lair. Quite large, lots of teeth, always hungry. I don't know about you, but I'd not go anywhere near that thing.

text.Damon: Er, well, uh... Well! A good reporter knows never to take foolish risks. "Plan first, then act." That's every respectable journalist's motto!

text.Mireille: If it's a "plan" you're looking for, I'd say you have one right here. Wouldn't you?

text.Damon: So, my good mercenary. If I might impose upon you again, it would be lovely if you investigated Lookout Point for me.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Damon again.

CHOICE.Damon: The forgotten Lookout Point deep within the scrap. Could it be that this place holds the secrets of the Angel? This is what we need to find out!
If you do happen to run afoul of any ravenous fiends, it would be lovely if you did something about it. For the truth!
I promise I'll pay you once the job's complete. Just make sure you come back with good news—or any news!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille again.

CHOICE.Mireille: Heard the monster up at Lookout Point ain't your average beastie. You be careful now.
Don't let that thing lay a claw on Aerith, you hear me?
Hm. This oughta be good. Best be on your way, merc.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Chromogger.

text.Cloud: Okay then. Guess we should look around.

text.ACTION: Upon inspecting the Angel's calling card.

text.Cloud: "The Guardian Angel of the Slums will collect your offering on behalf of the poor."

text.Aerith: This must be one of her calling cards!

text.Cloud: I don't see anything else interesting. Let's head back and tell them what we found.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport in front of Damon.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Damon after inspecting the card.

text.Damon: I can't believe it! You found one of her calling cards! This is the genuine article, I'm sure of it! Penned by the Angel herself!

text.Mireille: Hmm... So this is one of her famous warnings.

text.Damon: It's an incredible find! Oh—was that all?

text.Mireille: Hold on. Looks like there's something else—a message. "To the nosy Shinra reporter sniffing around... I was planning to teach you a lesson you would never forget. However, by the grace of your mercenary friend, you were spared that lesson. But next time he might not be around to save you. You would be wise to watch your step."

text.Damon: Not just a message from the Angel... A warning!

text.Mireille: If the merc here hadn't bailed you out, that fiend in the scrap would've ripped you to shreds. Sorry about that, friend. Here I was just trying to help you out, but instead my kindness almost got you violently killed.

text.Damon: Now, now. No harm, no foul... right? In any case, I hope this narrowly averted tragedy won't discourage you from sharing information with me in the future.

text.Undercity Resident (Male 2): Hey, everybody! The Angel left another calling card! She's gonna rip off Don Corneo!

text.Undercity Resident (Male 8): Don Corneo's no easy mark. I can't wait to see how this goes down!

text.Damon: Excuse me! I'm a reporter for the Daily Buzz and—

text.Mireille: Here. Why don't you take this? Oh, and no need to thank me. Let's just say it slipped out of that reporter's pocket. (laughs) Can't call it theft if you're just claiming what you're owed—am I right? Well done, mister merc. You certainly lived up to your reputation.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille after the quest is complete.

CHOICE.Mireille: You know, there's a rumor that the Angel of the Slums is as radiant and beautiful as she is daring. Personally, I think that one's true.
Now what could our Angel want from a man like Don Corneo? Of all his many goodies—or maybe she wants his whole fortune!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the old man.

text.Old Man: Oh, I know you. You must be that mercenary. I have a problem. It's the anniversary of my wife's death, and I wanted to visit her grave. But I can't because some creatures have turned the graveyard into their nest. Could you do me a favor and go there in my stead? She shouldn't be alone today.

That's fine, that's fine. The graveyard's right by the head of the river. But I heard they put a new gate in recently to replace the old broken one. Now that those creatures have moved in, I'm sure it's locked up tight.

text.STATUS: If Cloud has the graveyard key.

text.Aerith: Didn't we buy a graveyard key off Moggie? I think we did.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Old Man again before completing the task.

text.Old Man: You'll find my wife's grave with all the others out by the river's head. But I suspect you're going to need a key to get past the new gate they put in.

text.ACTION: After defeating the enemies at the graveyard.

text.Aerith: This must be it.
Hey. You wanna say a prayer too?

text.Cloud: No thanks. I think you've got it covered.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", teleport to the old man.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the old man after defeating them.

text.Scared Man: I'm really grateful for what you did. Here's your reward. I owe him a lot—maybe more than I can ever repay. And now I owe you a lot too. I know it's not much, but I hope it makes up for it a little bit.

text.Aerith: We paid our respects to your wife—and we took care of those creatures.

text.Old Man: Oh, that's such a relief to hear. I can't tell you how much it was weighing on my mind. I was beginning to think I might never be able to visit her grave again. With my bad back and my legs—my whole body's a mess, frankly—I... I didn't think I could make it past the creatures. But I was prepared to die trying. And then you two came along.
Still, I've got to face facts. Creatures or no, I can't keep making these trips...

text.Cloud: This is the graveyard key. Run it back to Moggie.

text.Old Man: But... I just told you about my legs...

text.Scared Man: Why don't you just give it back?

text.Cloud: Okay. It'll cost you five thousand gil though.

text.Old Man: It's always money with you people! Hmph. Fine! I won't ask you for anything else! I'll take your damned key and give it to the boy!
It's downright depressing. What is the world coming to these days...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the old man again.

CHOICE.Old Man: Money! That's all you kids think about. Not a whit of generosity or selflessness. May as well keep working till the day I die!
Maybe it's not too late for kids to learn that life's about more than just *money*!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the scared man again.

CHOICE.Scared Man: You're a real dick, you know that? But on the bright side, it seems he's all fired up again.
I don't know if you knew, but he used to offer free lessons to all the street kids in the neighborhood. And yeah, I was one of those street kids.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith's garden.

text.Aerith: Wait a sec.
So... you coming?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Aerith by the flower bed.

text.Aerith: Shh. So yeah... It was that kind of day.
Let's go. Shouldn't keep Mom waiting.
"Good work today, guys."
Kidding. They didn't say a word. But you know... Ah... never mind. It's not like you'd believe me after all.
Really?

It won't be much longer now. The flowers, they... they have something important to tell us. Something they... need to share with us. At least, that's the feeling I get. But... before they can... there's a final step that has to be taken. Otherwise... we won't hear them. Maybe I should just give up. Honestly, it's what I do best.

text.Cloud: Could've fooled me. From what I've seen, you're no quitter.

text.Aerith: Well today's special! That's why I've been working my butt off.

text.Cloud: Uh... What's so special about it?

text.Aerith: Okay, time to go!
Did the flowers say anything?
That's the spirit!

text.Elmyra: Where have you two been? I've been worried sick.

text.Aerith: Sorry. We got a little sidetracked.

text.Elmyra: Dinner's ready, in case you're wondering.

text.Aerith: Ah, great!

text.Elmyra: But before we sit down—I want you to make up the guest room.

text.Aerith: Gotcha! Take a load off, okay?

text.Elmyra: Judging by those eyes, I'm guessing you're a SOLDIER?
I hate to ask... but would you leave here tonight? Without any fuss—no questions? You boys made a trade—a normal life for power. You can't have it both ways.

text.Aerith: I'm back!

text.Elmyra: Good. Now—I hope you're hungry.

text.Aerith: Starving. Right?

text.ACTION: In Cloud's dream.

text.Claudia: I've never been so proud. The man you've become... Women must be hounding you day and night.
You know, there's all kinds of temptations in the big city. I'd feel a lot better if I knew you'd found a good girl—one who'd make sure you didn't get into trouble.

text.Cloud: I can take care of myself.

text.Claudia: An older, more mature girl that could keep you on the straight and narrow—and tell you when you're being a silly goose. That's the perfect type for you, I'd say.

text.ACTION: After Cloud wakes up.

text.Cloud: Don't want to overstay my welcome.

text.ACTION: Upon waking Aerith up the first time.

text.Aerith: What're you doing?
Did you have a bad dream? Don't worry. You'll feel much better in the morning. And I promise to take you straight home.

text.Cloud: Please don't let her hear me again.

text.ACTION: Upon waking Aerith a second time.

text.Aerith: You jerk! I thought I told you not to leave your room. Now get back in there!

text.ACTION: Upon waking Aerith a third time.

text.Aerith: No. More. Games.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the ground floor.

text.Elmyra: You're leaving.

text.Cloud: So, how do I get to Sector 7?

text.Elmyra: It's simple enough. Just cut through Sector 6. It isn't exactly safe, but you should be okay, seeing as you're a SOLDIER.
Promise me. You'll never talk to Aerith again. Please.
Thank you.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Elmyra.

text.Elmyra: I'm sorry.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Housemother.

text.Housemother: If it isn't the new florist! I appreciate you helping the kids out today. Thank you. They won't stop talking about the SOLDIER who "saved the day." And make sure to give my thanks to Aerith too.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Housemother again.

CHOICE.Housemother: The kids are talking about you like they've found themselves a new hero. Thank you for being there for the children. I really appreciate it.
Are you working at this hour?

text.LOCATION: Chapter 9: The Town That Never Sleeps

text.Aerith: Well, look who it is. Talk about a coincidence.
Waiting.
Because I'm not sick of you yet.
With pleasure. (hums)
Cloud? Is something wrong?

text.ACTION: While walking down the S6-5 Road.

text.Aerith: They're still working on the new plate. I don't like this part of Midgar. Back when they were still building Midgar, there was an accident, and the plate fell. People had only just started moving in, so there weren't a lot living there at the time, but...

text.ACTION: Halfway along the road.

text.Aerith: The underside of Sector 6. "Wall Market." A real *special* place. But... I'm sure you already knew that, right?

text.Cloud: I didn't tell you? I enlisted pretty much right after I left home. Dunno much about this place, or any of the slums.

text.Aerith: Well, it took a lot of people to build Midgar. And they all needed to blow off steam. So some traders built an entertainment district. Inns, shops, bars, the works. Folks started pouring in from all over. Business was booming, money was flowing... Which attracted the attention of some guys who... didn't much care for the law.

Right. But instead of trying to solve the problem, the government decided to just wall it in. And that's how Wall Market began. "Out of sight, out of mind," as the old saying goes. For the folks in charge, there's no better way to deal with it.

text.Cloud: So it's like a giant veil.

text.Aerith: Yeah. Wanna see what's behind it?
That's good—'cause I know a better way to get to Sector 7. One that—tragically—doesn't go through Wall Market. And it's just through this tunnel here. At least it was, back when I was a kid.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Collapsed Expressway.

text.Aerith: It's been like this, you know. Ever since the plate fell.
It'll be an adventure.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the first robot arm.

text.Aerith: A big arm. Kinda cute, don't you think?

text.ACTION: Upon dropping to the first Robot Arm Worksite.

text.Aerith: Oh, great. Someone's pulled up the ladder.
I wonder if we can use this.

text.ACTION: Upon offering Aerith a ride with the robot arm.

text.Aerith: Here's an idea. I'll hop on, and you give me a ride.
Absolutely! I'll throw down the ladder for you to climb up after.

text.ACTION: After dropping Aerith by the ladder.

text.Aerith: Piece of cake! Gimme a sec.
And here comes the ladder.
Well? What did I tell ya?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith.

text.Aerith: You did it!
Hm?
Alright, good enough. Let's keep on truckin'!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Sweeper Prototype.

text.Aerith: Did we wake it up?

text.ACTION: After destroying it.

text.Aerith: Huh, that's weird. Used to be a way through here.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Aerith.

text.Aerith: I wonder if someone blocked it off because of all the monsters that kept showing up.

text.Cloud: Pretty dangerous place for kids to play.

text.Aerith: Raised in the slums, remember?
Hmm, that supposed to be a compliment?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the tunnel.

text.Aerith: Looks like a dead end.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the robot arm controls at the Machinery Graveyard.

text.Aerith: Hey, I bet you can grab that container with the arm.

text.ACTION: After grabbing the container.

text.Aerith: Not half bad! So, do you moonlight as a crane operator or something?
Yeah?
Uhhh...
Aw, no. Look. Why's it always gotta be so tough? Lucky for me, you'll make this easier.
Well then, I'm gonna head down.
Okay, Cloud! Ready!

text.ACTION: Upon dropping Aerith near the magic materia.

text.Aerith: Hold on a second.
Gotcha!

text.ACTION: Upon dropping Aerith by the ladder.

text.Aerith: Okay, right there! Hold on while I drop the ladder!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith.

text.Aerith: Cloud, over here!

text.ACTION: Upon descending the ladder to the Thugs' Lair.

text.Aerith: Whoa. Not too fast, okay?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith at the end of the Large Cave-In if the Thugs' Lair has not been reached yet.

text.Aerith: Well, jumping's not an option, that's for sure.
Someone made a campfire.

text.Cloud: If they found a way down, so can we.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the campfire in Thugs' Lair.

text.Aerith: Anybody around?
Guess it's just us.
Should we relight it? Have our own campfire?

text.Cloud: I need to get back. Besides—

text.Beck: Lookie here, boys! Caught us some burglars!

text.Burke: Comin' into our homes and stealing out shit—doin' crimes!

text.Beck: I'd say we're owed "compensatory damages"!

text.Butch: Yeah! Complementary—uh, composite— Uh, I don't get it.

text.Beck: How stupid can you be? It's crazy simple! Compensatory damages is like, uh... It's like... compensation... For damages!

text.Burke: Oh yeah! (laughs) That's what you get when you... no, when somebody else! Uh...

text.Aerith: Yeah. We were just passing through.
Okay, what do you want?

text.Beck: Nothing but our due recompense—that's all!
No, shit-for-brains! "Due recompense"! It's like... uh... It's like... uh... Compensatory damages!

text.Butch: Oh! So damage is recompense! I get it!

text.Beck: Simple as that!

text.Aerith: I think we've heard enough.

text.ACTION: After defeating Beck, Burke, and Butch.

text.Beck: Okay, guys. Whatever you do... don't move...

text.ACTION: Upon passing further through the Thugs' Lair.

text.Beck: Shit! Let's get the hell outta here!

text.Butch: Wait, you guys! Don't leave me! I'm coming!

text.Aerith: Random question, but... why did you quit being a SOLDIER?
You don't have to tell me if you don't want to.
Um, did you have any SOLDIER friends? Any war buddies?
Oh, okay.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first group of bandits.

text.Bandit (2): Fresh meat to test our new toy on, that's what!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the robot arm controls for the Dual Robot Arms Worksite.

text.Aerith: Stupid ladders. Always out of reach... Okay Cloud, heading down. You're in charge of the arm, got it?

text.ACTION: After dropping Aerith by the support materia.

text.Aerith: Gotcha.

text.ACTION: Upon hitting Aerith with the robot arm.

text.Aerith: Cloud?!

text.ACTION: After reaching Aerith by the ladder at the end.

text.Aerith: That went pretty well.
Hm? Wait a minute, did you just... ?
Don't worry, we'll be on the same page next time.
I'm sorry, okay!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the enemies at the end of the Utility Tunnel.

text.Bandit (2): You wanna pass through our territory, then you gotta pay the toll!

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Aerith: We made it! Smell the fresh air?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith at the end of the Utility Tunnel.

text.Aerith: Cloud. Up top.

text.ACTION: While waiting before giving Aerith a high five.
Upon reaching Evergreen Park.

text.Aerith: Alright, there it is. The gate to Sector 7.

text.Cloud: Looks shut. How do we open it?

text.Aerith: More importantly, how about we take a break? Sound good?

text.Cloud: No. I don't have time for—

text.Aerith: Up there looks nice.
C'mon!
You know, a long time ago, I used to sell flowers here.
So, Cloud... You were a SOLDIER: First Class, right?
Weird.
Nothing. Just that you were the same rank.
The first guy I ever loved.

text.Cloud: What's his name? I probably know him.

text.Aerith: Are you okay?
Wow... Your eyes.

text.Cloud: Oh. It's 'cause of the mako. All SOLDIERs have 'em.

text.Aerith: Yeah... I know. Sorry, I'm bumming you out. We should go.
Gotta look forward, not back.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with Aerith by the tunnel.

text.Aerith: Here. This won't take long.
Ready! Wanna get to Sector 7 in style? This is the passageway for you.
So...
Go ahead.

text.Cloud: You gonna be okay getting home?

text.Aerith: And if I said I wasn't?
Thought you needed to get back? (chuckles) Don't worry. I have a backup route for emergencies. And it's safer too.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Aerith again.

text.Aerith: Guess this is it, then. Ready?

CHOICE.Aerith: Aww, you big softie. Gonna miss me?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon talking to Aerith again after first answering "No."

CHOICE.Aerith: Nothing wrong with taking a little break.

text.Tifa: Cloud! You're alive! I thought we'd lost you!
Shh. I'll explain everything later. But now, I'm on my way to see Don Corneo. You should head back to Seventh Heaven, meet up with the gang.
I'll be fine. You've seen how much ass I can kick.

text.Aerith: Oh no you don't. You're going after her.

text.Cloud: She's a big girl. She can handle the likes of him. And worse.

text.Aerith: Uh-uh. You don't know Corneo. It doesn't matter how strong or smart you think you are. He'll find a way to turn it against you. And where's she going to meet him? A mansion filled with his goons. Come on. Aren't you worried what might happen in there? You have to help her!
Come on!
Come on, Cloud. We gotta hurry!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Stablehand by Wall Market.

text.Aerith: You gave a ride to a girl earlier. Do you have any idea where she went?

text.Stablehand: No, and if you don't need a ride, then get the hell outta here. Can't you see I'm trying to work?
What'd you say to me, you little—

text.Sam: What's all the ruckus out here? Hmm... I don't know you. What's your story?

text.Aerith: We're looking for a girl who took one of your carriages. Can you help us find her?

text.Sam: Depends. What d'you want with this girl of yours?

text.Aerith: Save her from a life without this handsome guy!

text.Sam: So that's how it is, huh? Well, I get a lotta customers. Hard to keep track of 'em all. This girl, what's she look like?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "She's great at handling the books."

CHOICE.Cloud: She's... great at handling the books.

CHOICE.Aerith: Cloud, I really don't think that'll help.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Sam: Wait a minute, you talking about Tifa?
Oho, looks like someone's got a bit of a crush! Hate to break your heart, kid, but it's gonna be a long while before she sees the light of day again.
She's a real pretty girl. Corneo's hosting another audition, and Tifa was chosen as a candidate.

text.Aerith: An audition for what?

text.Sam: For the title of the next Mrs. Corneo. She's what he likes, all rolled into one sweet package. Having scouted girls for so long, I know his tastes better than my own. And considering those tastes, I can guarantee you this: she won't be walking out of that mansion anytime soon... if at all.

text.Cloud: So where can we find this Don Corneo?

text.Sam: What're you asking for? Thinking of raising holy hell or something? Do what you gotta, but leave me out of it. I told you what you wanna know—now take a walk.

text.Aerith: And there goes our best lead yet. Maybe we'll have better luck in town. Let's check it out.

text.ACTION: Upon entering Wall Market.

text.Barker: Welcome to Wall Market, the pleasure capital of Midgar that's got everything for everybody! Couple, huh? S'all good! Play together, do your own thing—earn a little scratch on the side, even—whatever you're into, we got you. Got a special onetime limited offer—

text.Aerith: No, thank you! Come on, Cloud—let's go!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Barker.

CHOICE.Barker: So, what kind of mischief you looking to get up to tonight?
You gotta let go of your inhibitions and set yourself free!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the inn.

text.Barker: You two! Yes, you! Do you have a place to stay this enchanted evening? We have the perfect room for a sweet-looking couple like you!

CHOICE.Aerith: But you thought about it, didn't you?

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Barker: Just give me a holler when you change your mind.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Barker outside the inn again.

CHOICE.Barker: No preferences we can't accommodate, no sir.
Hey, hey, heeey! If you're looking for the most unforgettable night of your life, look no further!
Enjoy a sleepless night in the city true to its name!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Innkeeper.

text.Innkeeper: Welcome. Are you in need of accommodations?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny's Father.

CHOICE.Johnny's father: You know, I've heard from more than a few people that my son, Johnny, has been roaming the streets of Wall Market. Before he leaves town, I need to make sure I deliver him his lucky pillow. I have faith in my boy, of course. But a growing man needs plenty of sleep—sleep of good quality, no less. That's how mind and body stay healthy and active. In other words, this pillow is crucial to his health.

My wife is back in Sector 7. I thought it best she wait for me there because the establishments in this town are, uh, provocative. Of course, I haven't been to any myself so I don't know what goes on around here. Not in the slightest.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the item procurement machine room.

CHOICE.Barker: Step right up, step right up! It's the fully automated, state-of-the-art item procurement machine!
Welcome to the world of tomorrow! Any item you can think of, just a button push away!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to use the machine.

text.Aerith: Maybe it's broken?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Barker outside the item procurement machine.

CHOICE.Barker: Huh? What's that? Not working, you say? Maybe there's something wrong with the wiring...
Huh!? It *shot* you!? Well, that's not good for business. Wiring must be faulty or something...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Pharmacist.

text.Pharmacist: Hey there. We're a pharmacy, but we stock other stuff too.

text.ACTION: After closing the Pharmacist store menu.
Upon talking to the Restaurant Owner.

text.Restaurant Owner: Hey there, friend! Grab a seat, any that's open.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Restaurant Owner again.
Upon talking to the Materia Vendor.

text.Materia Vendor: See the sign out front? All I got is materia.

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.
Upon talking to Chadley.

text.Chadley: Cloud! I will go wherever my research leads me, but the success of my endeavors rests entirely upon you. Your assistance would be much appreciated.

text.ACTION: After closing Chadley's menu.

text.Chadley: Cloud, I've registered a new summons battle intel request. Please take a look. I need you to defeat the summoned entity so I can complete the materia.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the Fat Chocobo.

text.Chadley: Truly amazing work, Cloud! This is incontrovertible proof that the universe has a sense of humor. Now that you have a fun new partner in Fat Chocobo, you can work together to squash Shinra like a bug.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Cowgirl before obtaining the "Farm Boy" disc.

text.Cowgirl: I can't believe I bought the same disc twice. Excuse me, sir. If you like, you can have it.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Cowgirl again.

text.Cowgirl: Even if you love the artist, you don't need more than one copy.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Thugs in an alleyway northwest.

CHOICE.Thug: It's always best to be prepared for the worst, wouldn't you agree?
Quality monster insurance is more essential than ever these days.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Receptionist at the Honeybee Inn.

CHOICE.Honeybee Receptionist: My apologies, sir. We are not ready to open at this time.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ms. Folia.
Upon talking to Ms. Folia a second time.

text.Ms. Folia: Hey! What the hell, merc!? Digging into people's personal affairs in this town is a huge no-no!
Well, if you must know... I've wanted to be a dancer ever since I was a little girl. I come here at night to live the dream. I'd appreciate it if you didn't tell the children, okay?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ms. Folia again.

CHOICE.Ms. Folia: I practice every second I can. It's the only way I'll become the best!
I've always wanted to dance for a living.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ms. Folia a second time if "Kids of Patrol" was not completed.

text.Honeygirl: Um are you a customer? In case you can't tell, I'm on a break. If you're looking for a good time, I'm sure you can find it inside.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ms. Folia again if "Kids of Patrol" was not completed.

text.Honeygirl: Sorry, buddy, but I'm on a break right now.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Undercity Residents in an alleyway northwest.

text.Undercity Resident (Older Man with Glass: Hey. You hear 'bout that real narrow street just over there... ?

text.Undercity Resident (Older Man): You're not still wasting your gil at the Honeybee Inn, are ya?

text.Undercity Resident (Older Man with Glass: You bet I am. Found me a secret route in, one nobody don't know about. Only trouble is, it's filled with drunks 'n' garbage!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Man in Line in the bar.

text.Man In Line: Shit! These are high stakes, man!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Patient inside the bar's bathroom.
Upon talking to the Singer at the bar's karoake stand.

text.Singer: Thank you. I signed with Shinra Records a while back, but I'm still looking for my first big hit. It's been seven years now. Not easy, but you gotta do what you love—and I love to sing. This is a new song of mine. Maybe it'll be that number one.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Clothing Store Owner at the bar.

text.Clothing Store Owner: Dig a hole and throw me in. I'm already dead.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Weapons Vendor.

text.Weapons Vendor: Welcome to Wall Market's premier weapons shop!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Corneo's mansion.

text.Aerith: Check it out! I think we might've found our man... and he's a gaudy one.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Leslie.

text.Leslie: Not so fast, buddy. Back it up. Got no need for pretty boys here.
Lemme guess. First time in Wall Market.
So people can't just walk through the don's front door. Especially men.

text.Aerith: How 'bout me, then? Can I go inside?

text.Leslie: Maybe, but you're gonna wish you didn't.

text.Corneo Lackey (1): Y'know, Leslie, she's kinda cute. Homely, but cute.

text.Aerith: Excuse you?

text.Leslie: "Kinda cute" is not gonna cut it.

text.Aerith: Come on, can't you help us out?

text.Leslie: Do you have any idea what you're getting yourself into?

text.Corneo Lackey (2): Seriously, Les, she's not half bad! With a little work, I bet she'd clean up real nice.

text.Aerith: Cloud... requesting permission to kill.

text.Leslie: If you're really sure you wanna join an audition, then you're gonna need to get official approval.

text.Aerith: And who can give us that?

text.Leslie: The Trio—the only ones in town who're considered authorities on Corneo's particular tastes. First, there's Chocobo Sam. And then there's Madam M, over at the massage parlor. Last but not least, there's the Honeybee Inn's Andrea Rhodea. They're an eccentric bunch, to put it mildly, and you should know they don't recommend just any girl stupid enough to come knocking.

text.Aerith: Hmm, duly noted. Thanks for the info. We'll be back soon.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Leslie again.

text.Leslie: If you're hell-bent on getting in, then go bother the Trio.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering Johnny.

text.Johnny: Warmth, relaxation, the sweet embrace of pretty ladies! That's what I need!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Johnny: To enter, or not to enter. *That* is the question. Wherefore does this philosophical quandary torment me!? You totally get where I'm coming from, right?

CHOICE.Johnny: Hah! I *knew* it! Let me guess—after you've had your fun, you fall into a spiral of shame and self-loathing. But it only lasts a moment, doesn't it? Next thing you know, you're right back here again... Huh? Gotta question for me?

Yeah, I should've figured. You're not the philosophical introspective type like me. That soft, naive face. I know your kind well, bro. You're just another musclehead who uses violence to work through your inner demons. It's sad, really. Huh? Yeah, what's up?

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Johnny: Tifa? My love, my light!? Who are you, and how do you know her!? No, shut up. I don't care! Tifa's here? Why!? Tell me why! Oh god, no. I did this to her, didn't I. She came looking for me, to beg me not to leave her! Snap out of it, Johnny. Your Tifa needs you! Tifa—I'm coming, baby!

text.Aerith: Who was that... ?

text.Cloud: Nobody you want or need to know.

text.Aerith: If you've got any better ideas...

text.Johnny: So that's the way it is, hmmm? Tifa's been invited invited into the don's estate...

text.Aerith: Huh?

text.Johnny: But! To earn such a privilege, you must first win the approval of one of the Trio. Right? Meaning! I now know what I must do to save her! Stay strong, Tifa! Help is on the way! Johnny's comin', baby!

text.Aerith: Not the sharpest tool in the shed, is he?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Sam.

text.Johnny: What were you thinking!? Stupid, stupid, stupid! Crawl into a hole and die!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny after he sits down.

CHOICE.Johnny: You should've known better. Always go with your gut!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam.

text.Sam: Not you two again. Told you once, I'll tell you a thousand times—got nothin' for you. Now scram.

text.Aerith: Wait, hear us out. You're one of the Trio, right? I want you to get me into the audition.

text.Sam: Huh?

text.Aerith: Pretty please?

text.Sam: Why not.

text.Aerith: Really!?

text.Sam: Sure. Next time an audition comes round, I'll put your name in the hat.

text.Aerith: Next time will be too late. Can't you get me into this one?

text.Sam: You want in now? No can do, sweetheart. I already recommended Tifa, and she's got this in the bag.

text.Aerith: How can you be so sure Corneo will pick Tifa? You never know. He might pick me.

text.Sam: Damn, you really do want in, don't you?

text.Aerith: Sure do!

text.Sam: Then how's about we play for it? Call it, missy. Heads or tails. Guess right, and I'll grant you your wish. Guess wrong, and you'll leave me in peace.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Sam: Hey, don't look so glum. You're a pretty enough gal, just... not quite Corneo's cup of tea. But if only the don will do, try convincing one of the other two. That's why it's a Trio, and not just the me-oh. Now skedaddle.

text.Cloud: Wait. Mind if I see that coin of yours?
Trick coin. I had a hunch.

text.Aerith: That's cheating!

text.Cloud: And that's the Wall Market way. Lesson learned.

text.Aerith: Still cheating.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Honeybee Inn.

text.Johnny: Damn, man... It wasn't supposed to go down like this. I-I just wanted to see Andrea. Curse my weak will... But... It was like whoa...

text.Aerith: Think so.

text.Cloud: Lemme handle this. You wait out here, okay?

text.Aerith: And why would I do that? No, I'm coming with.
You're a man of many talents, but "talking" isn't one of them.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny after he sits down.

text.Johnny: I mean, shit...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Honeybee Inn.

text.Aerith: Whoa... (chuckles)
Heya.

text.Honeybee Receptionist: Welcome to the heart and soul of Wall Market—the Honeybee Inn. Is there a honeyboy or girl whose company you desire?

text.Cloud: We're here to see Andrea Rhodea.

text.Honeybee Receptionist: Ahhh, the shining star of the Honeybee Inn. Now, are you the one who made the appointment, sir? Can I have your name?

text.Cloud: Oh, we don't have an appointment.

text.Honeybee Receptionist: I see... I'm terribly sorry, sir. An appointment is required, and the earliest available slot is three years from now.

text.Aerith: Three years!?

text.Cloud: All we want is five minutes. He can spare that.

text.Aerith: I need his help for the Corneo audition.

text.Honeybee Receptionist: Yes, well, regardless of the circumstances, you cannot meet him without an appointment.

text.Aerith: Is there really no other way?

text.Honeybee Receptionist: It is rare, but Mr. Rhodea does occasionally extend invitations to individuals who catch his eye. Otherwise, I'm sorry, but there really is nothing that can be done.

text.Aerith: I guess that's that, then. Ah well. Let's try someone else.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Receptionist again.

text.Honeybee Receptionist: I'm sorry that I couldn't be of more help to you.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open the door to her parlor before completing "Sam" and "Andrea Rhodea" first.

text.Aerith: I guess they're closed right now?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Madam M's parlor after completing the other two.

text.Johnny: The hell is this bullshit? I ain't payin' that much!

text.Madam M: Well this ain't a charity—so if you don't have the gil to pay, then get the hell out!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny after he runs into a corner.

CHOICE.Johnny: Ol' Johnny's been had. She's a siren, I tell you...

text.ACTION: Upon entering Madam M's parlor.

text.Madam M: Welcome, welcome. Just the two of you? Step right up. Now then, what manner of massage do you desire?

text.Aerith: Say what?

text.Madam M: This your first time in our establishment? We are a hand-massage parlor. An excess of fatigue and tension can make even the simplest task a terrible strain. It is our pleasure to relieve our patrons of that tension. (chuckles) And what better way to seek relief than through the skilled ministrations of a professional? So now that we understand each other, what manner of massage do you desire?
Then you are... ?

text.Aerith: Hoping you can help us get an invite to an audition with Don C—

text.Madam M: Oh for the love of— Say another word and I'll shove this fan right down your throat!

This is the last thing I need. You're young and stupid, and I suppose that means you think I'll let you off easy. So you want what? A favor? Well, here's the thing... This is a massage parlor—a respectable establishment. But if you don't require our services... Then tell me! Is there any reason I shouldn't have you dragged outside and shot for wasting my valuable time!? Well!?
Hm. Name?
Hand.
Give it to me!
The strong, firm hands of a fighter... yet they possess a certain elegance and grace. Okay, Cloud. Let's see what you're made of. After that... we'll talk.
So. Which course will it be?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Not today."

text.Madam M: Hmph! If you're not a customer, then get out.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting Madam M a second time if "Not today." was previously selected.

text.Madam M: Ready to take the plunge, are we.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to interact with a vase.

CHOICE.Madam M: Keep your filthy hands to yourself.
Do you even know how much that costs?
If you break it, you're paying for it.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting a course the player cannot afford.

text.Madam M: Hey! You don't have enough for that. Why don't you choose a course you can actually afford?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting any course if the player has enough gil.

text.Madam M: Then make your way to the room in the back... and wait.

text.Aerith: Cloud...

CHOICE.Madam M: This exclusive treatment is reserved for our most well-to-do patrons... First... the hand cream... A generous coating for each and every one of your richly deserving fingers...
Let's start... with the tips... That's it. Relax. I'm only here to help.
Oh? Did that hurt?
Then I'll move on... to the base of the fingers... Let's see if we can't improve your circulation. Get that blood flowing.
No, don't fight it. Stress is poison to the body. And finally... some gentle simulation for the palm. No more than a touch. Just like this.
Oh? What was that? A cry of pleasure? Is this how you like it? How about this? Or maybe this?
If that was to your liking, do come again.
Well then. It should go without saying that you get what you pay for. All four fingers at once. Quick and to the point.
Hm? I can stop at any time if it's too much to handle.
Try flexing the muscles. You'll feel the difference.
Loose and limber. Am I right?

CHOICE.STATUS: If "Poor Man's Course - 100 G" was chosen.

CHOICE.Madam M: I should warn you. This technique has certain risks. It's somewhat... experimental. You may find it extremely pleasurable and rewarding. Or the opposite.
Absolutely not. You asked for this, now take it like a man!

text.ACTION: After Cloud returns from a massage.

text.Aerith: How was it?

CHOICE.STATUS: If "Poor Man's Course - 100 G" was chosen.

CHOICE.Aerith: Did something happen to you in there?

CHOICE.Cloud: Just... just give me a sec.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Madam M: Think you'll make a habit of it?
All right then. I think I've seen everything I need to see.

text.Aerith: So...

text.Madam M: Tell me what you want and we'll take it from there.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M.

text.Aerith: You're one of the Trio, right? I want to get into Corneo's next audition.

text.Madam M: And why in the world would you want to do that? Hmmm... Okay.

text.Aerith: Really!?

text.Madam M: But. You cannot go dressed like that.

text.Aerith: Huh?

text.Madam M: I could never send Corneo a candidate wearing such a plain-looking getup. Doing so would call my position as one of the Trio into question.

text.Aerith: Is something wrong with my outfit?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "It matter what I think?"

CHOICE.Aerith: Well I think it's pretty cool.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Madam M: Look, just... take it outside the parlor, would you?

text.Aerith: Sorry, we'll stop. So... what should I do about the outfit?

text.Madam M: You just leave that to me. I'll put you in a dress so fabulous, you'll look like a million gil. So long as you can afford it.

What I said. But don't worry. It's obvious you can't afford a dress with that kind of price tag. So listen. I have an idea. There's an underground colosseum in this town. Up for a fight, Cloud? Good, because I'm getting you into that arena. If you win the tournament, I'll transform Aerith into a drop-dead gorgeous beauty.
Yes—for the person who got you in. So? What do you say?
That's what I like to hear. You'll need this. They're already letting fighters inside. You should hurry, run along.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M.

text.Madam M: Remember: you are going to win me that money.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the parlor.

text.Aerith: What have we gotten ourselves into?

text.Cloud: Nothing good. I wouldn't expect a fair fight in this town...

text.Aerith: Think we can win it all?

text.Cloud: That's one thing I'm definitely sure of.

text.Aerith: I appreciate the confidence, just... don't get too cocky, okay?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Corneo Colosseum.

text.Staff (4): Spectators, please enter from the right, and contenders from the left.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny's Father opposite the gym.

text.Johnny's father: Wall Market really is one helluva town, isn't it? I'm sure my son Johnny learned a lot of lessons about life right here. The hard way, of course. Oh, my beautiful boy! As your father, and as someone who's been where you are, I look forward to seeing the man you become.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny's Father opposite the gym a second time.

text.Johnny's father: I heard there was some sort of tournament going on. That must be why it's so crowded. It almost made me miss a chance to get a ticket to my favorite place. What's that? Oh, I could never tell!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Souvenir Shop Owner.

CHOICE.Souvenir Shop Owner: Everybody knows I've got the best colosseum souvenirs around! And when I'm open for business, you can buy some!
I'm waiting for a shipment of fresh stock, but be sure to swing by on your way out.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the first Staff by the spectator entrance.

CHOICE.Staff (2): You lost? This is for spectators only.
Check-in for contenders is over there.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the second Staff by the spectator entrance.

CHOICE.Staff (7): This check-in is for spectators only.
Contenders should take the elevator over to the left.
If you're in the tournament, you really oughta hurry.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the third Staff by the spectator entrance.

CHOICE.Staff (8): The entrance for contenders is over there.
Please go to the designated area.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Staff by the Colosseum elevator.

text.Staff (1): What's this? You're here to compete? I hope you know you're cutting it really close. So—the two of you are a team?

text.Aerith: Yes! The two of us are a team!
I need to get into that audition, but I won't let anyone else fight my battles for me. That includes you, mister.

text.Staff (1): All right, team it is. Head to the waiting area down below.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Staff by the Colosseum elevator a second time.

text.Staff (1): You need to take the elevator down. Don't keep 'em waiting.

text.ACTION: After taking the elevator down.

text.Aerith: Down, down, down we go.
So how deep does this thing go, you think?
I wonder how many people are fighting.
Hey, you're not nervous, are you?
Really? You're even more quiet than usual.

text.Cloud: Just trying to focus. Like you should.

text.ACTION: After leaving the elevator.

text.Scotch: In the city that never sleeps!

text.Kotch: In the paradise of debauchery and sin—of pain and pleasure!

text.Scotch: Where your every desire can be indulged for the right price—Wall Market!

text.Kotch: To you esteemed connoisseurs of chaos and bloodshed—we bid you the warmest of welcomes!

text.Scotch: Are you sitting comfortably? For tonight, the most gruesome spectacle anywhere in Wall Market or beyond shall be yours to witness! Here in the Corneo Colosseum!

text.Kotch: Tonight's grand prize is no less than one million gil! And there is only one way to get it: brutalize your opponent!

text.Scotch: Thoroughly and utterly!

text.Kotch: Viciously!

text.Scotch: Without mercy!

text.Kotch: Until they vomit blood!

text.Scotch: Only the most ruthless fighters—

text.Kotch: The savages still standing here at the end—

text.Scotch: Shall claim the gil and the glory!

text.Kotch: And now, the long-awaited event in which the blood-starved beasts will battle for your amusement is upon us!

text.Scotch: Warriors of every shape and size will fight to the death before your very eyes! In tonight's Corneooo Cuuup!

text.Aerith: Wow, this place is really something.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Staff.

text.Staff (Cap): You two—wait here until it's time.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper before the announcement.

text.Gatekeeper: Uh, it's not your turn yet. Your names will be announced over the speaker. Just wait until then.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Johnny: Oh... You again.

text.Aerith: Ouch! What happened to your face?

text.Johnny: I just needed a little scratch, you know? So I signed up for the preliminaries, and well... I hope you guys realize what you're getting into. I don't wanna scare you but if you can make a run for it, you should.

text.Announcer (Corneo Cup): Cloud and Aerith. Your match will begin shortly. Please make your way to the gate.

text.Aerith: We're in way too deep to back out now.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny again.

text.Johnny: Never been more scared in my entire life.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the bottle next to Johnny.

text.Johnny: It's a gift from Don Corneo. Drink it, and they say you'll be raring to go for hours on end. If I had, maybe things would've gone differently for me. Maybe you should. It's yours if you want.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "I'll taste it."

text.Aerith: How is it?
But you... like it so much you couldn't possibly share, right?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper.

text.Gatekeeper: You two ready?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Not yet."

text.Gatekeeper: Come on! Hurry it up!

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Ready."

text.Gatekeeper: Try not to get yourselves killed.

text.Scotch: For our next match, we welcome two fighters—a young couple, no less!

text.Kotch: Talk about a bad date!

text.Scotch: This is their first tournmanet!

text.Kotch: A bad first date!

text.Scotch: And most likely their last, inexperienced as they are—or are they!? Give it up for Cloud and Aerith!

text.Kotch: Booo! Get lost! Go home! You suck!

text.Spectator (male 1): "Couple"!? Get outta here with that lovey-dovey bullshit!

text.Spectator (male 2): 'Sup with the pole!? Gonna do a little dance for us, baby girl?

text.Aerith: Okay. Now I'm mad.

text.Kotch: Their opponent—one of Wall Market's own, a renowned master of beasts! Will his pets make a meal of our two challenges before our very eyes?

text.Scotch: They've already been given their appetizer!

text.Kotch: Their hunger for flesh and fear is unquenchable—the demon dogs of hell, the Sanguine Stalkers!

text.Aerith: You brought animals?

text.Beastmaster: Oh? First-timers, huh? There's no rule that says you gotta fight man-to-man.

text.Scotch: We're in for a treat, ladies and gentlemen! Who will prevail in this brutal contest between man and beast!? This could be over in an instant, so don't even blink! Without further ado, the fourth match of the first round... begins now!

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies on the first match.

text.Scotch: Can you believe it!? I don't think anyone saw this coming!

text.Kotch: What a completely unexpected turn of events!

text.Scotch: And the winners of our match are... Cloud and Aerith!

text.ACTION: After waiting before leaving the arena.

text.Announcer (Corneo Cup): Contenders, please return to your waiting room.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to the waiting area.

text.Aerith: Well that's one win down. Go team!
What's wrong?
Yeah, true. But maybe it'll be better in the next match?

text.Cloud: Nah, wouldn't bet on it. Better to expect the worst.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Staff after the match.

CHOICE.Staff (Cap): You've got some time before your next match. Get some rest.
You better make sure you rest up nice and good.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Beastmaster after the match.

CHOICE.Beastmaster: Guess I better start lookin' for a new job.

text.ACTION: After some time.

text.Announcer (Corneo Cup): Cloud and Aerith. Your match will begin shortly. Please make your way to the gate.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper when the semifinals are ready.

text.Gatekeeper: That's what they call beginner's luck. But the next match won't be so easy. Ready to rock?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Not yet."

text.Gatekeeper: You gonna take all day?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper a second time.

text.Gatekeeper: Ready to rock?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Ready."

text.Gatekeeper: Just remember: try not to die.

text.Scotch: For the second match in our spectacular semifinals... Fresh from their first date with death, I present... the lucky couple!

text.Kotch: More like "unlucky" for the rest of us!

text.Scotch: Give it up once again for Cloud and Aerith!

text.Spectator (male 1): "Couple" my ass! The hell you two tryin' to pull!?

text.Spectator (male 2): You assholes cost me a fortune!

text.Kotch: Their opponents—reavers of the scrapyard, thieves and killers through and through! Too criminal for common criminals—the worst of the worst!

text.Scotch: Ladies and gentlemen, check your pockets, because they may have already robbed you blind!

text.Kotch: The most contemptible sons of bitches this side of Wall Market—Beck's Badasses!

text.Aerith: Hey, it's those guys.

text.Beck: Well, hot damn! Been fixin' to feed you two your just desserts! So open wide, 'cause we're gonna serve up a heapin' helpin'!

text.Butch: Hey, what do "just desserts" taste like?

text.Beck: Like *justice*! Like *payback*!

text.Aerith: Huh? More of 'em?

text.Scotch: And who are these unscrupulous-looking gentlemen?

text.Kotch: It would seem that there are actually eight members of Beck's Badasses!

text.Aerith: Hey! That's cheating!

text.Beck: The only rule here is that there are no rules! If Corneo says it's okay, then you gotta suck it up!

text.Kotch: The don has granted his approval!

text.Aerith: This is ridiculous!

text.Kotch: The odds are overwhelmingly stacked against them!

text.Scotch: This could be a real bloodbath! So I implore you, ladies and gentlemen—don't look away, or you may miss the best part!

text.Kotch: The second match of the Corneo Cup's semifinals... begins now!

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies of the semifinals.

text.Kotch: Un-freaking-believable! What the hell did I just see!?

text.Scotch: It was two against, uh, I don't remember who many exactly, but a lot! But somehow, the winners of our match are... Once again! Cloud and Aerith!

text.ACTION: Upon returning to the waiting area.

text.Sam: That kid's really something.

text.Madam M: Well, of course he is. I did give him a massage you know. His palm told quite the tale. He's cheated death more than a few times...

text.Sam: So have half the people in this town. Anyway, we're both still alive. Call it?

text.Madam M: There you go again. One of these days your "luck" is going to run out.

text.Sam: When I fall from grace, maybe I'll land in your parlor once more.

text.Madam M: That is one mistake I will *never* repeat.

text.Honeygirl: You gotta admit, Andi—the way he moves is *totally amazing*!

text.Aerith: Next up: the big finale.
I thought you'd be happier.

text.Cloud: Just thinking about what we might face next.

text.Aerith: But you know, we've made it this far. I'm sure we can handle anything they throw at us.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Butch in the waiting area.

text.Butch: Does... this mean I don't gots to play dead no more?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Beck in the waiting area.

text.Beck: Damn, you two are *really* somethin' else. I could use that kinda muscle in my gang.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Burke in the waiting area.
After some time in the waiting area.

text.Announcer (Corneo Cup): Cloud and Aerith. The final match will begin shortly. Please make your way to the gate.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper.

text.Gatekeeper: Man, you proved me wrong! You guys are pretty good! It's the final match! You good to go?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Not yet."

text.Gatekeeper: Hey, it's the finals. Take all the time you need.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper a second time.

text.Gatekeeper: It's the final match! You good to go?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Ready."

text.Gatekeeper: I've got a lotta money riding on you two. Win it for me!

text.Kotch: Ladies and gentlemen, our time together is almost over!

text.Scotch: Tonight's thrilling Corneo Cup–filled with unprecedented upsets and drama—has only one match to go!

text.Kotch: We know—we're just as disappointed as you are! But ladies and gentlemen, all good things must come to an end! So let's celebrate by getting so damn loud—they'll hear us up on the plaaate!

text.Scotch: Once more—the sweethearts who've surprised us with upset after spectacular upset! The power couple with a boundless love for bloodshed! The champions of Madam M—Cloud and Aerith!

text.Kotch: Yeah! Come on, now! Come on, you can do better than that! And now—five-time winners of the Corneo Cup! Murder machines with countless kills to their names!

text.Scotch: Along with a handful of maimings.

text.Kotch: The deadly duo that takes out the trash—with a vengeance!

text.Scotch: The electric executioners... Chocobo Sam's champions... Cutty and Sweepy!

text.Kotch: Come on out!

text.Aerith: Robots!?
More like cheating!

text.Scotch: Who will walk away with the one-million-gil prize!? Get ready for a fight guaranteed to go down in history!

text.Kotch: The final match of the Corneo Cup... begins now!

text.Scotch: The final match of the Corneo Cup... begins now!

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies on the finals.

text.Kotch: This has never—! I can't believe it! And the winners of the Corneo Cup—the deadly and dynamic duo, Cloud and Aerith!

text.Madam M: My condolences.

text.Sam: Hmph.

text.Madam M: Oh! You're taking this rather well. I was looking forward to a little temper tantrum.

text.Sam: When you bet it all on a toss, sometimes you get burned by lady luck. Every coin has two sides.

text.Madam M: You're right of course—even if they are both the same.

text.Sam: Later.

text.Madam M: And now, I believe I have a prize to collect.

text.Leslie: Sorry—the madam will have to wait. The don's demanding that we tack on one more match, it seems.

text.Madam M: What?

text.Leslie: If they win out, then you get paid in full.

text.Madam M: Now hold on just a goddamn minute!

text.Leslie: His call, not mine.

text.Aerith: Now that that's over, we can go save Tifa.

text.Cloud: So we'll head back to Madam M's, get you changed, and then it's off to Corneo's.

text.Aerith: Right!

text.Madam M: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news. But... you still have one fight left.

text.Aerith: What do you mean?

text.Madam M: The crowd loved your show a little too much. People were placing hefty bets, much heftier than you can possibly imagine. Corneo's going to milk this for as much as he can.
You face and defeat Corneo's fighter of choice, and only then will you be declared winners of the tournament.

text.Aerith: Hey! That wasn't the deal!

text.Madam M: Don't you think I know that!? (groans) You greedy bastard! Scum-sucking piece of shit festering asshole!
But that's the way it is. Corneo's the one who makes the rules around here. But if you win this match, Corneo will have to accept your victory. And the crowd will make sure he does.

text.Cloud: So this is the last one?

text.Madam M: I sure hope so.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M.

text.Madam M: Go on, now. That prize money is going to pay for your dress.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Staff.

CHOICE.Staff (Cap): I've been working here a long time, but this has never happened before. Whew—gonna be one helluva match.
You'd better be ready for this one.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam in the waiting room.

CHOICE.Sam: Well then. You sure fixed my wagon.
Do you two have any idea how much those mechs cost me?
Sure you got time to shoot the shit with me? Don't think you do.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper.

text.Gatekeeper: Watching you guys fight gave me goose bumps. Hope your next match is even better than the last! Ready to kick ass!?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Not yet."

text.Gatekeeper: Hey, consecutive matches are tough. Take all the time you need to rest.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper a second time.

text.Gatekeeper: Ready to kick ass!?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Ready."

text.Gatekeeper: It's not even about the money anymore, man. I just want you guys to win it all! Show 'em what you got!

text.Scotch: Tonight's Corneo Cup has been a spectacle like no other. And we shared your disappointment, ladies and gentlemen, when we told you that it was coming to an end.

text.Kotch: But nobody felt it more keenly than one Don Corneo... who has decided that a bonus match is in order!

text.Scotch: Participating in this match will be this evening's leading lights—the dynamic duo that has crushed all competition thus far! Cloud and Aerith!

text.Spectator (female): Cloud! Cloud! Over here! Look at them! They're so adorable!

text.Spectator (male 4): Aerith! I love you! Marry me!

text.Kotch: Their opponent! Buried in the bowels of the colosseum... An unspeakable horror, long imprisoned, set free tonight for your entertainment!

text.Scotch: The secret star of Don Corneo's stellar stable!

text.Kotch: Enter: the Hell House!

text.Scotch: Enter: the Hell House!

text.Aerith: Huh?
It's just... a house.

text.Kotch: The manifestation of pure evil versus the most badass couple this side of Midgar—have you ever seen a fight more incredible, more epic!?

text.Scotch: You have not! No sir, you have not!

text.Kotch: They'll be singing songs about tonight for generations to come!

text.Scotch: Keep your eyes glued to the action, ladies and gentlemen!

text.Kotch: The Cup's final, final battle...
Begins... now!

text.Scotch: Begins... now!

text.Kotch: The battle is joined, and already I can tell you this bonus match will not disappoint!

text.Scotch: This couple has fought the toughest of the tough, the meanest of the mean, but can they handle the horror of the Hell House!?

text.Kotch: Who will come out on top!? Strap yourselves in, folks, 'cause this show is only getting started!

text.ACTION: Upon hitting Hell House will an elemental spell of an element it is weak to.

text.Kotch: That had to hurt! Has our dynamic duo already found this house's major design flaw!?

text.ACTION: Upon using Healing Wind.

text.Kotch: A heroic move by Aerith as she provides support for her partner! Savor that healing wind!

text.Scotch: Let it wash over you—restore you inside and out!

text.ACTION: Upon summoning.

CHOICE.Kotch: We have a special guest that wants to kick things up a notch! But don't get too close—you can't handle his heat!

CHOICE.Scotch: Feel that raging fire! Can the Hell House weather the inferno!?

CHOICE.Kotch: Tearing through the colosseum like a tornado, a moogle and chocobo!

CHOICE.Scotch: Don't be fooled by their cute looks, because they're here to kick ass and take names!

CHOICE.Kotch: Grab your coats, folks! You're gonna wanna bundle up for this! We've got the queen of ice herself coming in for a meet and greet. What a beauty!

CHOICE.Scotch: That frosty stare could strike a man dead where he stands. Maybe I'll be the lucky victim!

CHOICE.Kotch: A fat chocobo from the heavyweight division joins the combatants in the arena! I think the feathers are about to fly!

CHOICE.Scotch: Will our big-boned birdie make a meal of the Hell House? Will he gobble it right up? Yum, yum, yum, yum, yum!

CHOICE.Kotch: The spiteful dragon of the sea is here in the arena! I'm warning you folks: you *will* get wet!

CHOICE.Scotch: Hold on tight, ladies and gentlemen, for the fury of the ocean might swallow you whole!

CHOICE.Kotch: What? Do my eyes deceive me? The king of dragons has graced us with his royal presence!

CHOICE.Scotch: I hope you have insurance, because safety is *not* guaranteed. None of us may make it out of here alive!

text.STATUS: When Cloud falls to critical HP.

CHOICE.Kotch: Cloud is shaken—and stirred! I bet he's not gonna be standing for much longer!

CHOICE.Scotch: Cloud has seen better days! Can he keep fighting the good fight or is he ready to throw in the towel!?

text.STATUS: When Aerith falls to critical HP.

text.Scotch: Ouch, that's gotta hurt. Aerith gets a double dose of neighborly hatred!

text.STATUS: When Aerith falls unconscious.

CHOICE.Scotch: And Aerith is down for the count!

CHOICE.Kotch: Can you hear that, Midgar? Aerith fans are not happy!

CHOICE.Scotch: And Aerith is down for the count!

CHOICE.Kotch: Aerith is down for the count!

text.ACTION: As the battle goes on while a party member is low or unconscious.

CHOICE.Kotch: This housewarming party is putting their love to the test! Are they strong enough to pull through?

CHOICE.Scotch: I'm sorry, ladies and gentlemen, but this is painful to watch!
Batten down the hatches, folks, because a storm is brewing on the horizon!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Game Over.

text.Scotch: And the winner, the man-eating monstrosity, the horror, the Hell House!

text.Kotch: The babe and beautiful Cloud and Aerith would be champions reduced to food for the beast. We will never forget your sacrifice!

text.ACTION: After Hell House first uses Barrier Shift.

text.Scotch: Oof, that color is a dead giveaway! The architect must've had one too many when he designed this thing!

text.ACTION: Sometimes upon pressuring Hell House.

text.Kotch: The Hell House is d-d-d-down! Cloud is taking control of the fight and is really showing this building who's boss!

text.ACTION: Upon staggering Hell House.

CHOICE.Kotch: Whoa! And in a stunning turn of events, the Hell House has come to a complete stop!
And the Hell House is down! Will this be the end for our quaint living space of evil?

text.ACTION: After Hell House loses 25% HP.

text.Madam M: It's almost disappointing.

text.Andrea: No. Not yet...

text.Scotch: Ladies and gentlemen! What is happening!?

text.Aerith: What the—

text.Kotch: Just try and call this house warm and inviting now! We dare ya! We double-dog dare ya!

text.Scotch: The Hell House is showing us its *true* paint job! How will Aerith and Cloud adapt?

text.ACTION: Sometimes before Hell House charges Renewed Hospitality.

text.Kotch: Who has been caught in the Hell House's sights!?

text.ACTION: Sometimes when Hell House uses Renewed Hospitality.

CHOICE.Scotch: If you wanna know what's in the box, you'll just have to open it up and see!

text.ACTION: After Hell House swallows Cloud or Aerith with Hospitality or Renewed Hospitality the first time.

text.Kotch: The Hell House has welcomed its first guest! What kind of party is it!? I don't know, but I'm glad I wasn't invited!

text.ACTION: Sometimes after Hell House swallows Cloud or Aerith with Hospitality or Renewed Hospitality.

CHOICE.Kotch: And with that, the gateway to hell slams shut!
This house is hungry, and it's about to chow down on the competition!

CHOICE.Scotch: What is going on in there!? Only time will tell, but I'm not sure we wanna know!

text.ACTION: Sometimes after Hospitality or Renewed Hospitality releases a character still conscious.

text.Kotch: A miraculous escape from our courageous contender! But from the looks of it, they had a pretty wild time in there!

text.ACTION: After Hospitality or Renewed Hospitality releases Cloud unconscious.

text.Kotch: And Cloud is back with us once again... or is he!? The masticating mansion did a real number on the man!

text.ACTION: Sometimes when Hell House charges up Housing Shock.

text.Kotch: The Hell House is ready to shove its message of hate down their throats!

text.STATUS: When Hell House lands a hit with a powerful attack.

CHOICE.Kotch: Oh, man! Did anyone get the number of that house!?

CHOICE.Scotch: The Hell House isn't afraid to fight dirty!
Now that had to hurt, folks! Are these moves even legal!?

CHOICE.Kotch: What a brutal hit by the Hell House! There's no way that didn't hurt!
Talk about making an impact! The Hell House is absolutely tearing it up tonight!

text.ACTION: Upon pressuring Hell House before it charges.

text.Kotch: Cloud and Aerith with a stunning reversal! The Hell House is dead in the water!

text.Scotch: Now *that* is the price you pay for daring to get in the way of true love!

text.ACTION: Sometimes when the Hell House uses God House Mode.

text.Scotch: The Hell House isn't afraid to fight dirty!

text.ACTION: Upon attacking the Hell House with normal attacks while its God House Mode barrier is active.

CHOICE.Kotch: The lovebirds are going hard at the house, but they'll have to do better than that if they wanna raze *this* roof!
Well, that sure ain't workin'!
Nope! Not gonna cut it!
Not even so much as a flinch!

text.ACTION: Upon casting a spell against Hell House while its God House Mode barrier is active.

text.Kotch: The barrier's still holding! Does our dynamic duo have what it takes to defeat the security of this high-tech home!?

text.ACTION: Sometimes before Hell House uses Double Rocket Charge.

text.Kotch: Our favorite couple is about to get a face full of flame! Is there any way to escape the heat!?

text.ACTION: Before Hell House uses Chair Salvo Deluxe the first time.

text.Kotch: Here comes the windup, folks! Brace for impact!

text.Scotch: There'll be no coming back from this one!

text.STATUS: When Hell House uses Chair Salvo Deluxe again.

CHOICE.Kotch: Looks like our couple's in for another round of musical chairs!

CHOICE.Scotch: Another barrage of chaos coming in hot, folks! Will this turn the tide against them!?
Where'd these chairs come from? Who do they belong to? Who needs all those chairs? I have so many questions!

text.STATUS: When Hell House falls to 50% HP.

text.Kotch: Stuffed animals are available at the colosseum gift shop. The perfect present for friends and family! Available only while supplies last so act fast!

text.STATUS: When Hell House uses Heavensward.

text.Kotch: Liftoff! We have liftoff! Ladies and gentlemen, are you seeing this!? The world's first flying house!

text.ACTION: Sometimes when Hell House uses Hellbound.

CHOICE.Scotch: What's this? The ol' switcheroo? As usual, the Hell House is up to no good!

CHOICE.Kotch: This house has had enough of the neighborhood riffraff!

text.ACTION: Upon pressing Hell House during Heavensward flight.

text.Kotch: Our tremendous twosome has put on their hard hats! They know exactly what they need to do to make this house come crashing down!

text.Scotch: They're bringing that high-flying house back down to earth!

text.STATUS: When Hell House uses House Call.

text.Kotch: Well, wouldja look at this! A gift from the selfless and generous Don Corneo himself!

text.STATUS: When Hell House falls to 20% HP.

text.Scotch: Cloud and Aerith—they stand poised to win it all!

text.Kotch: The crowd is going wild, but no amount of applause is gonna bring this house down!

text.STATUS: When Hell House is staggered at low HP.

text.Kotch: Are we witnessing the final moments of the wicked Hell House!?

text.Aerith: We did it!

text.Kotch: And the winners—

text.Scotch: And champions—

text.Kotch: Cloud and Aerith!

text.Scotch: Cloud and Aerith!

text.Madam M: Yay! Yes!

text.Andrea: That boy...

text.Madam M: Awfully rare, you showing an interest in someone. What will you do?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the man outside the elevator after beating Hell House.

CHOICE.Staff (1): Why didn't you tell me you guys were gonna kick so much ass!? Can I have your autographs?
I know that you can take on bigger and better opponents, champ! Keep on fighting!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave the colosseum.

text.Gatekeeper: There you are. I've been looking for you two. So Madam M wanted me to give you a message. She says you guys did pretty damn good, and that you should swing by her shop when you're done here. Got it? I was also hoping you might be interested in a few more matches here at the colosseum. Big events like the Corneo Cup are pretty sporadic, but there's always action if you wanna get a piece.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper again on the first floor.

text.Gatekeeper: Huh? You wanna take me up on my offer now? Cool! Then I'll see you down below.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper on the colosseum's bottom floor to begin a free match.

text.Gatekeeper: Hey, been waiting for ya. So—what're ya in the mood to fight?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Souvenir Shop Owner.

text.Souvenir Shop Owner: With these babies, you can send intruders flying! I guarantee this is the only home protection you'll ever need!

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.

text.Souvenir Shop Owner: Only a few left. Get yours while you can!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Staff on the colosseum's first floor.

CHOICE.Staff (1): Why didn't you tell me you guys were gonna kick so much ass! Can I get your autographs?

CHOICE.Staff (2): Congratulations on the win! You know tonight's tournament is going down in history!

CHOICE.Staff (3): Watching you win was so inspiring! It made me want to fight too!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny's Father.

CHOICE.Johnny's father: Congratulations on winning the tournament! You're an impressive fighter! I know that you'll be a great influence on my Johnny. Why, you might even end up having a friendly rivalry! You can spur each other to greater heights! I can see it. You two will become great friends—the best of friends. (laughs)

I tell you, I'm exhausted from all the fun and excitement of that tournament. I'll look for my son tomorrow. For now, though. I really should get some rest. And what's rest without a little relaxation for the body, mind, and soul? Fortunately I'm in the right place for that...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M.

text.Madam M: You're here. Good. I have everything I need to get started. Just one thing before we do. You're *the* Cloud, right? Cloud the merc?

CHOICE.STATUS: If no Odd Jobs in Chapter 8 were completed.

CHOICE.Madam M: Hah! Well that's what you call yourself I'm told, but what've you actually done for the people of Sector 5, hmm? There's this little thing called karma. How a person treats others dictates how they themselves should be treated. And believe me—I'll get you the dress that you earned.

CHOICE.STATUS: If a few Odd Jobs in Chapter 8 were completed.

CHOICE.Madam M: I've heard a few stories about you helping out the people of Sector 5. If you don't mind me saying so, though, you could be doing a little bit more. The rule of karma is highly respected in the slums. A somewhat decent person deserves a somewhat decent dress. But really, let's not kid ourselves. Corneo's not even gonna look at what she's wearing.

CHOICE.STATUS: If all Odd Jobs in Chapter 8 were completed.
