CHOICE.Madam M: I'm told you did a wonderful job helping the people of Sector 5. You have a very impressive work ethic. It's like they say, "Good things come to those who work." What goes around, comes around—and in ways that might surprise you. I'm gonna put Aerith in the most gorgeous dress you've ever seen. It'll be a real jaw-dropper.

text.ACTION: After previous dialogue.

text.Madam M: All right. Now that that's out of the way... Once you change, you won't be able to leave town. Are you sure you're ready?

CHOICE.Madam M: All right, then. Let's get started. Beauty takes a lot of work and preparation, far more than you'd know. In the meantime, let me see, let me think...
Huh!? Don't waste my time! If you have things to do, then get out there and do them!

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon interacting with Madam M a second time.

CHOICE.Madam M: Like I said, once you change, you won't be able to leave town. Are you sure you're ready now?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", same dialogue as if selected first time plays.

CHOICE.Madam M: Hurry. It. Up!

CHOICE.STATUS: If Chocobo Sam's questline is selected.

text.Madam M: There oughta be things you can only do without your friend. Now's your chance to get out and have some fun. I can tell you're already beginning to feel at home here. Though being so new to it I assumed you still wouldn't know how to enjoy yourself properly. So I went and had a chat with Sam. He said he'd be happy to help you out.

text.Cloud: Hey. No one asked you to do that.

text.Madam M: But there's so much you don't know! This is the perfect opportunity for you to learn the ways of the world and man the hell up!

CHOICE.STATUS: If Madam M's questline is selected.

text.Madam M: You look like you haven't experienced the best of what this town has to offer. That really won't do.

Then maybe you can show the town what you have to offer instead. Which is to say, why don't you try putting those finely honed mercenary skills of yours to good use here in Wall Market? I have a few little requests that you might be able to help out with. I gave that hand extra-special treatment. Now get out there and show me what you can do with it.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Madam M: And that's enough of that. Aerith, come with me.

text.Aerith: Oh boy! I can't wait to see the dress!

text.Madam M: The dress is part of it, sure... but we'll also need to do something about that plain-Jane makeup and hairdo. This is gonna take some work.

text.Aerith: Ouch! Well, I'll see you later, Cloud!

text.Madam M: Peek and I'll poke out your eyes.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with Madam M behind the curtain.

CHOICE.Madam M: I thought I told you. No peeking!
You have a lot of nerve.
How old are you?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam if his questline was selected.

text.Sam: Howdy. Madam M said you'd be swinging by. Lemme see if I've got this straight. You ditched your lady friend and fellow champion to have a boy's night out in Wall Market?

Kidding! If I know the madam—and I do—this was all her idea. I can see why. There's no denying you're skilled with a sword, but when it comes to damn near anything else, well... can't help but have my doubts. Ain't nothing wrong with that, but then there's nothing wrong with expanding your horizons neither. Seeking new experiences. Knowing the ways of this here world will help you to better protect her while you're in it. Reckon I've got a few solid gigs for you. Whaddya say? You game?
That's the spirit. You have yourself a grand time tonight, mister merc.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the gym.

text.Jay: Here to work out? Put some muscle on that bony frame of yours?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules.

text.Jules: Cloud! Been waitin' for you to show up. Thanks for coming, and welcome to our humble training hall. Jules—head trainer. If you've got some time to spare, how about a little bit of fun? Wanna try taking on one of our guys?

text.Ronnie: Hah! You're not serious, are you? Look at him! He's a scrawny little thing. I could snap him like a twig!

text.Jules: Now, now—I wouldn't judge this one by his muscle mass. What do you say, Cloud? If you wanna give it a go, just let me know.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules again.

text.Jules: So? You up for a round?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Ronnie: Ha! You're taking me on? You look like a dried-up old terpsicolt left out in the sun. You got no idea what you're getting into, little man.

text.Jules: All right, enough talk. We'll settle this the tried-and-true traditional way: a squat-off. Now, let's all see what you've got.

text.STATUS: When beginning the Trainee challenge.

text.Ronnie: Now don't go crying to mommy.

text.ACTION: Upon successfully performing a squat if Jules is not competing.

CHOICE.Jules: I knew you could do it!

text.ACTION: Upon failing a squat if Jules is not competing.
Upon winning a squats match.
Upon beating Ronnie.

text.Ronnie: How—? How the hell did I lose to this scrawny little kid who looks like he doesn't even consume his daily recommended amount of protein?

text.Jules: Ronnie—you know it's all about quality, not mass. You're too quick to judge people by their build. That, and your overtrained ego are the main reasons you lost to our bold challenger here!

Thanks for helping me teach my boys a valuable lesson. And sorry for dragging you into it. Cloud, we're all one big family here at this gym, and now you're part of it. If you're ever up for training, our doors are always open to you. Let's work together to maintain healthy minds *and* bodies.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules again before unlocking Pro difficulty.

text.Jules: If you're ever in the mood for another workout, just talk to Jay or Ronnie.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jay.

text.Jay: You wanna go, do ya? All right then, bring it on!

text.ACTION: Upon beginning the Amateur challenge.
After completing the challenge.
The first time after beating Jay.

text.Jay: You did it, you really beat me. You gotta be in incredible shape!

text.Jules: It's unfair that you guys are having all the fun. What do you say? May I have this squat?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules when Pro difficulty is unlocked.

CHOICE.Jules: Let's you and me work up a sweat.
I'll never say no to a friendly competition.

text.ACTION: Upon beginning the Pro difficulty challenge.

text.Jules: I won't go easy on you.

text.ACTION: Upon successfully performing a squat in a Pro difficulty match.

CHOICE.Ronnie: Just how much training do you do!?

CHOICE.Jay: I can't get enough of those beautiful muscles!

text.STATUS: When Jules falls.

CHOICE.Jay: You can do it, Jules! We're rooting for you!

text.STATUS: When the scores are closely matched.

CHOICE.Ronnie: Oh, man! Who's gonna win this one? It's too close to tell!

text.ACTION: After failing the Pro difficulty match.

text.Jules: You gotta loosen up. You're way too tense.

text.ACTION: After beating Jules the first time.

text.Jules: I had no idea how strong you really were. You truly are something, aren't you?
Listen up, everyone. We can be stronger, better. Let's hit those weights!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the bar.

text.Johnny: Wait up, Cloud! Sam caught me up on everything. He said you're gonna go rescue Tifa. And to do that, you're trying to learn all about Wall Market. Bro, I know this town like the back of my hand, so I can answer all of your questions! Now, let's go knock this one out! The bar's this way, Cloud.
Drunkards', here we go!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the bar's entrance.

text.Johnny: Uh, are we even allowed to walk through the door? I'm getting a "regulars only" kinda vibe.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the bar.

text.Johnny: It's mostly the same folks every night, so... Whoa! You can't just waltz in there uninvited! Listen, there are rules for this kind of—

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Clothing Store Owner

text.Johnny: Hey! Old dude!

text.Clothing Store Owner: Huh... ? Son, is that you? Did you always look so... moronic?

text.Johnny: Wha—? Well, right back at ya! Ugh, whatever. We're here to take you back to the store.

text.Clothing Store Owner: I'm not going back! Not ever! My life is ruined. It's over. Kill me now!

text.Johnny: Come on, there's no need to talk like that, old dude! I'll help you out with whatever you need!

text.Clothing Store Owner: Really? Oh, thank you, son! See, I made this bet with the materia merchant—a sure thing—but then I lost... And so I had no choice but to steel my heart and surrender my precious inspiration!

text.Johnny: Your precious inspir-who with the what now?

text.Clothing Store Owner: INSPIRATION! Without it, there's simply no point in me ever going back to the store...

text.Johnny: Got it! I mean, I don't got it, but... I just need to get your inspiration back, right? Whatever the hell that is. Leave it to me, old dude!

text.Clothing Store Owner: Uh, hey... Aren't you gonna go with your friend?

text.ACTION: While leaving the bar.

text.Johnny: I've never actually been inside, now that I think about it.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the materia store.

text.Johnny: I don't even really know how people use materia. They're just, like, huge orbs of... something.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny outside the materia store.

text.Johnny: This place looks kinda creepy, don't you think? Like maybe they practice ritual sacrifice or...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the materia store.

text.Johnny: Hey, wait for me!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Materia Vendor.

text.Johnny: Sooo... this is it, huh?
I'm here for the "precious inspiration" you took from the old dude.

text.Materia Vendor: Inspiration... ? Oh, that thing. But I didn't "take" it, I won it fair and square. It's mine by rights now.

text.Johnny: Well, that's true!

text.Materia Vendor: But I tell you what. I'll consider giving it back in exchange for... a favor.

text.Johnny: ... Whatcha need?

text.Materia Vendor: Something only... "real men" can deliver. I need you to go and get me something from the vending machine at the inn. You know what. You know!

text.Johnny: No, I don't think I... Wait. The Sauce!

text.Materia Vendor: Stop saying "the Sauce!" ... Anyway. Good luck.

text.Johnny: The time has come... for me to wield my powers of assessment!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Materia Vendor again.

text.Materia Vendor: Wait, you haven't even gone there yet? Well, I guess I can't force you to go...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the inn.

text.Barker: I have the perfect room for the both of you! Just say the word, and I'll show you to it!

text.Johnny: Huh!? No no no, we're not here for that!

text.Barker: Say what? If you don't need a room, then what the hell do you want?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny outside the inn.

text.Johnny: I wish I was here with Tifa. No offense, bro.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the barker outside the inn.

CHOICE.Barker: No preferences we can't accomodate, no sir.
Hey, hey, heeey! If you're looking for the most unforgettable night of your life, look no further!
Enjoy a sleepless night in the city true to its name!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the vending machine.

text.Johnny: That's it. That's the one! It looks like a regular old vending machine, right? But wait! You ready for this? All right. This particular model has secret buttons.
Well... I can't tell you—it's a secret! You just need to tap into your knowledge and expertise—like, grab it and whip it out! And then you'll be able to see everything?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Cloud: I don't need to "whip it out." I've done this before. Watch this.

text.Johnny: Whoa, look at you, bro!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining vitalabrew from the machine.

text.Johnny: Huh? Is this the Sauce? I dunno... Come on, bro! You know there are more hidden buttons waiting to be pushed!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining Crimson Spike from the machine.

text.Johnny: Oh... So this is the Sauce. Neato... It-it's time. The last button...

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the Sauce from the machine.

text.Johnny: The Sauce! P-put it away! Put it away before someone sees you! No one can know that we have it!

text.Vending Machine: You're the grand prize winner! Have a special prize!

text.Johnny: Don't scare me like that! Whatever! We got what we came here for. Let's get outta here and head to the materia guy!

text.ACTION: While leaving the inn.

text.Johnny: Uh, is it me, or is everyone looking at us... ? So this is what it feels like to be a champ.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the materia store again.

text.Johnny: Come on, bro! Hurry up! Let's show him what we brought back from our little trip into the weird!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Materia Vendor.

text.Johnny: It's time, bro! The Sauce.

text.Materia Vendor: Could it be... ? It is! The Sauce! The Sauce! Whoa... Never thought I'd live to see the day...

text.Cloud: It's just sauce. No big deal.

text.Materia Vendor: Don't sell yourself short! This is only given to one who is truly a man among men.

text.Johnny: Damn, bro! That's why you're such an awesome dude!

text.Materia Vendor: Oh, right... Hate to break it to you, but that thing you were looking for? Not here. It's long, long gone.

text.Johnny: You shittin' me!?

text.Materia Vendor: Nope. Sorry. As I recall... the guy who runs the restaurant should have it.

text.Johnny: Ugh... Well, I guess we know where we're headed next. Come on, bro!

text.Materia Vendor: Well, that's that. Time to polish the ol' orbs, give them a spit shine so they positively sparkle!

text.Johnny: Restaurant up next, huh? Getting kinda hungry, actually. Do you smell that? I think it's coming from over there.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Materia Vendor again.

text.Materia Vendor: Oh! An honor as always, sir!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the restaurant entrance.

text.Johnny: Let's see what's on the menu today. Meat, fish, and... ooh, that special looks good.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny outside the restaurant.

text.Johnny: Man, I like seriously don't know which one to get! I'm a decisive, but when it comes to food, it's a different story.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the restaurant.

text.Johnny: Hey, wait for me! I still don't know what I wanna order yet!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Restaurant Owner.

text.Restaurant Owner: Welcome! Feel free to take any open seats.

text.Johnny: Sorry, we're not here to eat. The materia guy gave you something, yeah? We want it.

text.Restaurant Owner: Materia guy? Ohhh, you're here for *that*. I'm surprised—didn't take you for the type. Lemme ask you something. Either of you know anything about cooking?

text.Johnny: Nope. Never cooked once.

text.Restaurant Owner: That's too bad. For some reason, my food doesn't taste nearly as good as it used to. I was hoping one of you two might be able to help me figure it out. I've narrowed it down to the fridge, the stove, or the power supply, but I'm not sure what's to blame.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Johnny: Man, I seriously have no idea what it could be. This sucks.

CHOICE.Johnny: You know... your fridge might be broken. Maybe it's not keeping the ingredients cold enough.

CHOICE.Restaurant Owner: That so? You're an expert on all things ice? Okay then. Let's see if we can't fix this by fiddling with the temperature.
Hmm... At a glance everything looks fine to me.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Johnny: Man, this looks great!
I can't...

text.Restaurant Owner: What a shame. He seemed to be enjoying the meal so I wanted to ask him what he thought. Maybe next time. Anyway, thanks for your help. Oh—and here's a voucher with my apologies. Get the poor guy some medicine, will ya?

text.Johnny: Drugs... I need all the drugs right now! Outta the way! Outta the goddamn way! N-no... Can't go...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Restaurant Owner again.

text.Cloud: Hey. About that thing we're looking for...

text.Restaurant Owner: Maybe I should fine-tune the flavor more—give it something extra to punch it up? Now what did I do with those spices I ordered from Wutai? I know there's some left...

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the restaurant.

text.Johnny: Goodbye, cruel world...

text.Pharmacist: Hey! Off my doorstep, you bum! You're scaring away my customers.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Johnny: Sanctuary...

text.Pharmacist: Oh, that a voucher you got there? Should've said something sooner. Come on in.
What is it with today? People are dropping like flies.
Loads of 'em. I got enough outstanding orders to fill a book. I was about to leave and make some deliveries, but...

text.Johnny: I'm gonna hurl...

text.Pharmacist: Can't very well leave him alone now, can I? Hey, you're not doing much. Maybe you can deliver that medicine for me. You're, what, military or something, right? Then you must know a thing or two about dealing with the sick and injured.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Pharmacist: You're a lifesaver—literally. So, lemme see, what needs delivering... Here—need you to deliver this to someone. You'll probably find this guy sprawled out on the ground somewhere. But make sure you check his symptoms before giving him meds.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Johnny: Can't... go on...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Patient in the bar.

text.Patient: It was poisoned, I tell ya. The sick sonuvabitch puts poison in his food...

text.Cloud: I've got meds. Lemme take a look at you.

text.Patient: Thanks, buddy! You saved my life. Here, it's not much, but it's yours. ... I'm grateful for your help but... do you think a guy could get a little privacy?

text.ACTION: Upon returning to the pharmacy.

text.Johnny: And then there was this crazy-looking house, right? And it was all like trying to kill 'em! But then Cloud was all like bing, bang, boom!

text.Pharmacist: Your friend fought... a house? A house?

text.Johnny: Oh, hey! Welcome back, bro.

text.Pharmacist: Yeah, and now he won't shut up. Anyway, how'd the deliveries go?

text.Cloud: I did about as much as I could.

text.Pharmacist: Thanks for the help. And great work. Anyway, I promised it'd be worth your while. Here, Iv'e got something you're definitely gonna like.

text.Johnny: What is it?

text.Pharmacist: Well, it belonged to the owner of the clothing store first. Heard from the cook that you boys been running all over town looking for this, am I right?

text.Johnny: Wait, we have? Hold up. What were we doing before all this? Oh shit! The inspiration!

text.Pharmacist: Bingo. Y'see, all us Wall Market entrepreneurs go way back. We get together for a game every night, bet all kinds of stuff. This found its way into the pool, and eventually into my possession. And now it's yours, 'cause hey—why the hell not. It's a VIP card, highly coveted and extremely rare. They're only given to a select few. Not that having it's gonna do you much good, but...

text.Johnny: Holy mother of... No way! Bro! We gotta get to the Honey—er, um, I mean Drunkards' on the double!

text.Pharmacist: Tell the old man I said hi!

text.Johnny: C'mon, bro. Get a move on!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bar entrance.

text.Johnny: C'mon, c'mon, c'mon! I gotta know!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny outside the bar.

text.Johnny: You still got the inspiration, right? You didn't lose it!?

text.ACTION: Upon entering the bar.

text.Johnny: My heart is beating so fast, bro. Like it's gonna burst right outta my chest!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Clothing Store Owner.

text.Johnny: Hey, old dude. We're back!

text.Clothing Store Owner: Huh? Who're you? You're no son of mine. I think.

text.Johnny: Special delivery—just for you.

text.Clothing Store Owner: Hoho! My inspiration! You've returned to me at long last!

text.Johnny: Yo, is that... what I think it is... ?

text.Clothing Store Owner: Oh you bet it is. And it was hard won! I sewed dresses day and night for those ladies, until I got what I was after. A Honeybee Inn VIP card!

text.Johnny: I knew it!

text.Clothing Store Owner: Now make way for the VIP, boys. I don't wanna keep my ladies waiting any longer! But first—I should pick up a gift dress!

text.Johnny: Lead the way, old dude. We are comin'!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the clothing store.

text.Johnny: Hey, how's about this?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Clothing Store Owner's Son.

text.Clothing Store Owner'S Son: Well, thanks for bringing him back. Can't imagine what you went through. Here, you earned it.

text.Johnny: Hey—you're coming, right bro? Get ready for a *real* Wall Market education!

text.Cloud: I'm done with this. You—you can do whatever the hell you want.

text.Johnny: I get it, bro. You're scared. It's only natural for people to fear the unknown. It's a pity you're not gonna join us, but I swear to you, bro, as an aspiring Wall Market connoisseur... I'm gonna go in there and get as much inspiration as I can handle. For you, bro! For you! Because Cloud—you are my one true bro. Honeybee Inn, here I come!

text.Clothing Store Owner'S Son: Perfect example of how age has absolutely nothing to do with maturity.

text.Cloud: Couldn't agree more. Should probably go see Sam again.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Clothing Store Owner's Son after completing the quest.

text.Clothing Store Owner'S Son: My dad is one amazing designer! At least, he would be if he ever actually did some work.

text.ACTION: While walking around the clothing store.

text.Johnny: Hey, how's about this?

text.Clothing Store Owner: What're you, crazy? This one's much better!

text.Johnny: Hot damn, old dude. Y-you made this one, too?

text.Clothing Store Owner: Now you see why all the ladies love and adore me? Tonight, you're with the VIP. I'll teach you all the right moves, all the ways to make 'em swoon!

text.Johnny: Yessir! I'll be your most loyal pupil, I swear it!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Clothing Store Owner after completing the quest.

text.Clothing Store Owner: Huh? You wanna help us pick a dress? Alrighty, what d'you think of this real skimpy one here?

text.Johnny: This silky one over here's kinda nice, too!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chocobo Sam.

text.Sam: So, tell me. What'd you see in our little enclave of sin and debauchery? Bet it was an eye-opening experience.

text.Cloud: Nothing I haven't seen before. That it for jobs?

text.Sam: Not exactly. I got one more favor to ask. You wanna get Tifa out, right?
Heh, just get your ass to the colosseum. You'll see.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam again.

text.Sam: Heh, just get your ass to the colosseum. You'll see.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper.

text.Gatekeeper: We've been waiting for you, champ!

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Free Battle", the Corneo Colosseum menu appears. Upon selecting "Cancel", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Special Match".

text.Gatekeeper: Stands are packed, thanks to you! Now get out there and give 'em a show!

Lovers of bloodshed and mayhem! Your favorite champion, Cloud, is back in the ring! Right now, this boy may be hot, hot, hot... But look out, folks, 'cause these dynamite challengers may just blow the champ clean off his throne! I hope you brought shades because you're about to see some fireworks! Fighters... begin!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating all enemies.

text.Gatekeeper: The reigning champ does it again! Was that hot enough for you, fight fans? Did the champ bring the heat!? Indeed he did—he proved there's nothing more explosive than the guns he's packing!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Sam.

text.Sam: Nice going, champ. You were in fine form today. Here's your cut. You earned it.

text.Cloud: Not here for the cash. Tell me about Tifa.

text.Sam: Ahh, Tifa... She's something of a bombshell herself, huh? Girl keeps in shape, and boy does it show.
Just making an observation, that's all. Anyway, seems like you're serious about getting the poor girl out of her predicament. I could tell easy enough by the way you fought back there.

text.Cloud: Cut to the chase. Well? You helping or not?

text.Sam: Never said I would—opposite, even. Getting mixed up in other people's business isn't my way. Plus... As you are now, I reckon you could ride to her rescue without anybody's help. And that's the truth. You've changed since you first rolled into this here town. For the better.

At any rate, I've said all I'm gonna say. Your lady friend oughta be done changing by now, am I right? She ain't no Tifa, but she is a firecracker. Keep her waiting too long and she might just blow up in your face.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Mireille and the Stablehand.

text.Stablehand: The Angel of the Slums strikes again! It even says so on the card!

text.Mireille: Oh, don't be an idiot! The Angel would never stoop so low as to steal from children! I'm telling you, I saw the real culprits.

text.Stablehand: You're saying there's multiple Angels on the loose?

text.Mireille: What? No there's not!

text.Stablehand: Then the Angel of the Slums is their leader!?

text.Mireille: Hell no!

text.Stablehand: Hmph! How can you be so sure?

text.Mireille: How can you!?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille.

text.Mireille: Madam M told me about a merc. That you? Maybe you can help us sort this out. Some criminals have stolen a shipment of donations bound for the Leaf House. The fiends!

text.Stablehand: The culprit is none other than the notorious Angel of the Slums. People worship her as some kind of folk hero, but there's no denying she's the one that done did it! I mean, look at this calling card. "The Garden Angle Three"... ? Well they must've meant to write "Guardian Angel"!

text.Mireille: Oh, come on! "Garden angle"!? Listen to me. I guarantee this is not the work of the Angel. I saw it with my own eyes. Three shady-looking types wandering around, scouting their mark I bet.

text.Stablehand: Well if you're so sure then bring 'em here! Prove to me this wasn't the work of your beloved "Guardian Angel"!

text.Mireille: You heard the man, merc. I've got to find those thieves to clear the Angel's name—and I need your help to do it. She would never, ever, do anything to harm the less fortunate. Find the three I saw and bring them here to me. They ran off toward the old expressway on the other side of Evergreen Park.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille again.

text.Mireille: The expressway's just past Evergreen Park. Hurry—those thieves've got a head start. They won't catch themselves!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Collapsed Expressway.

text.Beck: The garden angel strikes again! Suckers! And all it took was one fake card. Too easy! (laughs)

text.Burke: Sucks to be you, Miss Angel, but we're stealing your name and all that sweet loot!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Beck, Burke, and Butch.

text.Beck: Hey! It's you!

text.Burke: The hell you doin' comin' after us!?

text.Butch: Shit! Um... play dead. Play dead!

text.Beck: Shuddup! It's too late for that. Bring it. We're ready for you this time! Wakey wakey! Time to shine.
Check out this brick shithouse! We picked him up at the colosseum! Gonna pay you back double—nah, quadruple for what you done to us!

text.Butch: What's a droople? I, uh... what are we doing!?

text.Burke: Uh... Sh-shut up! We're kicking blondie's ass for bein' an ass!

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Stablehand: These are the Angels of the Slums... ?

text.Butch: Oh man, you're real stupid! We're the garden angels! Get it right!

text.Beck: Shut your trap, moron!

text.Mireille: Hmph, you don't honestly thing that the beloved Angel of the Slums could be any of these three idiots, do you?

text.Stablehand: Nah, I recognize the masks. These guys're just small-time crooks who've been pestering folks around here for a minute. Should've listened to you earlier. Sorry about this.

text.Mireille: Well, you should be sorry. I'll consider us square once you've taught these boys a lesson.

text.Beck: Hey, watch it! Not so rough, you lummox.

text.Butch: Yeah, you lummox! You lum... mucks?

text.Cloud: So what about the donations? Do you need help taking them to the Leaf House?

text.Mireille: Kind of you to offer, but I can manage on my own. I know these streets like the back of my hand. Better, even.

text.Staff (5): It's the Angel of the Slums! She took the don's stuff! He's gonna be pissed!

text.Mireille: Well, I'll be seeing ya. Thanks to you, we can put this mess behind us. I'm grateful.

text.Cloud: "The Guardian Angel of the Slums, radiant defender of the downtrodden"... ? Huh. Wonder if I'm an accomplice.

text.ACTION: After beating the other two Odd Jobs.

text.Cloud: That's enough of that. Should head on back to Madam M.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Madam M's parlor with both Odd Jobs complete.

text.Gatekeeper: Why hey there, champ! Got word from Madam M. She said you had time to kill before Aerith's ready for the big event. So, uh... whaddya say to taking on a little extra work while you're waiting around? We've got a helluva lotta fans clamoring to see their favorite champ go another round or ten. And something tells me they're not gonna rest until they see you kick ass again. Now get on down to the colosseum ASAP!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper at the colosseum.

text.Gatekeeper: Here he is, the man of the hour!

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Free Battle", the Corneo Colosseum menu appears. Upon selecting "Cancel", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Special Match".

text.Gatekeeper: Stands are packed, thanks to you! Now get out there and give 'em a show!

This challenger wanted another bite at the champ! One of Sam's favorite machines of mayhem, Cutty! He's been sharpening his blades and dreaming of payback! Can our champ come out on top again? Fighters... begin!

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies.

text.Gatekeeper: Our champ stands victorious once more! Cloud wins! Cutty's quest for sweet revenge has ended in bitter defeat!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Madam M.

text.Madam M: Very nicely done! (chuckles) Here's your cut—you earned it.

text.Cloud: Wait, you're here? What about Aerith?

text.Madam M: My people are working on her hair right now. I thought I'd take the opportunity to drop by and watch your match. (laughs) I have to admit, I never get tired of seeing Sam's precious toys take a beating.
I can tell by your hands you've come a long way. They're the hands of a fighter... who has found new purpose. A woman... or two? I wonder...

text.Cloud: Just doing what I've always done.

text.Madam M: Anyway, Aerith should be finishing up soon. I'll go on ahead to check on her. Whenever you're ready, come back to the parlor.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the door to Madam M's parlor.
Upon selecting "No", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Johnny: Nooo!
Cloud! Finally! Tifa! She—I— Tifa! She-she's—I don't—

text.Cloud: Take a deep breath. What about Tifa?

text.Johnny: I heard Corneo was gonna audition new girls soon, and Tifa's... Tifa's gonna be— I just... I-I don't know what to do.
I'll come too!

text.ACTION: On the way to Corneo's mansion.

text.Johnny: Hey Cloud! Bro! I can call you bro, right?
Just wanna say, bro, that I'm totally relieved that you're looking out for Tifa. So like, how'd you get so strong anyway, bro?

The way you fight, bro, is like poetry and violence! "Bam! Bam! Whoosh whoosh!" You know? I really wish I could be just like you. My problem is that I tend to overthink and overanalyze everything. So—bro, do you have any advice for a smart, stand-up guy like myself?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the mansion.

text.Johnny: Well, this is it for me. Call me crazy, but... I have a feeling that I'll just be getting in the way.

text.Cloud: Go find Aerith at Madam M's. Tell her to wait for me there once she's done. Think you can handle that?

text.Johnny: Yessir!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Leslie.

text.Leslie: You again.

text.Cloud: Got a letter of approval right here.

text.Leslie: You know that's only good for women, right?
Who? Oh, that girl you were with. Sorry to hear that. Well, either way, you're stuck out here, pal. I can't let you in.

Wouldn't try it if I were you. Trust me, you don't wanna screw with the don. If you even think about causing trouble, he'll make sure someone pays for it. And that "someone" might wind up being the girl you're trying so hard to break out. Or it could wind up being someone you've never even met before. Get it? You're in the don's world now. Anyway, you've got some time. The audition won't start for a while. If you're sure you wanna go through with this, then bring the girl and the letter. But... if I were you, I wouldn't.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Leslie again.

text.Leslie: Go on, get outta here.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the mansion.

text.Johnny: Hey, get outta the way! Quit gawking! Move it, move it! C'mon! Yo, clear the road!
Ma'am.

CHOICE.STATUS: If Aerith is wearing the poor dress.

CHOICE.Cloud: Uh, Aerith? What are you wearing?

CHOICE.Aerith: I know right? It's bad. Like, super bad. I've been trying to figure out if there was anything more I could've done with it, but...

CHOICE.Cloud: Doesn't really matter if you get picked or not anyway.

CHOICE.Aerith: Yeah, but still... You put a lot of work into this.
... Did you put a lot of work into this?

CHOICE.STATUS: If Aerith is wearing the medium dress.

CHOICE.Aerith: I hear Corneo likes his girls super-duper girly and dolled up. But I thought he might appreciate something a little more down to earth for a change.
Then... does that mean you do like it?

CHOICE.STATUS: If Aerith is wearing the best dress.

CHOICE.Aerith: Yeah. Corneo's got certain... tastes. This dress is so gaudy and impossible to move in...

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue concludes.

text.Cloud: Hey, wait a minute. Did Johnny forget to give you my message?

text.Aerith: The one asking me to stay put? No, I got it. I was worried about you.

text.Cloud: I'm starting to think this place is more dangerous than we thought. Who knows what they'll ask you to do in this "audition." No way in hell I'll let you go in there by yourself.

text.Aerith: By myself? Oh, don't worry, I wasn't gonna. Come on. You'll see.
According to Madam M, you've caught the eye of a certain fabulous someone, and they'd like to meet in person.

text.ACTION: While walking to the Honeybee Inn, if Aerith is in the best dress.

text.Loitering Man: Look at you all dolled up and fabulous. Where are you headed tonight?

text.Sweet Old Man: Well, what do we have here? You're quite the pretty little lady.

text.Man In Love: Huh. She's not bad at all.
Don't be like that. You're still the most beautiful girl in the world. And I'm lucky to be with you.

text.Woman In Love: Ohh, I can never stay mad at you!

text.Womanizer: Hey there, cutie. Where you headed? Why don't you let me buy you a cup of coffee?

text.Critical Woman: Hmm... I give her a B for effort.

text.Sharp-Tongued Woman: That dress is completely overshadowing her. She's got a lot to learn.

text.Poet: You are like the beautiful flower that blooms under the brilliant moonlight.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Honeybee Inn.

text.Aerith: To see the Honeybee Inn's Andrea Rhodea, and convince him to give you his stamp of approval. You said you didn't want me going alone, right? Well, with Andrea's help, you can join me. It'll be fun! And honestly, I think you'll look pretty cute in a dress.
It's pretty rare for Andrea to take a personal interest in someone. At least, that's what Madam M said. Trust me, this is gonna work out great.
C'mon. Don't you wanna save Tifa?

No can do, Cloud. This is our plan, and you'll learn to love it. So! Here's how I think we should approach him. Madam M said Andrea was a man who'd give anyone a fair chance to win him over. So I say we march right up to him, explain the situation, and see where that gets us. Sound good?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Aerith again.

text.Aerith: C'mon. Don't you wanna save Tifa?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Receptionist.

text.Honeybee Receptionist: Good evening. Welcome to the entertainment extravaganza that is the Honeybee Inn.

text.Cloud: We're here to see Andrea Rhodea.

text.Honeybee Receptionist: You must be Mr. Cloud. He's waiting for you.
I've been instructed to send you through without delay, sir. Please make your way to the stage in the back.
The one in the back, sir. Straight through those doors and down the hall.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Honeygirl in the bottom-left room with Johnny's Father.

text.Honeygirl: Watch the stinger, sweetie. What shape am I making?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny's Father again.

text.Johnny's father: Huh? Who's there? Eh, whatever... I'm havin' trouble seein' straight. What's the answer?

CHOICE.Honeygirl: Ding ding ding ding ding! That's a right answer, baby!

CHOICE.Johnny's father: Ya did it, boyo! I'm so damn proyd of ya.

CHOICE.Honeygirl: Aww, that's a wrong answer, sweetie!

CHOICE.Johnny's father: Man... You know what? You're useless...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny's Father again.

text.Johnny's father: Oh, I getcha. Ya wanna go for round two!

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes", the same dialogue options as before appear.
Upon talking to Johnny's Father after successfully answering.

text.Johnny's father: Huh? You're still here? But... why... ?

text.ACTION: Upon inspecting the top-right room.
Upon inspecting the top-left room.

text.Customer: Oh yeah, right there. That's the stuff!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the honeygirl in the bottom-left room.

text.Honeygirl: Hey there, dollface! We've been waiting for ya! Come on in, have a seat!
Huh? ... Oh, wait a minute. I think you might've wandered into the wrong room by mistake.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her again.

CHOICE.Honeygirl: Shucks. You would've been a fun distraction.
You could stay a while, you know.
Stage is through the door on the left, babe.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Honeygirl at the main door to the stage.

text.Honeygirl (1): And here's the man of the hour!

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Honeygirl (1): This is your first time, right? It's okay. Do you want to practice your dance moves first?

text.Cloud: Why would I want do that?

text.Honeygirl (2): Andrea thought it might be a good idea.

text.ACTION: Upon getting a Great score during Dance Practice.
Upon getting a Good score during Dance Practice.
Upon failing a prompt during Dance Practice.
After finishing Dance Practice with a mostly good score.

text.Honeygirl: You've got real rhythm, mister. Move over girls, a new dancer's come to town!

text.ACTION: After finishing Dance Practice with a mostly bad score score.

text.Honeygirl: Well, you weren't... awful, I guess

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "No", main dance starts.

text.STATUS: When the main dance begins.

text.Honeygirl: C'mon, c'mon—the show's about to start!

text.Madam M: My, my! Is that Cloud? Darling! I had no idea.

text.Honeygirl: Now you just sit tight until Andrea takes the stage!

text.Andrea: Welcome to the Honeybee Inn... Cloud. You seek my approval, do you? I understand. But those who crave my favor must first prove that they know how to move.

text.Aerith: Woohoo!

text.Andrea: Think you can follow my lead?

text.STATUS: If Cloud gets a good score.

text.Aerith: Woohoo! You're a start!
Keep it up, Cloud! Work it!

text.STATUS: If Cloud gets a bad score.

text.Aerith: C'mon Cloud! Get into it!
Uh, umm...

CHOICE.STATUS: After the dance minigame if Cloud gets a mostly good score.
After the dance minigame if Cloud gets a mostly bad score.

text.Andrea: Honey... I'm in love. Yes. Yes, I will transform you into a vision of beauty. Now, without further ado, let us begin!
Come.
Perfection! True beauty is an expression of the heart. A thing without shame, to which notions of gender don't apply. Don't ever be afraid, Cloud.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Cloud as Aerith outside the Honeybee Inn.

CHOICE.Aerith: Wow, Cloud. Now that was a show!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Cloud while he has stopped in place.
Upon talking to him again.

text.Aerith: Not even one?
But you're so pretty!
Hey! Watch the way you walk.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave Wall Market.

text.Aerith: No time to dillydally-let's go!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Honeybee Inn Receptionist.

CHOICE.Honeybee Receptionist: The evening performance has ended. We hope to see you again very soon.
I must say, you were breathtaking.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Andrea.

CHOICE.Andrea: Your equipment will be delivered to you at the appropriate time. Don't worry—I know people. As for the rest—it's up to you.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Honeygirl in the dressing room.

CHOICE.Honeygirl: Hey there. You the new girl?
One of our customers had to cancel. Poor guy fainted at the colosseum from all the excitement, or so I heard.
Wow, your bone structure is amazing! They're gonna love you.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Honeygirls by the main stage entrance.

text.Honeygirl (3): After all, we honeybees need fresh flowers to *pollinate*!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Poet near the Honeybee Inn.

CHOICE.Poet: Side by side with another beautiful flower.
A toast—to the lovely ladies of this town!
Oh, what's this? One magnificent blossom!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Critical Woman and Sharp-Tongued Woman in the alleyway near Honeybee Inn.

text.Critical Woman: Hey, you. We're looking for new hires. Wanna come work with us?

text.Sharp-Tongued Woman: With your looks, you could be the best in Wall Market. No, the best in Midgar if you wanted to!

text.Critical Woman: We hope you decide to join us!

text.Sharp-Tongued Woman: You could conquer the world with those cheekbones of yours!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Womanizer near Chadley.

CHOICE.Womanizer: I never believed it, but love at first sight does exist.
Whoa! Be still, my heart! It's the girl of my dreams!
Who is she? I need to learn everything about her!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley.

text.Chadley: Ohhh... Ahem. Forgive me, miss, but the way you're staring at me is rather... O-oh goodness... I'm experiencing an emotional response...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to him again.

text.Chadley: What is this emotional response... ?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Man in Love near the gym.

text.Man In Love: Whoa! She is the most beautiful girl in the world.

text.Woman In Love: Wait a minute! I thought you said that I was the most beautiful girl.

text.Man In Love: All right, then *you're* the most beautiful girl in the world. But *she's* the most beautiful girl in the entire universe!
I'd like to take this moment to officially declare to you my undying love!

text.Woman In Love: What the hell did I ever see in you!?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M at her parlor.

text.Madam M: Don't we look absolutely stunning in our dress? Not that I ever had any doubt you would, darling. I was a little pressed for time since Andrea didn't give me much notice, but I did my humble best. How could I not go the extra mile for the merc who's done so very much for me and mine. What's one more dress between friends?

text.Sam: Can't say I ever understood the appeal of going to so much trouble to gussy yourself up.

text.Madam M: No, you certainly do not, and I doubt that you ever will.

text.Sam: Wh... what's with the attitude?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her again.

CHOICE.Madam M: I have to admit, that was quite the show.
Off you trot. And remember: Corneo plays for keeps.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Barker at Wall Market's entrance.

text.Barker: Hey there, ladies! Would you be interested in making a *lotta* money? You get to eat, drink, and have loads of fun! How does that sound to you!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille.

text.Mireille: I owe you for your help. Here. I'm no fashionista, but I'm sure this'll go great with that dress of yours.
Oh, too good for my gifts, huh? Come on, just take it already, would you? Got these things comin' out of my ears as it is. Now get goin'. Teach that greasy slime ball a lesson he won't soon forget.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Clothing Store Owner's Son.

text.Clothing Store Owner'S Son: Hmm... You just might be the perfect "inspiration" my dad's been missing...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules.

text.Jules: Came running when I heard you were putting on a show. I didn't know you were such an amazing dancer! I wouldn't recommend lifting in that outfit, but if you need to work up a sweat later, feel free to pop into the gym!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Sweet Old Man and Kind Old Man opposite the Corneo Colosseum.

text.Sweet Old Man: Am I dead? Did these beauitful angels come for me?

text.Kind Old Man: Are you one of them models? The ones who wear those pretty clothes?

text.Sweet Old Man: I feel blessed just seeing them.

text.Kind Old Man: I've got butterflies in my stomach! It's been a while since I felt like this.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Loitering Man near the Corneo Colosseum.

CHOICE.Loitering Man: H-hello there. It's a fine night, isn't it?
Whoa! That is one hot chick!
And she's with that cutie from before! Who are they?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper at Corneo Colosseum.

CHOICE.Gatekeeper: Huh? You're planning on fighting in that getup? Uh, I don't know about that.
To be honest, I can't say I'm not curious, but... I really don't think I can let you do that.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Staff at the Corneo Colosseum.

CHOICE.Staff (6): Excuse me, miss, but... are you sure you're in the right place?
This is an arena where men and monsters fight each other to near death—nowhere a delicate flower like you should be.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Weapons Vendor.

text.Weapons Vendor: Your beauty is deadlier than anything I have here in my store!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Johnny: Bro, look at you. So... how's the dress workin' out for ya? I wanted to help out. Do my part, you know? After Andrea told me the plan, I ran all over looking for... something. But, like, I don't got a lotta money...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny a second time.

text.Johnny: Don't worry bro. You got this!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Leslie.

text.Leslie: No way.

text.Aerith: Here you are—letters from Andrea Rhodea and Madam M. That ought to do the trick, right?

text.Leslie: You serious?

text.Aerith: Is there a problem?

text.Leslie: I hope you know what you're in for.

text.Aerith: Oh, we'll be fine.

text.Leslie: If you say so. Come on.

text.ACTION: Upon entering further inside.

text.Corneo Lackey: The two of you here for the audition? Second floor, at the very end of the walk. And don't go pokin' your nose in where it doesn't belong!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Corneo Lackey on the left.

text.Corneo Lackey: Welcome to the mansion of the esteemed Don Corneo.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Corneo Lackey in the middle.

text.Corneo Lackey: Room's on the second floor, at the very end of the walk.

text.ACTION: Upon walking up the staircase.

text.Corneo Lackey: That one's Madam M's girl, ain't it? Man, she's hot.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the lackey outside the office.

text.Corneo Lackey: We've been waitin' for ya to show.

text.ACTION: Upon walking past Corneo's office.

text.Corneo Lackey: That Andrea's girl? I'd let her do things to me.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to enter Corneo's office.

text.Corneo Lackey: Go to your room and wait. Quietly.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the end room.

text.Corneo Lackey: Room's at the end. Keep walking!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the chamber.

text.Aerith: What's that weird, sweet smell? And why do I feel so dizzy?
Cloud...

text.Corneo Lackey (1): Wassup? How you pretty ladies doin'? Feeling a little light-headed? Well, we can't have that. What say we escort you to the parlor, so you can make yourselves more comfortable?

text.Corneo Lackey (2): Let's get this show on the road.

text.Aerith: Where... are you... taking us?

text.Corneo Lackey (1): The hell!? You wanna throw down!?

text.Corneo Lackey (2): They're Corneo's girls... so if ya leave a mark on 'em, you ain't gettin' off with a warning.
Managed to wrangle some real lookers this time though, know what I'm sayin'?

text.Tifa: Hey, can you hear me?
Yes... ?
... Mm-hmm.
Wait a minute. (gasps) Cloud!? Is that you!? Oh my god, that makeup! And that dress!

text.Cloud: Nailed it, I know. Thank you. Moving on.

text.Aerith: Yeah. Bit woozy, but I'll manage.
Hey, Tifa. How you doing?

text.Tifa: Okay...

text.Aerith: Oh right—I'm Aerith. A friend of Cloud's. We were worried and thought we'd come help you out?

text.Tifa: Thanks... ?

text.Cloud: Cut the chatter. We gotta leave.

text.Tifa: Huh?
No! Not until I've got what I came for.
So... After we made it back to the slums, some guys came around asking all kinds of questions. So I did some digging...

text.Cloud: And found out they were Corneo's men.

text.Tifa: Right. They were interested in Avalanche... But... I couldn't figure out why. So I thought I'd come and ask the man himself.
Thought if I could find a way in, and get some one-on-one time... But then I realized I'd only be one of three candidates. And that if he didn't pick me... it would all be for nothing.

text.Aerith: Then your worries are over, aren't they? Because the other two candidates are right here. Right?
So yeah! If we're all in on it, then nothing can go wrong!

text.Tifa: Uh, I guess not...

text.Aerith: You—me—Cloud. Makes no difference who gets chosen, does it?

text.Tifa: I dunno, Aerith. It feels wrong getting you involved in all this.

text.Cloud: Don't even bother trying to talk her out of it.

text.Aerith: Aww! Cloud gets me! Took you long enough.

text.Tifa: I think they'll call for us when it's time.

text.Aerith: This room gives me the creeps.

text.ACTION: Upon looking at Tifa.

CHOICE.Tifa: No?
Well?

text.ACTION: Upon passing Aerith.

CHOICE.Aerith: C'mon, you know you're into this.

text.ACTION: After some moments.

text.Corneo Lackey: Now ladies, listen up. I'm sure you're still feeling a bit woozy, but tonight's audition's about to begin. Head out the door to the left and up the stairs. Come on ladies, let's hustle.

text.Cloud: All right guys. Let's do this.

text.Tifa: Do you want to do this?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the top of the stairs.

text.Kotch: Okay, my beautiful ladies! Time to line up for the don!
Wait. You look kinda familiar. We haven't met before, have we?
Eh, whatever. Alright! Y'all good to go? Then let's do this thing! Introducing Wall Market's most elegible bachelor... The one and only Don Corneo!

text.Don Corneo: Ladies!
Nice. Very nice! Whichever one shall I pick?
Shall I pick you? Or maybe... you?
Oh yeah! I've got it! I've got it! Today's bride-to-be is...

text.Aerith: "Today's"?

text.Kotch: And tomorrow's or the day after's—if the don takes a shine to you.

text.Don Corneo: Huh? Hey, which one of you said that? Was it you?
Ohhh, you got a mouth on you! I'm gonna enjoy breaking it in! Today's lucky lady is the big-boned girl! (laughs) Still playing hard to get? I can dig it. Oh yeah.
The leftovers are all yours.

text.Kotch: Hell yeah! Okay ladies, y'all coming with me.

text.ACTION: In Corneo's office.

text.Don Corneo: Don't be shy, little kitten. Shimmy on over and give daddy some sugar! No need to play coy. Nobody here but you and me...
You're even cuter than I thought!
Ooh! (laughs) This kitten's got claws! I *love* it! (laughs)
Don't you worry your pretty little head. Just a picture to preserve the moment! And to ensure you don't do anything *inappropriate* like say "No"...
Oh! Praise me more!

text.ACTION: In the room with the lackeys.

text.Kotch: Ayo, fellas, we've got guests! And y'all got first crack at "entertaining" them! Courtesy of the ever-generous Don Corneo himself! Never forget—the don provides!

text.Scotch: Yeah...

text.Corneo Lackey: Corneo!

text.Scotch: So, ladies. Ready to... get to it?

text.Aerith: Yeah... I guess I'm good to go whenever. How 'bout you, Tifa?

text.Tifa: Mmm... Four guys between us... Okay. Let's not keep Cloud waiting.

text.Aerith: Right.

text.Scotch: Wait... I know you... The colosseum!

text.Corneo Lackey: What the hell!?

text.Tifa: Get down!

text.Corneo Lackey: Oh, you stupid— W-wait!

text.Tifa: Good job, Aerith!

text.Aerith: It was nothing compared to you!

text.Leslie: Andrea filled me in on the situation. I come bearing gifts—your gear. I'll do what I can to clean this up. Just finish the job.

text.Aerith: Thank you!
Okay, let's go rescue Cloud.

text.Tifa: Corneo's room, right?

text.ACTION: Upon passing or talking to Leslie.

text.Leslie: Better hurry.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the lobby.

text.Corneo Lackey: Man, I'd love to spend some quality time with girls like that. Bet they're going at it right now. Lucky bastard!

text.ACTION: Upon entering Corneo's showroom.

text.Corneo Lackey (2): Hey! Ain't you two the rejects!?

text.ACTION: Upon entering Corneo's office.

text.Don Corneo: Don't stop! Tell me what a bad boy I am!
Yes! Yes, I am! Here I come, baby! (screams)
Hey! Who the hell gave you permission to do that!? One of you get in here and teach this bitch some manners!

text.Tifa: Sorry, but... Your boys had to learn some manners too.

text.Don Corneo: What the—!?

text.Aerith: Cloud! Your clothes!

text.Don Corneo: So you're a man, huh? What are you three up to?

text.Tifa: *We'll* ask the questions. Like: why'd you have men in Sector 7 asking about Avalanche?

text.Don Corneo: Huh? Dunno what you're talking about.

text.Tifa: Don't play dumb with me. Let's try again. Why did you have men in Sector 7 asking about Avalanche? Spill the beans or...

text.Don Corneo: Alright, alright! I'll talk! I'll talk! Some guy with a gun for an arm—I was paid to find him!

text.Tifa: Paid by who?

text.Don Corneo: I can't tell you that! They'd hunt me down like a dog!

text.Tifa: Well you better... 'cause if you don't...

text.Aerith: I'll *rip* 'em off.

text.Don Corneo: It was the director of Public Security! Heidegger! It was Heidegger!

text.Tifa: Shinra!? And what were they planning?

text.Don Corneo: Some things are better left unsaid, ya know!?

text.Aerith: See, I'm not so sure they are. Better keep talking...

text.Tifa: Or I'll smash 'em.

text.Don Corneo: Heh. Alright, you got me. I could never say no to a sexy girl. Since Avalanche blew up two reactors, Shinra's decided they ought to stamp them out, home base and all. And I mean "stamp out." By targeting the support pillar and blowing it up.

text.Tifa: The pillar?

text.Don Corneo: Did I stutter? The plate will come crashing down! (mimes explosion noises) It'll be Sector 6 all over again. I'm sure you've been there and seen the wreckage for yourself. So you know exactly what Sector 7's gonna look like!

text.Tifa: They wouldn't...

text.Aerith: Come on, guys! We gotta go!

text.Don Corneo: Before you do!
Please! This won't take long!
As everyone knows, villains only divulge their plans in a certain situation. But what is that situation?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "When they're faced with certain death."

CHOICE.Cloud: When they're faced with certain death, jackass.

CHOICE.Don Corneo: Not what we were looking for! But you can find it... in the sewers!

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "When they think they've already won."

CHOICE.Cloud: When they think they've already won... right?

CHOICE.Don Corneo: Ladies and gentlemen, we have ourselves a winner! You get an all-expenses-paid trip... to the sewers.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "When they've lost their minds."

CHOICE.Cloud: I dunno. When they've lost their minds?

CHOICE.Don Corneo: Close, but no cigar! Your parting gift... is in the sewers!
Oh, I'm sorry! Time's up! The answer lies... in the sewers!

text.ACTION: After the previous options.

text.Don Corneo: Hee hee hahaha! Enjoy the sights and smells!

text.President Shinra: Are we on schedule?

text.Heidegger: The Turks are on top of it. Yes, there will be no delays.

text.Reeve: Please, Mr. President! I am asking you to reconsider—no, begging. The Sector 7 undercity is home to more than 50,000—

text.President Shinra: Director Tuesti.

text.Reeve: At least let us issue a warning, sir.

text.Heidegger: The stench of the director's cowardice fills the room yet again.

text.President Shinra: Reeve. Progress requires sacrifice. Learn to live with it.

CHOICE.Tifa: Cloud... We have to get to the slums—right now!
I didn't wanna drag Aerith into all this...
How do you two know each other?

CHOICE.Cloud: I saved her, she saved me... Round and round it goes.

CHOICE.Tifa: And... that's all there is to it? Sure there isn't something else going on?

CHOICE.Aerith: Cloud... We have to get to Sector 7...

CHOICE.Tifa: That bastard!

text.ACTION: After previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Tifa: You gotta be kidding me!

text.Aerith: You bet!

text.Tifa: Bring it on!

text.ACTION: After defeating Abzu.

text.Tifa: There it goes...

text.Aerith: Do you think it lives down here, or... ?

text.Cloud: Was probably Corneo's pet. And we were dinner.

text.Tifa: Hey... You don't believe that crazy story of his, do you? Shinra wouldn't sacrifice a whole sector just to take out Avalanche, would they? Destroying part of the city—killing all those people, just to get at us?

text.Cloud: I dunno... Is Corneo the kind of guy who'd make up shit just to screw with you?

text.Tifa: I wouldn't put it past him.

text.Aerith: But... if he was telling the truth... And there's still a chance he was, isn't there? Then... we should go. And if it turns out he was lying, then so what? Right?

text.Tifa: I knew it. These tunnels are all connected.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa.

text.Tifa: I'm pretty sure we can use these tunnels to make our way back to Sector 7. The sewers under Sectors 6 and 7 should be connected. "If you get in trouble, just follow the stench."
An Avalanche saying, actually. We use them to move around the undercity. In emergencies.
Positive. There should be a big waterway just up ahead. Let's find that first.

text.ACTION: Upon draining the first canal.

text.Aerith: Ugh, it reeks down here.

text.Tifa: Well the undercity isn't exactly the prettiest place, and we're under that so...

text.ACTION: Upon first entering a dark canal.

text.Tifa: Is it safe to go through here?

text.Aerith: It's really dark.

text.Tifa: I'm sure we'll be fine. Come on.

Hey, Cloud... Assuming Corneo was telling us the truth... What do you think Shinra's really up to? I mean, they've gotta have an endgame, but I can't imagine what it is. Destroying a whole chunk of the city just to get back at us doesn't make any kind of sense.

text.Cloud: Yeah. I can't imagine any way they could profit from it. It's gonna cost them a fortune to rebuild.

text.Tifa: Corneo's lying. He's gotta be. Guys like him do it all the time out of habit.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to use the door to the Trunk Line.

text.Tifa: But not if we used the skeleton key Jessie made.

text.Aerith: Huh. Does this mean it's in the water?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the power generator.

text.Cloud: That's a power generator, all right.

text.Aerith: Wow. Talk about ancient.

text.Cloud: It's an antique—older than the mako reactors even. It'll be a miracle if it still works.

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the Key to the Sewers.
Upon opening the door to the Trunk Line with the key.

text.Aerith: It worked!

text.Tifa: Wait a minute. I know this place. Sector 7 should be just on the other side of this waterway.

text.Cloud: So this is where Sector 6 ends.

text.Tifa: And where Sector 7 begins. Once we cross over we can start looking for a way back to the surface.

text.Cloud: Might be harder than you think.

text.Tifa: Let's just try to make our way down this tunnel. See if we can't use those gates to clear a path. We can do this. We'll figure it out.

text.Aerith: Yeah, for sure.

text.ACTION: Upon closing the sluice gate to create a bridge across the canals.

text.Tifa: All right! Now we should be able to get across.

text.ACTION: Upon crossing.

text.Tifa: Dammit. I can't stop thinking about what Corneo said.

text.Aerith: I know... Me too.

text.Tifa: It's gotta be a trick. There's no way they'd go that far. But... But what if Corneo really was telling the truth... ? We have to get there in time to stop it. We have to.

text.Aerith: Right.

text.Tifa: Aerith, what are you not telling me?

text.Aerith: Huh?

text.Cloud: Guys! C'mon! We gotta keep moving!

text.Tifa: Coming! I'll go first.
Okay Aerith! Your turn!

text.Aerith: On my way! Here we... go.

text.Tifa: Almost there!
Aerith!
That was close.

text.Aerith: Thanks. You saved me.

text.Tifa: Least I could do.

text.Aerith: Hear that, Cloud?
C'mon.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the ladder and passing through the gate.

text.Tifa: Focus!

text.Aerith: Still thinking about the plate?

text.Tifa: Yeah.

text.Aerith: The future isn't... set in stone. That's what I always tell myself.

text.Tifa: Yeah... ? I hope you're right.

text.Aerith: How 'bout this, then? Think of something fun. After saving Sector 7, you're gonna... ?

text.Tifa: I'm gonna... Go shopping—topside! I'll buy... Stuff for the bar! Decorations, coasters...

text.Aerith: Can I come?

text.Tifa: You'd better!

text.Aerith: Then it's a date! (both laugh)

text.Tifa: Cloud can carry all our stuff!

text.Aerith: He'll be our pack chocobo!

text.Tifa: Nothing! (chuckles)
Huh!? No way!

text.Aerith: C'mon, Tifa!
Cloud! Hold on tight!

text.Tifa: On three, okay? One, two, three!

text.Aerith: No need to be.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Sector 7 Sewers - Primary Treatment.

text.Aerith: Look. That must be the way out!

text.Tifa: I wonder. There must be some way we can lower the water level.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the water control room.

text.Tifa: Guys, check it out. Seventh Heaven's water tank has something similar. I'm betting we can use this to control the sewage level.

text.Aerith: Hey Cloud—you wanna give it a try?

text.Cloud: This oughta drain the water... right?

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to drain the water.

text.Aerith: No luck?

text.Tifa: A red light indicates a blockage, apparently. We can use the hand pump to clear the blockage. Sounds about right. I remember having to do this at the bar before.
Aerith, you mind giving me a hand? Cloud, you stay put. Keep an eye out for more red lights.
Trust me. This is the best way to handle it. We'll be back soon.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching with the pump.

text.Tifa: So maybe this is a little different from the one at the bar. More... industrial?

text.STATUS: When the wastewater pump minigame begins.

text.Aerith: Here goes.

text.ACTION: Upon correctly closing the valve.

CHOICE.Tifa: Spectacular!

text.ACTION: Upon failing to close the valve.

CHOICE.Tifa: Try to stay in sync.
Keep calm.

text.ACTION: Upon closing all three valves.

text.Tifa: Alright, I think that did it!

text.Aerith: Wonderful!

text.Tifa: Okay, let's head back. Cloud's probably getting worried.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the control room lever.

text.Tifa: We make a great team.

text.Aerith: Go team!

text.ACTION: Upon using the ladder up near the end.

text.Aerith: Sure is nice to go up for a change.

text.Tifa: Hope the pillar's not much further...

text.Cloud: Hang back. I'll go on ahead and secure the exit.

text.ACTION: Upon using the ladder.

text.Tifa: Cloud!
Looks like they're hungry for more.

text.Aerith: We're not delicious! Not even a little bit!

text.Tifa: Now!

text.Aerith: Okay!

text.Tifa: But there's too many of them!
Hurry!

text.Cloud: Last warning! Back off, or die!

text.Tifa: Cloud!

text.Aerith: C'mon!

text.Reno: "Summarily put down."

text.Aerith: Don't worry. We'll make it in time.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the first abandoned train car.

text.Cloud: We could get lost in here.

text.Aerith: Dark, dark, everywhere...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Aerith and Tifa.

text.Aerith: It's deserted... and kinda creepy.

text.Tifa: People don't come around here often. And not just because of the monsters, but... because of the stories.

text.Tifa: Guys, what was that!?

text.ACTION: After monsters emerge from the door.

text.Tifa: Don't scare me like that!
I think I just heard a little kid... Did you guys hear it too?

text.Cloud: Why would there be kids out here this late?

text.Tifa: What? Then—

text.Tifa: Huh? What is that!?

text.Aerith: All good... I think.

text.Tifa: Still in one piece here too.
Guys?

text.Aerith: "Come on," huh? Well, that's... inviting.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the facility entrance.

text.Tifa: Well, whaddya think... ?

text.Aerith: Hmm... I'm game!

text.Tifa: But...

text.Aerith: It'll be fine! We've got a bodyguard, don't forget. Mine! Right?

text.Tifa: You're just being modest! After you!

text.ACTION: Upon entering.

text.Tifa: What was that!?

text.Aerith: Look! Over there!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith.

text.Aerith: Found you. Hey... can we talk? Just for a bit?

text.ACTION: Some time after defeating the enemies.

text.Aerith: It's you...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Aerith.

text.Aerith: Don't!
I know, but even so...

text.Tifa: What the—!?
Yeah.

text.Aerith: Thanks, Cloud. You saved us.

text.Cloud: Gonna need to find another way through.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the closed entrance.

text.Tifa: Wh-what now?

text.Train Announcer: This train will be stopping at the Sector 7 slums... and is bound for the train graveyard. The train will depart shortly. Please stand clear of the closing doors.

text.ACTION: After the abandoned train car is lifted by the crane.

text.Aerith: That's not funny, you know.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to use the crane.

text.Cloud: It's not working. There's no power coming through.

text.Aerith: I wonder if this is another prank? Someone might be messing with the power supply to make us run around.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the abandoned warehouse on the lefthand side.

text.Tifa: Do you think there's... more in here?

text.Aerith: Looks like.
Aha! Found you!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to open the control room door on the lefthand side.

text.Tifa: I'm pretty sure I saw a door on the other side of this place. I think our only choice might be to find another route.

text.ACTION: Upon using the control room computer.

text.Aerith: Tifa!
"Coming to get you"... ?

text.Cloud: I don't have time for your shit.

text.ACTION: After defeating Ghoul.

text.Aerith: "That was fun"... All this time, you were waiting for someone to come and play with you.

text.Cloud: C'mon, let's get back to the crane.

text.ACTION: While walking back towards the crane.

text.Tifa: "Those who lose their way out there in the dark of night will never, ever find their way back home again." What do you guys think would've happened if they'd caught us?

text.Aerith: I wonder... Maybe they're the ones who were caught.

text.Cloud: Can we just drop the whole—

text.Aerith: What if they're trapped here and can't leave?

text.ACTION: Upon using the crane.

text.Tifa: Just like we hoped! What a relief.

text.Aerith: We should be able to get through now.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the exit.

text.Aerith: We're through!

text.Tifa: Great. Let's head outside.
Wait.

text.Aerith: A girl?

text.Tifa: Marlene?

text.ACTION: In Tifa's flashback.

text.Marlene: ... And... the kids that the black wind carries away have to live in the train graveyard forever and ever! So you have to stay far, far away from there!

text.Tifa: All right, then. I will.

text.Marlene: Oh, you know Betty? Yesterday she went with her daddy to... to...

text.Tifa: Actually... he might not make it home tonight.

text.ACTION: After the flashback.

text.Tifa: Marlene, what are you—
We can't waste any more time here.
Nothing you need to worry about. Let's get going.

text.ACTION: Upon activating the turntable.

text.Aerith: It's moving!

text.Tifa: Maybe now we can get to the other side.

text.ACTION: After climbing the first ladder and attempting to cross.

text.Tifa: This path is blocked too? But we're so close, I can see it.

text.Aerith: Hey, do you think these trains might still run?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the first movable train.

text.Cloud: Good call. Looks like it still works.

text.Aerith: I knew it!

text.ACTION: Upon moving it.

text.Tifa: Everybody good?

text.Aerith: Huh? I think that's...

text.Tseng: Plate separation code is... Got it?

text.Reno: Yeah, yeah, of course I do! We can drop the damn thing whenever... It's just that...

text.ACTION: At the support pillar.

text.Reno: You got a death wish or something? Because I sure as shit don't.

text.Tseng: Reno, what's happening? Do we have a problem?

text.Reno: Not really. Small arms fire from some local boys trying to defend the pillar.

text.Tseng: More would-be heroes, huh? Sending reinforcements. The more players that take the stage, the better.

text.Reno: So that's what we are, huh?

text.Tseng: Contact me when the mission is complete.

text.ACTION: At the Train Graveyard.

text.Tifa: They're really gonna drop the plate.

text.Cloud: They won't if Barret and the others have anything to say about it.

text.Aerith: All we can do now is keep moving.

text.Tifa: Please... Please let us be in time.

text.ACTION: Upon seeing helicopters after the ladder at the end of the first bridge.
Upon activating the second movable train.

text.Aerith: Wow—would you look at that!

text.ACTION: Upon activating the third movable train.

text.Tifa: Thanks.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Freight Storage.

text.Tifa: Almost there. Come on!

text.Aerith: Cloud!

text.Marlene: The kids that the black wind carries away have to live in the train graveyard forever and ever!

text.Aerith: You're just trying to help, aren't you?
You. You're the one who...

text.Boy (Vision): Are you ready? Well, are ya!?

text.Aerith: I'm ready! I'm ready!
I said I'm ready! Come get me!
I'm right here... (cries)

text.Tifa: Hey. We found you.

text.Aerith: I guess you did.

text.ACTION: While Eligor has the Reflect buff.

text.Tifa: How do we hurt it?

text.Aerith: Hit it with magic.

text.Cloud: It'll bounce right off. Gotta deal with the barrier first.

text.ACTION: After Eligor is down to 30% HP.

text.Aerith: Cloud!

text.Tifa: Look out!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Eligor.

text.Tifa: Hold on, guys. We're coming.
And you... can go to hell!
Let's go.

text.Aerith: Right!

text.Tifa: It's that ghost...
Wow...

text.Aerith: So long.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the fence at the end.

text.Tifa: We made it!

text.Shinra Helicopter: Attention, Avalanche! You are surrounded! Stand down and surrender to Public Security immediately! Shinra does not negotiate with terrorists! Resist and we will use lethal force! I repeat: Shinra does *not* negotiate with terrorists! Resist and we will use lethal force!

text.Barret: Got your lethal force right here, asshole!

text.Tifa: Dropping a whole plate... just like that. No. No way.

text.Aerith: Tifa!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa.

text.Aerith: Please! Let us through!
Cloud, Tifa! We have to get past, whatever it takes!

text.Tifa: Right!

text.ACTION: After the Enigmatic Spectre battle ends.

text.Tifa: There's too many!

text.Aerith: Come on!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Pillar Plaza.

text.Barret: What you got!? Come on!

text.Tifa: That's Barret!
Wedge!

text.Wedge: Cloud... It's Shinra! They're trying to take out the pillar!
I have to go back— Barret and the others are still—

text.Cloud: Stop! Stay with Wedge. I'm going up.

text.Aerith: Sure.

text.Wedge: I'm going too! I can still fight! Biggs, he— They were shooting at me and he—

text.Tifa: Wedge, please. Let Cloud handle it.

text.Aerith: Don't worry. I'll patch him up.

text.Wedge: Hang on, guys! Help is coming!

text.Cloud: Wedge—listen to me. You *stay here with them*.

text.Biggs: 'Bout time you showed up, merc. Gotta do my part to clear the path before you steal the show.

text.ACTION: While moving through objects on 2F.

text.Security Officer (1): Ah, for the love of... I'm getting sick of this. Don't they have anything better to do?

text.Security Officer (2): Tell me about it. You see how hard we got hit over here? Shit. What's wrong with these people?

CHOICE.Security Officer: Hope things stay quiet down here.
This is Echo 1-3. What's the situation up there? This is Echo 1-3. L-2 is quiet.
I repeat: This is— Goddamn it. No signal.

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the enemies on 2F.
Upon engaging the enemies on 3F.

text.Security Officer: Bastards just keep coming! Don't think you're gonna get away with this!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching floor 4F.

text.Biggs: You made it... though... I might not. Hey. Is Wedge...
That's... good to hear. Could've used some extra padding myself. (coughs)
It's... pretty bad up there. Cloud. Promise me. Don't let it be for nothing.

CHOICE.Biggs: You're a good man. Giving me that... that comfort.
I've still got some fight left in me. 'Nough for another platoon or two. Don't gotta be a SOLDIER... to make a difference.

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Biggs: Oh. One more thing. The Leaf House. It's an orphanage. In the... Sector 5 slums. The kids... they're great. I used to visit—(coughs)

text.Cloud: That, you'll have to do yourself.

text.Biggs: Lemme guess... not a fan of kids.
But you have... so much in common.
Good luck... Cloud. Our future... is in your hands.

text.ACTION: Upon engaging the enemies on 5F.
Upon engaging the enemies on 6F.
Upon climbing the stairs on 7F.

text.Reno: Testing, testing... Attention, Avalanche scum! We know all about your evil plans to destroy the pillar. But the Turks—ahem! But Shinra—that's us—won't let you get away with it! So go crawl back into whatever hole you crawled out of, or something!
That oughta do it, right?
Wait. I know you... Mister "First Class." (chuckles) First-class asshole! Gotcha now! You ain't got nowhere to run!

text.Rude: Throw down your weapon and surrender! Shinra does not negotiate with terrorists!

text.Reno: Man, screw this cheap-ass play.

text.ACTION: Below the pillar.

text.Tifa: Get down!

text.Aerith: Thank you!

text.Wedge: That was a close one...

text.Aerith: How is it?

text.Wedge: Much better, thanks.

text.Tifa: I'm sorry. I can't stay here—I have to help them.

text.Aerith: Go. Follow your heart.

text.Tifa: Aerith. There's a bar in the center of town—Seventh Heaven. I need you to—

text.Aerith: Get Marlene to safety. Right? It's okay. I'll find her.

text.Tifa: Huh?
Can you take her to the bar for me, Wedge?

text.Wedge: Consider it done! Now get up there and kick Shinra's ass!
C'mon—Seventh Heaven is this way!

text.Aerith: Wedge, wait!

text.Wedge: You guys can't stay here! Come on, come on!

text.ACTION: Near the gate.

text.NPC (Male 1): Hey, let us through! How else're we supposed to get to Wall Market!?

text.Senior Officer: Sir, you need to step away from the gate!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the gate.

text.Wedge: You have to open the gate! If you don't let these people through—

text.Senior Officer: Back off! It's not gonna happen!

text.Aerith: Wedge!

text.Wedge: I'm no good—not to anyone up there or down here...

text.Aerith: That's not true, Wedge. Don't give up hope yet! We can still save a lot of lives!

text.Wedge: You don't think we're gonna stop them from dropping the plate, do you? I wanna believe that we can still win somehow.

text.Aerith: Mm.

text.Wedge: But... something in my gut tells me we're due for a reckoning. Just this... feeling. Know what I mean?

text.Aerith: Yeah... I do. But... that's no excuse to give up. I don't wanna look back one day... and wish I'd done it different. Right here, right now, I need to know I did everything I could.

text.Wedge: I'm not sure what's gonna happen next. But I am sure I don't wanna regret the choices I make tonight. Our lives are in your hands. If you don't open up, we're all gonna die!

text.New Recruit: No, sir! I will not obey that order!

text.Aerith: Wedge! Seventh Heaven is just down this road, isn't it?

text.Wedge: Head straight and look right—you can't miss it!

text.Aerith: Don't worry about me!

text.Wedge: Alright, I'll get these people to safety!

text.ACTION: After the scene ends.

text.Wedge: There's no time, guys! You've got to get out of Sector 7 as quickly as you can! We'll have a better chance to survive if we work together!

text.Aerith: Get out of Sector 7, please! You need to get as far away from Sector 7 as possible! Right now! Go to Sector 5 or 6—anywhere but here!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Residential Area.

text.Aerith: You all have to get out of Sector 7! Now! Please!

text.Marle: Slow down! Do you know what's going on? What do they want with the pillar?

text.Aerith: Well, there's still time, but...

text.Marle: They're going to drop the plate on us?

text.Aerith: Yes.

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (2): What good do they think that'll do!?

text.Marle: Feel free to cry about it later! Right now, we need to get everyone to safety.

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (1): Wait—the watch should clear the roads first!

text.Marle: Ah, good thinking! Hop to it!
Avalanche, I take it?

text.Aerith: Just a friend.

text.Marle: Tell Tifa to lay low. We'll take care of things here.

text.Aerith: I've got to get to Seventh Heaven!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to run down the road on the left.

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (Not Found): We've got this area covered, don't worry!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Seventh Heaven.

text.Aerith: That's it!
Oh no...
Marlene!

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (Male 1): We need water! Hurry! The fire's spreading!

text.ACTION: Upon moving.

text.Aerith: Ow... Marlene...

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to approach the crashed helicopter.

text.Aerith: Oh, no! Need to find another way to get there!

text.ACTION: While running through the alternate route.

text.Aerith: Gotta get through. Gotta find a way.

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (Male 2): If anyone needs any assistance, please let the watch know!
This underground passage'll take you to Wall Market.

text.ACTION: Near the end of the road in view of Seventh Heaven.

text.Aerith: Finally!
Hold on.
Oh, you poor thing!
I know it must hurt... but you've got to be brave now, okay?

text.Marle: C'mon, keep moving! This way! Hey! Hey! Over here! C'mon!

text.Aerith: I'll take you to her. Ready?

text.ACTION: While walking to Marle.

text.Aerith: Almost there, okay?
No need to rush. Steady now...
I'll be fine. Don't worry about me.

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (Female): We can get through this! We just have to work together!
Get to Wall Market *now*! It's too dangerous here!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Marle

text.Marle: This way, people! Quickly now! Keep moving!

text.Aerith: Can you take care of her?

text.Marle: Of course.

text.Betty's Dad: Betty! I've been looking everywhere for you!

text.Betty: Daddy!

text.Aerith: You'll be fine.

text.ACTION: While running to Seventh Heaven after dropping off Betty.

text.Marle: Stop! That way's already—

text.Aerith: Please, I need to get through!
Almost there!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the crashed helicopter.

text.Tseng: Confirmed, one more bird lost. Probably for the best. After all—
Change of plans. You can take it from here. Someone's been a little too adventurous.

text.ACTION: While running to Seventh Heaven again.

text.Aerith: Please be okay.
Hold on, Marlene. I'm coming for you.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Marlene.

text.Aerith: You're Marlene, right?
I'm... a friend! Of Tifa's!
Right now, she's with Cloud and the others.
You mean Barret? Yep. He's there too.
Not yet. That's why I came to find you. Tifa asked me to. She said, "Take care of Marlene." The thing is, this place isn't safe now. I'm gonna take you somewhere safer, okay?
