text.Marlene: Are they gonna destroy the bar? Are they gonna destroy our house?

text.Aerith: I know it's hard. Just remember, you still have your daddy. You can build a new home together. Anywhere. Shall we go?
Oh?
I hope you remember it. C'mon.
Tell you what. We'll grow lots of flowers at your new house.

text.Marlene: Do you think that I could help too?

text.Aerith: Of course you can. Hey—what's your favorite flower?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the door.

text.Tseng: You led us on a merry chase, Aerith.

text.Aerith: Tseng.

text.Tseng: Before you say another word, know that your options are limited.

text.Aerith: There's nothing to be scared of. Okay?
How about... we make a deal?

text.Reno: Pop your head out and let me finish this already.
Two birds with one shitload of bullets!
Hey!

text.Tifa: Cloud!
Nice catch!
Just like you. So suck it up, 'cause I'm not leaving.

text.Reno: Dammit! You wanna explain yourself, partner?

text.ACTION: After the scene ends.

text.Tifa: I sent her to Seventh Heaven to get Marlene out.
I asked him to show her the way.
We can still stop this... right?
Then let's keep moving!

text.Reno: And where do you think you're going? Come out, come out, wherever the hell you are!
Save us all some time and give up.

text.ACTION: Upon being attacked by helicopter gunfire.
While running around when out of Reno's sight.

CHOICE.Reno: Well, if this is how you wanna play it, that's fine by me.
Stay where I can see ya!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering a group of enemies.
Sometimes upon defeating the a group of enemies.

text.Reno: I don't know about you, but I am *over* this shit!

text.ACTION: Upon being attacked by helicopter fire while in the middle of a battle.

text.Reno: Looks like you guys are having the time of your life.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 12F.

text.Tifa: What was that?

text.Jessie: So, how'd you guys rate my latest and greatest design? Eleven outta ten?
Today's your unlucky day, 'cause I never miss.

text.ACTION: After defeating the enemies on 12F.

text.Reno: What, what?

text.Rude: Seems we've lost control of the top floor.

text.Reno: Huh? Our guys are seriously struggling to take down these assholes?

text.Rude: Anyway, we may need to intervene personally.

text.Reno: Whatever you say, partner. Keep 'em busy, will ya?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Jessie.

text.Tifa: Jessie!

text.Jessie: Oh, jeez... Tifa... If you could see the look on your face...
So... you're the guy... who gets to hear my last words... Heh... Lucky me.
It's okay, Cloud... It's okay. They were my bombs. They were all... my victims. I had it... coming.
My hero. So gentle...
So dramatic... I... I just wish that... I could've had you over again... Everyone... With Mom's cooking... I really wanted... to believe... we could...

text.Cloud: Yeah. You owe me a pizza.

text.Jessie: That's right. I do. But... I don't think...
Oh no... Tifa's crying. Did I say something wrong?
Don't you guys... have somewhere to be? It's not polite... to stare... you know...

text.Tifa: Jessie...

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the stairs to 15F.

text.Barret: I ain't done with you yet! You hear me!? Think you can come up in here—do what you want—and we're gonna take it!?

text.Tifa: Barret!

text.Barret: Tifa!? Get your ass behind cover! Now! Chopper's gonna chew you up!
Damn right! Leadin' man sticks around till the credits roll! Though we gotta keep moving if we wanna make it that far. You ready?

text.Reno: Time for a rematch, huh... Rude!
It's nothing personal... bitch! Ha!
Missed me!

text.Barret: You're next, asshole!

text.Reno: Sorry, losers! Gotta play for keeps today. No time to dick around.

text.Announcement: Plate separation authorized. Awaiting confirmation. Plate separation authorized. Awaiting confirmation.

text.Reno: Yeah, yeah, coming right up.
No you don't! Not when I'm working!

text.Announcement: Plate separation authorized. Awaiting confirmation.

text.Reno: Now, now... You ain't got shit on us.

text.ACTION: During battle against Reno.

text.Barret: Yeah, quick at runnin' away, maybe!

text.Reno: Ha! In your dreams.
So. Heard you gave Rude a beating.
No choice, huh? I guess I ain't got one neither.

text.STATUS: When Reno loses 30% HP.

text.Reno: Stubborn little shitbirds, ain'tcha?

text.Rude: Prepping for bombing run, how copy?

text.Reno: Say what!?
I see you're doin' whatever the hell you want. Guess I'm rubbing off on ya.

text.STATUS: When Reno is down to 30% HP and Rude's helicopter is shot down.

text.Reno: Dammit...
Clipped your wings, huh?

text.Rude: I was planning to join you anyway.

text.Reno: Any landing ya can walk away from... C'mon! Let's teach 'em the Turks two-step!
What happens when you mess with the Turks! If you're gonna pick a fight with the Turks, you'd better be prepared to leave in a body bag.

text.Barret: Confident, ain't we?

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Reno while Rude is active.
Upon defeating Rude while Reno is active.

text.Reno: Rude!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating both.

text.Announcement: Plate separation authorized. Awaiting confirmation.

text.Reno: Who knows?

text.Barret: Where you going!?
Getting real tired of your shit!
Where'dja—

text.Announcement: Plate separation initiated. Plate separation initiated. Commencing separation sequence. Section 1 separation imminent. Evacuate immediately. Plate separation initiated.

text.Barret: You son of a bitch! What have you done!?

text.Tifa: Cloud!
What do we do!?

text.Tseng: Nothing. There is nothing you can do now.

text.Tifa: You can't do this!

text.Aerith: Tifa! I found Marlene!

text.Tifa: Aerith!

text.Barret: Marlene? My Marlene!? What did you do with her!?

text.Aerith: I'm at the—

text.Tseng: Your activities unwittingly brought you into contact with the Ancient, who is now back in our custody where she belongs. For this, you have my sincerest gratitude. Alas, the sector in which you stand has been condemned.

text.Aerith: Run! You have to go now!

text.Tseng: And where exactly do you expect them to go?

text.Announcement: Total plate separation imminent. Evacuate the area immediately.

text.Tifa: No, no, no...

text.Barret: If we don't get the hell outta here right now, we're dead! We gotta think of something! Think dammit think! Look around... Gotta be something! Shit... shit... Shit!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa.

text.Barret: Hey! Over here! Found us a way out!
C'mon, c'mon!
Now!

text.ACTION: While moving towards Barret.

text.Barret: Hey! Anybody out there!?

text.Tifa: Barret!?
I think I hear him up ahead!

text.Barret: Hey! Can anybody hear me!?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the rubble.

text.Tifa: And *push*!

text.ACTION: After moving it.

text.Barret: Marlene... Marlene! Marlene!
Marlene! Biggs! Wedge! Jessie!
Goddammit. Goddamn you! Goddamn you all! (cries)
Marlene... Marlene... (cries)

text.Tifa: It was us. We did this.

text.Barret: No. You can't think like that. Whatever came before, it was Shinra that pulled the trigger today. Am I right!?

text.Tifa: ... Yeah.

text.Barret: Hold on to this. This... *anger*. Okay?

text.Cloud: Barret. Marlene's fine. Aerith found her.

text.Barret: Aerith? Is that the girl they took?

text.Tifa: Yeah. That's her.

text.Barret: The hell's going on!?

text.Tifa: I asked Aerith to find Marlene and take her somewhere safe.

text.Barret: And she did? You sure!?
Hey! Where you going!?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the New Recruit and Senior Officer.

CHOICE.New Recruit: I don't—What do we do now?

CHOICE.Senior Officer: What you were hired to do. Get these people outta here!
So you know, things could've been worse if you hadn't done what you did. Sometimes you can't let yourself be bound by orders.

CHOICE.New Recruit: I've made up my mind. I'm not gonna do this job for Shinra anymore. I'm an officer of the people now!
We need to think about supplies and shelter and food for all these people. I work for the people now, not some corporation.

CHOICE.Senior Officer: You know, you've given me a lot to think about. I can't let rules and orders dictate my life.

text.ACTION: Halfway down the S7-6 Road.

text.Barret: I said—where you going?

text.Cloud: Aerith's house. It's in the Sector 5 slums.

text.Barret: And that's where Marlene is?
Tell me she is! Give me something to hang on to! Even if she's not. I won't blame you for it, I swear!
Who am I kidding. I'd probably try to tear your head off.

text.Tifa: I know I've heard of them at least.

text.Barret: They come up in planetology books. Meant to be the original stewards of the planet. Could even "commune" with it. Talk to it and stuff.

text.Cloud: That must be why the Turks wanted her so badly.

text.Sephiroth: Within my veins flows the blood of Ancients. This planet... is my birthright.
You have failed again, I see.
But through suffering, you will grow strong. Isn't that what you want?

text.Tifa: Cloud?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam.

text.Sam: Hey. Pretty crazy, huh? Can you believe this mess?
I am, but I can't say the same 'bout my birds. Poor things're scared half to death.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to him again.

CHOICE.Sam: Times like these, people are gonna need our help.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Stablehand at Wall Market.

CHOICE.Stablehand: Who could've seen this coming? It's all so tragic...
Chocobos are so frightened, they're refusing to move.

text.ACTION: Upon entering Wall Market.

text.Barret: What the hell are they doing here?

text.Cloud: Their jobs, probably. Just focus on seeing Marlene again. Nothing else.

text.ACTION: Upon passing the Security Officers in Wall Market.

text.Security Officer (2): We're searching the compound as we speak, sir.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Andrea.

text.Andrea: Did you find what you were looking for?
Good. Now never let it go again.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to him again.

CHOICE.Andrea: I need to prep for my next show.
Times like these, song and dance are truly essential.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M.

text.Madam M: Well, this is a fine mess...
Compared to Sector 7, we're doing fine. But that's hardly an accomplishment.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her again.

CHOICE.Madam M: How ever did it come to this... ?
I don't like not knowing what's going on...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the S6-5 Road.

text.Barret: You guys run into Jessie at the pillar?

text.Tifa: Yeah... Biggs too. They were both in pretty bad shape. But Wedge wasn't up there with 'em. He got out.

text.Barret: All right.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Stablehand on the S6-5 Road.

text.Stablehand: Come on now, there's no need to be afraid. We're all scared...

text.ACTION: Upon running further down the S6-5 Road.

text.Barret: I've been thinking, y'all... We gotta go find the others.

text.Tifa: Huh?

text.Barret: If we don't look for them, who will?

text.Tifa: ... Right.

text.Barret: Hey, Cloud. Gonna need your help with it too.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Sector 5 Slums - Center District.

text.Barret: This is Sector 5, right? So where's this place you said Marlene is?

text.Cloud: Where I think she is. It's a house on the other side of town.

text.Barret: Well, come on then, pick up the pace!

text.Cloud: I'm going as fast as you are.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley.

text.Chadley: Cloud! I'm glad to see that you're okay. In these trying times I hope to develop new materia to help us endure.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Aerith's garden.

text.Barret: Marlene! Marlene!

text.ACTION: Upon entering Aerith's house.

text.Barret: Where's Marlene!? Is she here!?
Sorry. I'm Barret. Marlene's my little girl. Marlene—she's got short hair. She's cute as a button, with the heart of an angel. She was wearing... Uh... pink! She was wearing a pink dress today!

text.Elmyra: She's sleeping upstairs.
I said she's sleeping!

text.Tifa: I wanna see her too. C'mon. Let's go look in on her.

text.Elmyra: Keep it down. Don't wake her.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Elmyra.

CHOICE.Elmyra: Maybe you should join your friend upstairs.
Keep it down. Don't wake her.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the upper floor.

text.Barret: Marlene... my baby. Thank god.

text.Tifa: Sh.

text.Elmyra: Shinra has my daughter now.

text.Tifa: No. I'm the one who asked her to go get Marlene. We'd only just met, but she was so kind and helpful. I... took advantage of her.

text.Elmyra: It's not your fault. It was only a matter of time before she ended up back there.

text.Cloud: Because she's an Ancient. That it?

text.Elmyra: So she told you about that? She must trust you all a great deal...
Yes. Aerith is an Ancient. Probably the last one living. She's not my daughter. Not by blood, I mean. If that's what you were wondering...

About fifteen years ago... My husband, he'd been shipped off to fight on the front lines. But then I received a letter saying he'd be home for a bit. So when the day came, I went to the station to meet him... But... he didn't come. I couldn't help fearing the worst, even then... but I told myself his leave must've been postponed, that he'd been delayed. Every day I went, to wait, and to pray...

And that's how I met her. Her and her mother. I thought maybe they'd run away from Wall Market. Or that they were topsiders fallen on hard times. I'd seen that sort of thing a lot. "Take Aerith somewhere safe." Those were her mother's dying words. My husband had been away for so long, and I was lonely. So I convinced myself the safest place for the girl was with me.

It took no time at all for her to start feeling like family. She was a real chatterbox. She told me strange stories... Like how she and her mother had escaped from some sort of facility... And how she wasn't sad because her mother had just... "returned to their planet."

text.Barret: Their planet, huh? Yeah, that sounds about right.

text.Elmyra: I didn't understand any of it at the time. When I asked if she meant one in the sky... She said no, this one. Right here. I mean... what can you say to that... ?

text.Aerith: Mommy, don't be sad.

text.Elmyra: That's what she said to me one day, out of the blue.
So I asked her, "What's wrong?"

text.Aerith: A man you really, really love just died. His heart came a long way to say goodbye. But he couldn't stay, 'cause he had to return to the planet.

text.Elmyra: I didn't believe her, of course. And then, a few days later, I received a letter saying my husband had been killed in action. Things like that, she'd just know. It was a lot to deal with, but we were happy. And then came the knock.

text.Aerith: Coming!
No... Go away!

text.Tseng: Aerith... You know you're not just any little girl. You're a descendant of the Ancients.

text.Elmyra: I had no idea what he meant, so I said, "Who are the Ancients?"

text.Tseng: They were the original stewards of the planet whose boundless knowledge and wisdom shall guide us to the promised land. Some believe the promised land to be a myth. Others, an allegory of sorts. But we take the words of the scriptures at face value, and believe it to be quite real. Which is why Shinra would like very much for Aerith to help us—

text.Aerith: You're wrong! I'm not an Ancient!

text.Tseng: But Aerith... Even when you're all alone, don't you hear voices whispering secrets?

text.Aerith: No, never!

text.Elmyra: But all three of us knew that wasn't true. That man knew exactly who Aerith was, where she'd come from, and what she could do.

text.Cloud: They knew where she was, but they didn't just take her? Doesn't sound like the Turks I know.

text.Elmyra: She had to come willingly, otherwise it wouldn't work, they said. That's why... even if they did take her away, I'm sure she's still being treated like a guest... And that they'll send her straight back home once they get what they need.
You're not planning anything, are you? Don't make things worse than they already are. If I lost her too, I don't know if I could... if I could ever... Just don't.

text.Tifa: Cloud. Maybe she's right about this. Maybe they'll let Aerith go when it's all over. Maybe... we'd be better off waiting a little while.

text.Barret: Let's head back to Sector 7. Got things to take care of. Like... checking up on the bar.

text.Tifa: Yeah.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Elmyra.

text.Elmyra: Take care of yourselves now.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with Marlene.

text.Barret: We're gonna win this fight. I promise.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving Aerith's garden.

text.Tifa: The main entrance to Sector 7 is buried under rubble now. So how are we supposed to get back inside?

text.Barret: Ah, good plan.

text.Tifa: But how do we get to the park?

text.Cloud: I know another way to get there. Aerith showed me before.

text.Barret: Heh. This Ancient girl knows her stuff. Didn't mean anythin' by it.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Collapsed Expressway.

text.Barret: Aight, let's keep moving.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Old Bypass.
Upon encountering the first group of bandits.
Upon encountering Beck, Butch, and Burke.

text.Beck: Not so fast! You wanna come through here, you'll need to provide due compens— You again!?

text.Barret: Friends of yours!

text.Beck: Stop lying! We go way back!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Dual Robot Arms Worksite.

text.Tifa: Over there!

text.Barret: Huh? That a way out?

text.Tifa: I'm almost afraid to go back. To see it with my own eyes...
Come on.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Evergreen Park.

text.Barret: Wymer! You're alive!

text.Wymer: Still in one piece.

text.Barret: Who else made it out?

text.Wymer: I wish I knew... Sorry.

text.Tifa: It's fine.

text.Barret: I'm just glad you survived. Gives me hope for the others.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Wymer.

text.Wymer: This is bad.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer.

CHOICE.Wymer: We need able-bodied men and women.
We can't afford to lose any more lives. Not now.
I don't even know where to start.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Betty.

text.Betty: I really hope that all my friends are okay.

text.Betty's Dad: I'm sure they are, honey. Don't worry.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Item Store Owner.

text.Item Store Owner: Never know what you're gonna run into out there. Best be prepared.

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.
Upon talking to the Weapons Vendor.

text.Barret: Yeah... Left a few things behind.

text.Weapons Vendor: I see. I know it's not much, but it's all I got.

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.
Upon talking to him again.

CHOICE.Weapons Vendor: I dug this stuff out of the rubble. It's still usable.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Sector 7 tunnel.

text.Barret: Okay. Let's see what's on the other side.

text.ACTION: After an earthquake upon using the ladder.

text.Barret: Again!?

text.Cloud: That one was a lot closer.

text.LOCATION: Home Is Where the Heart Is

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Sector 7 Slums.

text.Barret: My god...

text.Marle: Just a little more! Come on! C'mon!

text.Barret: Make room!

text.Tifa: Marle!

text.Marle: You're alive!

text.Barret: Great job, guys.

text.Marle: I can't tell you how relieved I am to see you. So. What now?

text.Barret: Don't know. Find something—anything—to do.

text.Marle: Been back to the bar yet?

text.Barret: No.

text.Marle: Maybe you should go take a look.

text.Barret: Okay. First the bar... then the rest.

text.Marle: Careful. The roads are a mess. Watch your step or you'll wind up in a hole!

text.Barret: Hello! Anybody out there!? If you can hear me, say something!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle.

CHOICE.Marle: I take it that little Marlene's safe and sound?
That little girl's a hell of a lot stronger than you might think.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Barret.

text.Barret: Shit!

text.Tifa: Hear that?

text.Barret: What?

text.Tifa: Let's follow it.

text.ACTION: Upon moving the rubble.

text.Barret: Ready? One, two, three!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Wedge's house.

text.Tifa: Is this all that's left of Wedge's place?

text.ACTION: Upon dropping down the cave-in in the ground.

text.Barret: Hey! We're coming down! Stay right where you are!
Hmph. This place reeks of Shinra.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Wedge.

text.Tifa: Wedge?

text.Barret: Wedge!
Of all the times! (screams)
Tifa! Cloud! Shout if you can hear me! Hey!

text.ACTION: After closing tutorial "Destroying Obstacles to Progress".

text.Barret: If there's no path, you gotta make one.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Waste Processing Chamber.

text.Barret: Must be a secret Shinra facility.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Type C Specimens - Nursery.

text.Barret: How long it take 'em to build all this beneath our feet?

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the ladder to B5.

text.Barret: Man... you'd think they dug halfway to hell.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the ladder to B4.

text.Barret: Just no escapin' them, is there?

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group of Bugaboos on B4.

text.Barret: I'm really gonna enjoy burning it all down.
Tifa! Hey, Tifa!

text.Tifa: Barret!

text.Barret: You okay?

text.Tifa: To tell you the truth, not really. I think there's a nest around here somewhere. Can you take care of it?

text.Barret: I gotcha!

text.ACTION: After destroying the nest.

text.Barret: Sorry.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Tifa.

text.Barret: Tifa! Where's Cloud?

text.Tifa: I don't know.

text.Barret: Well, he can take care of himself. We've got bigger issues.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Bugaboos.

text.Barret: Are you all right?

text.Tifa: Yeah, I'm good, thanks.

text.Barret: All right. Gotta go find Wedge. Come on.

text.ACTION: Upon entering Type-D Specimens - Creche.

text.Tifa: I'm afraid to ask, but did you just shoot your way in here?

text.Barret: Well, yeah. Worked, didn't it?

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the first ladder in the Type-D Specimens - Creche.

text.Barret: If I gotta climb another damn ladder...

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the second ladder down to a lower platform.

text.Tifa: Hey. You think Wedge is holding up okay?

text.Barret: Of course he is. He's a lot tougher than people think. Probably sleeping soundly, dreaming about his cats.

text.Tifa: You're right. We should treat him to a nice meal when he gets back. His choice.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the staircase to the Break Room on B1.

text.Barret: Gotta stay on my toes if I'm gonna make it outta here alive.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Specimen Testing Area.

text.Barret: Wedge!

text.Tifa: He's okay.

text.Barret: You sure?
Making me worry like that. I'd kick your ass if you didn't look like shit! Thank god.

text.Tifa: Thank you!
Okay. Let's go.

text.Barret: Uh—sure!
Yup... it's you all right.

text.Tifa: What is this... ?
Barret!

text.Barret: The hell is this now!?

text.STATUS: When the battle against Unknown Entity enemies begins.

text.Barret: Where were you freaks hiding!?

text.Tifa: Are they Shinra experiments!?

text.Barret: Hah! Well if that's the case, then it's only right we put the bastards down!

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group.

text.Barret: Ah, of course there's more.

text.Tifa: You good?

text.Barret: Like you even gotta ask!

text.ACTION: After defeating the second group.

text.Barret: Gettin' real tired of this shit!

text.Tifa: This is ridiculous.

text.STATUS: When the third group appears, or after time passes before Tifa reaches the higher ledge.

text.Barret: We gotta close that duct. Tifa, you're up!

text.Tifa: Okay! Cover me!

text.ACTION: After Tifa reaches the higher ledge.

text.Barret: Tifa!

text.STATUS: When Tifa is surrounded by a group of enemies.

text.Tifa: Seriously!?

text.STATUS: When the Failed Experiment uses Fling.

text.Tifa: It's using its friends as weapons!?

text.STATUS: When the Failed Experiment uses Demolish.

text.Barret: Hey, Tifa! Heads up!

text.ACTION: Upon crippling the Failed Experiment's appendage.

text.Barret: Huh! Getting tired?

text.Tifa: Look!

text.Barret: Well, that sure looks like a weak point to me!

text.STATUS: When the Failed Experiment loses 30% HP.

text.Barret: All that's left is to deal with these freaks!

text.ACTION: After defeating the Failed Experiment.

text.Tifa: Cloud!

text.Barret: 'Bout time, merc.
Late to the party and you're giving *me* orders?
Hell yeah!
So how'd you manage to track us down?

text.Cloud: Followed the trail of bullet holes. There's nobody else I know who'd leave that kinda mess.

text.ACTION: Upon destroying the fracture.

text.Tifa: Oh, god... were those...

text.Barret: People?

text.Cloud: Yeah. That's the Shinra I know.

text.Tifa: Cloud?

text.Barret: What the hell was that?

text.Tifa: We need to get him somewhere safe. Everything else can wait until after.

text.Barret: Agreed. Let's go.

text.Tifa: Cloud.

text.ACTION: After walking some distance back.

text.Barret: I want you to take Wedge back for me. I'm gonna look around for the others. He made it, didn't he? They could still be alive.

text.Cloud: I saw them both at the pillar... Jessie and Biggs. Saw... how bad they were hurt. I'm sorry, but...

text.Barret: Don't.

text.Tifa: They've returned to the planet.

text.Barret: They... they were supposed to return to *us*.
But if we stop now... they'll never let us live it down. So... we carry that weight.
I'm sorry. I truly am. We had no other place to go and...

text.Elmyra: I would never leave a wounded man out on the street.

text.Cloud: Elmyra. I know what you said, but you have to let us go after Aerith.

text.Elmyra: Not this again.

text.Cloud: We found an underground Shinra lab where they've done human testing. This wasn't the first time and it won't be the last. I know these people, and I know they're never gonna let Aerith go. She's the last living Ancient on the planet. Think about what that means to Shinra's scientists. Especially to that son of a bitch Hojo. We're all just numbers and meat to him.

text.Elmyra: Enough!
Please. I need some time to think. You've all had a long day. Why don't you go upstairs and get some rest.

text.Barret: You should rest up while you can.

Nah, I'm good—real good. 'Sides, when I close my eyes, I start thinking 'bout things. 'Bout people. Like Finn. Lazy little punk. Kid would do damn near anything 'cept what you told him. But ask him to paint you a picture and boy howdy. Those Stamps in the tunnels? Finn's work. Every one.

Then there's Al. Intel guy. He had these tricks for stealing codes I still don't understand. Stole his share of hearts, too. But, when it came to the ladies, he just had the one trick. Bouquet of flowers hidden behind his back. Funny to think, some of 'em might've even come from here. He pulled the flower trick on Tifa once, believe it or not. She told him where to stick 'em.

Our quartermaster, Nellie, had a good laugh at that. She was tight with Jessie. People sometimes took 'em for sisters even. They'd say "No way!" and get upset, but then they'd start giggling and you knew...
Yeah... They'll all be fine. They're strong. They're tough. Like me. After we save Aerith, I'll introduce you to them.
Never thought I'd feel better after talking with your hard-boiled ass.
Oh yeah. Like a baby.

text.Tifa: No. You too?
Sorry. Didn't mean to wake you.

text.Cloud: I'm a light sleeper. It's a SOLDIER thing.

text.Tifa: That flower you gave me the other night. That was from Aerith, wasn't it?

I knew there was something weird going on. You, buying flowers. They symbolize reunion, believe it or not. I was curious, so I looked it up. I tried to keep it alive as long as I could. But now... it's dead and buried.
Like the bar... our home... and everything else.
They took everything from us. Again. (cries)
Cloud... Cloud, you're hurting me.
It's stupid. I know that crying's a waste of time.
Thank you.

text.Cloud: How is this... ? Is this a dream?

text.Aerith: Maybe. You tell me.
Don't I look it? I used to live in the Shinra Building, back when I was really little.
Right. So it kinda feels like I've gone back to my childhood home, you know? Honestly, it's not that bad.
C'mon, Cloud. Don't be silly.
"Too"? So you're worried about me?
I'm sorry about that. Really.
Everyone dies eventually.
So we need to make the most of the time we have—to live our lives the way we wanna live. Every minute... every moment, matters.
Good. So...

text.Cloud: You need to embrace this moment. Right?

text.Aerith: I'm glad I met you, Cloud. I really am. I'm grateful for all the words we've shared. For all the moments and the memories. You've made me more happy than you know. And I'll always cherish what you've given me. But... But whatever happens, you can't fall in love with me. Even if you think you have... it's not real.

text.Cloud: Do I get a say in all this?

text.Aerith: It's almost morning. Time to go.
If that's what you want. Thank you.

text.Barret: You've done more for us than we deserve. I won't forget this. If you ever need anything, all you gotta do is holler.

text.Elmyra: Happy to help out however I can.
... I've been thinking about what you said.

text.Cloud: She's calling out to me. I can feel it.

text.Tifa: We all can. So please. She's our friend. We have to help her.

text.Barret: Mm.

text.Elmyra: I always knew it was coming. Knew that one day I'd have to say goodbye to my baby girl. But not yet. Please—bring her back to me.

text.Barret: Marlene...
I'm sorry, honey. I wish I didn't have to. I wish I could be with you all the time. I really do. But if I stay here, I can't fight out there.
Some bad people are... trying to hurt the planet. And Daddy... Daddy and his friends are trying to stop those bad people. The slums, your friends, the whole planet—it's Daddy's job to protect it.
And that's why I've gotta go. You remember that nice girl who came to find you? Well, now we have to go find her. And when we bring her home, you ned to say thank you, okay?
What?
We will.
Of course, I promise.

text.Tifa: Barret...

text.Barret: She's tougher than me.
Aight! Time to get some payback.

text.Cloud: Don't forget why we're doing this.

text.Barret: I know, I know. To rescue Aerith.

text.Tifa: So, how're we supposed to get topside? With everything that's happened, the trains still aren't running.

text.Barret: Well, we could walk along the tracks.

text.Cloud: The city's on high alert. All the roads and public transit have probably been locked down by now.

text.Barret: So what's the plan then? You know another way up?

text.Tifa: No, but I think I know someone who might.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Sector 5 slums monitor.

text.Kyrie: My fellow grounders, listen up, because boy, do I have some news for you! And it's assured to knock your socks all the way into next week! Gather round, 'cause this is the good stuff!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the monitor.

text.Kyrie: So, after bombing Reactors 1 and 5, what do the eco-terrorists do? They go for the trifecta and take out Mako Reactor 7! Another attack by amateurs who don't care about collateral damage. The sky is falling and Avalanche is to blame! But wait! Did you know Wutai is the one funding their activities!? For all their claims about fighting for the slums... they're nothing more than pawns of Wutai—puppets dancing to the tune of their foreign masters! And that's the truth! Topside news delivered straight to your ears! That'll be five gil. Five gil—come on!

text.Undercity Resident (Male 3): Damn, man! Knew we couldn't trust Wutai to leave us alone.

text.Undercity Resident (Male 6): It's the reactors. They want 'em, we got 'em.

text.Undercity Resident (Female 6): Does this mean there'll be another war?

text.Undercity Resident (Male 3): After what they've done? What choice do we have?

text.Kyrie: Five gil apiece—cough it up! The truth ain't free, you know!

text.Barret: We ain't no damn pawns of Wutai! I couldn't care less about the rest, but that shit?

text.Tifa: No one will listen to us. There's no point in even trying.
I'm sorry.

text.Barret: Hey... Hey Tifa, listen. There's no room in this for regrets or what-ifs or any of that. All we can do is keep moving forward. Keep following this path we chose. Wherever, so we can say we did all we could.

text.Tifa: I know. But... right now... instead of looking forward, you need to look around. Everyone here is terrified. So I'm asking you... don't.
I know we're short on time, but let's try to help out wherever we can.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Leviathan in Chadley's VR Combat Simulator.

text.Chadley: Marvelous! Leviathan, the patron deity of Wutai, is not an enemy to be trifled with. Together, you can cleanse the world of the Shinra scourge.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Bahamut in Chadley's VR Combat Simulator.

text.Chadley: Now that was a battle! What an impressive feat to hold your own against one of the most exalted summons known to man. Together with the legendary Bahamut, I have every confidence you can expunge Shinra from existence. Such bravery... incredible!

text.ACTION: Upon entering Wall Market.

text.Tifa: Do we really have to deal with Corneo again?

text.Barret: What? Did you guys get into it with him or something?

text.Tifa: I don't wanna talk about it.

text.Barret: Huh? Hey, Cloud, what ha—

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Innkeeper at Wall Market.

text.Innkeeper: It's quite crowded at the moment, but I'll see what I can do.

text.ACTION: After selecting "Yes" and restoring HP and MP.
Upon talking to the Souvenir Shop Owner.

text.Souvenir Shop Owner: With these babies, you can send intruders flying! I guarantee this is the only home protection you'll ever need!

text.ACTION: After closing the store menu.

text.Souvenir Shop Owner: Only a few left. Get yours while you can!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper without beginning "Tomboy Bandit", or selecting "Free Battle" during the quest.

text.Gatekeeper: Hey, been waiting for ya. So—what're ya in the mood to fight?

text.ACTION: Upon entering Corneo's mansion.

text.Barret: No one's home.

text.ACTION: Upon walking down the dungeon staircase.

text.Kotch: Help, somebody! Hey!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Kotch.

text.Kotch: You mother— Uh, I mean... Hey, there. Would you mind helping me out? I'm kind of in a bind, as you can see...

Thanks, you guys! Man, these jerks from Shinra showed up outta nowhere! Accused me of leaking information and called me "useless." And, well, the rest is history. Well, anyway, thanks for helping me out. Peace out!

text.ACTION: Upon entering Corneo's bedroom.

text.Leslie: Long time no see. What brings you back here?

text.Tifa: Well, we need to find a way to get topside as quickly as possible, and we figured Corneo oughta know one.

text.Leslie: Is that so... In that case, I can help.

text.Barret: You serious? Then tell us!

text.Leslie: Follow me.

text.Barret: So... what's the deal with the hole?

text.Leslie: Unfinished business. If you three give me a hand with it, I'll give you what you need to get topside.

text.Tifa: You want us to go back into the sewers with you? What's down there?

text.Leslie: Corneo's hidey-hole. That's where I'm headed.

text.Barret: You're not gonna try to screw us over, are you?

text.Leslie: If that's what you think, walk away. I'll find somebody else to work with. And you'll have to find another way to get topside.

text.Barret: Say what?

text.Leslie: Fine by me.

text.Tifa: He means it.

text.Leslie: I'll tell you more after we've climbed down. When you're good to go, let me know.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Leslie again.

text.Leslie: You guys ready?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Leslie: Okay. Follow me.

text.Barret: Seriously—what's the deal with the hole?

text.Cloud: It's a trop for the don's enemies.

text.Barret: What?

text.Leslie: No one's ever gotten out alive. Well. Until recently that is.

text.ACTION: Upon approachig Ms. Folia.

text.Ms. Folia: How far could they have gone?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ms. Folia.

text.Ms. Folia: Oh, Cloud! Have you seen the kids around by any chance? I haven't seen them since they left to do their patrols. I knew I should've told them to stay inside today. If you do happen to run into them somewhere, could you tell them to come back right away? I can describe them if it'd help—

text.Barret: Just stay calm and wait here. Never know—they might come back on their own. Okay?

text.Ms. Folia: Yes, of course. Thank you so very much.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her again.

CHOICE.Ms. Folia: Thank you, I appreciate the help.
Plates aren't supposed to ust fall. I mean, what's going on up there?
Please come back safe and sound. Please.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching to Oates.

text.Oates: Hey, Cloud.

text.Barret: Hmm. Gotta be one of them lost kids.

text.Oates: Lost? Who said we were lost? Stupid old man.

text.Barret: What'd you say?

text.Cloud: What're you doing out here? And where's everyone else?

text.Oates: Well, we saw a bunch of tombstones lying on the ground, so we decided to stand them back up. And then I heard laughing coming from somewhere, and when I turned around, everyone was gone. I was alone.
That! I heard that and everyone disappeared.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Phantoms.

text.Oates: Guys!

text.Barret: So why'd you kids come out all this way?

text.Oates: This is where our parents are. They're resting, but we wanted to say hi. Sometimes you just wanna do that, you know?

text.Barret: ... I do.

text.Oates: Thanks so much for coming to find us! That's another one I owe ya! We're gonna head back to the House now. Ms. Folia's probably pretty worried.

text.Boy (2): Hey Cloud, I found this on the ground. You should take it. I think it might come in handy!

text.Barret: Buncha little smart-asses... With good hearts.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the stablehand in the Sector 5 Slums.

text.Stablehand: Hey, you! Cloud, right? Man, am I glad I caught you. Sam—he told me who you are. Said you're a merc, and a former SOLDIER at that! Listen, I hate to ask, but we've got a few runaway birds. Mind helping us find them? Poor things were so startled by that plate coming down, they just up and bolted. I'm sure they're around here somewhere, frightened and hungry. My poor birds...

text.Barret: Worried about 'em huh? All right. I think we can help you out.

text.Stablehand: Oh, thank you! When you find them, feed them this. THere's there missing all told, and their names are Coco, Lolo, and Momo. They'll come on home once they got some food in their bellies. Good luck. I'm counting on y'all.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Stablehand near Wall Market.

text.Stablehand: Oh, thank goodness! Been looking for y'all. You gotta help me. It's the chocobos... They've escaped, wouldn't you know!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam before bringing back all chocobos. Sentences referring to chocobos will not be said if they have been recovered.

text.Sam: Thanks for agreeing to find my birds. You're a real saint. Someone said they heard a chocobo warking in one of them Sector 5 back alleys. Heard there's a chocobo out by the collapsed expressway. A chocobo was spotted near the old church. That's about all that's reached my ears. I'd bet good money those wandering birds are mine.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam again.

CHOICE.Sam: You don't think my missing birds're hurt, do ya?
It's just plain senseless, that's what it is.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching a lost chocobo.
Upon interacting with the lost chocobo by the church.
Upon interacting with the lost chocobo in the Sector 5 scrapyard area and the Collapsed Expressway.
Upon interacting with the chocobo again.
After finding all three.

text.Barret: Okay then! That makes three.

text.Cloud: We'd better check in at Sam's.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam after finding all three.

text.Sam: There's the champ with a heard of gold! My babies are all back home, safe and sound. Now I can finally get back to the busienss of business. Thanks, partner. Here, y'all earned this. It's a pass that'll get you a ride on one of my carriages whenever you need it—free of charge, of course. Not bad, am I right?

Chocobos're somethin' else. You can ride 'em, pet 'em, befriend 'em. What would we do without 'em? They're the reason a guy like me can keep a roof over his head in a town like this—and that's no lie. I wouldn't blame ya for doubting that coming from me, but it is what it is.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Sam after completing the quest.

CHOICE.Sam: Anyhow, gotta make up for lost time.
But hell, me and the birds've been through thick 'n' thin. We'll fiigure it out.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M.

text.Madam M: If it isn't Cloud.

text.Cloud: We're looking for a way topside. Know one?

text.Madam M: Good luck with that. Security's so tight these days that not even a gnat could slip through. Wall Market's in a sorry state, too. Corneo's men are turning it upside down looking for Avalanche.
Hmm? The man with a gun for an arm...

text.Barret: What? Got a problem?

text.Madam M: No, but you might. Corneo's men are searching high and low for an Avalanche member who fits your description. Shinra has placed a very impressive bounty on you and your friends' heads. And a lot of people are looking to get rich.

text.Barret: Ain't these fools got anything better to do?

text.Madam M: You should also know that you and that arm of yours were spotted in the Sector 5 slums. Apparently, you were loitering in a rather lovely flower garden?

text.Barret: Oh yeah... ? Wait!

text.Tifa: This is bad. Really bad.

text.Barret: Let's move!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M again.

text.Madam M: Do be careful on your way back to the slums.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Housemother by Leaf House.

text.Housemother: Oh Cloud! Thank goodness you're here. A group of Corneo's men just came through—headed for Aerith's place.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her.

text.Housemother: I don't know what business they have with Aerith, but I know it can't be anything good.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Corneo Lackeys.

text.Corneo Lackey: I dunno... You really think this gun-arm dude'll come back instead of running?

text.Hoodlum: Oh, you bet your ass he'll come back. Now shut up and keep your eyes peeled.

text.Corneo Lackey: Yeah, yeah. Well, not like we're goin' anywhere with this thing, anyway.
Beats me. His face creeps me out.
Better watch where he points that thing.

text.Hoodlum: Better watch your mouth, bitch. You don't wanna give him a reason to hold a grudge, ya know?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Corneo Lackeys.

text.Corneo Lackey: Hey, it's him! Gun-arm!

text.Barret: Heard you punks were lookin' for me. Didn't wanna keep you waitin'.

text.Corneo Lackey: Wait! You!?

text.Hoodlum: Should've known you were one of 'em!
Whatever—enough of this bullshit! Hey, let 'em loose.

text.Corneo Lackey: Uh, sure!

text.Hoodlum: Hah! Y'all are in for a world of hurt now! Hack 'em to bis, y'hear me! Leave the faces, though. Shinra ain't gonna give us the bounty otherwise!

text.ACTION: During the battle.

CHOICE.Corneo Lackey: An eye for an eye, right!?

text.ACTION: After defeating the Tonberry.

text.Hoodlum: We give up, okay!? We won't say a word to no one about you bein' here. Really—honest!

text.Cloud: That's right. You'll tell everyone we were never here—that the rumors were bullshit. And if we hear about you, or any of your friends, coming round here ever again...

text.Tifa: You'll answer to my boot.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Madam M after finishing the quest.

CHOICE.Madam M: Been saying a lot less of Corneo's men lately. Your doing?
I know that look. You're up to no good, aren't you? (chuckles) Good luck.
Do stop by again if you desire additional treatment.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Andrea in the gym.

text.Jules: It's been hours now—don't you think you've done enough? Believe me, I ought to know.

text.Andrea: No... not yet...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jay.

CHOICE.Jay: Andi hasn't slowed down or stopped.
Man, I can hear his lats screaming out in pain!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ronnie.

CHOICE.Ronnie: I'm worried about Andi. He's gonna push himself too far.
But my god, when I look at that magnificent physique of his...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules.

CHOICE.Jules: Looking for Andi? You found him/ He's been at it half the day.
Not sure what's gotten into him.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Andrea.

text.Andrea: Cloud... How are you?

text.Cloud: I was hoping you knew a way we could get topside.

text.Andrea: Hmm... Sorry, but it's... not possible...
Well, well. What do we have here? I can see you're someone who likes to train, to be their very best.

text.Tifa: Me?

text.Andrea: Your physique: slender, yet toned. And that perfectly balanced symmetry. I can tell from a glance that you learned from the best there is. But your muscles look tight, which can only mean one thing—you're conflicted.

text.Jules: Excuse me. You're Tifa, right? While you're here, wanna give Andi a run for his money? Work up a sweat, release some endorphins. It's the answer to everything. I promise.

text.Andrea: I'm in... if you are.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Andrea again.

text.Andrea: All right then. The winner will be the one who does the most pull-ups.

text.STATUS: When the challenge against Andrea begins.

text.Andrea: It's just the two of us now.

text.ACTION: During Pull-Ups matches, dialogue from other characters will be the same as during the Squats minigame.
After Andrea wins.

text.Andrea: Thank you. I had quite a wonderful time.

text.ACTION: After Tifa by with a wide margin.

CHOICE.Tifa: Worked up a good sweat!
Would kill for a shower!
That's the way to do it!

text.ACTION: After Tifa wins by a narrow margin.

CHOICE.Tifa: No surprises there!
Gotta learn from this for next time!
You can do better than that! Much better!

text.ACTION: After beating Andrea.

text.Andrea: You truly are perfection, my dear.
... It seems you've bested me, Tifa.

text.Tifa: I can't believe I won.

text.Andrea: Your fiery passion pushed me to my limits and helped me to overcome my lingering stress and fatigue. I'll be taking the stage tonight in the best condition of my life. Thank you.

text.Tifa: No, thank you for... the same!

text.Andrea: To commemorate the evening. I would be honored if you joined me onstage for a perfomance someday. (laughs)

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Ronnie.

CHOICE.Ronnie: Looking to work up a sweat?
You here to test your muscular mettle against mine?
Today's another great day to feel the burn!
What're you looking at me for? Oh, you here to take me on, are you? Bring it on.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules before the Pro challenge is unlocked.
Upon talking to Jay.

CHOICE.Jay: You wanna go, do ya? All right then, bring it on!
Those who sweat together get swole together!
True athletes need to be able to perform in cool and hot conditions!

text.ACTION: Upon beginning the Amateur challenge.
After beating Jay.

CHOICE.Jay: You beat me fair and square. You really are a true champion!
You've gotta give me another chance!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jules with the Pro challenge unlocked.

CHOICE.Jules: Hm? Are you here for a workout?
Let's you and me work up a sweat.
I'll never say no to a friendly competition.

text.ACTION: Upon beginning the Pro challenge.
After losing to Jules.

text.Jules: You know where to find me for a rematch.

text.ACTION: After beating Jules.

CHOICE.Jules: Couldn't keep up with you. Even as a trainer, I still have a lot to learn.
I couldn't have asked for a better opponent.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Betty.

text.Betty: Everyone's so sad... Think, think...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Betty.

text.Betty: Oh, heya!

text.Tifa: Betty. I'm so glad to see you're okay.

text.Betty: You too! Uh, where's Marlene? Is she okay?

text.Barret: Don't worry. She's safe.

text.Betty: Really? I'm so glad! Hey, can you help me with something? I'm looking for music discs for the jukebox. I think some new music might cheer people up—make them happy!

text.Tifa: That's a wonderful idea.

text.Barret: Okay! If we find any music discs, we'll bring 'em straight to you. You just promise to crank up the volume, all right?

text.Betty: You know I will! Thanks!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Betty again.

CHOICE.Betty: Hope you guys find some really good ones.
I just want people to smile more.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting a song on the jukebox that is not one of the objectives.

text.Betty: Hmm, I don't think this song's doing it. People still seem kinda sad. I'm still seeing a lot of frowns.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Old Man near the jukebox.

text.Old Man: It's not right, me getting out...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Woman near the jukebox.
Upon talking to Man near the jukebox.

text.Man: Th-th-there's nothing left for me now.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Guest at the inn.

text.Guest: There's nothing quite like kicking back and letting the music flow through you. What's that? You wanna get in on my flow?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Souvenir Shop Owner.

text.Souvenir Shop Owner: With these babies, you can send intruders flying! I guarantee this is the only home protection you'll ever need!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Woman near in the alley outside the Honeybee Inn.

text.Woman: Hey, what's up man! You vibing with this jam too? You can have a copy if you want.

text.ACTION: Upon playing a song that is not part of the quest.

text.Betty: Hmm, I don't think this song's doing it. People still seem kinda sad. I'm still seeing a lot of frowns.

text.ACTION: Upon playing "Good Night, Until Tomorrow" on the jukebox.

text.Betty: Ooh, I like this one. It's really peaceful, don't you think?

text.Woman: Um... Is it okay if I stay and listen for a bit? This song is a favorite of mine.

text.Betty: Sure!

text.ACTION: Upon playing "Fight On!".

text.Betty: Wow, what a song! It makes me feel like I can do anything!

text.Man: Yeah... yeah! I can feel this song calling to my inner warrior. Yeah, I can take on the world! It's time I took action, made a stand!

text.Barret: Hell yeah, that's it! That's the fire we need right now! Be a force for change, brother!

text.ACTION: Upon playing "Stand Up".

text.Betty: I know this one! Marlene and I danced to it before.

text.Old Man: That's wrong! Wrong, wrong, wrong! This is how you get down with this jam. I oughta know—it was my favorite back in the day! Pay attention kiddo! It's all in the hips!

text.ACTION: laughs C'mon, little lady. Why don't you give it a whirl?
Upon talking to Betty after finding and playing one or two discs.

text.Betty: Tell me if you find more music discs!

text.ACTION: Upon playing all music discs.

text.Betty: Isn't this great!? Everyone's smiling again. Thanks so much for the help!

text.Tifa: Our pleasure. I think we needed it too.

text.Barret: Until our victory fanfare rings out through all of Midgar, our battle will rage on! Hey, I'm just kidding.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Betty after completing the quest.

CHOICE.Betty: Make sure to bring Marlene next time!
I'll be here if you wanna listen to more!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Doctor.

text.Doctor: What am I gonna do now... ?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Doctor.

text.Doctor: Hey, I know you. You're Aerith's bodyguard. I could really use her help. She always knew where to find the best herbs, and... You haven't seen her, have you? I used up all my meds treating people injured when the plate fell, you see. I could make more, but not without those herbs.
You mean you're willing to help me out? Oh, thank you! You'd be doing this town a huge favor. Here's a list of everything I'm looking for.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Doctor before finding all items. Lines related to specific herbs will not play if they have been found.

CHOICE.Doctor: Couple of my patients were talking about a behemoth in some underground lab or something. Can't say I've ever heard of a lab like that before though...
Apparently, Aerith was looking after flowers elsewhere—not just at her house.
My son claims he got a mortar from a moogle. If you can believe a crazy story like that.
I can whip up alternatives with the right ingredients.
I'd been stockpiling Shinra meds, but it was nowhere near enough.
Please, hurry. Time is of the essence.

text.ACTION: After finding all three.
Upon talking to the Doctor after finding all three.

text.Doctor: Oh! Did you manage to get everything I needed? Thank you. This oughta be more than enough. I can see why Aerith put her trust in you. Don't worry. I'll take it from here. You've done more than your fair share already. Here, take this. I'm betting it'll come in handy.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Doctor after finishing the quest.

text.Doctor: My medicine's gonna help a lot of people.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Johnny.

text.Johnny: What were you thinking!? Stupid, stupid, stupid! Crawl into a hole and die!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Johnny: Bro! Tifa! Damn, is it good to see you guys again.

text.Cloud: I told you to stop calling me that.

text.Johnny: Bro. I'm in serious need of your expertise. Lend me a hand!

Truth is, I'm, uh, trying to get outta town, for, uh, reasons. Yeah, reasons. But the thing is... (cries) I got mugged! She took it. Took it all, man! I tried to chase her down, I really did! But she was real fast-like. Man, what I am gonna do? This could be the end for ol' Johnny boy! I'm beggin' ya—help me out! Come on, bro!
Bro! Uh, hold on. Lemme think—wanna get this right. She was a cutie. Black hair. Pretty sure she was wearin' a hat. And... oh yeah! She was wearing these striped stockings too.

text.Barret: Which way'd she go?

text.Johnny: Uh, toward the church I think.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny again.

CHOICE.Johnny: Looked like she was hurt real bad, so I stopped to help.
And this is the thanks I get!
Bro! Do me a solid. Get my money back!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Kyrie.

text.Kyrie: What? It wasn't me. You've got the wrong girl! Never committed a crime in my life!
Kyrie? Who's that? Can't say I know her, but cool name.

text.Tifa: Someone mugged our friend and took every last gil he had. Sound familiar?

text.Kyrie: Oh, that? I thought I was in actual trouble. Don't scare me like that!

text.Barret: Now I remember you. You're that chick. The one who was spreadin' lies in Sector 5.

text.Kyrie: Oh yeah, I did do that. Good times, good times.
Hold on. I know you, blondie! You're that merc everyone's talking about! Maybe my luck's not so bad. Shinra's after me. You've gotta help me.

text.Cloud: Stole from them too, did you?

text.Kyrie: No! Well, yes, sorta—it's complicated. How was I supposed to know they were Shinra? And now those jerks won't leave me alone! Even though all I took was some ugly key. I mean, what's the big deal anyway?

text.Barret: Wait a minute—that was you!?

text.Kyrie: ... Oh greqt. So, everyone's talking about it? Is this the end? Am I a dead woman? Do I have to go on the run? Leave Midgar forever and never look back?

text.Tifa: Kyrie, please. Just give us the money you stole from our friend, would you? And the key while you're at it.

text.Kyrie: No way. You're gonna split the second I do. And then who'll protect me? I can't handle this on my own... (cries)

text.Cloud: We'll handle Shinra if you give us the key. Deal?

text.Kyrie: It's a deal! Right about now, those Shinra creeps should be hanging out at the colosseum. They're waiting for a special match to start, starring yours truly. It's the talk of the town.

text.Tifa: You're joking!

text.Kyrie: Oh, I won't be there. I'm not stupid.

text.Barret: It's a miracle you've managed to stay alive this long.

text.Kyrie: I'll take that as a compliment. Now run along and clean up my mess.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Kyrie again.

CHOICE.Kyrie: You'll get your key... once I know I'm safe.
Man, if I'd known he was Shinra... Well, lesson learned.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper.

text.Gatekeeper: Oh! Champ! Couldn't have picked a better time. This Kyrie chick totally flaked on her match, which means we're down a fighter. And we can't exactly pit the other guy against himself! What d'you say? Mind takin' her spot?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Special Match".

text.Beastmaster: The hell you doin' here!? Where's the girl, Kyrie!? That thievin' little pip-squeak!

text.Barret: Guessin' he's the guy she's runnin' from.

text.Cloud: Kyrie's not coming. You'll have to make do with us.

text.Beastmaster: Whatever. I can roll with it. After all, you and me, we got unfinished business!

text.Gatekeeper: In a shocking turn of events, our next bout is now a grudge match! Which of these two will claim victory in today's Angel Cup!? Fighters... begin!

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies.

text.Gatekeeper: Our reigning champion does it again! Not only does he retain his crown, but now he can add beast whisperer to his list of impressive achievements!

text.Barret: Hah! That wasn't too much trouble.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Gatekeeper.

text.Gatekeeper: Watching you guys fight gave me goose bumps. Hope your next match is even better than the last!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Kyrie.

text.Kyrie: So, how'd it go?

text.Cloud: Well enough. If they're smart, they won't send anyone else.

text.Kyrie: Really!? (sighs) That is so good to hear!

text.Barret: Learn your lesson, girl?

text.Kyrie: Totally! From now on, I only steal from the right people.

text.Barret: That ain't the lesson.

text.Kyrie: Talk about a weight off my shoulders. Oh, I completely lost track of time! I'd better get going.

text.Mireille: Hold it!

text.Kyrie: Grandma!? Why're you here?

text.Mireille: You, young lady, are gonna hear about this later. Thank you for keeping her out of trouble.

text.Tifa: She say "grandma"?

text.Mireille: What? Did I forget to mention it to you? Kyrie's my granddaughter—my flesh and blood. See? We even have the same eyes.
Kyrie, the key. You've kept them waiting long enough.

text.Kyrie: Yeah, yeah... What's it for, anyway? Why do you guys want it?

text.Mireille: And how's that any of your business, young lady? Learn to wipe your own ass before you start rooting around in other people's shit.

text.Kyrie: Ugh, Grandma! Cut it out. You're embarrassing me...

text.Mireille: Me embarrass you? Says the girl who steals from anyone. Even a thief needs principles, not to mention the courage of convictions to follow their conscience. Take it from me—the Guardian Angel of the Slums.

text.Tifa: Wait a minute—you're the Angel!?

text.Mireille: And you three are Avalanche. There's a fire in you. I can see it flickering in your eyes. That same fire's in me, too. The Guardian Angel of the Slums, Avalanche—they're just names. We are who we choose to be. But you have to decide who that is, and commit. Make the most of your time while you still have it. Right?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Damon.

text.Damon: It's you, my good merc! What brilliant timing you have! Oh, hello there—it is a pleasure to meet you both. I'm a journalist for the Daily Buzz.

text.Barret: The Daily Buzz? You mean that trash filled with Shinra fluff pieces?

text.Damon: Well, yes, that's fair—but we do get a lot of inside information because of our close ties with the company. (laughs) Curious? Here's the scoop. A certain division of Shinra—that shall remain nameless—was planning to seize Corneo's assets. But before they could, the key to his secret vault within which his misbegotten gains were securely tucked away... was stolen! And my sources tell me that the thief... is the undercity's beloved hero: the Angel of the Slums! The unidentified bandit who's been targeting anyone with ties to Shinra or Corneo! Yes, that Angel of the Slums has struck again! Well? Do I have your undivided attention now?

text.Barret: Kinda, but hurry it up. We don't have time for a three-act play.

text.Damon: Then I'll make this quick. So! My good merc. You do remember where the Angel's hideout is, right?

text.Cloud: Do you remember the death threat she left there?

text.Damon: Oh, that. I've decided to seek the silver lining in this case. If the Angel of the Slums deigns to taken an interest in a humble reporter, then that itself would be a story!

If you recover the stolen key, feel free to help yourself to the contents of Corneo's vault. All I want is knowledge—the identity of the Angel. So if you happen to learn anything of value, I'd be tremendously grateful to you if you passed it along.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to him again.

CHOICE.Damon: If you learn anything at all, I demand that you tell me!
I'm dying to find out who the Angel of the Slums really is.
It is a desire that transcends the professional! Could it be... love?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Mireille after finishing "Tomboy Bandit".

CHOICE.Mireille: I hear Corneo's got secret rooms hidden in the sewers. More than even he knows, if the rumors are true.
That reminds me—someone spotted a tacky-looking door over by the collapsed expressway.
If you're curious, there's another door that's got Corneo's emblem and everything on it, right by the Angel's hideout.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever to lower the water in the Sewer System.
Upon obtaining all three tiaras.

text.Barret: Okay then. Y'all think we got everything? Question is: now what? It's not gonna be easy selling this stuff.

text.Tifa: Oh, I know. What about Marle? We could ask her to help. I'm sure she'd be happy to.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle.

text.Marle: Oh, what brings you here?

text.Tifa: They're to be used to help the people of Sector 7 rebuild.

text.Marle: The Angel of the Slums? You didn't meet her, did you? Tell me, what was she like?

text.Cloud: Never met her. Just her go-between.

text.Marle: A shame. Bless her sweet soul... I don't know what to say... I'll make sure the funds are put to good use. Here, why don't you take this? Something tells me you can use it more than me.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Wymer.

text.Wymer: This is bad.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer.

text.Wymer: Oh, hey Barret.

text.Barret: Hey, how's it going?

text.Wymer: Could be better. I've got a good number of watchmen out looking for survivors. But as much as I'd love to join them, I've got another mess on my hands at the moment. Remember those rumors about a lab? They're true. There is one—hidden underground somewhere, and it's full of monsters. So, Cloud... think you can lend us a hand with it? It's only a matter of time before these monsters come calling. I know it's a dangerous job but—

text.Cloud: But no one else can do it.

text.Wymer: Well, yeah. So help us out.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer again.

text.Wymer: I've been hearing reports of howling from deep underground.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Neighborhood Watch Member in the S7-6 Service Tunnel.

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (Male 4): We've been getting tremors ever since last night. Roads are collapsing, and sinkholes are opening up all over.

text.ACTION: On approach to the Type-0 Behemoth.

CHOICE.SYSTEM: You hear growling closer than before.
You hear growling from behind the door.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the Type-0 Behemoth.

text.Barret: Yeah! That's how it's done.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer.

text.Wymer: You took care of those monsters? Oh, thank you! That's one less big problem to worry about. We owe you.

text.Barret: I know it's tough right now, but stay strong, y'hear?

text.Wymer: You too, buddy. But hey, we're grounders. We don't break easy. I know it's not much, but take this, with my thanks.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny after finishing "Tomboy Bandit".

text.Johnny: My wallet! My precious wallet! You really did it, bro! I knew I could count on you.

text.Cloud: For the last time, don't call me that.

text.Johnny: Thank you. Now I can get outta town.

text.Tifa: You're leaving?

text.Johnny: Hush, Tifa. Don't try to stop me. I'm a wanted man in these parts. If I stayed I'd be a danger to you too.

text.Tifa: Uh, okay...

text.Johnny: But if you begged me to stay, I could reconsider throwing everything away—

text.Tifa: Good luck out there, Johnny.

text.Johnny: Oh, er... okay.

text.Tifa: You'll be fine wherever. You're Johnny—don't forget!

text.Johnny: Uh, yeah... hell yeah, I am! I'm your Johnny, Tifa. And nothing's gonna bring me down! Bro, Tifa, keep on shinin'. Johnny out!

text.Barret: You *are* gonna hold up your end of the bargain, right?

text.Leslie: Long as you hold up yours—yeah.

text.Barret: I don't trust you, and I don't like you. So if you so much as breathe in a suspicious way... I'll turn that face of yours into a honeycomb.

text.Leslie: I'd save your bullets for the monsters if I were you. Some are a lot tougher than you'd think. Hate to say it, but I can barely take 'em on my own. You, on the other, shouldn't have any trouble, am I right?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Leslie.

text.Leslie: Head for the trunk line—it marks the border with Sector 7. You three lead the way. I'll follow a short distance behind.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the hallway at the Settling Basin Corridor.

text.Barret: The mark of Avalanche. Right. Jessie and Biggs stashed a skeleton key down here.

text.Tifa: I never got the chance to thank them for what they did.
Let's just keep moving, okay?

text.Leslie: Hate to interrupt, but the trunk line's just through that door. The one over there.

text.Barret: Yeah, we heard you.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Sector 7-6 Main Aqueduct.

text.Barret: Made it. 'Bout time.

text.Leslie: This way. There should be a door with Corneo's mark on it around here somewhere.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Leslie.

text.Tifa: Hey... wasn't this locked before?

text.Leslie: Your time to shine. Clear the path ahead, would you?

text.Barret: Yeah, yeah...

text.Tifa: Can I ask you something? Why did you help us out before? You could've lost everything.

text.Leslie: Andrea. He told me to.

text.Tifa: That really it?

text.Leslie: And I couldn't bring myself to let it happen again...

text.Tifa: Huh?

text.Leslie: It doesn't matter. Let's go.

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to the Sector 6 Restricted Area.

text.Leslie: Wait. We're getting close to Corneo's hideout. From here on, I'll take the lead.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Leslie.

text.Barret: This it?

text.Leslie: Yeah.

text.Cloud: So how we supposed to get topside?

text.Leslie: Through here.

text.Cloud: Then you're telling me we're not done?

text.Leslie: Sorry guys, but it's not that simple—
No... Wait! We gotta catch him!

text.Tifa: Huh?

text.Leslie: He took the key to the door! Without it, we're screwed!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Barret.

text.Barret: Bastard went that way!

text.Leslie: Shit! Don't lose him!

text.ACTION: Upon encountering Sahagins.

text.Leslie: Deal with 'em!

text.ACTION: After defeating them.

text.Barret: Where in the hell did that thing run off to?

text.Leslie: Up. As if this wasn't enough fun already.

text.ACTION: After climbing the ladder.

text.Leslie: The area up ahead—it's that thing's den. Keep your eyes peeled. You never know when its friends're gonna pop up, or where.

text.ACTION: After chasing it further.

text.Barret: We ain't got time to play hide-and-seek, ya little shit!

text.STATUS: When the Mischievous Shoat reaches a dead end.

text.Barret: Gotcha now! So, gonna make us work for it, are ya! I'm not gonna hurt ya, little fella. So just stay st—

text.ACTION: After chasing the Mischievous Shoat to the aqueduct.

text.Tifa: I'm on it.

text.Barret: Your days are numbered, ratboy!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Mischievous Shoat.

text.Tifa: He's so slippery!

text.Leslie: Give it back!

text.ACTION: After defeating the Mischievous Shoat.

text.Leslie: Give it back.

text.Tifa: That's...

text.Leslie: Give it back.

text.Barret: That's not a key.

text.Leslie: Sorry.

text.Barret: That's not your pendant either. Were they family?

text.Leslie: No...

text.Leslie'S Fiancée (Flashback): It was all just a dream, wasn't it... But one day... No. Time to wake up. And forget.

text.Leslie: Six months ago... On that day Corneo picked her as a bride. And on the next she vanished without a trace. But before she did, she gave it back. Salt on the wound. Thing cost me a small fortune.

text.Tifa: Why did you wanna come down here?

text.Leslie: Revenge. I know I need to let go, but I can't. I need closure, 'cause without it... I'll never be able to move on.

text.Cloud: It's fine. As long as you get us topside, we're still in.

text.Leslie: Thanks. And don't worry, I got you.

text.Barret: You all right.

text.Leslie: I know a shortcut. Follow me.

text.ACTION: While following Leslie.

text.Barret: That twisted piece of shit. I'm gonna enjoy beatin' him to a pulp.

text.Leslie: Corneo's mine, and mine alone.

text.Barret: Huh?

text.Leslie: Please.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Leslie.

text.Leslie: Wait outside.

text.Barret: Think the kid's gonna be okay goin' it alone?

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to follow Leslie.

text.Leslie: It's Leslie! Got some urgent info for hte don!

text.Don Corneo: Oho? Come alone?

text.Leslie: 'Course.

text.Don Corneo: Really? Without my little Avalanche kittens? I thought I told you to round them up and bring them to me.

text.Leslie: Actuallly... it's them I came to talk about.

text.Don Corneo: Leslie. I don't think I need to remind you why I'm down here. Spilling the beans to those three escape artists was a serious mistake. And now I'm on Shinra's shitlist! The plate stunt was meant to be an unprecedented tragedy claiming countless innocent lives... But those naughty little kittens organized an evacuation and screwed up the plan.

I'll let you in on a secret. Shinra's going to abandon Midgar... and build something close to paradise. I was invited to be a part of it—don of a new and improved Wall Market. I'll be lucky to live another week. Leslie... I was gonna let you run your own place—give you a piece of the action. What a shame.
Pop quiz time, kiddo! Villains like us only divulge our evil plans... in a certain situation. But what is that situation, hm?

text.Leslie: When you think... you've already won.

text.Don Corneo: Goodbye.
Oho! It's you!

text.Barret: You were talking 'bout the Sector 7 plan. Keep talking, asshole.

text.Don Corneo: Ahh! Over there! Over there, look!

text.Barret: Don't try to bullshit us!

text.Don Corneo: But that's the thing! It's not technically bullshit when it's true.
Good Abzu! Feel free to play with your food! Don out...

text.Barret: Bastard...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Leslie.

text.Leslie: Where's Corneo?

text.Barret: Sorry. Bastard got away.

text.Leslie: It's fine. I'll track him down eventually. Not like I have anything better to do.

text.Tifa: You know, I wouldn't be so sure about that. She could still be out there.

text.Barret: Can never be sure how much someone means to ya till they're gone. Don't give up on her yet.

text.Leslie: Was it a message? What was she trying to tell me?

text.Tifa: "We'll meet again."

text.Leslie: Huh?

text.Tifa: It's a symbol of "reunion."

text.Leslie: Then I guess I've got no choice but to find her first. Thanks.

text.Barret: Hold up. I think ya might be forgetting something.

text.Leslie: I haven't. Found it. Let's get outta here. And then I'll give you what you need.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the ladder.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", leave the Sewer System.

text.Barret: Ahh! Taste that sweet Midgar smog!

text.Leslie: This way.

Grappling guns. You can practically fly with the souped-up motors on these babies. Sector 7 is on the other side of that wall. The guns will get you over and past it, along with any number of other obstacles. But—they're one-way tickets. So once you start up, there's no coming back. You should probably get your affairs in order. Just in case.

text.Tifa: Thank you.

text.Barret: Didn't tell you before, but we're looking for someone too.

text.Leslie: That right? Hope you find 'em.

text.Barret: Let's go.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the wall.

text.Barret: Ready to do this? Once we start up that wall, we won't be comin' back here any time soon.

CHOICE.Barret: We won't be comin' back here anytime soon. Best handle any unfinished business now, okay?
Hope you're ready now. No coming back, remember? Last chance to change your mind.
So... when this is over, you gonna go on being a merc?
Reckon it suits you.

CHOICE.Tifa: Yeah, it does.

CHOICE.Barret: Used to think you were a little shit with a big attitude and a bigger inferiority complex. Quite possibly the worst person I have ever met. But that was before I figured you out. All this? It ain't you.

CHOICE.Tifa: Deep down, you're a pretty nice guy. Didn't see it when we were kids, but...

CHOICE.Cloud: Don't know about any of that, but kindness is no use on the battlefield. If anything, it's a liability.

CHOICE.Barret: Hey, no one's asking you to treat Shinra with kid gloves.

CHOICE.Tifa: Aerith's up there waiting for us.

CHOICE.Barret: Then we better get a move on, huh?

text.LOCATION: Chapter 15: The Day Midgar Stood Still

text.Barret: Two goals! Goal one! Kick some Shinra ass and save the planet! Goal two! Save the girl—while kicking more Shinra ass—and get out!

text.ACTION: While following Barret.

text.Barret: Gotta be careful. No tellin' what's gonna collapse or when.
See what I mean?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the Neighborhood Watch Member.

text.Neighborhood Watch Member (Male 3): Hey, you guys might wanna turn around.

text.Tifa: A friend of ours needs help.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to him again.

text.STATUS: When the camera pans up to a skyscraper by the plate.

text.Tifa: So that's where we have to climb?

text.Barret: If it comes apart while we're up there... (imitates falling and splatting)

text.Cloud: We've made it through worse, you know.

text.Barret: Yeah, no kidding. It's a miracle we haven't been killed a dozen times over by now.

text.ACTION: After crawling through the fallen metal pillar.

text.Barret: It's a dead end.

text.Tifa: Wonder if this rope belongs to search and rescue.

text.Barret: Think we might be able to climb up here.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the gap across.

text.Tifa: Time for the grappling guns. Try to aim for that part of the rope that's hanging there.

text.Barret: Don't screw up and fall. By the way, how well you do with this grappling gun will tell us a whole lot about you.

text.Tifa: Just remember, we can't come back down. Are you ready?

text.Barret: I think I see a rope hanging off the top there.

text.ACTION: After using the grappling gun.

text.Barret: Too easy. This keeps up, I'm gonna get bored.
We can take 'em.

text.Cloud: We need to stay on mission.

text.Barret: I know. Saving Aerith is our top priority.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first group of 3-C SOLDIER Operators.
After defeating them.
Upon picking up the radio.

text.Cloud: This is Hunter 2-2. Just had to put down a few monsters. Over.

text.Radio: Roger. Friggin' Avalanche making us put in OT... Probably cowering in the dark somewhere. If you find the shitheads, make 'em suffer. 2-3 out.

text.Barret: Listen up! We ain't runnin' and we ain't hidin'! Y'all don't know the meaning of sufferin'! But you will!

text.ACTION: After the camera pans over to the Valkyrie .

text.Barret: Not this guy again!

text.Tifa: Come on! We need to get inside!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the rope.

text.Barret: Why don't we use our grappling guns to get up there? Jump over all this shit.

text.ACTION: After using the grappling gun.

text.Barret: I guess everybody and their mothers knows we're here now.

text.ACTION: After defeating the first wave of enemies.
After defeating the second wave of enemies.
After defeating all enemies.

text.Tifa: They'll be coming for us now.

text.Barret: Well, to hell with being subtle!

text.Tifa: What do you think? Can we climb it?

text.Barret: Sure—with a grappling gun.

text.Tifa: I just hope that this time it holds.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the rope in the crumbling building.

text.Barret: I think I see a rope hanging off the top there.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the ladder up the Industrial Tank.

text.Barret: Dammit. If any of this crumbles, we're all going down.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the top of the Industrial Tank.

text.Tifa: No...

text.Barret: Don't you *ever* forget this view.

text.ACTION: Upon crawling through the rubble on the Collapsed Highway.

text.Barret: Just thinkin' about bustin' into Shinra HQ's got me fired up!
No need, son. I've got more than enough to keep me goin' for days.

text.ACTION: Upon walking across the thin pillar.

text.Barret: Don't look down. You can do this. Don't look down. Just keep going. Don't look down. Don't look down!
That son of a bitch is back!? I thought we lost him!
Dammit! Looks like there's only one way to go.

text.Cloud: We were headed that way anyway.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the Blast-Ray.

text.Barret: You want some of this? Then come get it!

text.LOCATION: To the Top of the Plate

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the top of the Industrial Tank Utility Access.

text.Tifa: Cloud...

text.Barret: I guess... we'll build another bar.

text.Tifa: Yeah. We will.
You'll help too, won't you?

text.ACTION: Upon using the grappling gun to encounter the Valkyrie.
While running from it.

text.Barret: Run, dammit, run! Move your ass!
Shit! Look out!

text.ACTION: Upon engaging it in battle.

text.Barret: Was gettin' tired of playing tag anyway!

text.ACTION: After the Valkyrie falls to 80% HP.

text.Tifa: Cloud!

text.Barret: That was close!

text.Cloud: It's not done with us yet.

text.Barret: Yeah, I hear ya. Let's blow the bitch outta the sky!

text.ACTION: After the Valkyrie falls to 50% HP.

text.Barret: What the hell!?

text.STATUS: When the Valkyrie's Mark 99 Anti-fiend Artillery attack connects.

text.Barret: Oh you gotta be shittin' me.

text.Cloud: Don't get caught in the open.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the Valkyrie.

text.Barret: We win again. Not that there was ever any doubt! (chuckles)
Now what?

text.Tifa: Barret!

text.Barret: There's such a thing as too much excitement.

text.Tifa: Yeah. And there's still more to come.

text.Barret: Guess so.

text.LOCATION: Chapter 16: The Belly of the Beast

text.Barret: Rolled out the welcome wagon.

text.Tifa: Gotta say, I can't help but wonder if this is a lost cause.

text.Barret: Well, ya know, some lose causes are worth fighting for.
So. I got an idea. Frontal assault, guns blazing. Make for a good story.

text.Cloud: Why'd we bring you along again?
Rear entrance. We'll get inside via the parking garage.

text.ACTION: While following Barret and Tifa.

text.Tifa: Security's looking pretty tight.

text.Barret: Ha! So they know what they're up against.

text.Cloud: Somehow I don't think it's all for us. Could be for Avalanche. Or maybe even Wutai.

text.Barret: Can't be for Wutai. What about the cease-fire?

text.Cloud: That only put the war on pause.

text.Barret: Either way, I'm gonna put the fear of Avalanche in 'em! Their days of sittin' smug in this glass tower are over!

text.Cloud: We're here to rescue Aerith, remember? We don't need much more attention than what we're gonna get. We need to be smart.

text.Barret: Yeah, I hear ya! But my soul's screaming for payback, you know? I'm a tickin' time bomb, and sooner or later, I'mma have to blow up!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bridge.

text.Tifa: That one there—that's a Shinra truck, isn't it?

text.Barret: So far, so good. (screams)

text.ACTION: Upon running further in.

text.Barret: Ha! Bring it on!

text.Cloud: The idea was to not get noticed.

text.Barret: Stealth ain't my style.

text.Cloud: You never planned to be stealthy in the first place.

text.Barret: Don't remember. Maybe, maybe not.

text.ACTION: After defeating the first wave of enemies.

text.Barret: It's feelin' like a proper party now!
