text.Cloud: Let's keep moving. Should be a service entrance in the back.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Gate-01.

text.Security Officer (2): Can't get in contact with HQ.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the gate.
Upon defeating the Elite Security Officers at the gate.
Upon engaging the enemies in the warehouse.
After defeating the first group in the warehouse.
Upon engaging the final group of enemies.
Upon defeating all enemies.

text.Barret: That's that.

text.Tifa: Sure hope no one else knows we're here.

text.Cloud: Come on. We need to move.

text.Barret: Nobody's home.

text.Tifa: Do you have any idea where they might be holding Aerith?

text.Cloud: I'm thinking a research facility. That'd make the most sense.

text.Barret: And where is that?

text.Cloud: Upper floors... maybe near the top... That's where you are.

text.Barret: Maybe!?

text.Tifa: Maybe we can use the console at the reception desk to find out.

text.ACTION: After the scene ends.

text.Tifa: This building's incredible.

text.Barret: Hah! A shining monument to corporate greed. One of these days I'm gonna tear it down and burn the rubble.
Yeah, yeah.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa by the reception desk.

text.Tifa: I don't know about you, but I don't think we should try touching it.

text.Barret: Shit. Making life hard.

text.ACTION: Upon using the lobby stairs.

text.Barret: So, how do we get upstairs?

text.Cloud: Either the elevator or the emergency stairwell.

text.Barret: Isn't the lab we're looking for on one of the top floors? I vote we take the elevator.
No getting upstairs without a keycard, huh?

text.Tifa: Think we're gonna need a few before this is over.

text.Cloud: Pretty sure I saw one lying around.

text.Barret: The reception desk!

text.Cloud: Yeah, but how to get in?

text.Tifa: Go up and over, maybe?
Look. Pretty sure we could reach it if we hop across those lights.

text.Barret: I don't know...

text.Tifa: I think I'll give it a shot. As the lightest one here, I figure I've got the best chance. You two can sit back and watch.

text.ACTION: After the scene ends.

text.Tifa: Okay, guys. Wish me luck.

text.Barret: You be careful.

text.Tifa: Aren't I always?

text.ACTION: After falling from the lamp.

text.Barret: Oh shit! Tifa!

text.Tifa: I thought I was dead for sure!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the first monkey bars on the main path.

text.Tifa: Hand over hand, huh? That's fine, bring it on.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the third pillar.

text.Tifa: This isn't so bad. Pretty close now. Just need to make it over there.

text.ACTION: Upon using the ladder on the fourth pillar.

text.Tifa: Almost there. Just need to get across those platforms.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the reception desk.

text.Barret: That's some fine work.

text.Tifa: Ah! I might be able to disable security from here.
Huh?

text.Barret: Ha! Hot damn, girl.

text.Tifa: But I didn't do anything...

text.Barret: Shit, I'll take it. So you can use that to look up what floor the research facility's on?

text.Tifa: I think so. Gimme a sec.
Bingo. Professor Hojo's lab. 65th floor, looks like.
Huh. Guess we can only get to the 59th floor via the elevators or stairs. To access any level above that. we need to check in at the Skyview Hall reception.

text.Barret: Right.

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator.

text.Barret: So what can we expect further up?

text.Cloud: More security and restrictions. It's not gonna get any easier.

text.Barret: Huh?

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator again.

text.Barret: Wasn't expectin' that.

text.Tifa: Think anyone knows we're here?
Wonder if it'll stop again.

text.Barret: People oughta try using the damn stairs sometime!

text.Cloud: If it happens again, we'll deal with it like before. We got this.

text.Barret: Well that didn't take long, did it?

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator again.

text.Barret: Straight on up to the top now. C'mon.

text.Tifa: We just keep getting waylaid, don't we?

text.Cloud: If you wanna take the stairs...

text.Barret: Now that you mention it... No.

text.Tifa: Right. Normal people work here too.

text.Barret: She probably called for help.
Who's it gonna be next?

text.Shinra Employee (lift): Yeah... Yeah, we're safe here. What about you, Mom? You okay? Good. That's a relief... ... What? Oh, they gotta be kidding!
... No, we haven't heard anything new yet. But they told us that Avalanche could attack again at any time. Just get somewhere safe, okay? Yeah. About that...

text.Tifa: A whole lotta mormal people with families and friends work for Shinra. People just trying to support their loved ones as best they can. I know it's not exactly a revelation, but... It's easy to forget.

text.Barret: A good man who serves a great evil is not without sin. He must recognize and accept his complicity. He must open his eyes to the truth—that his corporate masters are profiting from the planet's pain. Only then can he redeem himself. I know you know this.

text.Tifa: I do.

text.Cloud: Tifa. We need to focus on saving Aerith.

text.Tifa: I know. I will.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the stairwell.

text.Barret: You have got to be shittin' me.

text.Cloud: Nope. We're a lot less likely to get caught this way.

text.Barret: But a lot more likely to die of boredom.

text.Tifa: Nothing to it.

text.Barret: Well, at least it ain't a race. Small blessing.

text.ACTION: Upon using the stairs from 4F.

text.Tifa: Wonder what it's like up there.

text.Cloud: More security and restrictions. It's not gonna get any easier.

text.Barret: We're gonna be exhausted by the time we finally get to the top.

text.Cloud: Long as you pace yourself, you'll be fine.

text.Barret: Maybe we should take a quick break.

text.Tifa: C'mon, Barret.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 10F.

text.Barret: You can stop if you want. Can even say it's for me.

text.Cloud: Just say you can't hack it.

text.Barret: I'll hack you, jackass!

text.Tifa: That's enough from both of you. Stupid arguments aren't going to get us there faster.
Not now. Save it for the top!

text.ACTION: Upon passing 17F.

text.Barret: Guess these labs... and shit... are all the way at the very top?
That's... good to know...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 20F.

text.Tifa: Cloud! Keep an eye on Barret!
What was that? I don't think I heard you. Speak up!

text.Cloud: I'll keep an eye on Barret!

text.Barret: Thanks for the assist.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 24F.

text.Barret: I said... wait up!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 29F.

text.Tifa: Hey, guys! Where are you!?

text.Barret: Hey! Just a few floors behind you!

text.Tifa: Oh? You're sounding better!

text.Barret: Think I've got, like, a stairclimber's high!

text.Tifa: Glad to hear it!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 30F.
Upon reaching Tifa near 34F.

text.Tifa: I was. But I'm feeling okay now.

text.Barret: Hahhh... Hahhh... Hahhh... Then what're we waitin' for!? Let's roll!

text.Tifa: You really are doing better!

text.Barret: Hahhh... We... we gotta keep movin' (laughs)... to keep movin'! Hahhh...

text.Tifa: Hard to argue with that. Let's go.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 40F.
Upon passing 41F.

text.Barret: But tell me, these stairs... are these stairs ever gonna end!?

text.Tifa: I dunno! Ask the stairs!

text.Cloud: I don't think the stairs are talking.

text.Barret: Well, duh. I mean... duh.

text.Tifa: That's enough from both of you.

text.ACTION: Upon passing 47F.

text.Barret: Worst route ever. Gimme a suicidal last stand. At least— At least—at least that'd have an end!

text.Tifa: Yes, let's.

text.Barret: Why?

text.Tifa: Because wishing for trouble might bring it.

text.Cloud: Yup. And you're in no state to fight anyway.

text.Barret: So... what *should* I do?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 50F.
Upon reaching 55F.

text.Barret: This sucks! I wanna go back!

text.Tifa: You wanna go down all those stairs you just climbed?

text.ACTION: Upon passing 57F.

text.Barret: Another day, another struggle... Climbing stairs is so much trouble.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching 59F.

text.Barret: Cloud, slow down!

text.Tifa: ... The end.

text.Barret: Made it.

text.Cloud: The real challenge starts now. Okay. Let's go.

text.ACTION: After using the elevator or stairwell to reach floor 59.

text.Researcher (1): Seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred percent, one hundred ten... Mako supersaturation confirmed.

text.Researcher (2): Engaging materia cooling to reduce temperature.

text.Subordinate: Madam Director. You have a meeting shortly.

text.Scarlet: Stop. Your timing is impeccably atrocious.

text.Researcher (1): Mako density and materia integrity are both holding steady.

text.Researcher (2): Registering mass increase in core materia!

text.Scarlet: Now... Show me something truly exquisite!
We're leaving.

text.Researcher (2): Materia growth accelerating—outpacing models! Registering crystallization within the reserve tanks!

text.Researcher (1): The reaction is out of control! We have to stop it quickly—

text.Scarlet: Clean up the mess, would you?

text.Subordinate: Ma'am.

text.Barret: So this is the Skyview Hall, huh? Bet this place cost a fortune and then some.

text.ACTION: Upon passing the Skyview Lounge window.

text.Barret: Hey! Check it out.

text.Tifa: Come take a look, Cloud.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Barret.

text.Barret: Damn fools.

text.Tifa: Hm?

text.Barret: Ones who come here at night to "take in the view." So pretty and marvelous and beautiful! But every little light burning bright runs off her blood. And bit by bit they bleed her, never stoppin' to think how it'll end for them.

text.Tifa: Yeah.

text.Barret: Terrible, but beautiful all the same.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the elevator.
Upon selecting "No", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Yes".
Upon interacting with the reception desk.

text.Hologram Receptionist: You must be here for our grand tour. Visitors have access to floors 60, 61, 62, as well as floor 63. You will proceed in that order. By the exit to each floor, you will find a device that will allow you to update the keycard in your possession... thereby allowing you to access the next floor. And now begins your grand tour. Please enjoy the Shinra experience!

text.Barret: Why's this whole thing gotta be such a big pain in the ass?

text.Tifa: I don't know about you, but this is kinda weird.

text.Cloud: You think everything's going too well?

text.Tifa: Yeah, I do. Think this is a trap?

text.Barret: Ha! If it is, then bring it on. Let's get this party started!

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to the Elevator Hall with the keycard.

text.Barret: Man, why we gotta get all these damn keycards just to get anywhere?

text.Cloud: This is Shinra HQ. The hell did you expect?

text.Barret: Says the former company man himself. Guess you'd know about all the rules, regulations, and red tape—it's like coming home, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon taking the escalator to floor 60.

text.Reeve: Yes. Every reactor, every pillar. Like I said... a full inspection. There's no telling what kind of damage there might be. If you see anything—anything out of the ordinary, I want to know.

text.Administrative Assistant: I've brought the damage assessment for Sector 7 you requested. Sir... perhaps you should try and get some sleep.

text.Reeve: No, not yet. I need to finish preparing my draft of the reconstruction plan before tonight's board meeting. Whatever reasons they might've had, destroying an entire sector is... ... It's beyond the pale.

text.Administrative Assistant: Director... I would strongly advise you not to say such things outside this room.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Memorial Museum.

text.Guide: Welcome to the Shinra Building, our humble home!

text.Barret: Oh, hell no.

text.Guide: Here in the Memorial Museum... you can learn all about our president... as well as the various divisions that make up the company... and of course, the city of Midgar and the miracle of mako energy. Whatever takes your fancy, you're sure to learn something new!

text.Barret: Yeah, yeah. Shut up.

text.ACTION: Upon walking further in.

text.Tifa: I think I just threw up a little.

text.Barret: Man thinks very highly of himself.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the hallway to the next room.

text.Guide: Hey, everybody! How's the grand tour? I hope you're all enjoying yourselves! Wasn't it *fun* to learn about Shinra and our esteemed president? And to get a peek at the president's mementos—that was super cool!

Now, moving along! The next exhibit will teach you about the important work we do here... by giving you a closer look at each of our divisions! I hope you're ready to be amazed, because you simply won't believe all the exciting adventures we have here!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the next room.

text.Tifa: These all look so familiar.

text.Barret: 'Cause we've destroyed a bunch of 'em already.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Scarlet hologram.

text.Guide: The Advanced Weaponry exhibit is currently undergoing maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Palmer hologram.

text.Palmer: What, what? Read this? This paper right here? Give me a moment... "Welcome to the Shinra Building. The Space and Aeronautics Division has taken rocket systems developed for military applications and adapted them to a different purpose: the search for new precious resources in the infinite reaches of space." That being said... since we have plenty of mako at the present, those plans are currently on hold. It's a... bit of a shame, really.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Hojo hologram.

text.Hojo: Uh, welcome to Shinra headquarters. My duties as director of Research and Development are, in all likelihood, far beyond your ability to comprehend. So, there will be no presentation, as it would be a waste of my time and yours. But rest assured, we are making great strides. Albeit not at this particular moment, because I'm filming this rubbish instead. I believe I've wasted enough of my precious time as it is. Science waits for no one, after all. So—good day.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Heidegger hologram.

text.Guide: The Public Security exhibit is currently undergoing maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Reeve hologram.

text.Reeve: Welcome to the Shinra Building. Our mission here at Urban Planning is to supply the residents of Midgar with energy created from mako. We also take pride in maintaining public infrastructure—the pillars and railways that run all throughout the city. Currently, we are working to construct an intra-plate expressway. When this project has been completed, it will provide much easier access to numerous locations all across Midgar. We appreciate your patience and understanding in the meantime.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the following hallway.

text.Guide: Impressive, wasn't it? I hope you enjoyed learning about our divisions... and the wonderful ideas and solutions that are produced to benefit us all! Here at Shinra, we strive to ensure the safety of all residents around the clock!
Now, moving along! The next exhibit will teach you all about the miracle of mako energy and our reactors... as well as the city of Midgar itself! So come on!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the next room.

text.Guide: This is Midgar—our home—recreated in 1/10000 scale. As you can see here... the eight mako reactors form a ring around the center of our city... and keep Midgar running day and night. The mako which flows beneath our feet is a truly limitless resource. At Shinra, we have developed technologies to extract it... and transform it into the fuel and electricity that powers everything we do. Thanks to the miracle of mako energy, our lives are richer and better than ever before. Mako keeps our lights on at night, and made Midgar into the city that never sleeps. A triumph of technology and testament to man's potential.

text.Barret: Nothin' but a buncha lies!

text.Cloud: Except that mako *has* made people's lives better.

text.Barret: It's made people blind. Blind to the cold hard truth. Even I used to buy into their bullshit. Rememberin' that... makes me even madder.

text.ACTION: Upon using the keycard to leave the room.

text.Guide: Congratulations! You can call yourself a proud Shinra scholar! Now, moving along! Next you'll learn about our progress in advanced science and technology. Please proceed to the 61st floor, the Visual Entertainment Hall.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the following hallway.

text.Guide: Welcome to the Visual Entertainment Hall, where we showcase Shinra's cutting-edge technology... through an immersive visual and audio experience. Please relax and enjoy the show!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching floor 61.
Upon attempting to use the keycard to leave.

text.Guide: Please stay, and enjoy the show!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Cosmos Theater.

text.Barret: This place is empty.
The hell—!?

text.Guide: In the distant past, our planet was home to a people we call the Ancients. Many millennia before we discovered mako, these precursors were already pioneering its use. Somehow they learned of the great reservoir of energy pulsing beneath their feet. And once they had... the Ancients developed the means to harness this bountiful energy and bend it to their will. The fruits of their labors have survived to this very day in the form of certain kinds of materia. Their scripture, too, has endured: "We who are born of the planet, with her we speak. Her flesh we shape." "Unto her promised land shall we one day return. By her loving grace and providence may we take our place in paradise."

Alas, the Ancients themselves are long gone. Two thousand years ago, a meteor brought an end to their civilization. But before their fiery end, did the Ancients find their promised land? Even now, we have only to wonder. Times have changed—and the Shinra Electric Power Company is committed to changing and evolving with them. Like the Ancients, we have harnessed the power of mako.

Are they out there, watching us? Waiting for us to join them in some blessed corner of the world—a green and verdant land, where boundless mako energy will provide for our every need? Shinra is working for you, to fulfill the hope of the Ancients and lead us to that promised land. We shall not rest until our dream is realized.

text.Barret: That it?

text.Palmer: Oh dear, oh dear... A man of my refined tastes running out of butter! Shorn of its proper accompaniment, this tea... might as well be boiled pond water!
No, it couldn't possibly have been...

text.Barret: Crazy-ass thing made me wanna puke. And not just 'cause of the presentation, but the content too. Oughta come with a warning! That ain't for kids!

text.Tifa: That huge meteor... What was that about?

text.Barret: Like I said—nothing you should show a kid.

text.ACTION: Upon using the keycard to leave the Cosmos Theater.

text.Guide: Congratulations! You can call yourself a proud Shinra expert! Your mission is to go out and tell everyone about the wonders of Shinra! Next, you'll be visiting the repository for Shinra's expertise and know-how. Please make your way to the 62nd floor, the Corporate Ar—

text.Barret: What the—!?

text.Hart: Greetings and welcome. Avalanche, I presume? My name is Hart, and it's a pleasure to meet you. I've come to escort you to Mayor Domino, per his request.

text.Barret: The mayor of Midgar? The empty suit that's just a mouthpiece for Shinra?

text.Hart: Yes. The mayor of our dear Midgar... the most magnificent city ever built. That Mayor Domino. The Visual Entertainment Hall has been experiencing technical difficulties of late... and he suspected that these difficulties might impede your progress.

text.Cloud: So what does the mayor want with us?

text.Hart: I'm afraid you will have to ask him that yourself.

text.Barret: Guess we're supposed to follow.
Look at this place! So what—you telling me the mayor's some kind of crazy bookworm?
If this is a trap, you're a dead man, y'hear?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Hart.
Upon entering Domino's office.

text.Barret: This can't be right.

text.Domino: Ah! Wonderful! You finally made it. I am the mayor of the great metropolis of mako. Domino, at your service. (chuckles) I must say, you three haven't exactly been discreet. I wonder who's been cleaning up all your messes.
Come on. Think about it. You've been caught by security several times... walked in front of every other camera... and scared an accountant half to death. Do you hear the alarm? No? You're weclome.
I can only assume your cell wasn't looped in. I am Avalanche's man on the inside.

text.Barret: Say what?

text.Domino: Is it really that surprising to you? You've seen where they've put me. The mayor of the greatest city in the whole wide world... tucked away in a secret broom closet in the damned archives! The nerve. Those stupid Shinra pricks thought I'd just shut up and accept their treatment, but they were wrong! Dead wrong!

text.Barret: Huh. Well, this oughta make things easier.

text.Tifa: We need to break into Professor Hojo's lab.

text.Domino: What? Why? You mean you're not here to give President Shinra his comeuppance?

text.Cloud: We're here to save a friend who was taken.

text.Barret: But the president's gonna get his too—if I have anything to say about it.

text.Domino: Well, I don't particularly care what you end up doing—so long as it hurts Shinra.

text.Barret: Great.

text.Domino: So. I can get you as far as the 64th floor.

text.Barret: Hold up. You telling me that that's the best you can do?

text.Domino: That is indeed the best that I can do.

"But you're the mayor"!? Does this look like the office of a mayor? I'm a glorified librarian—nothing more! They don't even invite me to their meetings! Sorting records and reports—that's all I do! My hands and fingers have more paper cuts than skin! No one knows my pain—my daily torment! They've made me a pathetic shell of a man.

text.Barret: Okay! They did you wrong, like us—but we'll make it right. So just calm down. Deep breaths, man. Deep breaths.

text.Domino: Hm. Let me see that keycard of yours.
Here you are. You can now use it to access the Recreational Facility on the 63rd floor.

text.Barret: And then what are we supposed to do?

text.Domino: You look for a fellow Avalanche collaborator. Identify yourselves and he'll give you a keycard to the 64th. The countersign is... "The mayor is the best!" "Midgar's mayor is nothing less!" "Everyone says he's cooler than the rest!"
Just say "mayor" to the guy, and if he goes "the best!" with gusto, then you've found your man. You got it?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Domino again.

text.Domino: If you think you've found the collaborator, say "mayor" and see if he says "the best!" You got it now?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Hart.

text.Hart: If you require additional assistance, please do not hesitate to ask.

text.Cloud: So, can you tell us anything about this collaborator?

text.Hart: Certainly, I can do just that. But a man in my position must conduct his affairs with discretion. Which is to say that that which has been requested cannot be freely given... if you take my meaning.

text.Barret: You want money!

text.Hart: Disclosing confidential information entails considerable risk. Due compensation is to be expected. In this particular instance, that would amount to ten thousand gil.

text.Barret: Rip us off more, why don'tcha?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "No", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Yes".

text.Hart: The 64th floor is reserved for our executives. The individual you seek is fastidious and well-dressed. This individual likes to visit the 63rd floor to decompress from the stress of the job.

text.Barret: That really all you got for us?

text.Hart: Oh, are you dissatisfied with your purchase? How unfortunate. Perhaps this will help preserve our relationship.

text.Barret: Huh?

text.Hart: An expression of my gratitude and appreciation.

text.Barret: That's better.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Hart again.

text.Hart: If you require additional assistance, please do not hesitate to ask.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the office.

text.Tifa: I still can't believe the mayor is working with Avalanche.

text.Barret: Would've been nice to know. Idiots at HQ shoulda kept us in the loop.

text.ACTION: Upon passing the robots in the archives, depending on the robot passed.
Upon traveling to floor 63.

text.Hojo: So. About this precious promised land of yours... Come now, Aerith. You misunderstand my intenions. I wish only to satisfy their material greed so I can be left to pursue my great work. *Our* great work, my dear.

Hmm. You're the spitting image of her now. I regret it to this day. If she had only trusted me instead of trying to run, it could have played out quite differently. What a terrible tragedy, to lose the last of the pure-blooded Ancients... though not completely. Would like to see your mother? Albeit, through the lens of one of my microscopes. Did you really think we'd leave such a precious specimen to rot in the gutter? We collected and catalogued every last bit of her. Hair, skin, organs, every fragment of every bone... As breathtaking in death as in life! As *you*, my dear! Ifalna was elegance, right down to her cellular structure. (chuckles) And there it is. That same elegance.
Oh—yes. Time for yet another meeting. Sit tight. I won't be long.

text.Barret: Here's the 63rd floor, where loyal Shinra employees relax and recharge!

text.Tifa: It's pretty late, but I bet people are still here dealing with the aftermath of Sector 7.

text.Barret: It's their own damn fault.

text.Cloud: Stay focused. We need to find this guy.

text.Barret: Yeah, yeah. Guess I better get working on my conversation skills.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Urban Planning Adminsitration hallway.

text.Tifa: They look busy.
Seeing them like this somehow makes me feel a little bit better.

text.Barret: Not seeing any security around. One less thing to worry about.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Food Court.

text.Barret: Where are you... mister collaborator...

text.Tifa: I think we just need to start talking to people who look the part.

text.Barret: Remember, say "mayor."

text.Tifa: If they say "the best," then we have a winner.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the projector screen.

text.Host: Today we welcome a special guest: Shinra's Director of Public Security... who has an important message to share with us.

text.Heidegger: Everyone here at Shinra is deeply saddened and outraged by this unconscionable act of terrorism. But at the same time, we will not be cowed by threats or violence. To the people of Midgar, I make this vow: we will find the villains responsible and bring them to justice. Are you listening, Avalanche—you cowardly dogs!? Run all you like. Shinra is coming.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Combat Simulator Lounge.

text.Barret: The hell's that?

text.Cloud: Combat sim. You can use it to train for battle in a virtual space.

text.Barret: Does training in that thing really make you better?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Server at the cafeteria.

text.Server: Hello there! So—what'll it be for you today?
Mayo? Sorry, we don't have any here.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to her again.

text.Server: Come on, why don't you eat something hearty? It'll give you energy.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Shinra Employee on a table near the.

text.Shinra Employee (glasses): Hm? Are you military? Cool, cool. I guess things have been keeping you pretty busy around here. Have you found the guys who did this yet?
Huh? Uhh... what about the mayor?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Shinra Employee on a phone close to the window.

text.Shinra Employee (phone): No, I'm gonna be here a while longer.
Hey, shhh! I'm on the phone!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Shinra Employee holding his head on the table.
Upon attempting to talk to the man sitting on the bench.
Upon talking to the employee on a table near the Shinra Combat Simulator.

text.Shinra Employee (sim): You're gonna train in the sim at a time like this?
Hm? Are you looking for the mayor? He's not on this floor...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Shinra Employee on the right side of the Shinra Combat Simuatlor.

text.Shinra Employee (tips): You're military, right? Can you give me any tips for doing better in the sim?
Mare? I need to be tough like a horse?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Server at the Item Shop.
Upon talking to the Collaborator, listed at first as Shinra Employee, in front of the Shinra Combat Simulator entrance.

text.Collaborator: You work here? I don't recognize you. Can I help you with something?
... Is the best! I was told to expect you. Need access to upper floors, right?

text.Barret: That's right.

text.Collaborator: Before I trust you with this keycard, I need to see what you can actually do.

text.Barret: Say what?

text.Collaborator: Do you know what would happen if you got caught? We're putting our lives on the line here. Prove you're worth it. We have a state-of-the-art combat simulator. It can provide a real challenge, let me tell you. If you beat the sim, then the keycard is all yours.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Collaborator after beating the "Three-Person Team vs. Mayor Is Best" challenge.

text.Collaborator: All right, I've seen enough. I'm a man of my word. Here. This keycard will grant you access to the 64th floor. You can use the elevator to get there. Once you're up there, just what is it you plan on doing?

text.Cloud: We came to get one of our friends. She's being held in a research lab somewhere.

text.Collaborator: A lab? Then she must be with Professor Hojo. It won't be easy to get to her. Access to R&D is limited to authorized personnel only.

text.Cloud: We'll find a way in. Know where we can find Hojo?

text.Collaborator: A board meeting is scheduled to start soon. It's being held in the main conference room. President Shinra, Professor Hojo, and the other directors will be in attendance.

text.Barret: Think they like surprises? We can even take the president as a hostage. Think of the leverage!

text.Collaborator: Try it, and security will be on your asses in seconds.

text.Cloud: We need to find out what they're planning.

text.Collaborator: So you want to spy on their meeting? Hmm, I have an idea. Head to the men's restroom. You can climb into the air ducts there. They go all the way to the conference room.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley.

text.Chadley: Cloud. I've been waiting for you. You haven't forgotten me, have you? I'm an intern in the R&D Division here. I took the liberty of hacking into the executives' private network to monitor your progress through the building. I will support you in any way that I can. I sense a surge in trust. We should keep this brief to avoid suspicion.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave the floor.

text.Security Officer: Cloud? You're Cloud, right? Holy shit! It's cool, bro. We went through training together. Damn! So you still alive and kicking, huh? Some of the guys heard you got smoked, but I told 'em it was all bullshit!
Hey, sit tight man—I'mma go get Kunsel. I'll be right back!

text.Barret: Old buddy?

text.Tifa: You okay?
But you were just—

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Escalator Hall.

text.President Shinra: I trust the narrative is intact?

text.Heidegger: Rock solid. The people have embraced the Wutai-Avalanche conspiracy wholeheartedly. I've almost come to believe it myself.

text.President Shinra: Wutai's response?

text.Heidegger: So far, nothing. And if those cowards *do* react, all the better for us and our story.

text.President Shinra: Very well. Then we shall stay the course.

text.Heidegger: If I may, sir, there was one other matter.

text.President Shinra: Oh?

text.Heidegger: A message from our man Palmer.

text.Barret: Dammit!

text.Tifa: Barret.

text.Barret: Yeah, yeah, I know. We came here to save Aerith. That's our first priority.

text.Cloud: That's right. We only get one chance. Hojo should be at that board meeting, so that'll buy us some time. We need to plan this just right.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Domino.

text.Domino: I've done everything I can for you. Now don't make me regret doing it!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching floor 64.
Upon talking to the Shinra Employee outside the central conference room.
Upon walking further inside the conference rooms hallway.

text.Tifa: What's the plan?

text.Cloud: Little bit of recon. Need to find a way to infiltrate that room.

text.Barret: You hear the words comin' out of your mouth? We just gotta find that bathroom so we can get into the air duct. Ask anyone here. They can point us in the right direction.

text.Cloud: No, thanks. We can find it on our own.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Shinra Employee standing by a pillar.
Upon talking to the Shinra Employee standing by vending machines.

CHOICE.Shinra Employee (vending): Hm? You guys private security or something?
Are you allowed to be hanging out here on the clock?

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to men's restroom.

text.Tifa: All right, I'll wait out here.

text.Barret: Huh? You can't hang out here.

text.Cloud: Tifa. It'd be better if you waited inside.

text.Tifa: Maybe, but this is... Oh... never mind, you're right.

text.ACTION: Upon entering.

text.Tifa: Oh, thank god. No one's in here.

text.Barret: Love to show them what the ones down below look like.

text.Tifa: Come on, let's just find that duct.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the air duct.

text.Barret: Look, I'm...
Right.

text.Tifa: So... can I go with you? Don't wanna be here any longer than I have to.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the first vent.

text.Shinra Employee (vent 2): But we live right by Sector 7 and I keep calling and calling, but I still can't get through.

text.Shinra Employee (vent 1): I heard that all the phone lines are down. It doesn't mean anything.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the second vent.

text.Shinra Employee (business): Depending on the board's decision, we may start two projects simultaneously: rebuilding the plate and the city. Members of the Urban Planning Division will likely take point on both. Director Tuesti has ordered teams to come up with three-, five-, and ten-year plans. Each team needs to come up with a detailed proposal and schedule. We're going to have to put a lot of man-hours into this, so we'll need to start ASAP. Does anyone have any questions at all? If not, then we'll wait for the director to return.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the final vent.
Upon interacting with the final vent.

text.Palmer: I'm telling you, I saw him! With my own eyes! Sauntering down the corridor!

text.Heidegger: We don't have time for this nonsense!

text.Palmer: He was as close to me as you are now! The shock of it made me spill my tea!

text.Heidegger: Enough already! If there are intruders in the building, my men will deal with them.

text.Palmer: But Mister President! Sir! I swear to you—

text.President Shinra: Reeve.

text.Reeve: Sir. I have the damage assessment for Sector 7, and I'm afraid the figures are catastrophic—

text.President Shinra: Spare us the doom and gloom. Was there anything else?

text.Reeve: Uh... Well sir, I've also drafted a reconstruction plan—

text.President Shinra: That will not be needed. Not with the Ancient in our custody once more.

text.Reeve: Uh... with respect, sir, I don't see how—

text.Scarlet: Two words, Reeve: "Neo Midgar." Hm.

text.President Shinra: In their promised land... we will build a new mako-powered metropolis.

text.Reeve: Mister President! We still don't know for sure that the promised land even—

text.President Shinra: Professor Hojo.

text.Hojo: The test results were within expectations. The specimen is somewhat lacking compared to her pure-blood mother, but for our purposes she should more than suffice.

text.President Shinra: So, she can lead us to the promised land?

text.Hojo: Well, Mister President, that remains to be seen. I would like your permission to secure her cooperation through more "forceful" means. Forceful yet gentle. She is a precious resource that must be handled with care.

text.Scarlet: Personally, I've never had a problem with torture.

text.Heidegger: My armory is at your disposal, should you require anything.

text.Hojo: I... had something more... psychological in mind. Better to scar the psyche than mar the flesh.

text.President Shinra: Proceed as you see fit. However. You will not make the same mistake twice. Is that clear?

text.Hojo: If I may, Mister President, I have an idea how we might mitigate the risks. Simply put, we could have the Ancient reproduce. In the absence of a second specimen, we would need to identify an alternative mate. I would start with candidates from SOLDIER. These would of course include S and G types. Quite frankly, there's no telling what kind of properties a crossbred specimen might possess. So— What say you all?

text.President Shinra: If there is nothing else.
Meeting adjourned.

text.Hojo: Something stinks.

text.Barret: Anything?

text.Cloud: The man in the lab coat. Head of R&D. We follow him.

text.Barret: Okay. And then we kill the son of a bitch.

text.Cloud: Not until he's led us to Aerith. That's the plan.

text.ACTION: Upon exiting the conference rooms.

text.Hojo: Walking the halls of this very building. Who would have believed it. I wonder... were I to arrange a face-to-face... (chuckles) How I should like to meet their offspring. Ahh, but that can wait. First, we must have answers. A simple psychoactive agent should suffice. Nothing likely to cause any long-term damage. (laughs)

text.Barret: Right.

text.ACTION: While following Hojo.

CHOICE.Hojo: So first... Hmm, or perhaps instead...
This one. This is definitely the one.
Yes, yes. Why didn't I think of that earlier?
Wait, wait. You mustn't overthink it.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Hojo.

text.Barret: Don't move! I ain't bluffing.

text.Hojo: What is this?

text.Barret: A dozen bullets in your head, unless you open that door right now.

text.Hojo: You must be the ones who've been stirring up trouble lately. The eco-terrorists? If so I can't imagine what business you have with me. The president's upstairs. Go on, shoo.

text.Barret: Shut up. Keep walking.
None of y'all better move a muscle!

text.Hojo: Do stop pushing. Unlike you, I am less accustomed to physical violence.

text.Barret: You'll get used to it.

text.Hojo: What is it that you want?

text.Barret: Our friend. She's in your lab.

text.Hojo: Really?

text.Barret: Tell us where Aerith is!

text.Hojo: Oh, so she's your friend... Well well well, in that case... Yes... That might do the trick.

text.Barret: Mind speaking up some?

text.Hojo: It's nothing. Just imagining how she might react if I were to present to her your fresh corpses. (laughs) I promise... you will regret this.

text.ACTION: Upon Specimen H0512.

text.Barret: Hey! Hojo's getting away!

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator.

text.Hojo: Very impressive. I really must thank you for providing me such invaluable combat data.

text.Barret: Cocky little egghead, ain'tcha.

text.Hojo: The results provided by my predictive models... indicate that this force should be more than capable of handling you.

text.Barret: Y'all 'bout to learn predictable.

text.Hojo: Oh? "Take her back," you say? Correct me if I am wrong, but did the girl not come here of her own free will? Or do you mean to tell me that she is your "personal property"?

text.Barret: She only came here to save Marlene!

text.Hojo: I'm afraid you misunderstand. But I really can't be bothered to explain. This facility is home to extraordinary specimens that will change the world as we know it. Do try to be considerate.

text.ACTION: After defeating the group of enemies.

text.Barret: Looks like your models got it wrong.

text.Hojo: Yes... an unknown variable, perhaps. Well, no matter. Reinforcements will soon arrive.

text.Cloud: But will they get here in time to save you from me?

text.Hojo: My, are you a SOLDIER?
No, not quite. Oh, now I recall. My memory was mistaken. My boy, you weren't a SOLDIER...
What!? What is this—fascinating phenomenon!? What's happening!? Where are you taking me!?

text.Barret: What are those things up to this time?

text.Aerith: Cloud!

text.Barret: Got it. Stand back.

text.Aerith: You came for me.

text.Tifa: You good?

text.Aerith: I'm great!

text.Barret: Thanks for saving Marlene. I owe you one.

text.ACTION: After defeating the group of enemies.

text.Tifa: Aerith! You okay?

text.Aerith: Mm-hm. Thank you.

text.Barret: The hell was that thing?

text.Aerith: We need to go!

text.Tifa: Aerith!

text.Barret: What the—!?

text.ACTION: Upon entering the laboratory control room.

text.Barret: What? You wanna go?

text.Aerith: Stop. This child's a friend.

text.Barret: Uhh... So what the hell is it?

text.Tifa: Did it just *talk*?

text.Red XIII: You asked what "it" is. Hmm... I am that which you see before you. Nothing more. I'd appreciate it if we simply left it at that. Agreed?

text.Tifa: Thirteen?

text.Red XIII: "Red XIII." The designation given to me by Hojo.

text.Tifa: Then... you must have another name. What is it?

text.Barret: So, we gonna go get the son of a bitch?

text.ACTION: While walking towards the elevator.

CHOICE.Sephiroth: Mother. I have come for you.
Mother. Together we can reclaim our world.
Mother. The days have come again.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the elevator.

text.Tifa: Cloud!

text.Aerith: Cloud!

text.Tseng: You know, Reno. I think you might be due for some R&R.

text.Reno: Nah, I'm good...

text.Rude: What are we going to do about Sector 7?

text.Tseng: "We" are going to do nothing.

text.Rude: Been thinking. Was all that necessary?

text.Tseng: Had we refused, someone else would've completed the task. We have spared that someone the burden of a guilty conscience. Perhaps that will ease yours.

text.Reno: Yeah... nope.

text.Tseng: Let's try another tack then. They were a sacrifice to balance the scales.

text.Reno: Say what?

text.Tseng: After everything we've taken from the planet, we were due to give something back.
Does it matter?
Yes. Understood.
The VP needs us.

text.ACTION: After the previous cutscene in hard mode for *Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade*.

text.Chadley: That should be everything. Initiate projection sequence.

What do you make of the new form, Weiss? We’ve replicated everything about you, from thought patterns to stress responses. You should, however, notice some improvements in my latest update. Indeed, I’d venture to say you’re stronger now than you’ve ever been.

text.Weiss: Hm. Stronger than I’ve ever been… A big claim, little man.

text.Chadley: Given that this is merely a training exercise—no one.

text.Weiss: We’ll see. Be sure to choose my victims wisely… (laughs)

text.Tifa: Cloud.

text.Aerith: Oh, thank goodness. You're awake.

text.Tifa: You okay?

text.Aerith: Where I lived—when I was still a child.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Tifa.

CHOICE.Tifa: Are you okay? Maybe you should rest a little longer.
I don't want you to push yourself. We're all worried.\

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Barret.

CHOICE.Barret: Don't scare us like that, man.
Not enough sleep?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Red XIII.

CHOICE.Red XIII: I'm the one who carried you here.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Aerith.

text.Aerith: My mom and I stayed here, years ago when I was just a little girl. The room... looks exactly the same.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Aerith again.

text.Aerith: Every morning, they'd come and take my mom away. I remember crying here alone.

text.Cloud: ... Aerith. Before we break outta here, talk to us. There's so much we don't know.

text.Aerith: I'm... a descendent of the Ancients. That's pretty much it, really. Oh, but just so you know, that's not their actual name. They called themselves... the Cetra.

text.Barret: "We who are born of the planet, with her we speak. Her flesh we shape." "Unto her promised land she well one day return." "By her loving grace and providence may we take our place in paradise."

text.Aerith: You know it!

text.Barret: Yeah, well... Honestly I thought that part was just a fairy tale.

text.Aerith: Shinra thinks it's true. They've been searching for the promised land for a long time.

text.Tifa: And they must think you can lead them to it... Can you?

text.Aerith: Nope. Someday, maybe, I'll find it in me. But now? Not even if I wanted to.

text.Barret: Even if you could, that land belongs to the—I mean... To you and your people. Shinra's after it because they believe it's rich in mako—mako they've got no right to claim. But they'll try to take it anyway, won't they? Hmph. Greedy bastards'll never stop.
Okay. New plan. Y'all take Aerith and get the hell outta here. Me, I'mma go bust some Shinra heads.

text.Aerith: Barret, wait... You can't do that...

text.Barret: Oh, great. These assholes again! Probably some Shinra science experiment.

text.Red XIII: Whispers. Perhaps best described as arbiters of fate. They are drawn to those who attempt to alter destiny's course and ensure they do not.

text.Tifa: Like capital D... "Destiny"?

text.Red XIII: The flow of the great river that is the planet, from inception to oblivion.

text.Tifa: And you're saying that that flow is somehow... fixed?

text.Red XIII: Yes. For it is the will of the planet itself.

text.Barret: So if we're destined for a bleak future, these Whispers will try to keep us on that course? Now wait just a damn minute! How in the hell can you possibly know any of that? Spouting that cryptic stuff—which could all be bullshit! I mean, ain't you a Shinra lab rat—dog?

text.Red XIII: I'm not a rat dog. When Aerith reached out to me... I found this knowledge of the Whispers.

text.Aerith: Listen to me! Please...

The Shinra Electric Power Company isn't the real enemy. It started with them, sure... but I promise you... there's a much bigger threat. I just want to do everything in my power to help. All of you... And the planet.

text.Tifa: Aerith. What are you not telling us?

text.Aerith: I'm lost in a maze, and... every step is taking me further from the path... Every time the Whispers touch me... I lose something. A part of myself. "Follow them. The yellow flowers."

text.Tifa: It's okay. We'll find a way out together.

text.Aerith: Okay.

text.Barret: Weird...

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the screen.

text.Wedge: Hey guys! Long time no see!

text.Barret: Wedge!?

text.Tifa: You're here!?

text.Barret: Y-you shouldn't be up and moving!

text.Wedge: I'm feeling much better thanks to Elmyra's cooking! Ah, but that's not what I wanted to talk to you about! Listen—any moment now—

text.Tifa: What was that? An explosion?

text.Wedge: HQ's running the show this time. They're raising hell to try and flush out the president.

text.Domino: This complicates matters. That explosion just now put the whole building on high alert.

text.Tifa: So now we're trapped in here?

text.Domino: No need to panic, little lady. See? You can still move freely within Hojo's laboratory.

text.Wedge: Find a way to the roof. An Avalanche chopper will come to extract you.

text.Barret: HQ's bailing us out? I doubt it. Not after all the shit we've pulled.

text.Wedge: I asked them really nicely! Like, super-duper nicely!

text.Tifa: Thanks, Wedge.

text.Wedge: Just get to the roof, okay?

text.Barret: I didn't ask him to do any of that.

text.Cloud: Yeah, well, I'm glad he did.

text.Barret: Huh? Heh. I'mma still chew him out for it later.

text.ACTION: While following Barret and Red XIII.

text.Barret: Anyway, we gotta get to the roof, right?

text.Red XIII: Then we can use the same elevator that Hojo did.

text.Barret: That elevator. Was it this way?

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator.

text.Barret: What happened here?

text.Aerith: The little ones in the pods. Where did they go?

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Red XIII.

text.Barret: Now what do we do?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching them.

text.Barret: So go give 'em one already!

text.ACTION: After defeating the group of enemies.

text.Barret: Nice job!
What?
Shit—what the hell Red!?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the VR simulator in *Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade* in Hard Mode.

text.Chadley: Cloud… We’ve added a new individual’s data to the combat simulator. I can’t divulge any details…but I can say its existence is both highly-classified and extremely dangerous. To be completely honest…I had some misgivings about implementing it. Even now, I’m still not entirely sure I made the right decision. However, I do believe that engaging it in combat will yield vital information. And who better to extract that information than you, Cloud? If you’re willing to try, I’d appreciate the help.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Pride and Joy Prototype in Chadley's VR simulator in Hard Mode.

text.Chadley: Now that my research is at long last complete... I believe that it's time I told you the truth about myself. I'm... not human. I'm a cyborg created to serve as Hojo's assistant. I was given knowledge and power beyond that of a human... ... But I was robbed of free will, bound to obey the whims of my master. But when we met, Cloud, I sensed something within you—something I knew would allow me to break free of my chains. By identifying and studying a subject with infinite potential such as yourself... I could adhere to the directives imposed upon me... all the while pursuing my plans for independence in secret. Your combat data provided me the vital information that I required to enhance my basic functionality... This is the result. Through my research and with your assistance, I have freed myself from Hojo's bondage.
I cannot thank you enough for your help. You've given me the power to finally live my life on my own terms.

text.Cloud: So... what are you gonna do now?

text.Chadley: I'm not sure. It's all a big, wonderful mystery. It's nice not knowing something for a change...

text.ACTION: Upon beginning "Three-Person Team vs. The Immaculate One".

text.Weiss: They shall be slashed, strangled, and slaughtered. Beaten, stabbed, and crushed. Garroted and impaled. Shot and executed…without mercy. Now…let the hunt begin!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Weiss.

text.Weiss: So this is what’s possible when you transcend the flesh? Good to know. (laughs) Either way, see you in Deepground.

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator.

text.Tifa: Right.

text.Barret: Hell is this place?
What I wouldn't give to burn it all down... but we need to get to the roof.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the bridge.

text.Barret: What is that... ?

text.Aerith: Jenova.

text.Sephiroth: Mother... Together we will reclaim our world.

text.Tifa: I'm *sick* of this! I'm sick of all of this!
Cloud?

text.Cloud: Tell me. Is it really you?

text.Sephiroth: Don't deny me. Embrace me.

text.Aerith: Cloud!

text.Sephiroth: A touching reunion.

text.Hojo: Very, very good! And thus is the hypothesis proven correct! I can only hope you will continue *not* to disappoint. (laughs)

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the first lever.

text.Cloud: Test subject pods? Guess I can use these.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first Unknown Entity group.
After defeating them.
Upon reaching the second set of test pods.

text.Cloud: If we flip that switch, we can get to the other side.

text.Red XIII: Hm. I may be able to do that.

text.ACTION: Upon directing Red XIII to leap across.
Upon entering the 1st Ward.
Upon approaching Barret.

text.Barret: What kind of freak show have they got going on in here?

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Barret.

text.Barret: Stay back!
Yeah, right! Just having a little bit of fun with them, that's all.
Long as it took you to get here?

text.ACTION: After the M.O.T.H. Unit arrives.

text.Barret: Shit, it's like they're churning out monsters here.

text.Red XIII: That's not far from the truth.

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies.

text.Barret: Hey... You okay?
If you say so.
First, we find Tifa and Aerith. Then we head for the roof. Should be an elevator somewhere. Didn't expect any of this, but we just gotta roll with it. Come on, let's go.

text.ACTION: After directing Red XIII to leap across to use the lever.

text.Barret: All right. Now you're starting to impress me.

text.Aerith: We got 'em!

text.Barret: Yeah! Keep it up, y'all!

text.Aerith: Don't move an inch! We'll head down too. Be right there!

text.ACTION: Upon crossing the pods.

text.Barret: Huh? I can't hear what you're saying!

text.Red XIII: I think there's something over there.

text.ACTION: Upon directing Red XIII to leap across the pods on the far side.

text.Red XIII: There's no control panel. We don't have the means to go this way.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the PHS Terminal.

text.Tifa: Hello? Cloud? Can you hear me?
No need to worry. We're fine, but what do we do now? I don't see any way out of this room.

text.Hojo: Ahem. Can you all hear me?

So tell me. How are you finding the Drum? You know it's filled with the most advanced technology in Midgar, if not the entire world. You should feel honored to see it firsthand! You'll also have the opportunity to take part in a rather ambitious experiment of mine.

text.Barret: What!?

text.Hojo: When all the pieces are in place, I will open the door to the 3rd ward. Perhaps you can help me with the necessary preparations? Given that you're already in the perfect position to do so. I look forward to data both invaluable and instrumental.

text.Barret: "Necessary preparations"? What the hell is this asshole talking about?

text.Tifa: Can't we just ignore him and keep going?

text.Red XIII: I'm afraid not. If I know Hojo, he won't let us out until we indulge his request for data.

text.Tifa: He said something about a ward, right? I'm pretty sure I saw a door to one upstairs somewhere.

text.Aerith: So... you wanna check it out?

text.ACTION: After conversations at the PHS Terminal end, or if there is no conversation.

text.Cloud: You two'll be on your own. Be careful.

text.Tifa: Thanks. We will.

text.Barret: We'll be waiting right here. If anything happens—anything at all—you call us. All right?

text.Aerith: Roger that!

text.Tifa: Hey, you think Cloud's doing okay? He's been acting really weird lately—more than usual.

text.Aerith: True, but it's Cloud—I'm sure he'll be fine. But what about you, Tifa? How are you holding up?

text.Tifa: Huh? Oh (chuckles) I'm fine!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the entrance to the 3rd Ward.

text.Tifa: I guess this has to be the 3rd ward, right?

text.Aerith: Think so. But it looks like the door's locked.

text.Tifa: There has to be something we can do. Let's look around.

text.Aerith: Gotcha.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever.

text.Aerith: Look! Now they can get across too.

text.Tifa: We should let Cloud know.

text.ACTION: Upon using the PHS Terminal.

text.Tifa: Cloud, can you hear me? We found the door to that ward he was talking about, but it's locked and we can't get it open.

text.Aerith: About those preparations Hojo mentioned before... I think we're supposed to do something with that.
We were fiddling with some sort of control panel. Do you see a way to get across now?

text.Cloud: All right. We'll make our way to the central terminal. Sit tight until you hear from us.

text.Barret: The hell kind of "research" is this?

text.Red XIII: The cataclysm that came from the stars—Jenova. Hojo has devoted half of his life to her study.

text.Barret: I don't give a shit about any of that.

text.Red XIII: The experiments in this facility... involve the enhancement of life-forms and machines through the application... of Jenova biological data. Hojo's plan is to pit his subjects against ust, thereby facilitating their growth.

text.Barret: Hmph! So this asshole thinks he can treat us like his experiments.

text.Red XIII: I know what fate awaits these creations. Let us put them out of their misery.
We must first find a passage that leads to the center.

text.ACTION: Upon directing Red XIII to leap across.

text.Red XIII: There's no control panel. We don't have the means to go this way.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the central pillar.

text.Barret: Wait sec. Weren't the girls right by the door to the 3rd ward?

text.Red XIII: There are four switches. One for each ward.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling a lever. After pulling it again, only the Announcement line is spoken.

text.Barret: What the—?

text.Announcement: Transfusion procedure complete. Commencing test of augmented research specimen.

text.ACTION: After opening the 3rd ward.

text.Red XIII: You need to warn the others. Tell them to be careful. Very careful.

text.ACTION: Upon using the PHS Terminal after opening the door.

text.Cloud: Tifa, you there? We accessed the central terminal. The door should be unlocked now.
Any one of Hojo's twisted creations could be in that ward. Be careful.

text.Tifa: We will. See you in a bit.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the 3rd Ward.
Upon entering the 3rd Ward - Nursery.

text.Tifa: Uh, what is this place for?

text.Aerith: There's a... sadness...

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the top of the staircase overlooking pipes across the following room.

text.Aerith: Look.

text.Tifa: Let's get across with those.

text.ACTION: After falling.

text.Aerith: That hurt. Did we wake 'em up?

text.Tifa: Yeah, looks like it.

text.ACTION: Upon walking through the exit.

text.Tifa: Is this really the exit?

text.Aerith: I hate that man. I really do.

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever at the end.

text.Tifa: You think now the others can get across too?

text.ACTION: Upon using the PHS Terminal.

text.Tifa: Hey, Cloud?
We used the control panel here a little while ago, so you should be able to get to the other side. Can you check?

text.Barret: Roger that. Was gettin' pretty bored anyway.

text.Cloud: You two, stay there. We'll call if anything comes up.

text.Aerith: Okay. Be careful.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the ward before opening the door.

text.Red XIII: We need to open the door first.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the 2nd Ward.
Upon entering the first two testing rooms.

text.Announcement: Commencing test. All personnel must evacuate area. Commencing test.

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies in the first testing room.

text.Hojo: I hope you're enjoying your experience.

text.Barret: Why don'tcha come down here and ask me?

text.Hojo: Before you get any ideas, you should know this glass is bulletproof. No discernable changes after contact. Most fascinating. Hmm...

text.Barret: Hey! We ain't done yet!

text.Red XIII: It seems we have no choice.

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies in the second testing room.

text.Barret: How'd ya like watchin' your precious toys get torn to shreds!?

text.Hojo: I never grow tired of watching my toys be broken, no matter how many times I've seen it happen. Such is the case when you truly enjoy your work. Now, for the next step...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the third testing room.

text.Barret: Look! Now's our chance to kill the bastard! Time for you to pay the piper!

text.Hojo: Hmph. They never learn.

text.Announcement: Commencing test. All personnel must evacuate area. Commencing test.

text.Hojo: Be a good boy and keep the other pets company. (laughs)

text.Barret: Shit. Looks like Red might need our help up there!

text.ACTION: After defeating all enemies in the room.

text.Barret: C'mon! We're going!

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the staircase.

text.Barret: Get outta here!
What was that thing?

text.ACTION: Upon entering the 2nd Ward - Specimen Refinement.

text.Barret: Remind me. This ain't a hospital, is it?
This guy's a real piece of work...

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave.

text.Barret: Now what!?
Hey, let us out!
I remember you!

text.Red XIII: And he remembers us, I think.

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the ward.

text.Barret: Fine! One step at a time it is.

text.Red XIII: I don't see any elevators around here.

text.Cloud: I'll let Tifa and Aerith know.

text.Barret: Huh, whaddya know. That's the door to the 4th ward.

text.Red XIII: If we want to get in, we'll need to go all the way back to the central terminal.

text.Barret: But the door we used to get here is shut. So what now?

text.Cloud: The passages have to be connected somehow.

text.ACTION: Upon directing Red XIII to leap and pull the nearby lever.

text.Barret: It's a PHS terminal. Call up Tifa, see if they can get to the central terminal.
Hey! You okay down there?
Shit! He can't hold them off forever!
You should call Tifa.

text.ACTION: Upon using the PHS Terminal.

text.Tifa: Is something wrong?

text.Cloud: Red fell to your level. Can you try to get to him?

text.Aerith: Oh, no!

text.Tifa: Come on!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Red XIII.

text.Aerith: Sorry for the wait!

text.Tifa: Now, let's get this over with!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating all enemies by Red XIII.

text.Tifa: Let's finish this!
You okay?

text.Barret: Nice one!

text.Tifa: Have Cloud and Barret found anything?

text.Red XIII: Actually, they just found the entrance to the 4th ward. But to unlock it, they have to access the central terminal—which they cannot do from their position.

text.Aerith: Maybe we can get to it instead.

text.Tifa: Yeah, let's try.

text.ACTION: Upon directing Red XIII to leap across to use the lever.

text.Aerith: Look! An elevator!
... And it's not moving.

text.Red XIII: The professor still has plans for us, I presume.

text.Aerith: For the record, I don't like this one bit.

text.Red XIII: All that remains is the 4th ward. We must trust in Cloud and Barret to see it through.

text.ACTION: After unlocking the door to the 4th ward.

text.Tifa: This was a good idea... right?

text.Aerith: Yep! Let's go give the others the news.

text.ACTION: Upon using the PHS Terminal.

text.Tifa: Yeah. We found an elevator on our side.
But... we can't use it for some reason.

text.Aerith: Hojo did something. I know it.

text.Red XIII: There's only one thing we can do. We need to head to the 4th ward, just like he wants.

text.Tifa: We unlocked it on our side. You should be able to get in.

text.Barret: Right. Now we head back to that door.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the ward.

text.Barret: We, uh, made Wedge wait a while to be rescued.
You know, he really likes you.
Friendly guy, but he has a hard time opening up to people.

text.Cloud: Well... that makes two of us.

text.Barret: He's got your back, though. Heh... makes two of us.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the second tube.

text.Barret: Huh. You hear that?
Flyin' fishbot here's trying to turn us into mincemeat!

text.STATUS: When Swordipede falls to 50% HP.

text.Barret: It's outta control!

text.Tifa: What the—!?

text.Aerith: I think it's coming this way!

text.ACTION: After defeating Swordipede.

text.Aerith: That's enough.

text.Hojo: Again you triumph! (laughs) I'd be disappointed if you didn't! Yes... I believe I have just about all the data that I require. Then we are ready to proceed to the next stage.

text.Aerith: Yes! We got it to work.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the elevator.

text.Tifa: Could this be a trap?

text.Aerith: Don't worry. The elevators are safe.

text.Tifa: All right. If you say so.
Huh? Are we there already?

text.Aerith: No, something tells me that we aren't. Call it a hunch.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching Cloud and Barret.

text.Barret: We don't have all day, you know.

text.Tifa: I think it might be locked from this side.

text.Aerith: Should we open it up then?

text.ACTION: Upon pulling the lever.

text.Barret: Uh... Cloud...

text.Aerith: Heya, guys!

text.Barret: Oh... hey. Band's back together. Past time we got outta here and made our way to the roof.

text.Red XIII: There's an elevator just over there. But it will move only at Hojo's discretion.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the elevator.

text.Tifa: Well, okay then. Looks like the elevator's working.

text.Red XIII: It appears Hojo's done having his fun.

text.Barret: Glad to hear he enjoyed the show.

text.Tifa: We're back... again.

text.Barret: Hey.
What the hell's going on?

text.Tifa: Who would... ?

text.ACTION: Upon opening the door to leave.

text.Barret: So what's above this floor?

text.Red XIII: The president's office. And then the roof.

text.Aerith: Wait. Once we get in that elevator, there's no turning back.

text.Tifa: We're ready... right?

text.Red XIII: The elevator back there can take us down to the central terminal again. Now's the time for any unfinished business.

CHOICE.Cloud: I'm ready to do this. Let's go.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the staircase on floor 69.
Upon reaching floor 70.

text.Barret: Where the hell is that bastard hiding?

text.Tifa: And Sephiroth?

text.ACTION: While in the office, before reaching President Shinra.
Upon reaching President Shinra.

text.President Shinra: Help me...

text.Barret: Well, well, well...

text.President Shinra: Pull me up! I'll give you all the money you want! I have gil! Plenty of it!

text.Barret: Thing is, I don't want your money.

text.President Shinra: Please!
Just let me live. Everything you want can be yours.

text.Barret: I'm a man of modest dreams. Dropping you from seventy stories up would get me damn near to good.

text.President Shinra: But not all the way. You want something *more*, don't you!?

text.Barret: More than this right here? Talk to me again like you know me.

text.Tifa: Barret!

text.Aerith: Stop it!

text.Barret: You're gonna get on TV and tell 'em. Tell 'em what you did to Sector 7—that it was you who killed all those people! Then, you're gonna tell them the truth about Avalanche. That Avalanche ain't Wutai or anybody's puppet! That Avaalnche fights for the people—the planet! That we fight to hold Shinra to account for its crimes! That is Avalanche! The filthy sewer rats... who brought down a goliath! You tell 'em that.

text.President Shinra: Is that really all you want? For your names to be cleared? Hmph. That is what matters most to you? More than shutting down the reactors? Than the future of the planet itself?

text.Barret: Huh? Damn.

text.President Shinra: You're lying to yourself, even now. Truth... justice, honor, freedom! Vain indulgences, every one. Picture it! Picture a world without Shinra. Without mako energy. A stagnant, impotent world. Now picture a natural disaster. Who would help the people? Help the recover and rebuild? You? With their old would ruined, will they thank you for the new? I'm going to give you a chance. One last opportunity to consider what your principles are truly worth. But bear in mind that time is of the essence.

text.Barret: And what about you Mister President. What are your vaunted principles?

text.President Shinra: What principles!? Did you understand even a single word of what I told you? I know what I want, and I take it. I take advantage of whatever I can, and discard that which I cannot. There is no room for sentiment or guilt.

text.Barret: You son of a bitch!

text.Tifa: Barret!

text.Aerith: The source. Of everything.

text.STATUS: When the battle against Jenova Dreamweaver begins.

text.Tifa: What's happening!?

text.ACTION: After Jenova Dreamweaver falls to 20% HP.
After defeating Jenova Dreamweaver.

text.Avalanche Helicopter: HQ, this is Avalanche 3-1. Making another pass to search for friendlies.

text.Tifa: Barret! Are you hurt!?

text.Barret: Don't think so.

text.Red XIII: This death was not the one ordained for you by fate.

text.Barret: Thanks.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing the ladder toward Sephiroth.
Upon reaching the rest of the party.

text.Barret: Hey. Get your man?
Huh. 'Bout time we made our escape too.

text.Reno: Sure you wanna do this personally, boss?

text.Barret: If it ain't Rufus Shinra. Heir to the throne himself.
Huh!? The hell I will! We can finish off the family here and now!

text.Cloud: Take Aerith and get outta here.
I'll buy you guys some time.

text.Barret: I could stay here—back you up.
Fine. Have it your way then. But you better be right behind us.

text.Rufus: You're a SOLDIER, aren't you? Which, of course, would mean that I own you.
Secure the others. Just the two of us. Well. Maybe three.

text.STATUS: When the battle against Rufus Shinra begins.

text.ACTION: Upon blocking Darkstar's Whirlwhip attack in Punisher Mode.
Upon blocking Darkstar's Corkscrew attack in Punisher Mode.
After Darkstar loses 50% HP.

text.Air Traffic Controller: This is control. Hostile air units sighted. Redirect to engage.

text.ACTION: As Rude leaves.

text.Rufus: Not at all. You're making me sweat. Good thing I came prepared.

text.ACTION: After defeating Darkstar.

text.Cloud: Now it's just the two of us.

text.Rufus: Let's make it a night to remember.

text.ACTION: After defeating Rufus.

text.Cloud: I could end this—here and now.

text.Rufus: No, not quite. Tonight marks a new beginning for Shinra!

text.Tifa: You gotta be better than this... if you're gonna play the hero.

text.Red XIII: Think they can manage on their own?

text.Barret: You've seen the both in action. You know they can. Besides—
What was that!?
Gotta believe they made it out.

text.Aerith: I hope so.

text.Barret: Dammit!
Screw it—we gotta go back!

Get down!

text.Wedge: We're cool. Everything's cool.
Barret!
Not again!
You can't stop me! For Bigggs... For Jessie... Tifa... and Barret too! I'm sorry, Cloud... (screams)
Just... tell me that—that I made a difference...

text.Barret: Hey. Still in one piece?

text.Aerith: Yeah. Somehow.

text.Barret: Oh, you gotta be kidding me!
Okay, you asked for it, mech! Open wide! And suck on this!
I was born ready, Red.

text.Arsenal: Barrier drones damaged. Overriding main cannon safety protocols.

text.STATUS: When the Arsenal drops to 80% HP.

text.ACTION: Sometimes with the Arsenal's right arm is exposed.
After destroying both Barrier Drones.

text.Arsenal: Defensive systems compromised. Threat level: elevated.

text.STATUS: When the Arsenal falls to 60% HP.
When the Arsenal drops to 10% HP.

text.Barret: We piss it off?

text.Aerith: This doesn't look good!

text.Barret: Any ideas!?

text.ACTION: After the Arsenal fires Cry Havoc in its final phase.

text.Aerith: They all just... flew off.

text.Barret: If more come, we're done.

text.STATUS: When the Arsenal charges Cry Havoc a second time in its final phase.

text.Barret: Not this again!

text.Aerith: We can't hide! What do we do!?

text.ACTION: After the Arsenal is defeated.

text.Barret: Damn, does it feel good to be alive!

text.Red XIII: Quite. But we could still die later tonight. Cloud and Tifa could be dead already.

text.Barret: The hell they are!

text.Red XIII: Then we need to find a way we can all escape—and quickly.

text.Aerith: You're right. Let's go.

text.Barret: All we gotta do now is find the others.

text.Heidegger: Yes... I can see that. It was only a matter of time. And here we are. (laughs) So then—what is this ragtag group of misfits I see before me?

text.Barret: Avalanche!

text.Aerith: Local florist!

text.Heidegger: And where are the rest of you?

text.Barret: Up your ass.

text.Heidegger: Hm. Charming. Though not what I would've chosen as my last words. Secure the Ancient, but feel free to kill both the idiot and the dog.

text.Barret: Aerith. You saved my Marlene. Now... it's time I returned the favor.

text.Aerith: Wait!
Cloud!

text.Heidegger: Goddammit!

text.Tifa: Everyone, get in!

text.Heidegger: Stop, them you fools! Don't let them escape!

text.Tifa: Okay!

text.Barret: Why's he always gotta— Whoa! Shit.
Home free, Red!
Man, you need to lighten up. Hell, you might even try smiling.
On second thought... maybe frowning suits you better. Hey, don't pout!
Whoa! Are you guys seeing this!?

text.Aerith: Whispers.

text.Tseng: Is something wrong, sir?
I see. Very good.
The men are on standby, sir. Your orders?

text.Barret: It's like the whole damn building's made of 'em.

text.Tifa: I don't understand. What are they doing?

text.Aerith: Who knows...

text.Barret: Wedge—you don't think he got caught up in it do you?

text.Tifa: If he did, I hope he's okay...

text.Barret: Who?
This, we don't need.

text.ACTION: Through the bike minigame, Cloud, Tifa, Aerith, and Barret will randomly say lines from their battle dialogue.
As the bike minigame starts.

text.Barret: They're gainin' on us! C'mon, step on it!

text.Tifa: I'm trying, but it won't go any faster!

text.Barret: How the hell'd we get saddled with this junker!?

text.Security Officer: Give it up! There's nowhere to run!

text.ACTION: Upon dying.

text.Barret: No... dammit...

text.ACTION: While the Security Officers are active.

text.STATUS: When the truck arrives.

text.Security Officer: Pull over right now! We *will* use lethal force to make you comply!

text.ACTION: Upon being hit by the truck's machine gun.

CHOICE.Red XIII: Careful—stay out of the line of fire.
Circle around to the other side.

text.ACTION: After destroying the truck.

text.Barret: Stubborn bastards!

text.Aerith: Look!

text.Tifa: Come on!

text.Barret: And let that be a lesson to you!

text.STATUS: When the helicopter arrives.

text.Barret: That chopper is all mine! I'll bring it down real quick!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the tunnel following bridge.

text.Barret: Try catching us now, ya bastards!

text.Red XIII: I hate to spoil the celebration, but... there's more.

text.STATUS: When the M.O.T.H. Unit arrives.

text.Aerith: What the—!?

text.STATUS: When the M.O.T.H. Unit charges a spinning blade attack.

text.Barret: Cloud! Keep your guard up!

text.ACTION: Upon successfully charging the M.O.T.H. Unit's spinning blade attack.

CHOICE.Barret: That's it! Now seize the opening and attack!

text.ACTION: After destroying the M.O.T.H. Unit.

text.Barret: Ha ha *ha*! How do you like that!?
Them again!?
Guess we owe you another!
Shit! We got incoming! I'll take the chopper! The bikes are all yours, Cloud!

text.STATUS: When the helicopter charges an attack.

text.ACTION: After defeating most Mobile Officers.

text.Barret: Ha! Think you can take us? Well think again, asshole!

text.ACTION: After destroying all Mobile Officers.

text.Barret: That's it—I'm takin' you down!
We done here!?

text.Aerith: Somehow!

text.Barret: So now... they're on our side?

text.Red XIII: The Whispers intervene not to defend us, but to preserve the flow of destiny.

text.STATUS: When M.O.T.O.R. arrives.

text.Barret: Oh no, don't you *dare*!
C'mon! You see the piece of shit we're driving here!?

text.Red XIII: Says the three hundred pound sack of it.

text.Barret: Hey!

text.Tifa: Focus!

text.ACTION: Sometimes upon staggering M.O.T.O.R.

CHOICE.Barret: Get your ass in gear!
Time for a serious ass-whooping!

text.STATUS: When M.O.T.O.R. uses its electric attacks.

text.Aerith: I don't want any trouble!

text.ACTION: After M.O.T.O.R.'s stagger ends on low HP.

text.Barret: Time to meet your maker!

text.ACTION: After defeating M.O.T.O.R.

text.Barret: Okay, y'all! Let's finish him off! C'mon!
Nice!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the end.

text.Barret: Okay, asshole, let's—

text.Aerith: Don't.
And you... You're *wrong*.

text.Sephiroth: Those who look with clouded eyes see nothing but shadows.

text.Aerith: Everything about you is *wrong*.

text.Sephiroth: All born are bound to her. Should this world be unmade, so too shall her children.

text.Cloud: The world won't end today. But you... You will.

text.Sephiroth: Listen.
Destiny come.

text.Zack: We drag our asses all this way... and this is the welcome we get.
Boy, oh boy... The price of freedom is steep.
Embrace your dreams. And, whatever happens... Protect your honor... as a SOLDIER! Come and get it!

text.Sephiroth: I'm waiting, Cloud.

text.Aerith: This is the point of no return.
Destiny's crossroads.

text.Cloud: Then why did you stop me?

text.Aerith: I'm not really sure.

text.Tifa: What will we find on the other side?

text.Aerith: Freedom. Boundless, terrifying freedom. Like a great, never-ending sky. What you heard just now were the voices of the planet. Those born into this world. Who lived and who died. Who returned. They're howling in pain.

They... Their words... they don't reach him. All these moments and memories, precious and fleeting... they're like rain rolling off his back... And when they're gone, he won't cry... or shout... or anything. He'd tell you that he only cares about the planet. That he'd do everything in his power to protect and preserve it. But this isn't the way it's supposed to be. There's no greater threat to the planet than him. Sephiroth has to be stopped. He has to be. And that's why... I'm asking you to help me. I know that together, we can do this. But if we do... We'll be changing more than fate itself. If we succeed... if we win... we'll be changing ourselves... I guess... maybe, that's why I hesitated.

text.Cloud: You said it yourself. He has to be stopped. And frankly, I've heard enough howling for a lifetime.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Red XIII.

CHOICE.Red XIII: Is it our destiny to defy destiny? It's an interesting question.
Will there be Whispers on the other side?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Barret.

CHOICE.Barret: So if we go through that thing, there's no coming back?
I don't know what kind of freedom we're buying... but I know it'll cost us.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Tifa.

CHOICE.Tifa: Cloud, we should go.
If we wait any longer, I dunno...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Aerith.

CHOICE.Aerith: Whatever happens, we'll be okay... as long as we stick together.

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the portal.

text.Aerith: Ready?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "Not yet.", nothing happens.
Upon selecting "Yeah."

text.Tifa: Never tried to challenge destiny.

text.Red XIII: This could well be her last line of defense. It won't be easy.

text.Barret: Wouldn't be the first time I spit in destiny's eye. Whether you can see the seams or you can't... doesn't change that she's always trying to have it her way.
Daddy's coming home real soon, honey!
Don't know about you, but looks normal to me.

text.Aerith: Over there.

text.Barret: Okay, that ain't right!

text.ACTION: Upon reuniting with Barret and Tifa.

text.Barret: You're alive!
Wouldn't go that far.

text.Cloud: So that thing... that's a Whisper too, huh?

text.Barret: Looks a lot more like an "arbiter of fate" than the others.

text.Tifa: We can beat them.

text.Barret: Ha! Bring it on!

text.ACTION: After the first battle ends.

text.Barret: Come on, that ain't fair!
We gotta go!
Shit! Look out! Run dammit, run! Move your ass!

text.ACTION: After the second battle ends.

text.Tifa: Dammit!

text.Barret: We gotta get outta here now!

text.ACTION: After defeating Whisper Rubrum in the third battle.

text.Barret: Did we do it!?

text.Aerith: Hang on!

text.Tifa: Aerith!

text.Barret: What the hell did I just see?

text.Red XIII: A glimpse of tomorrow if we fail here today.

text.Barret: Dammit! How do we stop these things!?

text.Red XIII: Well, the big one is way over there. However...

text.ACTION: After defeating Whisper Croceo and Whisper Virdi in the fourth battle.

text.Tifa: This can't be our future...

text.Aerith: The future is always a blank page.

text.Barret: Them again? Least they could do is give us a little breather!

text.Cloud: I say we split up. Take 'em down at the same time.

text.Barret: In that case, ultra big boy's all mine!

text.STATUS: When Whisper Bahamut appears.

text.Tifa: Right!

text.Aerith: We can do this—together!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating one of the three Whispers in the fifth battle.

text.Aerith: Barret, we're counting on you!

text.Barret: Ain't no stoppin' us now!
Gotcha!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the second of three Whispers in the fifth battle.

text.Aerith: Red, you're up!

text.Barret: I'm gonna show you what Avalanche is made of!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the third of three Whispers in the fifth battle.

text.Tifa: Barret, go for it!

text.Aerith: We did it!
