text.Tifa: Right.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating Whisper Harbinger.

text.Sephiroth: I'm waiting, Cloud.

text.Barret: What the hell is this!?

text.STATUS: When the battle against Sephiroth begins.

text.Sephiroth: Fate is not to be taken lightly, Cloud.

text.ACTION: Sometimes during battle after attacking.

CHOICE.Sephiroth: Can you not see your future?

text.ACTION: Sephiroth does not seem to have any lines specifically for Barret.
After Sephiroth falls to 80% HP.

CHOICE.Tifa: Need some help?

CHOICE.Cloud: Don't know about need... Good to go?

CHOICE.Tifa: You know it!

text.ACTION: After Sephiroth falls to 60% HP.

CHOICE.STATUS: If Tifa joins the party, after Aerith had previously joined.

CHOICE.Tifa: What'd I miss?

CHOICE.STATUS: If Aerith joins the party, after Tifa had previously joined.

CHOICE.Tifa: Aerith!

CHOICE.STATUS: If Barret joins the party, after Tifa had previously joined.

CHOICE.Tifa: Barret!

CHOICE.Barret: Ain't you two havin' fun!

CHOICE.STATUS: If Barret joins the party, after Aerith had previously joined.

CHOICE.Barret: Better late than never!

text.ACTION: After defeating Sephiroth.

CHOICE.STATUS: If Barret has yet to join the party.

CHOICE.Tifa: Barret!

CHOICE.STATUS: If Tifa has yet to join the party.

CHOICE.Barret: We get him!?
'Bout time you showed!

CHOICE.STATUS: If Aerith has yet to join the party.

CHOICE.Barret: We get him!?

CHOICE.Tifa: Aerith!

CHOICE.Barret: 'Bout time you showed!

text.ACTION: After the previous dialogue options conclude.

text.Aerith: We can do this. We can. We can change it—make it right!
Cloud!

text.Tifa: Cloud!

text.Barret: Go!

text.Sephiroth: Careful now. That which lies ahead... does not yet exist.
Our world will become a part of it... one day. But I... will not end. Nor will I have you end.
The edge of creation. Cloud, lend me your strength. Let us defy destiny... together.
Not yet. Seven seconds till the end. Time enough for you. Perhaps. But what will you do with it? Let's see.

text.Heidegger: Mister Vice President.

text.Tseng: *Mister President*.

text.Elmyra: Marlene!

text.Barret: Marlene!
I'll come back.

text.Tifa: So... what now?

text.Cloud: Sephiroth. Long as he's still out there, I...

text.Barret: I thought you beat him.

text.Aerith: We can. We will.

text.Tifa: Count me in.

text.Red XIII: If it's to be a hunt, you could use a nose like mine.

text.Barret: I'm in too! Bastard wants to destroy the whole planet, doesn't he? An enemy of hers is an enemy of Avalanche!

text.Zack: Almost there, Cloud. We're almost there...

text.Aerith: This sky... I don't like it.

text.Yuffie: Well, guys... Your girl finally made it to Midgar.
Whoa...
Awha! (screams)
Blech!
You got this, Yuffie! Mm-hm.

My name is Yuffie, materia hunter and elite special forces operative for the new Wutai government. I have orders to infiltrate Shinra headquarters and steal their ultimate materia. To prove to our common enemy that Wutai is not to be trifled with. Members of Avalanche... with your full support... We got this!
So, members of Avalanche... Where are you!? Come get me already!
Okay. If I was a man in a moogle hat...
Wait, does this mean what I think it does? Interesting... So, I gotta come to you, do I? You got some nerve! (chuckles)

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first toxirats.

text.Yuffie: Hmph! Guess you're never far from a rat in Midgar! Let's see what you've got!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating them and the nearby gorgers.

text.Yuffie: Well, that was easy! And my search for the elusive moogle continues.

text.ACTION: Upon encountering the first robed man.

text.Yuffie: Huh?
No pom...
You okay? Anybody home?

text.ACTION: While near a robed man.
Upon approaching the elevator near the robed man.

text.Yuffie: Well, guess I'm not going anywhere until I get that elevator moving.

text.ACTION: Upon throwing at the switch to reactive the elevator.

text.Yuffie: Ah, I never cease to amaze myself.

text.ACTION: Upon exiting the warehouse.

text.Yuffie: Yeesh, this town's a total dump. I thought Midgar was supposed to be "the marvel of the modern world." Talk about false advertising. "City of Mako"? "City of Garbage," more like.

text.ACTION: Upon seeing the robed man surrounded by wolves.

text.Yuffie: Huh? I gotta do something!

text.ACTION: Upon spotting the bridge above.

text.Yuffie: Ah... You'll do the trick. Come on down!

text.ACTION: Upon lowering the bridge.

text.Yuffie: Sweet! Now to save the day!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the robed man.

text.Yuffie: Have no fear, Yuffie's here!

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the wayward wolves.

text.Yuffie: Uh, so... not even a "thank you"?

text.ACTION: While near the robed man by Scrap Boulevard.
Upon entering Scrap Boulevard.

text.Yuffie: This is too weird...
Hn, hn, hah! Okay... ! You got this!

text.ACTION: While running through Scrap Boulevard.

text.Yuffie: Huh, okay... That rotten egg smell's gone. Must've gotten used to it. Hah. Way things are goin', I'll be workin' for Shinra next. Nice try, Midgar.
I'm talkin' to myself. City's getting to me!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the screen inside the Sector 7 slums.

text.Scarlet: Mako Reactor 5 has been temporarily shut down, and all fires have been successfully extinguished. The situation is under control, and the people of our fair city need not worry about any additional complications. We are in the process of conducting a full forensic investigation. But we suspect the device used was similar to that employed in the attack on Mako Reactor 1.

text.Yuffie: Oh, oh, oh! Whadda we have here!? (chuckles) Man, that's gotta be Avalanche! Not bad. Not bad at all... But I can do better!

text.Zhijie: Yuffie?
Yo.

text.Yuffie: Wha... ? There's our pom!
So, you're Avalanche?

text.Zhijie: I'm *Zhijie*. Follow me.

text.Yuffie: Wha—? W-wait up!
So, Zhijie, why didn't you come meet me before?

text.Zhijie: I figured an elite W agent could find their own way.

text.Yuffie: I may be elite, but it's not like I've ever been to Midgar. ... And what exactly is a "W" anyway?

text.Zhijie: Anyone who lives where you just came from. Think of it as a codename.

text.Yuffie: Uh-huh...

text.Zhijie: Still can't believe they sent a kid to do this job...

text.Yuffie: This "kid" could kick your ass!

text.Zhijie: Sayin' you're a fresh face is all.

text.Yuffie: Oh, don't worry. I know exactly what you're saying!

text.Zhijie: Gimme a break, will ya?

text.Yuffie: And let you walk all over me?

text.Zhijie: Well, here we are. Ladies first.

text.ACTION: While near Jessie, Biggs, and Wedge.

text.Jessie: I don't get it. The mission was a success. So why aren't they back yet?

text.Biggs: Well, judging from the news, they didn't get caught. They'll turn up.

text.Wedge: And when they do, we're gonna treat 'em to a feast! I can almost taste your pizza now, Jessie!

text.Jessie: Shame, since you won't be getting any.

text.Wedge: What!?

text.Biggs: Heh heh...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Sector 7 Clinic.
Upon reaching Nayo, Polk, and Billy Bob.

text.Zhijie: These two are Billy Bob and Polk. And that's Nayo.

text.Yuffie: Hi. My name is Yuffie, materia hunter and elite special forces operative for the new Wutai government. I have orders to infiltrate Shinra HQ and steal their ultimate materia. To prove to our common enemy that Wutai is not to be trifled with. Members of Avalanche, with your full support... We got this!
You better believe it! So, did you guys meet Sonon yet? He was supposed to be here.

text.Polk: Yeah, he got in three days ago.

text.Nayo: He's out on the town as we speak. Really seems to be enjoying it here.

text.Yuffie: Oh he does, does he!?
As if. Ninjas always travel light. It's like a rule.
But I did bring these—Wutai's famous Da-chao beans. Eat up. And here you go.

text.Nayo: Sheesh. You ninjas are insane.

text.Zhijie: Do me a favor, Yuffie, and wait here for Sonon. I gotta head out. Your IDs should be ready for pickup by now.

text.Yuffie: Then why don't I join ya!?

text.Zhijie: Naw, I got this. Besides, you reek of trouble. (chuckles)

text.Yuffie: Huh?

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave before talking to everyone.

CHOICE.Billy Bob: Hey, you gonna be okay out there? Got all the info you need?

CHOICE.Polk: Uh, Yuffie? Might wanna wait for Sonon before hittin' the city.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Nayo the first time.

text.Nayo: You must be tired from your trip. Why don't you get some rest?

text.Yuffie: With all the noise in this city? Im-freakin'-possible. How about you tell me where in the Shinra Building they're keeping that materia instead. Don't hold out on me now. I know you know.

text.Nayo: Actually... I kind of don't. At least, not an exact location. All I know is that Shinra—for most purposes—treats materia as a weapon. Which means the Advanced Weaponry Division probably deals with it. And since that's in the basement...

text.Yuffie: I see... So... Shinra hides its top secret materia in the basement. (chuckles) You won't have to wait much longer, my precious... I promise.

text.Nayo: Just be careful, will you? Please?
Oh yeah, you should introduce yourself to Billy Bob. He knows a thing or two about the Shinra Building.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Billy Bob the first time.

text.Yuffie: You're welcome. So, the materia I'm looking for is in the Shinra Building, right? And where is that, exactly?
What did you just say?

text.Billy Bob: Haha, didn't mean to offend you. Of course, you probably knew this already, but there's a whole other city built on the plate above us. Shinra Building's right in the middle. You can't miss it.

text.Yuffie: Oh, *that* one. Why didn't you say so?

text.Billy Bob: Now, if ya wanna get topside, ya first gotta get outta the slums. And for help with that, you should talk to Polk.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Polk the first time.

text.Yuffie: I just wanna make sure I have the plan down pat. You know, like how to get up top and all that.

text.Polk: Huh, well... If you had an ID, you'd normally just take the train up there. But with all the commotion going on, that's not really an option. Security's on high alert. If you ask me, your best bet is to sit tight and wait for things to settle down some.

text.Yuffie: Sit tight? But I wanna go now...

text.Polk: Be my guest, then—go get killed.

text.Yuffie: Harsh.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Nayo the second time.

text.Nayo: Sonon's still not back? Must be in Wall Market, then.

text.Yuffie: What's Wall Market?

text.Nayo: Let's just say it's a place for people with "mature tastes."

text.Yuffie: Mature tastes...

text.Nayo: There's lots of different establishments. It's... kinda hard to explain.

text.Yuffie: No, I think I get it. Like bars filled with smoke so thick you can't even see, and drinks so bitter you wanna spit 'em right back out!

text.Nayo: Uh...

text.Yuffie: Where everyone gets drunk and complains about how "Kids just don't understand the value of hard work. They'll be the death of society." Ugh, how can they not see that *they're* the ones destryoing it!?
Wutai's got a place like that, where grown-ups drink their lives away. It's called the "Happy Turtle."

text.Nayo: Interesting. There's a Happy Turtle in Midgar as well.

text.Yuffie: Huh?

text.Nayo: I don't know where exactly, because I've never actually been, but I do see their flyers from time to time.

text.Yuffie: You do, huh? (gasp) They're taking down Midgar one citizen at a time!
I salute you, Happy Turtle!

text.Nayo: Come to think of it... There's a man who goes around putting up flyers for the bar. People call him "Old Snapper." And he doesn't dress like your average Midgar male. Might be from Wutai.

text.Yuffie: I oughta find him! Man deserves some Da-chao beans.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Billy Bob the second time.

text.Billy Bob: You know about the VR combat simulation module, right?

text.Yuffie: Huh? Uh... course I do! Why wouldn't I? It's that thing that... stimulates... modulation.

text.Billy Bob: Hm. (chuckles) Kinda. It's a machine that puts you in a virtual world where you can practice fighting all you want. There's even a portable version of it. Guy around the corner has one.

text.Yuffie: Uh-huh...

text.Billy Bob: Hardly ever see technology that cutting-edge down here. So whaddya say? Wanna try it?

text.Yuffie: I really don't have time to be playin' around with some stimulator. But, just to be polite, I guess I'll take it for a spin.

text.Billy Bob: The guy's name is Chadley. He's over by the neighborhood watch. If you ever feel like some virtual training, I'm sure he'd be happy to help.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Polk a second time.

text.Polk: You look about ready to die of boredom. Wanna play Fort Condor?

text.Yuffie: "Fort... Condor"?

text.Polk: I shoulda known. It hasn't been out long, so there's no way you Ws would've heard of it.

text.Yuffie: Uh, yes I have! And what's more, I'm awesome at it. I'll whoop you so hard, you'll wonder if you ever knew the rules!

text.Polk: For my benefit, then, lemme go over them...

text.ACTION: After beating Polk in a match.

text.Polk: Damn, Yuffie! How'd you do that? You totally kicked my ass!

text.Yuffie: You mean you didn't lose on purpose? ... Wow.

text.Polk: Well, if you're looking for a challenge, the undercity's got no shortage of serious players.

text.Yuffie: I've kinda got better things to do.

text.Polk: Sure 'bout that? Word is if you beat the grandmaster, you can win some serious cash—materia, too.

text.Yuffie: Materia!?

text.Polk: That's right. But you should know the hardcore competitors won't give you the time of day till you've proven yourself.

text.Yuffie: Whatever! Bring it on!

text.ACTION: After talking to all three twice.

text.Yuffie: Ugh... Al this talking's giving me a headache. I'm gonna go do some recon.

text.Nayo: I won't stop you. Just don't go too far, okay?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle by Stargazer Heights.

CHOICE.Marle: Got the place a guard dog. Figured it'd spare my tenants the troubles of chasin' off nosy men.
Ah, have business with the merc, do ya? If it's a job you want done, he's your man, but otherwise don't bother.

text.ACTION: While near the teacher with children in the middle of the slums.

CHOICE.Teacher: Okay, everyone, listen up! Time for "Stamp: The Loyal Little Helper."
"Bow wow! I'm Stamp, the good boy who never stops helping! Cap'n's given me a very important mission: to buy bread for tonight's dinner!"
So with his super-duper nose, Stamp went into town to sniff out a bakery. He went a-sniff-sniff here, and a-sniff-sniff there! Even finding milk, sausage, and cake didn't distract him.

Using his trusty nose, Stamp was able to find the best, most yummiest bakery in the whole city! And from that bakery, he picked out the best, most yummiest-smelling loaf of bread! Thinking about how pleased the captain would be, Stamp went trotting back to base, wagging his tail, and singing a happy song.

But on the road home, he came across a moogle crying all by himself. "What's wrong?" Stamp asked the forlorn little fellow. "I'm so hungry. I haven't eaten in ages, kupo," the moogle sniffled. "Never fear, Stamp's here! And I know just how to help." So Stamp gave the crying moogle his loaf of bread. "Thank you, kupo," the moogle exclaimed, his pom bouncing excitedly.

Then Stamp waved goodbye and returned to base. When he got there, he went straight to the captain and told him what had happened. The captain was very proud of Stamp. Helping that moogle was the right thing to do. "Who's a good boy," the captain laughed, as he gave Stamp a good scratch behind the ears. And Stamp let out a happy bark, for he knew that he was the good boy. The end.
That's all for today. Did everyone enjoy that?

text.ACTION: Upon passing Betty in front of the teacher.

CHOICE.Betty: Hi there, moogle! Are you here for the story?
I bet you like Stamp too, huh!

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to enter Seventh Heaven.

text.Yuffie: His ways are a mystery.

text.ACTION: While near the gate at the Pillar Plaza.

text.New Recruit: Um... Sir? What are we going to do?

text.Senior Officer: We're going to concentrate on our jobs, and not worry about things that don't concern us.

text.New Recruit: But... what if Avalanche is hiding somewhere in this sector?

text.ACTION: After beating one of the discovery quests before finding Sonon.

text.Yuffie: Sonon's gotta be back by now.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to the base.

text.Nayo: Ah, there you are. Someone's been expecting you.

text.Yuffie: What took you!?
Wh-what?

text.Sonon: Just thinking how you're nothing like your old man. Anyway, it's nice to meet you. I'm Sonon Kusakabe. I was lucky enough to learn how to fight from G—

text.Yuffie: Yeah, I don't wanna talk about him. Let's talk about something else. Like how you've adjusted to life here—indulging in "adult" pastimes. Which I guess means... drinking yourself stupid! Last thing I need is my partner stinking like an over-the-hill has-been.
Speaking of drinking... you been to the Happy Turtle? If you're part of Operation Down-in-One, I take it back. I am *there* next time you go. Don't worry, I can do adult stuff just fine.

text.Sonon: Well, I don't even know where to begin with all of that... But I *do* know I haven't heard of "Operation Down-in-One." At any rate, I'm looking forward to working with you, Boss.

text.Yuffie: "Boss"? As in *me*?

text.Sonon: Well, I've got a few years on you, I'll admit—but out of us two, you've done this longer.

text.Yuffie: I... I guess I have! "Boss," huh? I could get used to that. Beats being stuck on the bottom rung, that's for sure. (chuckles)

text.Sonon: After we get that materia, we can celebrate your promotion at the Happy Turtle.

text.Yuffie: Yeah! Yeah!
Stupid bird.

text.Polk: Says the merchandise is good to go. Handoff's at a depot in municipal storage.

text.Nayo: Okay. Yuffie, Sonon. You mind coming along?

text.Yuffie: Not at all! Need to scope out the city anyway. Really get to know the enemy.

text.Nayo: We'll be passing through a rough part of town, so you'll wanna go prepared. I'll leave you to get ready. Hit met up outside when you're done, okay?

text.Yuffie: Be right there!

text.ACTION: While near Chadley before talking to him.

text.Chadley: Searching for candidates...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley.

text.Chadley: Candidate detected. Performing physical analysis. She seems relatively agile, and has substantial muscle mass for her stature. Hm. An acceptable candidate.

text.Yuffie: Hey, uh... you wanna tell me what you're mumblin' about?

text.Chadley: My apologies. My name is Chadley. Would you be interesting in helping me with my research?

text.Yuffie: I'm Yuffie. Neet to meet you. So... what're you researchin'?

text.Chadley: Combat. It would entail doing battle with a summon in a virtual arena using this portable simulator. Interested?

text.Yuffie: Hmmm... sure! Why not. Imma kick its butt!

text.Chadley: Very well then...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley again before beating Ramuh.

text.Chadley: Can I assume you're ready to do battle with a virtual summon?

text.ACTION: Upon selecting "VR Missions" from Chadley and exiting.

text.Chadley: You're withdrawing? That is... most disheartening.

text.ACTION: Upon losing to Ramuh.

text.Chadley: What a shame. It was a close match. However, I did manage to obtain some invaluable data. Analyze and learn from your mistakes, so that you can claim victory next time.

text.ACTION: Upon beating Ramuh.

text.Chadley: Splendid! Thanks to the data you provided during your battle, I succeeded in developing a new materia! One might say you were "faster than lightning." And with the Lord of Levin on your side, your enemies will struggle to keep up!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley again after beating Ramuh.

CHOICE.Chadley: If you'd like to participate again, you're more than welcome!
You "kicked its butt," like you promised.

text.ACTION: While near Kyrie before talking to her.

text.Kyrie: Attention! For three gil, you can play Fort Condor against the lovely Kyrie!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Kyrie.

text.Kyrie: You know the drill. You wanna play, you gotta fork over—Hm? What's your deal? And why're you dressed like a five-year-old? That's just weird.

text.Yuffie: Uh... What are you talking about? This isn't weird—it's super cute!

text.Kyrie: "Super cute"? Heh. More like "super lame."

text.Yuffie: Not as lame as Midgar.

text.Kyrie: Huh?

text.Yuffie: Just saying how much I was looking forward to playing Fort Condor. I could really use the training, y'know?

text.Kyrie: Sure, I'll put you through your paces... but you do know it's gonna cost ya, right? One match, three gil. Play up.

CHOICE.Kyrie: Um, excuse me? I cheated and I *still* lost?

CHOICE.Yuffie: What can I say? Talent trumps all.

CHOICE.Kyrie: Whatever. You still owe me for my time. It's gotta be worth... seven gil at least!

text.ACTION: Upon passing Kyrie after beating her.

text.Kyrie: I don't wanna think about it. Maybe I should just go home and pass out.

text.ACTION: While near Johnny before talking to him.

text.Johnny: Ugh. Great work, Johnny. Just great. Where you gonna find enough money at this short notice?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Johnny.

text.Johnny: Ah! Don't freakin' scare me like that! I'm highly strung! You trying to kill me or—Huh? Who the hell are you?

text.Yuffie: Who am I? Someone who doesn't spend all day muttering to themselves in the shadows... Like some kinda Shinra spy!

text.Johnny: Say what!? *Me*!? Nuh-uh! I was just... y'know... thinkin' about stuff. Huh? Hmm... (chuckles) Yeah, like how to bag that sweet, sweet Fort Condor prize money! It's my ticket outta here!

text.Yuffie: Heh. So you're after the grandmaster too? Sorry to burst your bubble, Mr. Shadow Lurker, but *I'll* be the one takin' home those spoils of war.

text.Johnny: Wha—Over my dead body you will! My life's on the line here! I deserve to eat! I deserve to live!

CHOICE.Johnny: What!? No, this can't be—Say it ain't so! Goodbye fortune... Goodbye pride!

CHOICE.Yuffie: Now *I'm* taking down Midgar, a citizen at a time.
That all of Midgar's gonna suffer the same fate.

text.ACTION: While near the Shinra Middle Manager before talking to him.

CHOICE.Shinra Middle Manager: So the key to victory is ensuring that your units—Wait. What was a unit again... ?
And then there's formations and placement... Who came up with this stuff?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Shinra Middle Manager.

text.Shinra Middle Manager: So when your opponent leads with this, you respond with... this? This game is insane...

text.Yuffie: Hey there, suit. How's that conversation with yourself workin' out?

text.Shinra Middle Manager: Oh! Sorry, I didn't mean to disturb anyone. My daughter's been dying to play this game, and I promised to teach her. But first, I have to teach myself.

text.Yuffie: That "game" wouldn't happen to be Fort Condor, would it!? If you want, I'll help you figure stuff out.

text.Shinra Middle Manager: Y-you will? Uh, thanks, that'd be a great help.

CHOICE.Shinra Middle Manager: Well, whaddya know! I think I'm startin' to get the hang of this!

CHOICE.Yuffie: Starting to get the hang of what? Losing?

CHOICE.Shinra Middle Manager: Losing on purpose, to be precise. If I can let my daughter win without her suspecting, that to me is as good as a victory.
I know, I know... But if it'll make her happy...

text.ACTION: While near Jessie before talking to her.

CHOICE.Jessie: Enough already, Shinra. We get it.
I should be up there with them... Not that I'd be much use, but still...

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie before reaching rank 2.

text.Jessie: Where are they? They should've been here by now...

text.Yuffie: Hm? Waiting for somone? Ooh, you got stood up.

text.Jessie: As if! Wait, who are you?
Don't mean to be rude or anything, kid, but do you mind? I'm not exactly in the mood.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Jessie again before reaching rank 2.

text.Jessie: Not in the mood. Go bug literally anyone else.

text.ACTION: While near Roche before talking to him.

CHOICE.Roche: Hahahahahahahahaha! I'm waiting, my friend! Come out, come out, wherever you are!
Don't by shy! I simply wanna finish what we started!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Roche.

text.Roche: Why, hello there! Forgive me for saying, but you remind me of a dear friend of mine. Perhaps you've met him?

text.Yuffie: I dunno—is he Shinra too?

text.Roche: Perhaps, perhaps... My name is Roche, by the way. Ordinarily, your ill-concealed hostility and exotic wardrobe would give me pause. But not today, for I am here on business of a *personal* nature. Looking for my aforementioned friend.

text.Yuffie: What's his name?

text.Roche: Oh, I only wish I knew! But I *can* tell you that he has a real... "need for speed," as they say. And while he boasts a *very* large sword, his first love his plainly his mount!

text.Yuffie: Yeah, he sounds great. Say, is that Fort Condor I see over there? You play?

text.Roche: I'm always ready for a round of Fort Condor!

CHOICE.STATUS: If the player has not reached rank 2.

CHOICE.Roche: Though... I suspect a delicate flower like you would wither if exposed to my scorching passion for the game. Maybe after some practice, hm?

CHOICE.STATUS: If the player has reached rank 2.

CHOICE.Roche: In the absence of my friend, you will provide some much-needed entertainment, my dear!
Well played, my friend! And to think I thought I'd best you easily!

CHOICE.Yuffie: Wait... did you just call me your friend?

CHOICE.Roche: But of course! With that display of passion, you've more than proven yourself worthy! Henceforth, you shall occupy a place in the pantheon of my closest companions! When next we meet, it will be on the open road, the wind in our hair... Just don't make me come looking for you, my friend!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Roche again before reaching rank 2.

text.Roche: Hahahahahaha! Nice try, but no.

text.ACTION: Upon beating three rank 1 players.
Upon talking to Jessie after reaching rank 2.

text.Yuffie: So, I've been thinkin' about it, and I know just what you need... Round of Fort Condor?

text.Jessie: You gotta be—Didn't I tell you I'm not in the mood?
You know what? Fine, why the hell not. Might help take my mind off things.

CHOICE.Jessie: Damn... Well, can't win 'em all.
Ha ha, laugh it up. Now leave me alone, wouldja?

CHOICE.Yuffie: Hm? What's that I hear? The sound of the world's smallest violin?

CHOICE.Jessie: Keep pushing me...

text.ACTION: While near Wedge before talking to him.

CHOICE.Wedge: There, there... Don't worry. They'll be back soon. I promise.
We're all sad they aren't here, but we gotta be brave.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wedge after reaching rank 3.

text.Yuffie: So... I couldn't help noticing your Fort Condor set. Got time for a game?

text.Wedge: It'd be my pleasure!

text.Yuffie: Then let's do it up! I gotta warn you, though, I'm kind of an expert at this.

text.Wedge: Pretty sure I'll hold my own. I eat experts for breakfast!

text.Yuffie: Oho, is that right? Well, you can talk the talk, so let's see ya walk the walk!

CHOICE.Wedge: Not gonna lie... I didn't think you had a chance. Sure showed me.

CHOICE.Yuffie: You freakin' bet I did! Aw, not gonna go cryin' to your cats, are ya!?

CHOICE.Wedge: Ugh!

CHOICE.Yuffie: Looks like you've got your work cut out for you, my furry friends!

text.ACTION: After beating all players before the grandmaster.

text.Yuffie: Hey... Wait a second. That was everyone, right? Including the grandmaster? So where's my materia!? I want it now!

text.ACTION: While near Chadley upon reaching rank 4.
Upon talking to Chadley upon reaching rank 4.

text.Chadley: Hell, Yufife. I've finished reviewing your Fort Condor match records. You exhibit what in sporting parlance is called "the ability to perform in the clutch," and "the heart of a champion." In combination, these traits make you the ideal player! That being the case, if it isn't too much trouble, would you mind testing your mettle against me?

text.Yuffie: Uh... I guess so?

text.Chadley: I'm sure you'll "kick butt"!

text.ACTION: Upon choosing the "Fort Condor" option from Chadley's menu.

CHOICE.Chadley: That was quite the performance, Yuffie! Thanks to you, my hypothesis has been substantiated.
Substantiated. I was testing security measures against Wutaian espionage operations. By offering a reward, I surmised I could accelerate the rate of adoption, which would, in turn—

CHOICE.Yuffie: Yeah, yeah, skip to the end!

CHOICE.Chadley: My apologies. What I meant to say was this: The money and the materia are yours. Do with them as you please.

CHOICE.Yuffie: did you say "materia"!? So... *you're* the Grandmaster!? Whodda thunk! (laughs) How does it feel, Shinra—to see the whole of Midgar brought to its knees by the Amazing Yuffie!

CHOICE.Chadley: Heh. Your capacity to remain undeterred and overcome adversity is commendable. You are truly a worthy competitor. When I next test a hypothesis, I would be honored if you would agree to... ... "kick its butt"!
Shame; it was a close match. Maybe next time.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Chadley again before beating him.

text.Chadley: Would you care to assist in my research by joining me in a game or two of Fort Condor?

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Old Snapper.

text.Old Snapper: Oh the joy and cheer that await at the Happy Turtle...
Oho! Greetings, softshell. So, how many of those flyers didja find?

text.Yuffie: Wha?

text.Old Snapper: Ahem! Collect just six flyers for the Happy Turtle, and a one-of-a-kind prize could be yours! Ring any bells?

text.Yuffie: Nope.

text.Old Snapper: Well then! Allow me to explain. The Happy Turtle's running a contest. And the rules are simple. All you have to do is collect six of our fabulous flyers from around Sector 7... and you'll earn yourself a prize sure to delight even the dourest diamondback! Hah hah! Sadly, a handful of locals have taken to acting like stinkpots toward anything Wutaian, 'speciall since the bombings. Some've even gone so far as to tear down my poor posters. Little wonder nobody's won yet.

text.Yuffie: Bummer.

text.Old Snapper: Which leaves me in a pretty predicament... But hey, my pain might be your gain. By collecting just a handful of flyers, you could be the first, and—at this rate—the only winner of the most testudinarious contest in Midgar's history! This here's a sample of one of our ads. Breathtaking, isn't it? Now it's up to you to find all six. Leave no shell unturned, no pond unplumbed!

text.Yuffie: That prize is as good as mine!

text.Old Snapper: Ah, since you're here. You wouldn't happen to have any condor coins on you, wouldja? This job may keep a shell over my head, but my real passion's coin collecting. I'd gladly party with some oddities and commodities in exchange for those little beauts.

text.ACTION: Sometimes upon passing the Old Snapper.

text.Yuffie: Hm hm hm hm-hm-hm-hm-hmmm... (hums Happy Turtle theme)

text.ACTION: Upon talking to the Old Snapper again before obtaining all flyers.

text.Old Snapper: So, what can I do ya for?

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Let me redeem condor coins.", open store menu.
Upon selecting "Give me flyer hints.", hints given based on how many are left.

CHOICE.Old Snapper: Went to check on one of my flyers, and would't ya know, some rascally youngsters've hidden the darn thing.
Friend of mine manages some apartments nearby, and she's been kind enough to let me post a flyer.
Saw one of my babies floating through the air earlier! Poor thing...
The one I put up in Culvert Street's vanished, too. Swiped by one of those pesky cats...
Oh, if you overhear any songs, jams, or grooves about the Happy Turtle, be sure and follow 'em.

text.ACTION: Upon seeing a flyer in the distance.

text.Yuffie: There it is. The call of the turtle!

text.ACTION: Upon taking the poster behind boxes at the playground.

text.Yuffie: You never stood a chance, little guy!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the poster from the balloon.

text.Yuffie: The gumshoe ninja strikes again!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the second floor of Stargazer Heights.
Upon being spotted by the dog.
Upon obtaining the poster from Stargazer Heights.

text.Marle: Just what do you think you're doing, young lady?
And whaddya want with *that*, exactly? Better yet, who are you? Heard some punks've been hasslin' the nice people at the Happy Turtle, rippin' down their flyers. Are you one of 'em?

text.Yuffie: Mm-mm.

text.Marle: So you're trying to sneak a peek at the merc? Not that I blame ya. Boy's easy on the eyes, I'll give him that much.

text.Yuffie: Uh...

text.Marle: But cut your losses, honey. Unless you like your men silent and emotionally unavailable. Merc's built a wall around himself so damn high, even he can't see over it. He'll never tell you what he's thinking. And that attitude of his... ! I tried to get through to him—but would he listen? Would he?

text.Yuffie: Uh, I'm really not here for... whoever he is.

text.Marle: Then what *are* you here for?

text.Yuffie: For, uh... directions! But I'm all good now, thanks!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Marle after obtaining the poster.

CHOICE.Marle: Here for advice? Gonna have to wait your turn.
Something about today. Not sure what...

text.ACTION: Upon leaving Stargazer Heights after obtaining the poster.

text.Yuffie: Hah... That was a close one.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the tunnel at the back of the town.

text.Yuffie: I'm comin' for ya, flyer!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the correct flyer from the correct cat.

text.Yuffie: Heh heh, gotcha!
Flyer acquired!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Pillar Plaza after beginning the quest.

text.Wymer: Hey! Over here! Can't belive those freakin' morons... They damn near got 'emselves eaten tryin' to hide that stupid poster. You stay away from that factory, y'hear? Place has monsters comin' outta the walls.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Wymer again.

text.Wymer: Fiends've been actin' up since the bombings—like they know something we don't. (sighs) Just wish that merc were still around. He'd sort those critters out.

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the poster from the billboard at the Pillar Plaza.

text.Yuffie: Heh heh, gotcha! You thought you could hide from me, didn't ya!

text.ACTION: Upon entering the Abandoned Talagger Factory.

text.Yuffie: My turtle senses are tingling!

text.ACTION: Upon obtaining the poster from the factory.

text.Yuffie: Heh heh, gotcha!

text.ACTION: After obtaining six flyers.

text.Yuffie: And that makes six! Won't Old Snapper be impressed when I rock up with these bad boys.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", go to Old Snapper.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Old Snapper after obtaining all flyers.

text.Old Snapper: Well, well, well... Look what the tide washed in. That's a one, two... three and a four... five and—I can't believe it—six! We have a winner! Three cheers for the Happy Turtle's all-conquering champion! Hip hip, hooray! Hip hip, hooray! Hip hip, hooraaay!

text.Yuffie: Please, it was a piece of cake. Only these Midgarian dummies would find *that* a challenge. Speaking of which... Here—for a fellow tough nut!

text.Old Snapper: Would ya look at that... Da-chao beans! Does this mean what I think it does?

text.Yuffie: Mm-hm.

text.Old Snapper: Well, whaddya know. A real-life ninja, paying Old Snapper a visit. Truth be told, I'd love to have you 'round to the bar, but... you got your hands full. (chuckles) Not to mention the whole underage thing. Still just a young'n, I s'pose, ninja though you are. Well, I don't plan on movin' from Midgar anytime soon, so once your shell's seen a bit more wear and tear, make sure to come on back. Whip you up the finest food and drink this side of Wutai. Only the best for you.

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Nayo.

text.Nayo: You guys all set?

CHOICE.Nayo: Okay. Streets are kind of a maze, so stay close.
Take all the time you need.

text.ACTION: Upon walking away from Nayo.

text.Nayo: Yuffie? Where are you going?

text.ACTION: While following Nayo.

text.Nayo: To pick up your IDs. There's no way to get topside without 'em.

text.Yuffie: But I thought Zhijie was getting our High-D's. What happened with that?

text.Nayo: He is, but those are different. It takes more than one ID—or even two—to survive in this town. Don't forget, Midgar was built by Shinra, for Shinra.

text.Yuffie: Those tyrants!

text.Sonon: Put the claws away, Boss. Least while we're in Shinra territory.

text.Yuffie: Reowr!

text.Nayo: So, Yuffie, what do you think of the undercity?

text.Yuffie: Way too crowded. I can't stand it. Ugh, and the stench! How can anyone live here?

text.Sonon: Gotta agree with you about the smell, but you get used to it quick enough.

text.Nayo: And the crowds stop bothering you eventually. The place can grow on you if you give it a chance.

text.Yuffie: Uh... wait a second. Are you actually saying you like it here? I thought you hated it.

text.Nayo: Midgar isn't the enemy—Shinra is. I know Ws don't really see the distinction, but... we do.

text.Yuffie: Then what was that stuff on the news? About a reactor blowin' up and all. No way that was an accident. It had to be Avalanche.

text.Nayo: Shh!

text.Yuffie: Sorry...
Uh, what's up?

text.Nayo: Those guys there are from the splinter cell.

text.Yuffie: Splinter cell?

text.Nayo: They used to be with Avalanche, but left after a "policy dispute."

text.Biggs: Well, look who it is. Lovin' your work! So how many reactors is that now? Wait... Where's Cloud?

text.Barret: We lost him.

text.Biggs: You what?

text.Tifa: He *will* be okay though... right?

text.Barret: Well... of course he will! A little fall ain't gonna stop a hard-ass like him. He'll come swaggerin' back before long, you mark my words.

text.Tifa: Yeah... I guess he will.

text.Barret: Now can we talk about President Shithead? Spoutin' all that crap about us!? That lyin' son of a bitch! Working for Wutai!? Avalanche ain't nobody's—

text.Tifa: Barret.

text.Biggs: Speakin' of sons of bitches... I heard the Wall Market's very own Don Corneo has his stooges out lookin' for ya.

text.Tifa: Huh?

text.Barret: Is that so?
Don't got time for no low-level mobsters. We got Shinra in our sights.
Tifa. You and I both know this is far from over. Right? Might as well get some rest—while we still can.

text.Tifa: Right.
You know what? I think I am gonna look into this.

text.Biggs: Good luck out there.

text.Nayo: They're the ones who blew up the reactors.

text.Yuffie: Cool. Should we say hi?

text.Sonon: Nah, better not. After what they've done, you gotta assume Shinra's on their tail. Should keep our distance.

text.Nayo: Yeah. My thoughts exactly.

text.ACTION: While following Nayo again.

text.Nayo: The people in the splinter cell, they couldn't care less about collateral damage... long as Shinra goes down.

text.Yuffie: So, what's wrong with that? Sounds good to me.

text.Nayo: We're not out to blow Midgar up or tear it down—we want to save it from Shinra. Look around. Nine outta ten of the people living here are innocent bystanders. We can't level their home to take down one company.

text.Yuffie: Well, that company almost leveled *our* home, and they've gotta learn their lesson.

text.Nayo: Yeah, I get that.

text.Sonon: Gotta admit, I'm surprised you agreed to work with us.

text.Nayo: We're just doing what we think is necessary... to build a brighter future. That's all there is to it.

text.Sonon: In other words, you're working with us so we don't work with your old buddies—knowing what would happen if we did.

text.Nayo: Uh, can we table this for later, maybe? Not sure now's the best time for heavy topics.

text.Yuffie: Yeah, couldn't agree more. Consider it tabled!

text.ACTION: Upon talking to Nayo outside the gate.

text.Nayo: So... what exactly does this "ultimate materia" do? I'm guessing you have big plans for it?

text.Yuffie: Like after we steal it? Well, the more materia you have, the stronger you are, right? So once we've got the *ultimate* materia, we'll be stronger than anyone!

text.Nayo: I guess you will...

text.Yuffie: It's gonna be awesome!

text.Sonon: And not just that. By sneaking into Shinra HQ and snatching their most prized possession from under their noses... not only will we deal a massive blow to their morale... but we'll prove to them that while Wutai might be down, we're not out. That the gist of it, Boss?

text.Yuffie: Uh, sure is!

text.ACTION: Upon walking through the gate.

text.Corneo Lackey (2): Well hello there, hot stuff... How'd ya like a shot at the big time?
With those looks, I guarantee you're golden.
So whaddaya say? Ready to be queen of the undercity?

text.Yuffie: Hey! What am I? Chopped liver!?

text.Corneo Lackey (2): The kid doesn't need to hear this.

text.Corneo Lackey (1): Now be a good girl and cover your ears, okay?

text.Corneo Lackey (2): You'd be living and working in the most luxurious residence in all of Wall Ma—

text.Nayo: You want me to be one of Corneo's brides, is that it? Which makes you a "person of influence," right?

text.Corneo Lackey (2): Oh, I see you know your stuff. But I'd say I'm more of a "helping hand." So, why don't you help me help you?

text.Nayo: What're you doing!? Get your hands off me? Ugh!

text.Yuffie: Know any kids who can do *that*? No you don't, 'cause *I'm* an adult.
Also, I'm pretty hot stuff myself, thank you very much.

text.Corneo Lackey (2): Hah. Sure, whatever helps you sleep at night, *little girl*. But if you wanna pull up a seat at the grown-ups' table... be my guest.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Corneo Lackeys.

text.Corneo Lackey (2): You're gonna eat those words, you smuh piece of shit.

text.Corneo Lackey (4): Boss! Boss! You're not gonna believe this! The hottie of the century just fell righ t into our laps!
Goods under the hood, junk in the trunk, and down for a bumpy ride!

text.Corneo Lackey (2): Sorry, ladies, but after careful consideration, we've decided to go with a more "qualified" applicant. Let's go.

text.Yuffie: Okay...
So, who were those creeps anyway?

text.Nayo: Don Corneo's "talent scouts." They'll say and do just about anything to get unsuspecting girls back to the don's mansion.

text.Sonon: I thought it looked seedy. Guess you'd *have* to be a scumbug to build a place like that.

text.Yuffie: Oho? And how do *you* know what it looks like?

text.Sonon: I saw it while I was scouting the area.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the warehouse.

text.Nayo: Well, we're here. Now we just have to wait.

text.Yuffie: Wait for who?

text.Nayo: Not sure. We used to have someone who could make fake IDs in-house, but... they went off with the splinter cell. We've never dealt with this particular vendor before.

text.Yuffie: Hey, uh... What's up with that guy?

text.Nayo: Mako poisoning. That's what happens if you don't make the grade as a SOLDIER... or when the military's done using you.

text.Sonon: Just another one of Shinra's victims.

text.Yuffie: Them again!? Oh, Shinra's so gonna get it!

text.Counterfeiter: If it's Shinra you've got beef with... You'll be needing these. Can't access the plate without 'em. They're gonna scan for those things on the train, so make sure to keep 'em on you.

text.Nayo: Thank you.

text.Yuffie: Hey, hold up!
Try it. You'll love it.
Foreigners and their weak jaws...

text.Nayo: We should probably head back and wait for Zhijie.

text.Yuffie: Enjoy your materia while you still can, Shinra, 'cause we're comin'!

text.Sonon: Not yet, Boss. With things the way they are, we can't just go strolling up to the front gates. We're gonna need Avalanche to help us bypass security before we can do anything.

text.Yuffie: Aw! Hmph.

text.ACTION: Upon passing the robed man outside the warehouse.
Upon returning to town.

text.Yuffie: A-wha... ?

text.Nayo: Huh. What's this about?
"Change of plans. Go to the pillar. Will explain there. Hurry.—Zhijie"

text.Yuffie: "Change of plans"?

text.Nayo: Otherwise known as "the roof of the slums." Follow me, guys.

text.Sonon: Why's he need us to hurry? I don't like the sound of this.

text.Yuffie: Well, if you ask me, it's high time things picked up around here.

text.Nayo: You like living in the fast lane, huh.

text.Yuffie: Yeah, I'm not your garden-variety Wutaian. I'm a rare bloom!
Ooh, I'm *so* gonna use that!

text.Nayo: Almost there.

text.ACTION: Upon seeing Zhijie.

text.Yuffie: Hey! That's Zhijie.

text.Security Officer: Hey, I'm talking to you! Answer me! Well?

text.Zhijie: Uh... Look! A moogle!

text.Nayo: You two go after Zhijie. I'll head back and tell the others what happened.

text.Sonon: Boss. We might not be back for a while. Best to stock up before leaving.

text.ACTION: While following Zhijie to the station.

text.Yuffie: Do you have any idea what Zhijie actually did?

text.Sonon: Whatever it was, he probably did it for us.

text.Yuffie: Well, now I feel bad.
Right.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching Zhijie near the Shipping Facility Connecting Passage entrance.

text.Zhijie: Shit...

text.Security Officer (2): Tell us what you know. Now.

text.Zhijie: How 'bout later? I'm not stupid.

text.Yuffie: Oho! Talk about fast. Is he one of us?

text.Sonon: We don't have time to get into that, Boss. You can ask him yourself once he's safe. Come on.

text.Zhijie: You got grit, I'll give ya that.

text.Security Officer: Piece of shit. He's toying with us.

text.Yuffie: This some kind of factory or something? It reminds me of a place I passed through when I first got here. And if it's anything like that, it'll be crawlin' with monsters.

text.ACTION: Upon seeing Zhijie on the higher floor.

text.Zhijie: Sorry!

text.Security Officer (2): We should radio the other squads.

text.Yuffie: Aha! Been lookin' for you!

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the conveyor belt.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Yes", conveyor belt begins movement.

text.ACTION: While on board the conveyor belt.

text.Yuffie: Hey, you think Nayo's alright?

text.Sonon: She's a local, remember. She'll be fine.

text.Yuffie: You know, she's actually pretty cool. I feel bad saying this, but after what happened back home, I just kinda assumed no one in Avalanche could be trusted. Like, they were all the same as the ones I fought.
But it looks like Avalanche has changed a lot since that went down, huh?

text.ACTION: Upon exiting the conveyor belt.

text.Yuffie: C'mon.

text.Zhijie: You guys just don't know when to quit.

text.Yuffie: Man, that stings... Alright, now you've done it! When this is over, you're gettin' it good! Enjoy your freedom while you can, Zhijie!

text.ACTION: Upon running into the Security Officers again.

text.Security Officer (1): Ten-four. Be there as soon as we can. Unit 3 says they've got the suspect detained near pillar maintenance. We'd better not keep them waiting.

text.Security Officer (2): What? Pillar maintenance? How'd they let him get that far?

text.Security Officer (1): Hell if I know. Come on.

text.Yuffie: You heard the main.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Security Officers.

text.Yuffie: Well that sucked. Why did tailing people have to be so hard?

text.Sonon: You gotta learn to think before ya act, Boss. Gonna get yourself killed one of these days.

text.Yuffie: Eh. Sure, whatever. Now how do we find Zhijie?

text.Sonon: I've got an idea about that, but let's get to a vantage point first.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the Storage Depot.
Upon climbing the railing ahead.

text.Sonon: Alright, see that massive structure up ahead? That's the pillar those troopers were talking about. Assuming the maintenance facility's near there, we should probably head toward it. Sound good?

text.Yuffie: Yeah, works for me.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to cross the first set of railings.

text.Yuffie: Now how are we gonna get across. Hmmm...

text.ACTION: Upon seeing the distant switch.

text.Yuffie: Oho! Is that a switch I see?

text.ACTION: While further in the depot.

text.Sonon: Hey, about what you said earlier.

text.Yuffie: Which was... ?
Oh. That.

text.Sonon: These people are too soft. But those splinter cell guys? *They* sound like the ones we should've teamed up with. Don'tcha think?

text.Yuffie: Yeah... I guess so.

text.Sonon: I feel bad for complaining, considering all they've done for us.

text.Yuffie: I know what you mean, though... They're all just really good people, huh.

text.Sonon: And that's the problem. Midgar doesn't need good people. Not that we care what happens to it.

text.Yuffie: Right...

text.ACTION: Upon descending at the depot's exit.
Upon seeing the levikron.

text.Sonon: Hey, Boss... Wanna try treading a little lighter this time? No point fighting if we don't have to.

text.Yuffie: Yeah, yeah, I know... ! Gotta be quiet... Very quiet... As quiet as a mouse...

text.ACTION: While passing the levikron.

text.Yuffie: Eek!
Uh... Good morning!

text.ACTION: After defeating the levikron.

text.Yuffie: Alright, it can't be far now. Let's get our rears in gear! Big "g", little "o", go, go, go!

text.ACTION: Upon approaching the tunnel entrance to pillar maintenance.

text.Yuffie: Up ahead. Building just screams "important."

text.Sonon: Pillar maintenance. It has to be.

text.Yuffie: Bleh, why'd there have to be so many guards?

text.Sonon: I think you know exactly why. Gotta say, they might call this place a maintenance facility... but it looks more like an arms factory to me. Let's keep it tight, Boss. We can't afford any more mistakes. Zhijie's life depends on it.

text.Yuffie: Understood.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the staircase at the end.

text.Security Officer (1): Now spill it! Who gave you that information!?

text.Zhijie: Oh, his name was something like... Heidegger?
Alright, alright, I'll tell you. It was Rufus.
... Or was it Hojo? (chuckles)

text.Yuffie: Huh. Nice goin', Zhijie.
Born ready!

text.Sonon: Great. I'll draw their attention. You grab our guy.

text.Yuffie: A diversion, huh? I like it. But don't forget: *I'm* the leading lady.
Hey, you! Evildoers! Over here!
That's exactly what I was hoping you'd ask!
And... action!
Some know me as a beguiling ninja! Others as the world's greatest materia hunter. But! Who am I truly? Well, excited onlookers, wonder no more!
Before you stands a rare bloom: the single white rose of Wutai... the one-and-only Yuffie! (coughs)

text.Security Officer (2): Never mind, it's just some kid.

text.Yuffie: Hey, who're you callin' a kid!? (stumbles)
Uh... guh... uhk...

text.Security Officer (2): Wutaians? Got eyes on hostiles. Requesting backup.

text.Yuffie: No freakin' way!
Couldn't they have made it less gross?

text.STATUS: When the gigantipede first leaves.

text.Yuffie: Oho... Running away, are we?
Or maybe it's doing one of those... "tactical retreats"?

text.STATUS: When the gigantipede uses Drone Deployment.

text.Yuffie: It's spitting little critters!

text.Sonon: Drones? What does it need *them* for?

text.Yuffie: They've got lasers too! And where there's lasers...
How're we supposed to dodge those things!?

text.STATUS: When the gigantipede returns to the battlefield.

text.Yuffie: So now you've come crawling down.

text.STATUS: When the gigantipede falls to 1/3 HP.

text.Yuffie: Get wrecked!

text.Sonon: Looks like it wants to get serious.

text.Yuffie: Oh, we'll make it serious, alright—dead serious.

text.ACTION: After defeating the gigantipede.

text.Yuffie: You see that?
Yep.

text.Zhijie: Nice work! You saved my ass.

text.Yuffie: Hahaha... It was nothin'!

text.Zhijie: Well, it did earn ya these. Employee ID cards. They'll get you into the Shinra Building. And pretty much any floor—basement included. That's where Advanced Weaponry's got their lab set up... and where they conduct their materia research. If what you're looking for's anywhere in that place, it's gonna be there.

text.Yuffie: Got it.

text.Zhijie: You guys should probably get movin'. Word is, Shinra's got something big lined up for us. Nothing less than the destruction of Sector 7. But, whatever it is they're planning, you're better off out of it.

text.Yuffie: Right.

text.Zhijie: Imma go report to the others. Good luck up there. See ya soon.

text.Sonon: Yeah. Next time, I'm buying. I'll show you how Wutaians really party.

text.Zhijie: Deal.

text.Yuffie: Don't forget to tell the splinter cell—about Sector 7, I mean!

text.Zhijie: I won't.

text.Sonon: Well, Boss, sounds like we'd better get going. Let's head up as soon as you're ready.

text.Yuffie: Ready!

text.Undercity Resident (Intermission male): To think this is where those bastards plotted their attacks. Right under our noses.

text.Undercity Resident (Intermission female): Too bad they made it out before the military could get here. Like chickens flying the coop...

text.Sonon: Prob'ly best if we don't stick around. Let's catch the train.

text.Yuffie: 'Kay.

text.ACTION: Upon passing the Sector 7 Clinic.
Upon reaching the undercity station platform.

text.Sonon: Boss. I don't think we'll be back here anytime soon, so make sure you're ready for anything, okay?

CHOICE.Yuffie: I think we're good here. Let's roll.

text.Yuffie: What's with all these people?

text.Train Attendant: Due to the recent incident at Mako Reactor 5, only a limited number of trains are currently in service. Please note that the Sector 5 Undercity Station is closed until further notice. Thank you.

text.Nayo: Shh!

text.Polk: Splinter cell's done its best to make things hard for ya. Miss this train and there's no telling when the next'll be.

text.Billy Bob: Looks like it's now or never, guys.

text.Nayo: Sorry we couldn't give you a proper send-off. Just know that we're rooting for you, okay?

text.Yuffie: All aboard!
Oh boy...
I'll be fine... as long as I'm standing up...
Don't laugh.

text.Sonon: Melphie always got motion sick. Chocobos, boats... Sure trains would've done it too.

text.Yuffie: Who's Melphie?
Huh...

text.Sonon: She trained under your father at the same time as me. And she had such promise...

text.Yuffie: "Had"?

text.Sonon: The war was ending... But a Shinra mech went haywire near a crowd, and... she had to do something.

text.Yuffie: Yeah... They do. But I'm *not* your sister.

text.President Shinra: Are we on schedule?

text.Heidegger: The Turks are on top of it. Yes, there will be no delays.

text.Reeve: Please, Mr. President! I am asking you to reconsider—no, begging. The Sector 7 undercity is home to more than 50,000—

text.President Shinra: Director Tuesti.

text.Reeve: At least let us issue a warning, sir.

text.Heidegger: The stench of the director's cowardice fills the room yet again.

text.President Shinra: Reeve. Progress requires sacrifice. Learn to live with it.

text.Sonon: Whoa, look at all these people...

text.Yuffie: Enough to make you sick. Let's get this over with.

text.Newspaper Reporter: Excuse me! I have some questions! You work for Shinra, isn't that right? Then would you care to on rumors that Sector 7 will be the terrorists' next target? They're going to hit the reactor, aren't they?

text.Sonon: Elevators're right there. Let's catch one.

text.Yuffie: You're up, High-D!
C'mon, c'mon, c'mon!

text.Scarlet: Perfect. Just perfect. Hm?

But oh, how the mighty are fallen—Wutai... colluding with Avalanche and resorting to terrorism? Hm. I always thought the Wutaians an honorable people. They used to be, certainly... But now? Now they're nothing but blood-sucking flies, buzzing around Shinra's face.
Would you not agree? In light of recent events, I mean.

text.Yuffie: I would. A hundred percent! (chuckles)

text.Scarlet: What a lovely smile.

text.Yuffie: Open up!

text.Scarlet: I think not. Foreign visitors should take the scenic route. ... And savor the opportunity to meet our latest autonomous weapons. (laughs)

text.Sonon: Dammit! I'll never get a better chance. That was Scarlet, director of Advanced Weaponry. It was one of *her* machines that killed Melphie!

text.Yuffie: Calm down, Sonon. Calm down. Remember: we're here for a reason.
Don't be. I was ready to strangle her myself. And that's before she sent us off in the wrong direction...
Only one way to find out. Don't worry, we'll get to Materia Research eventually. Just a little longer, my precious...

text.ACTION: Upon entering the first room through the hallway.

text.Yuffie: Just look at this place. Weapons here, weapons there, weapons everywhere! They're ready for some serious action.

text.Sonon: It sounds like you are, too.

text.Yuffie: Duh. Unlike my old man, I'm not some lazy drunk. I fight for what I believe in, something *he'd* never understand.
Behind bars, you mean? Not well, if the government's got anything to say about it. Good on 'em. Jail's where he belongs.

text.Sonon: That's my master you're talking about. Mind laying off him a little?

text.Yuffie: You know what? Let's drop it. Not exactly my favorite topic. It's only gonna make me mad. More importantly...

text.Scarlet: My god, you people are deadly boring. Luckily, I know exactly how to liven things up... with a little experiment. Just don't go dying on me—that wouldn't yield very interesting results, now would it?

text.Announcement: Unit calibration complete. Initiating combat data-collection sequence.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the first group of enemies.

text.Announcement: Data collection complete. Re-calibrating for next test.
Unit calibration complete. Initiating combat data-collection sequence.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the second group of enemies.

text.Announcement: Data collection complete. Re-calibrating for next test.

text.Yuffie: What? There's more?

text.Announcement: Unit calibration complete. Initiating combat data-collection sequence.

text.ACTION: Upon defeating the third group of enemies.

text.Announcement: Data collection complete.

text.Scarlet: Credit where credit is due. You exceeded my every expectation. And for being such good sports... you may now leave.

text.Yuffie: Why did I ever think for a second she'd be nice to us!? She knows damn well it's gonna be a pain in the ass gettin' up there.

text.ACTION: Upon dropping the container to create a path up.

text.Yuffie: There we go. Honestly, how *do* I do it? Now then, Sonon, how ya feel about givin' me a boost?

text.ACTION: Upon climbing up with Sonon.
Upon dropping the ladder for Sonon.

text.Yuffie: Okay, get to climbin'!

text.ACTION: Upon exiting through the hallway.

text.Subordinate: Madam Director. The intruders are about to reach the research facility.

text.Scarlet: And we'll let them. Meanwhile, find out what it is they want.

You do have eyes, don't you? Then you can see that, while they are simpletons, they've made it further than any normal Wutaian ever could. Clearly, they are ninjas. *Teenage* ninjas. And they've come such a long way. We simply must roll out the red carpet. My trusty steed should provide a fitting welcome, I think. Keep me apprised, would you?

text.Subordinate: Ma'am. Cut system power to the research facility. Bar access to confidential data, then retrace their steps. Find out why they're here. Above all, do *not* let them out of your sight.

text.Yuffie: Oh, materia, where are you?

text.ACTION: Upon entering the first room in the hallway.

text.Yuffie: Hm? Is that materia I smell?

text.Shock Trooper: End of the line, Wutai scum!

text.ACTION: After defeating both troopers.

text.Yuffie: This their idea of mood lighting? 'Cause it's bad.

text.Sonon: Might be the power. That thing's off too.

text.ACTION: Upon passing a materia capsule.

text.Yuffie: Talk about hitting the jackpot! This must be where they make their materia!

text.Sonon: Maybe—but they're not what we came for. Let's keep movin', Boss.

text.Yuffie: Totally. After I grab a few souvenirs.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the level one power grid terminal.

text.Announcement: Level one power grid: online. Initiating mako energy saturation. Deploying security grate.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the security grate.

text.Yuffie: Wait, is that a security grate or a *ladder*? Thanks, Shinra!

text.ACTION: Upon climbing to the higher floor.

text.Yuffie: Huh, that's weird... Not even a whiff of materia up here... But then there's nowhere else to go.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the level two power grid terminal.

text.Announcement: Level two power grid: online. Initiating mako energy saturation. Deploying security grate.

text.Yuffie: Not long now, my precious. You'll be safe in my arms soon!

text.Announcement: Entry lock released.

text.Yuffie: And what do we have here? A secret materia vault perhaps?

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator from floor B14.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "B15 - Production", travel to lower floor.
Upon selecting "Stay on This Floor", conversation ends.

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator from floor B15.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "B14 - Maintenance", travel to higher floor.
Upon selecting "Stay on This Floor", conversation ends.

text.ACTION: Upon climbing to the higher floor.

text.Yuffie: Uh... uh-oh.
Aw, c'mon! How could we have gotten so lost!?

text.Sonon: Easy now. Focus. Ah, I know. Spare a Da-chao bean?

text.Yuffie: Sure...
You ate it!
Man, I'm glad you're here!
It really helps—knowing I'm not alone in all this.
Aha! Think I found our way across!

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the Box Buster terminal.

text.Announcement: Employee identity confirmed. Access granted. Occupancy limited to one subject. Proceed to gate to begin training exercise.

text.Yuffie: Training? Really? Just give us what we came for already!

text.Sonon: Might still be worth a shot. Could be something in it for us. Just... be careful, 'kay?

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal a subsequent time.

text.Announcement: Access granted. Occupancy limited to one subject. Proceed to gate to begin training exercise.

text.ACTION: Upon interacting with the terminal after unlocking SOLDIER training.

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "Basic Training", same options as before to begin basic training mode.

text.ACTION: Upon entering the materia development room.

text.Yuffie: Sonon! Check *that* out!

text.Sonon: It does look more important than the others...

text.Yuffie: This has to be it! Oh, sweet baby, come to mama!
Can't see squat. Light. Light! I need more light!

text.ACTION: Upon activating the level three power grid.

text.Announcement: Level three power grid: online. Initiating mako energy saturation. Deploying security grate.

text.Yuffie: Now we're cookin'! I'm comin', materia, ready or not!

text.ACTION: Upon using the elevator from floor B13. Lower floors then include the option "B13 - Development".

CHOICE.STATUS: Upon selecting "B14 - Maintenance", travel to lower floor.
Upon selecting "B15 - Production", travel to lower floor.
Upon selecting "Stay on This Floor", conversation ends.

text.ACTION: Upon returning to the materia capsule.

text.Yuffie: Man... Another stupid dud!
Wha—? Uh-oh...
Quit holdin' out on us, Shinra! We're here for materia, not these dorks!

text.ACTION: After defeating both troopers.

text.Scarlet: So—have you found out what they want yet?

text.Subordinate: We think so. We can't say for certain, as their behavior is... erratic. But they appear to be searching for materia.

text.Scarlet: Excuse me? You mean to say that these savages have gone to all this trouble for *materia*?

text.Subordinate: So far as we can tell, yes.

text.Scarlet: How very dull. Be that as it may, I suppose I should talk to them.

text.Subordinate: Ma'am!

text.Scarlet: Enjoying yourselves, I trust?
Awed by a simple hologram? How precious. But I know just what you need—to loosen up a little. After such a long journey... you must be so tense!
Luckily, I have toys for that—all far more entertaining than this.
Oh dear. Is that any way to talk to your host? Really though, as guests, it's more about what you want. And I think you'll find it just up ahead. Hurry now. Don't keep me waiting.

text.Yuffie: That we're walking into a trap, I guess. But it's nothing we can't handle, right?

text.ACTION: Upon entering the testing grounds.

text.Scarlet: Welcome to our state-of-the-art weapons testing facility. This is where we push every piece of ordnance to its limits... and beyond. Such tests are an invaluable part of the development process. Go on, see where the magic happens.

text.ACTION: Before a new test.

text.Research Program: Select ordnance type to deploy for this trial.

text.ACTION: Upon selecting a type.

text.Research Program: Selection confirmed. Initiating ordnance deployment procedure.
Subjects approaching test site. Test will begin momentarily.

text.STATUS: When a battle begins in the testing grounds.

text.ACTION: After defeating a group of enemies in the testing grounds.
After defeating Deathwheel.

text.Scarlet: My, my, how impressive! Seems I may have underestimated how resilient you ninjas can be.

text.Yuffie: "May have"!? How 'bout "did", you old hag!?

text.Scarlet: You Wutaians, so fesity. But let's see how you fare against what I have in store for you next. It's quite the treat, I assure you. Only the best for our honored guests, after all. Whenever you're ready.

text.ACTION: Upon reaching the room at the end of the corridor.

text.Yuffie: Where are we?
That thing... can't be operational, can it?

text.Scarlet: At long last, Wutai's finest deign to join us. You've performed admirably.

text.Yuffie: Quit acting all superior. We both know you're afraid of us!

text.Scarlet: Is that so? Well, maybe I am!

text.Yuffie: You should know there's more where we came from—lots more! And you'll never see 'em comin'! Just imagine a whole clan of ninjas landing on your doorstep!

text.Scarlet: Oh my! We must do something right away!

text.Yuffie: Well, you can't!

text.Scarlet: Don't say that. Won't you at least give us a chance?

text.Yuffie: What the—

text.Scarlet: Allow me to present... the latest innovation in Shinra battle armor... Designed by yours truly. This'll be a memory to cherish for the rest of your lives. All thirty seconds of them.

text.Yuffie: Oh look, we're surrounded!

text.Sonon: But not for much longer, eh, Boss?

text.Yuffie: Right on! They're as good as scrap!

text.STATUS: When Scarlet uses Directive: Deploy.

text.Scarlet: Rather rude to ignore your playmates, is it not?

text.Yuffie: Hey, no fair!

text.STATUS: When the Crimson Mare's HP reduces to 2/3.

text.Yuffie: Wha—Come back!

text.Scarlet: Oh, I will, my dear. But I rather suspect you'll wish that I hadn't.

text.Yuffie: So what! Just smash it up!

text.STATUS: When the Crimson Mare's HP reduces to 1/3.

text.Scarlet: A moment, if you please.

text.Yuffie: Hey! Don't you know that's cheating!?

text.Scarlet: Pardon the wait.

text.Yuffie: More? How many of those things you got?

text.ACTION: After defeating the Crimson Mare.

text.Scarlet: Useless!
Not nearly mobile enough. Should've known those actuators weren't up to the task. Time for an overhaul.

text.Yuffie: Hellooo!

text.Scarlet: Hm?

text.Yuffie: My, my, my, how the tables have turned...

text.Scarlet: Proud of yourself, little savage?

text.Nero: Weiss? This is a surprise. To what do I owe the pleasure?

text.Weiss: These idiots want to "digitally replicate" me, so I'm indulging them.

text.Nero: When will Shinra learn? There is no replicating *you*. They ought to know better.
I am. It has been too long since my last hunt.

text.Scarlet: Is this how it's done in Wutai? You just howl until you get what you want?

text.Yuffie: That's enough, Sonon. I got this. Alright, lady, out with it. Tell us where you're hiding the new materia. Don't play dumb now. We know you've been cooking up something super-powerful.

text.Scarlet: Well, well... Wutai must have some highly skilled intelligence operatives. That... or we have a mole in our midst.

text.Yuffie: What was... ?
Alright, but make it quick.

text.Scarlet: You *are* correct that we're in the process of creating an exquisite new materia. However, it is far from complete.

text.Yuffie: Yeah, right. You must think I'm stupid.

text.Scarlet: Would I lie to you? Regrettable though it is, other plans have been deemed a higher priority.

text.Yuffie: What other plans?

text.Scarlet: Well... just between you and me... My colleagues and I... are going to drop Plate Number 7 on the slums. And then we're going to blame it on Avalanche and Wutai.

text.Yuffie: I don't get it. You're gonna drop a plate? And?
What the—!?

text.Scarlet: Oh dear. I think your friend might've run into trouble. Aren't you going to save him?
Quickly now! (laughs)

text.ACTION: Upon meeting up with Sonon.

text.Yuffie: Who're these assholes!?
I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but...
There is no ultimate materia—not yet. She said it's still in the works. And she mentioned somethin' else. They're gonna drop Plate Number 7.
They're gonna drop Plate Number 7 on the slums... apparently.

text.Sonon: But that's the whole upper part of the sector!

text.Yuffie: Wait! So Zhijie was being serious!?
Let's go!

text.Sonon: Right behind ya! We may not have that materia, but we do have good intel.

text.ACTION: After defeating the Deepground SOLDIERs.

text.Yuffie: No way I'm givin' up!

text.Sonon: That's the spirit. Let 'em have it!

text.Yuffie: I'm not goin' down till I've been to the Happy Turtle!
Is it over?
Ow... Man, I so don't wanna go back out there... but I don't think we've got a choice.

text.ACTION: Upon attempting to leave the Combat Simulator Prototype.

text.Yuffie: Work, you stupid...
No good. Door won't budge.

text.Scarlet: I want them... to suffer.
The rest, I leave to you.

text.Combat Simulator: Pain Sensation Level set to: maximum.

text.Yuffie: What was that?

text.Sonon: They figure we need a challenge. Meaning we're in for a world of hurt.

text.Yuffie: No fair!

text.ACTION: After defeating the first group of enemies.

text.Combat Simulator: Pain Sensation: Max. Deploying additional combatants.

text.Yuffie: Where are these freaks even coming from!? 'Cause I'd really like 'em to stop!

text.ACTION: After defeating the second group of enemies.

text.Combat Simulator: Pain Sensation: Max. Deploying additional combatants.

text.Yuffie: Joke's on you, Shinra, if you think we're dying in this ugly box!

text.ACTION: After defeating the third group of enemies.

text.Combat Simulator: Pain Sensation: Max. Deploying additional combatants.

text.Yuffie: Okay, this is gettin' old!

text.Sonon: There's gotta be a projection mechanism around here somewhere. If we can just find it...

text.Yuffie: What the—!? Why can't I hit it!?

text.Sonon: Cause that tentacled freak won't let you. We're gonna have to tough this one out.

text.ACTION: After defeating Diabolic Creation a first time.

text.Sonon: Boss, the projector! While it's down!

text.Yuffie: Leave it to me!

text.ACTION: After defeating the projector.

text.Yuffie: Now can we *please* get outta here already?

text.ACTION: Upon leaving the Combat Simulator Prototype.
Upon reaching Nero.

text.Researcher (1): Subjects on site. It's time. Initiate the Tsviet field test.

text.Yuffie: What are you doing? Aren't you all on the same team?

text.Nero: "Team"? Fool. There are no "teams" in Deepground.

text.Yuffie: Deep... ground?

text.Nero: The place where my brother and I like to play.

text.Yuffie: Cool. Now, mind moving aside?
Well, can't blame a girl for trying.

text.Nero: Now... let the games begin.

text.Yuffie: What's with this company? They have a "freaks only" policy?

text.ACTION: Sometimes while fighting Nero.

text.Nero: Do I frighten you?

text.STATUS: When Nero grabs Sonon with Binding Talons.

text.Nero: You cannot run from me.

text.STATUS: When Nero grabs Yuffie with Binding Talons.

text.Nero: I have you now.

text.Sonon: Sonon, help! Get this creep off'a me!

text.STATUS: When Nero's HP is reduced to 3/4.

text.Researcher (1): Abnormal readings detected. The control program's been compromised!

text.Yuffie: You're dead!

text.Nero: How dare you? How *dare* you stand in my way?
Now then... where were we?

text.Yuffie: Dunno what this crap is, but it's definitely not good!

text.Nero: Surrender to the darkness. Embrace it.

text.ACTION: Sometimes when attacking Nero during the second phase.

text.Yuffie: Uhn heh... ! Urk... !

text.Nero: All your suffering will soon be at an end.

text.ACTION: Sometimes when Nero uses Soul Erosion.

text.Nero: All your suffering will soon be at an end.

text.STATUS: When Nero first uses Chaotic Pulsars.

text.Nero: Oh, Weiss. This is it. This is it!

text.Yuffie: No darkness! Get it away from me! Get it away!

text.STATUS: When Nero first uses Dark Torrent.

text.Yuffie: Ew... I don't want that stuff anywhere near me!

text.Sonon: Stay focused. We'll get through this.

text.STATUS: When Nero falls to half HP.

text.Nero: It hurts, Brother. It hurts... so much... (screams)

text.Yuffie: This is bad!
No!

text.Nero: This is where you die.

text.Yuffie: Gross! It's everywhere!

text.Sonon: Let's end this before it swallows us too.

text.ACTION: Sometimes when Nero uses Dark Matter.

text.Nero: It's time I brought this to a close.
Behold the true beauty of darkness!

text.ACTION: Sometimes when Sonon is hit by Dark Matter.

text.Nero: Yes, savor this pain.

text.ACTION: Sometimes when Sonon is knocked back.

text.Yuffie: Just stand back. Your boss has got ya covered!

text.Nero: Come closer. Allow me to hasten the inevitable.

text.Yuffie: Yeah, no. I don't think so.

text.ACTION: After defeating Nero.

text.Nero: Yes, yes! I must know more of this feeling! Of pain! Of death!

text.Yuffie: Don't gotta tell me twice!
Did we?
Awesome... (sighs)

text.Sonon: Don't wanna spoil the moment, but... we should prob'ly get going.

text.Yuffie: But I'm so tired...
You win. Sheesh.
Aha!
Hey, whaddaya think you're—
Sonon?
No, I—
But...
Sonon... ?

text.Sonon: Yuffie... . You gotta keep going... for *us*.

text.Yuffie: No... Stop it...
Sonon!?
You asshole! I'm not a kid! I'm not your sister!
This is just wrong... (screams)
Don't think I can do this alone.
The Amazing Yuffie wants *you*! Join her team and the sky's the limit!

text.Tifa: Hey, Barret. We really walking the whole way?

text.Barret: Yup.

text.Tifa: Kalm's still pretty far, though, isn't it?

text.Barret: 'Nother full day, give or take.

text.Aerith: Question... When my mom says, "a full day," she means from the time you get up in the morning till the time you go to bed... but for me, it means from the time you get up in the morning all the way through till the time you get up the *next* morning. So, which is it for you?

text.Barret: Gotta go with Elmyra on that one.

text.Aerith: Phew, that's a relief!

text.Tifa: Is it, though?

text.Barret: Cloud. Bet you've had to hoof it from sunup to sundown tons of times. This is all just same old, same old, right?

text.Cloud: That's right. But even so, we're all gonna need to stop and rest. Especially you.

text.Barret: Yeah, yeah, I know... Anyway, marchin' into the unknown ain't easy, but don't worry, 'cause I'm here to lead the way!

text.Aerith: That's comforting!

text.Barret: Of course it is! (laughs)
Alright, everyone—let's stop here for a minute. Leader's orders! Now breathe in that fresh air!
Actally, scratch that. Let's, uh... save it for later. When we're not so close to Midgar.

text.Tifa: Guess this is good-bye, City of Mako.

text.Aerith: Like this?

text.Tifa: Yup. Just like that.

text.Aerith: Cool.

text.Tifa: Hm? No way! A car!

text.Barret: Hey! Stop!
What is it with these damn birds!?

text.Tifa: Uh, sorry 'bout that.

text.Aerith: Look at that...
Where's a roof when you need one?
Should be, but... Weird... My stomach's in knots...

text.Barret: That's its way of telling you it's hungry. Let's move.
